declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.pairIso_torsor
declarations.doc:
Once an isomorphism of pairs has been chosen, every other isomorphism is uniquely its scalar
translate by a global `n`th root of unity.
declarations.statement:
public theorem pairIso_torsor (S : Scheme.{u}) (n : ℕ)
    (P Q : TrivializedPower S n) (φ : PairIso P Q) :
    ∀ ψ : PairIso P Q, ∃! a :
      (AlgebraicGeometry.rootsOfUnitySections n).obj (Opposite.op S),
      IsScalarTranslate a φ ψ
declarations.comment: every pair isomorphism is uniquely a scalar translate

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.scalarTranslate_pairIso
declarations.doc:
Every global `n`th root of unity acts on a chosen isomorphism of pairs,
giving a unique isomorphism whose sheaf map is its specified scalar translate.
declarations.statement:
public theorem scalarTranslate_pairIso (S : Scheme.{u}) (n : ℕ)
    (P Q : TrivializedPower S n) (φ : PairIso P Q) :
    ∀ a : (AlgebraicGeometry.rootsOfUnitySections n).obj (Opposite.op S),
      ∃! ψ : PairIso P Q, IsScalarTranslate a φ ψ
declarations.comment: every global root gives a unique pair isomorphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.pairIso_unitPair_iff
declarations.doc:
Two pairs whose invertible sheaf is the structure sheaf are isomorphic exactly when their
trivializing units differ by the `n`th power of a global unit; so the isomorphism classes of such
pairs are the global units modulo `n`th powers.
declarations.statement:
public theorem pairIso_unitPair_iff (S : Scheme.{u}) (n : ℕ)
    (f g : (Scheme.Γ.obj (Opposite.op S))ˣ) :
    Nonempty (PairIso (unitPair S n f) (unitPair S n g)) ↔
      ∃ u : (Scheme.Γ.obj (Opposite.op S))ˣ, f = u ^ n * g
declarations.comment: the pair side of the identification for pairs whose invertible sheaf is the structure sheaf: two such pairs are isomorphic exactly when their trivializing units agree modulo nth powers of global units, so the isomorphism classes of such pairs are the global units modulo nth powers; the cohomological side is AlgebraicGeometry.pairIso_iff_kummerBoundary_eq

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_trivializedPower_sheaf_iff
declarations.doc:
An invertible sheaf carries a trivialization of its `n`th tensor power exactly when that
power is trivial; so the invertible sheaves of pairs are exactly those whose class in the Picard
group is `n`-torsion.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_trivializedPower_sheaf_iff (S : Scheme.{u}) (n : ℕ)
    (L : SheafOfModules.{u} (ringSheaf S))
    (hL : IsInvertible S.presheaf (ringSheafCond S) L) :
    (∃ P : TrivializedPower S n, P.sheaf = L) ↔
      Nonempty (tensorPower S.presheaf (ringSheafCond S) L (n : ℤ) ≅
        SheafOfModules.unit (ringSheaf S))
declarations.comment: the invertible sheaves occurring in a pair are exactly those whose nth tensor power is trivial, with no restriction to the structure sheaf

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.pairIso_iff_trivializationRatio_eq_pow
declarations.doc:
Two pairs with the same, possibly nontrivial, invertible sheaf are isomorphic exactly when
their trivializations differ by the `n`th power of a global unit.
declarations.statement:
public theorem pairIso_iff_trivializationRatio_eq_pow (S : Scheme.{u}) (n : ℕ)
    (L : SheafOfModules.{u} (ringSheaf S))
    [hL : IsInvertible S.presheaf (ringSheafCond S) L]
    (α β : tensorPower S.presheaf (ringSheafCond S) L (n : ℤ) ≅
      SheafOfModules.unit (ringSheaf S)) :
    Nonempty (PairIso ⟨L, hL, α⟩ ⟨L, hL, β⟩) ↔
      ∃ u : (Scheme.Γ.obj (Opposite.op S))ˣ, trivializationRatio S n α β = u ^ n
declarations.comment: the pair side for an arbitrary, possibly nontrivial, invertible sheaf: two pairs with the same invertible sheaf are isomorphic exactly when their trivializations differ by the nth power of a global unit, so the pairs with a given invertible sheaf form one coset of the nth powers in the global units

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_pairIso_unitPair
declarations.doc:
A pair whose invertible sheaf is isomorphic to the structure sheaf — not only equal to it —
is isomorphic to the pair given by the structure sheaf and a global unit.
declarations.comment: every pair whose invertible sheaf is isomorphic to the structure sheaf is isomorphic to a unit pair, so the trivial-invertible-sheaf case is not a restriction to the literal structure sheaf

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.basePairCohomologyClassHom_bijective
declarations.statement:
public theorem basePairCohomologyClassHom_bijective
    (hroot : LocalRoots (BigFppfOver.baseRingedSite B S hS τ) n)
    (hSE : (kummerSequence (BigFppfOver.baseOverTopology B S hS τ)
      (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS) (unitsPresheaf_isSheaf_base B S hS τ) n).ShortExact)
    (hT : IsTerminal (C := BigFppfOver B S hS) (Over.mk (𝟙 (B.obj hS)))) :
    Function.Bijective (basePairCohomologyClassHom B S hS τ n hroot)
declarations.comment: the comparison homomorphism from the isomorphism classes of pairs to H^1 of the roots of unity is bijective. The group isomorphism the tag asserts is read off from this in AlgebraicGeometry.basePairClassesAddEquivH1, and the three statements of the tag -- etale for n invertible on the base, fppf and syntomic for n positive -- in the three declarations after it

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.pairClassesAddEquivH1Etale
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 040Q, the étale statement.**  For `n` invertible on `S`,
`H¹_étale(S, μ_n)` is the group of pairs `(ℒ, α)` — an invertible `𝒪_S`-module with a
trivialization of its `n`-th tensor power — up to isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def pairClassesAddEquivH1Etale
    (hn : IsUnit (n : Scheme.Γ.obj (op S))) :
    PairClasses S n ≃+
      Sheaf.H (rootsOfUnitySheaf (BigFppfOver.baseOverTopology B S hS .etale)
        (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS) (unitsPresheaf_isSheaf_base B S hS .etale) n) 1
declarations.comment: the etale statement: for n invertible on S, H^1_etale(S, mu_n) is the group of pairs (L, alpha) up to isomorphism, as an isomorphism of abelian groups

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.pairClassesAddEquivH1Fppf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 040Q, the fppf statement.**  For every positive `n`, with no
invertibility hypothesis, `H¹_fppf(S, μ_n)` is the group of pairs `(ℒ, α)` up to
isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def pairClassesAddEquivH1Fppf (hn : 0 < n) :
    PairClasses S n ≃+
      Sheaf.H (rootsOfUnitySheaf (BigFppfOver.baseOverTopology B S hS .fppf)
        (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS) (unitsPresheaf_isSheaf_base B S hS .fppf) n) 1
declarations.comment: the fppf statement: for every positive n, with no invertibility hypothesis, H^1_fppf(S, mu_n) is the group of pairs (L, alpha) up to isomorphism, as an isomorphism of abelian groups

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.pairClassesAddEquivH1Syntomic
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 040Q, the syntomic statement.**  The same with fppf replaced by
syntomic.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def pairClassesAddEquivH1Syntomic (hn : 0 < n) :
    PairClasses S n ≃+
      Sheaf.H (rootsOfUnitySheaf (BigFppfOver.baseOverTopology B S hS .syntomic)
        (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS) (unitsPresheaf_isSheaf_base B S hS .syntomic) n) 1
declarations.comment: the syntomic statement: for every positive n, with no invertibility hypothesis, H^1_syntomic(S, mu_n) is the group of pairs (L, alpha) up to isomorphism, as an isomorphism of abelian groups

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.basePairCohomologyClass_picard
declarations.doc:
**The comparison map of Tag 040Q is compatible with the Picard group**, read on the class of
a pair: the image of the class of a pair `(ℒ, α)` in `H¹((Sch/S)_τ, μ_n)` is carried by
`H¹(μ_n) ⟶ H¹(𝐆_m) = Pic(S)` to the Picard class of `ℒ`.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.trivializationTorsor_firstCohomologyMap` followed by
`Stacks.Picard.AllTopologies.baseH1UnitsAddEquivSchemePicardGroup_symm_classOf`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem basePairCohomologyClass_picard
    (hroot : LocalRoots (BigFppfOver.baseRingedSite B S hS τ) n) (P : TrivializedPower S n) :
    Stacks.Picard.AllTopologies.baseH1UnitsAddEquivSchemePicardGroup B S hS τ
        (Sheaf.H.map (kernel.ι (powerSheaf (BigFppfOver.baseOverTopology B S hS τ)
            (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS) (unitsPresheaf_isSheaf_base B S hS τ) n)) 1
          (basePairCohomologyClassHom B S hS τ n hroot (pairClass P))) =
      pairSheafClassHom S n (pairClass P)
declarations.comment: the comparison map from the isomorphism classes of pairs to H^1 of the roots of unity is compatible with the right-hand end of the two extensions: composed with the map to H^1 of the multiplicative group and the identification of that with the Picard group (Tag 03P8) it is the Picard class of the invertible sheaf of the pair. Injectivity and surjectivity of the comparison are not proved here, nor is the compatibility with the left-hand end

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.baseAssociatedModule_map_scalarEnd
declarations.doc:
**The associated-module functor carries multiplication by a global function of `S` to
multiplication by that same global function**, read over the terminal object `S / S` of the big
`τ`-site.

The functor is the pullback along the morphism of ringed sites `((Sch/S)_τ, 𝒪) → (S_Zar, 𝒪_S)`,
for which there is no formula on morphisms; the identity is obtained from the corresponding one
for the *pushforward*, `Stacks.SheafOfModules.map_globalSectionToEnd`, through
`CategoryTheory.Adjunction.map_endOfId`.  Its hypothesis is the square saying that the structure
map of the morphism of sites carries the restrictions of `s` from the top open of `S` to the
restrictions of `s` from `S / S`, and over the top open that map is the identification
`Γ(S, ⊤) = Γ(⊤, ⊤)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem baseAssociatedModule_map_scalarEnd
    (hT : IsTerminal (C := BigFppfOver B S hS) (Over.mk (𝟙 (B.obj hS))))
    (s : Scheme.Γ.obj (op S)) (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (ringSheaf S)) :
    (BigFppfOver.baseAssociatedModule B S hS τ).map (scalarEnd S s M) =
      Stacks.Cohomology.Torsors.Generators.scalarEndOfTerminal
        (BigFppfOver.baseRingedSite B S hS τ) hT s
        ((BigFppfOver.baseAssociatedModule B S hS τ).obj M)
declarations.comment: the associated-module functor of Descent, Proposition 03DX carries multiplication by a global function of the base to multiplication by that same function over the terminal object of the big tau-site; this is one ingredient of the compatibility of the comparison map with the left-hand end of the two extensions, and neither that compatibility nor any other part of the tag is proved here

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_unitPairTrivialization_eq_basePairTriv
declarations.doc:
**The transported trivialization of the unit pair is the site-level trivialization of the
unit pair, after one fixed twist.**  There is a global unit `c` of `S`, independent of `f`, with
`AlgebraicGeometry.basePairTriv` at the unit pair of `f` the comparison of the two structure
sheaves followed by
`Stacks.Cohomology.Torsors.Generators.unitPairTrivialization` at `c * f`.

This is the identification the compatibility of the comparison map of Tag 040Q with the left-hand
end of the two extensions was missing.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_unitPairTrivialization_eq_basePairTriv
    (hT : IsTerminal (C := BigFppfOver B S hS) (Over.mk (𝟙 (B.obj hS)))) :
    ∃ c : (Scheme.Γ.obj (op S))ˣ, ∀ f : (Scheme.Γ.obj (op S))ˣ,
      powerMap (BigFppfOver.baseRingedSite B S hS τ)
            (BigFppfOver.baseAssociatedModulePicardUnitIso B S hS τ) n ≪≫
          unitPairTrivialization (BigFppfOver.baseRingedSite B S hS τ) hT n (c * f) =
        basePairTriv B S hS τ n (unitPair S n f)
declarations.comment: the transported trivialization of the unit pair of a global unit f is the site-level trivialization of the unit pair at c * f, for one global unit c independent of f; this is the identification the compatibility of the comparison map with the left-hand end of the two extensions needs, and that compatibility is proved below, not here

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_kummerBoundary_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 040Q, the image of the pairs whose invertible sheaf is trivial.** A
class in `H¹(S, μ_n)` is the class of such a pair — equivalently, a Kummer boundary — exactly
when its image in `H¹(S, 𝐆_m)` vanishes. So the injection of
`AlgebraicGeometry.pairIso_iff_kummerBoundary_eq` has for its image precisely the kernel of
`H¹(S, μ_n) ⟶ H¹(S, 𝐆_m)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_kummerBoundary_iff (x : Sheaf.H (kummerSequence J F hF n).X₁ 1) :
    (∃ a : (Scheme.Γ.obj (op (F.obj T)))ˣ, kummerBoundary J F hF n hS hT a = x) ↔
      Sheaf.H.map (kummerSequence J F hF n).f 1 x = 0
declarations.comment: the image of the pairs with trivial invertible sheaf in H^1 of the roots of unity is exactly the kernel of the map to H^1 of the multiplicative group; so the injection of pairIso_iff_kummerBoundary_eq misses exactly the classes with nonzero image there

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_kummerFirstCohomologyMap_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 040Q, the image of `H¹(S, μ_n)` in `H¹(S, 𝐆_m)`.** It is exactly the
`n`-torsion subgroup, since the second map of the Kummer sequence induces multiplication by `n`
on first cohomology.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_kummerFirstCohomologyMap_iff (y : Sheaf.H (kummerSequence J F hF n).X₂ 1) :
    (∃ x : Sheaf.H (kummerSequence J F hF n).X₁ 1,
        Sheaf.H.map (kummerSequence J F hF n).f 1 x = y) ↔ n • y = 0
declarations.comment: the image of H^1 of the roots of unity in H^1 of the multiplicative group is exactly the n-torsion; with the kernel computed by exists_kummerBoundary_iff this presents H^1(S, mu_n) as an extension of that n-torsion by the global units modulo nth powers. What remains between this and the full statement of 040Q is the abelian-group structure on AlgebraicGeometry.PairClasses, for which no AddCommGroup instance exists, together with the comparison homomorphism to H^1; Tag 03P8 is NOT the gap, being proved at Picard/MultiplicativeGroupFirstCohomology.lean:206

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.forall_exists_kummerBoundary_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 040Q, the obstruction to surjectivity.** The pairs whose invertible
sheaf is trivial exhaust `H¹(S, μ_n)` exactly when `H¹(S, 𝐆_m)` has no `n`-torsion. So the
classes of Tag 040Q that the trivial-invertible-sheaf part misses are measured by that torsion
group, and by Tag 03P8 it is the `n`-torsion of the Picard group.
declarations.statement:
theorem forall_exists_kummerBoundary_iff :
    (∀ x : Sheaf.H (kummerSequence J F hF n).X₁ 1,
        ∃ a : (Scheme.Γ.obj (op (F.obj T)))ˣ, kummerBoundary J F hF n hS hT a = x) ↔
      ∀ y : Sheaf.H (kummerSequence J F hF n).X₂ 1, n • y = 0 → y = 0
declarations.comment: the obstruction to surjectivity: the pairs with trivial invertible sheaf exhaust H^1 of the roots of unity exactly when H^1 of the multiplicative group has no n-torsion, so the missing classes are measured by that torsion group

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.pairIso_iff_kummerBoundary_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 040Q, for the pairs with trivial invertible sheaf.** Two pairs whose
invertible sheaf is the structure sheaf of the base are isomorphic as pairs exactly when they
have the same class in the first cohomology of the sheaf of `n`th roots of unity. Together with
`AlgebraicGeometry.kummerBoundary_mul` this is an injective homomorphism from the group of
isomorphism classes of such pairs — the global units modulo `n`th powers — into `H¹(S, μ_n)`,
and by `AlgebraicGeometry.terminalBoundary_eq_fiberTorsorClass` it carries a pair to the class
of its torsor of trivializations.
declarations.statement:
theorem pairIso_iff_kummerBoundary_eq (f g : (Scheme.Γ.obj (op (F.obj T)))ˣ) :
    Nonempty (PairIso (unitPair (F.obj T) n f) (unitPair (F.obj T) n g)) ↔
      kummerBoundary J F hF n hS hT f = kummerBoundary J F hF n hS hT g
declarations.comment: the pairs whose invertible sheaf is trivial: the canonical injective homomorphism from the global units modulo nth powers into H^1 of the roots of unity, carrying a pair to the class of its torsor of trivializations, on any site over the base having a terminal object and a short exact Kummer sequence (by 040N and 03PL: fppf, syntomic, and etale for n invertible on the base); pairs with a nontrivial invertible sheaf, and surjectivity onto H^1, are not covered

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.pairIso_iff_kummerBoundary_eq_fppf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 040Q on the big fppf site.** The hypotheses of
`AlgebraicGeometry.pairIso_iff_kummerBoundary_eq` hold on the big fppf site over `S`, with no
assumption on `n` beyond positivity: the Kummer sequence is short exact there by Tag 040N, and
`S / S` is the terminal object.
declarations.statement:
theorem pairIso_iff_kummerBoundary_eq_fppf (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains S) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    [HasSheafify (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) AddCommGrpCat.{u})]
    (f g : (Scheme.Γ.obj (op S))ˣ) :
    Nonempty (PairIso (unitPair S n f) (unitPair S n g)) ↔
      kummerBoundary (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)
          (unitsPresheaf_isSheaf_fppf B S hS) n
          (kummerSequence_shortExact_fppf B S hS n hn)
          (Over.mkIdTerminal : IsTerminal (Over.mk (𝟙 (B.obj hS)))) f =
        kummerBoundary (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)
          (unitsPresheaf_isSheaf_fppf B S hS) n
          (kummerSequence_shortExact_fppf B S hS n hn)
          (Over.mkIdTerminal : IsTerminal (Over.mk (𝟙 (B.obj hS)))) g
declarations.comment: the fppf case of the trivial-invertible-sheaf part, with the terminal object and the short exactness of the Kummer sequence discharged

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.pairIso_iff_kummerBoundary_eq_syntomic
declarations.doc: **Stacks Project, Tag 040Q on the big syntomic site.**
declarations.statement:
theorem pairIso_iff_kummerBoundary_eq_syntomic (B : BigSyntomicSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains S) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    [HasSheafify (BigSyntomicOver.topology B S hS) AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf (BigSyntomicOver.topology B S hS) AddCommGrpCat.{u})]
    (f g : (Scheme.Γ.obj (op S))ˣ) :
    Nonempty (PairIso (unitPair S n f) (unitPair S n g)) ↔
      kummerBoundary (BigSyntomicOver.topology B S hS) (BigSyntomicOver.toScheme B S hS)
          (unitsPresheaf_isSheaf_syntomic B S hS) n
          (kummerSequence_shortExact_syntomic B S hS n hn)
          (Over.mkIdTerminal : IsTerminal (Over.mk (𝟙 (B.obj S hS)))) f =
        kummerBoundary (BigSyntomicOver.topology B S hS) (BigSyntomicOver.toScheme B S hS)
          (unitsPresheaf_isSheaf_syntomic B S hS) n
          (kummerSequence_shortExact_syntomic B S hS n hn)
          (Over.mkIdTerminal : IsTerminal (Over.mk (𝟙 (B.obj S hS)))) g
declarations.comment: the syntomic case of the trivial-invertible-sheaf part, with the terminal object and the short exactness of the Kummer sequence discharged

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.pairIso_iff_kummerBoundary_eq_bigEtale
declarations.doc: **Stacks Project, Tag 040Q on the big étale site**, for `n` invertible on `S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem pairIso_iff_kummerBoundary_eq_bigEtale (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains S) (n : ℕ) (hn : IsUnit (n : Scheme.Γ.obj (op S)))
    [HasSheafify (BigEtaleOver.topology B S hS) AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf (BigEtaleOver.topology B S hS) AddCommGrpCat.{u})]
    (f g : (Scheme.Γ.obj (op S))ˣ) :
    Nonempty (PairIso (unitPair S n f) (unitPair S n g)) ↔
      kummerBoundary (BigEtaleOver.topology B S hS) (BigEtaleOver.toScheme B S hS)
          (unitsPresheaf_isSheaf_bigEtale B S hS) n
          (kummerSequence_shortExact_bigEtale B S hS n hn)
          (Over.mkIdTerminal : IsTerminal (Over.mk (𝟙 (B.obj S hS)))) f =
        kummerBoundary (BigEtaleOver.topology B S hS) (BigEtaleOver.toScheme B S hS)
          (unitsPresheaf_isSheaf_bigEtale B S hS) n
          (kummerSequence_shortExact_bigEtale B S hS n hn)
          (Over.mkIdTerminal : IsTerminal (Over.mk (𝟙 (B.obj S hS)))) g
declarations.comment: the big etale case of the trivial-invertible-sheaf part, for n invertible on the base, with the terminal object and the short exactness of the Kummer sequence discharged

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.pairIso_iff_kummerBoundary_eq_smallEtale
declarations.doc: **Stacks Project, Tag 040Q on the small étale site**, for `n` invertible on `S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem pairIso_iff_kummerBoundary_eq_smallEtale (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains S) (n : ℕ) (hn : IsUnit (n : Scheme.Γ.obj (op S)))
    [HasSheafify (SmallEtale.topology B S hS) AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS) AddCommGrpCat.{u})]
    (f g : (Scheme.Γ.obj (op S))ˣ) :
    Nonempty (PairIso (unitPair S n f) (unitPair S n g)) ↔
      kummerBoundary (SmallEtale.topology B S hS) (SmallEtale.toScheme B S hS)
          (unitsPresheaf_isSheaf_smallEtale B S hS) n
          (kummerSequence_shortExact_smallEtale B S hS n hn)
          (SmallEtale.finalIsTerminal B S hS) f =
        kummerBoundary (SmallEtale.topology B S hS) (SmallEtale.toScheme B S hS)
          (unitsPresheaf_isSheaf_smallEtale B S hS) n
          (kummerSequence_shortExact_smallEtale B S hS n hn)
          (SmallEtale.finalIsTerminal B S hS) g
declarations.comment: the small etale case of the trivial-invertible-sheaf part, for n invertible on the base, with the terminal object and the short exactness of the Kummer sequence discharged

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.instAddCommGroupPairClasses
declarations.doc:
**The isomorphism classes of pairs form an abelian group.** The
addition is the tensor product of pairs, the zero is the structure sheaf with its canonical
trivialization, and the negation is the inverse pair.
declarations.statement:
instance instAddCommGroupPairClasses (S : Scheme.{u}) (n : ℕ) :
    AddCommGroup (PairClasses S n)
declarations.comment: the abelian-group structure on the isomorphism classes of pairs (L, alpha), with addition the tensor product of pairs, zero the structure sheaf with its canonical trivialization, and negation the inverse pair; this is the group the tag identifies with H^1 of the roots of unity, but the identification itself is not stated here

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.basePairTriv_tensor
declarations.doc:
**The transported trivialization of a tensor product of pairs is the tensor product of the
two transported trivializations**, on the big `τ`-site of `S`.

This is part (4) of the second construction of Tag 040Q: it is
`Stacks.SheafOfModules.TensorPowerTransport.transportTriv_tensor` at the associated-module functor
of Descent, Proposition 03DX, whose four coherences are
`AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.baseAssociatedModuleTensorIso'_natural`,
`_associator`, `_braiding` and `_rightUnitor`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem basePairTriv_tensor (P Q : TrivializedPower S n) :
    letI := basePairSheaf_isInvertible B S hS τ n P
    letI := basePairSheaf_isInvertible B S hS τ n Q
    letI : IsInvertible (BigFppfOver.baseRingedSite B S hS τ).O.obj
        (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (BigFppfOver.baseRingedSite B S hS τ).O).2
        ((BigFppfOver.baseAssociatedModule B S hS τ).obj
          ((((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor
            ⟨S.presheaf, Presheaf.isSheaf_of_isSheaf_comp _ S.presheaf
              (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat) (ringSheafCond S)⟩).obj P.sheaf).obj Q.sheaf))) :=
      basePairSheaf_isInvertible B S hS τ n (tensorPair S n P Q)
    letI : IsInvertible (BigFppfOver.baseRingedSite B S hS τ).O.obj
        (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (BigFppfOver.baseRingedSite B S hS τ).O).2
        (tensorSheafOfModules (BigFppfOver.baseRingedSite B S hS τ)
          ((BigFppfOver.baseAssociatedModule B S hS τ).obj P.sheaf)
          ((BigFppfOver.baseAssociatedModule B S hS τ).obj Q.sheaf)) :=
      Stacks.SheafOfModules.isInvertible_tensorSheaf
        (BigFppfOver.baseRingedSite B S hS τ).O.obj
        (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (BigFppfOver.baseRingedSite B S hS τ).O).2
        (basePairSheaf B S hS τ n P) (basePairSheaf B S hS τ n Q)
    powerMap (BigFppfOver.baseRingedSite B S hS τ)
          (BigFppfOver.baseAssociatedModuleTensorIso' B S hS τ P.sheaf Q.sheaf) n ≪≫
        tensorTriv (BigFppfOver.baseRingedSite B S hS τ) (basePairSheaf B S hS τ n P)
          (basePairSheaf B S hS τ n Q) n (basePairTriv B S hS τ n P)
          (basePairTriv B S hS τ n Q) =
      basePairTriv B S hS τ n (tensorPair S n P Q)
declarations.comment: the transport to the big tau-site carries the tensor product of pairs to the tensor product of pairs

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.basePairClass_tensor
declarations.doc:
**A tensor product of pairs has the torsor of trivializations of the tensor product of the
two transported pairs.**  This is
`AlgebraicGeometry.trivializationTorsor_class_eq_of_iso'` fed the object-level tensor comparison
of the associated-module functor and `AlgebraicGeometry.basePairTriv_tensor`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem basePairClass_tensor (hroot : LocalRoots (BigFppfOver.baseRingedSite B S hS τ) n)
    (P Q : TrivializedPower S n) :
    Quotient.mk
          (torsorSetoid (rootsOfUnitySheaf (BigFppfOver.baseOverTopology B S hS τ)
            (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS) (unitsPresheaf_isSheaf_base B S hS τ) n))
          (trivializationTorsor (BigFppfOver.baseOverTopology B S hS τ)
            (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS) (BigFppfOver.baseRingedSite B S hS τ).O.property
            (unitsPresheaf_isSheaf_base B S hS τ) n
            (baseRingedSite_isLocallyRinged B S hS τ) hroot
            (basePairSheaf B S hS τ n (tensorPair S n P Q))
            (basePairSheaf_isInvertible B S hS τ n (tensorPair S n P Q))
            (basePairTriv B S hS τ n (tensorPair S n P Q))) =
      Quotient.mk
        (torsorSetoid (rootsOfUnitySheaf (BigFppfOver.baseOverTopology B S hS τ)
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS) (unitsPresheaf_isSheaf_base B S hS τ) n))
        (trivializationTorsor (BigFppfOver.baseOverTopology B S hS τ)
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS) (BigFppfOver.baseRingedSite B S hS τ).O.property
          (unitsPresheaf_isSheaf_base B S hS τ) n
          (baseRingedSite_isLocallyRinged B S hS τ) hroot
          (tensorSheafOfModules (BigFppfOver.baseRingedSite B S hS τ)
            (basePairSheaf B S hS τ n P) (basePairSheaf B S hS τ n Q))
          (Stacks.SheafOfModules.isInvertible_tensorSheaf
            (BigFppfOver.baseRingedSite B S hS τ).O.obj
            (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (BigFppfOver.baseRingedSite B S hS τ).O).2
            (basePairSheaf B S hS τ n P) (basePairSheaf B S hS τ n Q))
          (tensorTriv (BigFppfOver.baseRingedSite B S hS τ) (basePairSheaf B S hS τ n P)
            (basePairSheaf B S hS τ n Q) n (basePairTriv B S hS τ n P)
            (basePairTriv B S hS τ n Q)))
declarations.comment: the torsor of trivializations of a tensor product of pairs

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.basePairCohomologyClass_add
declarations.doc:
**The comparison map of Tag 040Q is additive**, read on classes of pairs: the class of a
tensor product of pairs is the sum of the two classes.
declarations.statement:
public theorem basePairCohomologyClass_add
    (hroot : LocalRoots (BigFppfOver.baseRingedSite B S hS τ) n) (P Q : TrivializedPower S n) :
    basePairCohomologyClass B S hS τ n hroot (pairClass P + pairClass Q) =
      basePairCohomologyClass B S hS τ n hroot (pairClass P) +
        basePairCohomologyClass B S hS τ n hroot (pairClass Q)
declarations.comment: the comparison map is additive on classes of pairs

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.basePairCohomologyClassHom
declarations.doc:
**The comparison map of Tag 040Q as a homomorphism of abelian groups**,
`PairClasses S n →+ H¹((Sch/S)_τ, μ_n)`.  The addition of the source is the tensor product of
pairs and that of the target is the addition of `Ext¹`; additivity is
`AlgebraicGeometry.basePairCohomologyClass_add`, and the vanishing at the zero class follows from
it, the two groups being groups.

This is the map `Stacks.Kummer.bijective_of_comparison` consumes.
declarations.statement:
public def basePairCohomologyClassHom
    (hroot : LocalRoots (BigFppfOver.baseRingedSite B S hS τ) n) :
    PairClasses S n →+
      Sheaf.H (rootsOfUnitySheaf (BigFppfOver.baseOverTopology B S hS τ)
        (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS) (unitsPresheaf_isSheaf_base B S hS τ) n) 1
declarations.comment: the comparison map from the isomorphism classes of pairs to H^1 of the roots of unity as a homomorphism of abelian groups; injectivity and surjectivity are not proved here

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.pairSheafClassHom_eq_zero_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 040Q, exactness in the middle of the pair side.** A class of pairs has
trivial Picard class — that is, its invertible sheaf is isomorphic to the structure sheaf —
exactly when it is the class of a pair coming from a global unit. The forward direction is
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_pairIso_unitPair`, that a pair whose invertible sheaf is merely
isomorphic to the structure sheaf is isomorphic to a unit pair.
declarations.statement:
theorem pairSheafClassHom_eq_zero_iff (S : Scheme.{u}) (n : ℕ) (x : PairClasses S n) :
    pairSheafClassHom S n x = 0 ↔
      ∃ f : Additive (Scheme.Γ.obj (op S))ˣ, unitPairHom S n f = x
declarations.comment: exactness in the middle of the pair side of the extension, as abelian groups: the kernel of the homomorphism from the isomorphism classes of pairs to the Picard group is the image of the homomorphism from the global units; neither the cohomology group nor the comparison with it occurs

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_pairSheafClassHom_eq_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 040Q, surjectivity of the pair side onto the torsion.** A Picard class
is the Picard class of a class of pairs exactly when it is `n`-torsion. This is
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_trivializedPower_classOf_iff` read through the group of isomorphism
classes of pairs.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_pairSheafClassHom_eq_iff (S : Scheme.{u}) (n : ℕ)
    (c : PicardGroup S.presheaf (ringSheafCond S)) :
    (∃ x : PairClasses S n, pairSheafClassHom S n x = c) ↔ n • c = 0
declarations.comment: the image of the homomorphism from the isomorphism classes of pairs to the Picard group is exactly the n-torsion, as abelian groups; this is the surjectivity half of the pair side of the extension, and the cohomology group does not occur

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.geometricPointFiber_initiallySmall
declarations.doc:
The neighborhoods of a geometric point in the chosen small étale site admit a
universe-`u` cofinal subcategory.
declarations.statement:
public instance geometricPointFiber_initiallySmall :
    InitiallySmall.{u} (geometricPointFiber B S hS s).Elements

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.etaleStalk
declarations.doc:
The stalk of a presheaf on the small étale site at a geometric point, as the colimit over
its étale neighborhoods.
declarations.statement:
public def etaleStalk {A : Type v} [Category.{w} A] (F : (SmallEtale B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ A)
    [HasColimit ((Functor.Elements.π (geometricPointFiber B S hS s)).op ⋙ F)] : A

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAlgebraicSpace_finiteCoproduct
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 040T, algebraicity.** A coproduct of finitely many algebraic spaces over `S` is
an algebraic space over `S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAlgebraicSpace_finiteCoproduct {I : Type v} [Finite I]
    (F : I → (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hF : ∀ i, IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS (F i))
    (G : Sheaf (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) (Type u))
    (ι : ∀ i, (⟨F i, (hF i).isSheaf⟩ :
      Sheaf (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) (Type u)) ⟶ G)
    (hG : IsColimit (Cofan.mk G ι)) : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS G.obj

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isQuasiCompactSpace_finiteCoproduct
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 040T, quasi-compactness.** A coproduct of finitely many quasi-compact algebraic
spaces over `S` is quasi-compact.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasiCompactSpace_finiteCoproduct {I : Type v} [Finite I]
    (F : I → (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hF : ∀ i, IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS (F i))
    (hqc : ∀ i, IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS (F i))
    (G : Sheaf (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) (Type u))
    (ι : ∀ i, (⟨F i, (hF i).isSheaf⟩ :
      Sheaf (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) (Type u)) ⟶ G)
    (hG : IsColimit (Cofan.mk G ι)) : IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS G.obj

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.finiteFibres_of_mono_isFinite_fieldFibre
declarations.doc:
Let `F` be an algebraic space over a scheme `S`, let `x` be a point of `|F|` and let
`φ : h_U ⟶ F` be étale. Suppose some field-valued point of `F` in the class of `x` presents it by
a monomorphism `Spec(k) ⟶ F` for which `Spec(k) ×_F U` is nonempty and finite over `Spec(k)`.
Then `x` lies in the image of `|U| → |F|` and the fibres of `|U| → |F|` and of `|R| → |F|` above
`x`, where `R = h_U ×_F h_U`, are both finite.
declarations.statement:
theorem finiteFibres_of_mono_isFinite_fieldFibre (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F) {x : points B S hS F} {U : BigFppfOver B S hS}
    {φ : yoneda.obj U ⟶ F} (hφ : IsEtale B S hS φ)
    (h : ∃ p : FieldValuedPoint B S hS F, p.class B S hS F = x ∧
      Mono (fieldMorphism B S hS F p) ∧
      IsFinite B S hS (pullback.fst (fieldMorphism B S hS F p) φ) ∧
      Nonempty (points B S hS (pullback (fieldMorphism B S hS F p) φ))) :
    (∃ a : points B S hS (yoneda.obj U), pointsMap B S hS (yoneda.obj U) φ a = x) ∧
      (chartFibre B S hS F φ x).Finite ∧ (relationFibre B S hS F φ x).Finite

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_mono_isFinite_fieldFibre_of_finiteFibres
declarations.doc:
A point `x` of `|F|` lying in the image of `|U| → |F|` whose chart and relation fibres above
it are finite is presented by a monomorphism `Spec(k) ⟶ F` for which `Spec(k) ×_F U` is nonempty
and finite over `Spec(k)`, finiteness being the presheaf-relative form.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_mono_isFinite_fieldFibre_of_finiteFibres
    (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F)
    {x : points B S hS F} {U : BigFppfOver B S hS} {φ : yoneda.obj U ⟶ F}
    (hφ : IsEtale B S hS φ)
    (h : (∃ a : points B S hS (yoneda.obj U), pointsMap B S hS (yoneda.obj U) φ a = x) ∧
      (chartFibre B S hS F φ x).Finite ∧ (relationFibre B S hS F φ x).Finite) :
    ∃ p : FieldValuedPoint B S hS F, p.class B S hS F = x ∧
      Mono (fieldMorphism B S hS F p) ∧
      (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
        (@_root_.AlgebraicGeometry.IsFinite.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
        (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf
        (pullback.fst (fieldMorphism B S hS F p) φ) ∧
      Nonempty (points B S hS (pullback (fieldMorphism B S hS F p) φ))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isQuasiCompactSpaceULift_of_isSurjectiveULift
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 040W**, part (1), for a value universe `max w u` independent of the universe `u` of
the schemes: if `f : F ⟶ G` is a surjective morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` and `F` is
quasi-compact, then `G` is quasi-compact. The point space of `G` is the image of the
quasi-compact point space of `F` under a continuous surjection.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasiCompactSpaceULift_of_isSurjectiveULift
    {F G : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (max w u)}
    (hF : IsAlgebraicSpaceULift.{w} B S hS F) (hG : IsAlgebraicSpaceULift.{w} B S hS G)
    (f : F ⟶ G) (hf : IsSurjectiveULift.{w} B S hS f)
    (h : IsQuasiCompactSpaceULift.{w} B S hS F) :
    IsQuasiCompactSpaceULift.{w} B S hS G
declarations.comment: part (1), for a value universe independent of the universe of the schemes

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isQuasiCompactSpace_of_isSurjective
declarations.doc:
The image of a quasi-compact algebraic space over `S` under a surjective morphism of
algebraic spaces over `S` is quasi-compact.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasiCompactSpace_of_isSurjective {F G : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F) (hG : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS G) (f : F ⟶ G)
    (hf : IsSurjective B S hS f) (hFqc : IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS F) :
    IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS G

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isQuasiCompact_of_comp_surjective
declarations.doc:
In a commuting triangle `p = f ≫ q` of morphisms of algebraic
spaces over `S` whose horizontal morphism `f` is surjective, quasi-compactness of `p` implies
quasi-compactness of `q`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasiCompact_of_comp_surjective {F G H : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F) (hG : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS G)
    (hH : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS H) (f : F ⟶ G) (p : F ⟶ H) (q : G ⟶ H) (hcomm : p = f ≫ q)
    (hf : IsSurjective B S hS f) (hp : IsQuasiCompact B S hS p) :
    IsQuasiCompact B S hS q

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsQuasiCompactSpace.of_isSurjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 040W, part (1).** The image of a quasi-compact algebraic space under a
surjective morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is quasi-compact: if `f : X ⟶ Y` is
surjective on points and `X` is quasi-compact, then `Y` is quasi-compact.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsQuasiCompactSpace.of_isSurjective {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hf : IsSurjective B S hS f) (h : IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS X) :
    IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS Y

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsQuasiCompact.of_isSurjective_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 040W, part (2).** In a commuting triangle `f ≫ q = p` of morphisms of algebraic
spaces over `S` whose horizontal arrow `f` is surjective, quasi-compactness of `p` implies
quasi-compactness of `q`.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsQuasiCompact.of_isSurjective_comp {f : X ⟶ Y} {p : X ⟶ Z} {q : Y ⟶ Z}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z) (hcomm : f ≫ q = p)
    (hf : IsSurjective B S hS f) (hp : IsQuasiCompact B S hS p) :
    IsQuasiCompact B S hS q

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.injectiveOnFieldPoints_tfae
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 040X.** For a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` from an algebraic space over `S` the
following are equivalent:

1. the map `X(K) → Y(K)` is injective for every field `K` over `S`,
2. for every morphism `Y' ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces over `S` the induced map
   `|Y' ×_Y X| → |Y'|` is injective, and
3. the diagonal morphism `X ⟶ X ×_Y X` is surjective.
declarations.statement:
theorem injectiveOnFieldPoints_tfae (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    List.TFAE [InjectiveOnFieldPoints B S hS f, UniversallyInjective B S hS f,
      IsSurjective B S hS (pullback.diagonal f)]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallyOfFiniteType_tfae
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 040Y.** For a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces over a scheme `S` the
following nine conditions are equivalent: `f` is locally of finite type; `f` is of finite type
at every point of `X`; the base change of `f` along every morphism from a scheme over `S` is
locally of finite type; the same for every morphism from an affine scheme over `S`; the base
change of `f` along some surjective étale chart of `Y` is locally of finite type; the
composite of `f` with some surjective étale chart of `X` is locally of finite type; every
commuting square of étale charts of `f` induces a scheme morphism which is locally of finite
type; some such square whose chart of `X` is surjective does; and there are Zariski coverings
of `Y` and of the inverse images in `X` of its members over which `f` is locally of finite
type.

The conditions are listed in the order of the source, so the `n`-th entry of the list is
condition `(n)`. Schemes over `Y` are objects of the big fppf site of `S`, and condition (7)
is literally the definition of local finite type, which is why (1) ⇔ (7) is `Iff.rfl`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyOfFiniteType_tfae (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    List.TFAE
      [IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f,
       (∀ x : points B S hS X, IsFiniteTypeAt B S hS f x),
       (∀ (Z : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj Z ⟶ Y),
          IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS (pullback.fst g f)),
       (∀ (Z : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj Z ⟶ Y),
          IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj Z) →
            IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS (pullback.fst g f)),
       (∃ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y), IsSurjective B S hS g ∧
          IsEtale B S hS g ∧ IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS (pullback.fst g f)),
       (∃ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X), IsSurjective B S hS g ∧
          IsEtale B S hS g ∧ IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS (g ≫ f)),
       HoldsOnEveryEtaleChart B S hS
         (@AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyOfFiniteType.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) f,
       HoldsOnSurjectiveEtaleChart B S hS
         (@AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyOfFiniteType.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) f,
       (∃ (I : Type u) (Yᵢ : I → Subfunctor Y), IsZariskiCover B S hS I Yᵢ ∧
          ∀ i, ∃ (J : Type u) (Xᵢⱼ : J → Subfunctor ((Yᵢ i).preimage f).toFunctor),
            IsZariskiCover B S hS J Xᵢⱼ ∧
              ∀ j, IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS
                ((Xᵢⱼ j).ι ≫ (Yᵢ i).fromPreimage f))]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.locallyQuasiFinite_tfae
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 040Z.** Nine criteria for a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` to be locally
quasi-finite: pointwise quasi-finiteness, local quasi-finiteness of every base change to a
scheme or to an affine scheme or to one surjective étale chart of the target, local
quasi-finiteness of the composite with one surjective étale chart of the source, and local
quasi-finiteness of the morphism of schemes in every — or in one surjective — commuting square
of étale charts, or over a pair of Zariski coverings.
declarations.statement:
theorem locallyQuasiFinite_tfae {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    List.TFAE [
      IsLocallyQuasiFinite B S hS f,
      ∀ x : points B S hS X, IsQuasiFiniteAt B S hS f x,
      ∀ (Z : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj Z ⟶ Y),
        IsLocallyQuasiFinite B S hS (pullback.fst g f),
      ∀ (Z : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj Z ⟶ Y),
        IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj Z) →
          IsLocallyQuasiFinite B S hS (pullback.fst g f),
      ∃ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y),
        IsSurjective B S hS g ∧ IsEtale B S hS g ∧
          IsLocallyQuasiFinite B S hS (pullback.fst g f),
      ∃ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (p : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X),
        IsSurjective B S hS p ∧ IsEtale B S hS p ∧ IsLocallyQuasiFinite B S hS (p ≫ f),
      ∀ (U V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (p : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X) (q : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y) (a : U ⟶ V),
        IsEtale B S hS p → IsEtale B S hS q → p ≫ f = yoneda.map a ≫ q →
          IsLocallyQuasiFinite B S hS (yoneda.map a),
      ∃ (U V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (p : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X) (q : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y) (a : U ⟶ V),
        IsEtale B S hS p ∧ IsEtale B S hS q ∧ IsSurjective B S hS p ∧
          p ≫ f = yoneda.map a ≫ q ∧ IsLocallyQuasiFinite B S hS (yoneda.map a),
      ∃ (I : Type u) (Yopen : I → Subfunctor Y) (J : I → Type u)
        (Xopen : ∀ i, J i → Subfunctor (pullback f (Yopen i).ι)),
        IsZariskiCover B S hS I Yopen ∧ (∀ i, IsZariskiCover B S hS (J i) (Xopen i)) ∧
          ∀ i j, IsLocallyQuasiFinite B S hS ((Xopen i j).ι ≫ pullback.snd f (Yopen i).ι)
    ]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallyOfFinitePresentation_tfae
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0410.** Nine criteria for a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` to be locally
of finite presentation: pointwise finite presentation, local finite presentation of every base
change to a scheme or to an affine scheme or to one surjective étale chart of the target, local
finite presentation of the composite with one surjective étale chart of the source, local
finite presentation of the morphism of schemes in every — or in one surjective — commuting
square of étale charts, or over a pair of Zariski coverings.

Local finite presentation of morphisms of schemes is étale local on the source and target
(Stacks 04R3), stable under composition and base change, and implied by étaleness, so this is
the instance of `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.holdsOnEveryEtaleChart_tfae` at that property.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyOfFinitePresentation_tfae
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    List.TFAE [
      IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS f,
      ∀ x : points B S hS X, IsFinitePresentationAt B S hS f x,
      ∀ (W : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj W ⟶ Y),
        IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS (pullback.fst g f),
      ∀ (W : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj W ⟶ Y),
        IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj W) →
          IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS (pullback.fst g f),
      ∃ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y),
        IsSurjective B S hS g ∧ IsEtale B S hS g ∧
          IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS (pullback.fst g f),
      ∃ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (p : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X),
        IsSurjective B S hS p ∧ IsEtale B S hS p ∧
          IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS (p ≫ f),
      ∀ (U V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (p : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X) (q : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y) (a : U ⟶ V),
        IsEtale B S hS p → IsEtale B S hS q → p ≫ f = yoneda.map a ≫ q →
          IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS (yoneda.map a),
      ∃ (U V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (p : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X) (q : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y) (a : U ⟶ V),
        IsEtale B S hS p ∧ IsEtale B S hS q ∧ IsSurjective B S hS p ∧
          p ≫ f = yoneda.map a ≫ q ∧ IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS (yoneda.map a),
      ∃ (I : Type u) (Yopen : I → Subfunctor Y) (J : I → Type u)
        (Xopen : ∀ i, J i → Subfunctor (pullback f (Yopen i).ι)),
        IsZariskiCover B S hS I Yopen ∧ (∀ i, IsZariskiCover B S hS (J i) (Xopen i)) ∧
          ∀ i j, IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS
            ((Xopen i j).ι ≫ pullback.snd f (Yopen i).ι)
    ]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsSubmersive
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0412, part (1).** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is *submersive* when the
map it induces on points is a quotient map for the topology detected by scheme-valued points.

This is unrelated to the notion of a submersion of differential manifolds.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsSubmersive (f : F ⟶ G) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.UniversallySubmersive
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0412, part (2).** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is *universally
submersive* when its base change along every morphism to its target from an algebraic space
over `S` is submersive.
declarations.statement: abbrev UniversallySubmersive (f : F ⟶ G) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isOpen_iff_isOpen_preimage_pointsMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0413, open subsets.** A subset of the points of the target of a flat,
quasi-compact, surjective morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is open exactly when its
inverse image on points is open.

Openness in the point topology is tested on the presheaves represented by the objects of the
site, and openness there is openness in the representing scheme, hence local on its affine
opens; those affine opens are objects of the site with affine underlying scheme, so
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isOpen_preimage_pointsMap_of_isAffine` applies to each.
declarations.statement:
theorem isOpen_iff_isOpen_preimage_pointsMap
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hflat : IsFlat B S hS f) (hqc : IsQuasiCompact B S hS f) (hsurj : IsSurjective B S hS f)
    (T : Set (points B S hS Y)) :
    IsOpen T ↔ IsOpen (pointsMap B S hS X f ⁻¹' T)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isClosed_iff_isClosed_preimage_pointsMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0413, closed subsets.** A subset of the points of the target of a flat,
quasi-compact, surjective morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is closed exactly when its
inverse image on points is closed. This is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isOpen_iff_isOpen_preimage_pointsMap` at the complement.
declarations.statement:
theorem isClosed_iff_isClosed_preimage_pointsMap
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hflat : IsFlat B S hS f) (hqc : IsQuasiCompact B S hS f) (hsurj : IsSurjective B S hS f)
    (T : Set (points B S hS Y)) :
    IsClosed T ↔ IsClosed (pointsMap B S hS X f ⁻¹' T)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSubmersive_of_isFlat_of_isQuasiCompact_of_isSurjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0413, submersiveness.** A flat, quasi-compact, surjective morphism of algebraic
spaces over `S` is submersive: it is surjective on points, and openness of a subset of the
points of its target is openness of the inverse image.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSubmersive_of_isFlat_of_isQuasiCompact_of_isSurjective
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hflat : IsFlat B S hS f) (hqc : IsQuasiCompact B S hS f) (hsurj : IsSurjective B S hS f) :
    IsSubmersive B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.universallySubmersive_of_isFlat_of_isQuasiCompact_of_isSurjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0413, universal submersiveness.** A flat, quasi-compact, surjective morphism of
algebraic spaces over `S` is universally submersive: each of the three hypotheses is stable
under base change, by Stacks 03MO, Stacks 03HF and Stacks 03MH.
declarations.statement:
theorem universallySubmersive_of_isFlat_of_isQuasiCompact_of_isSurjective
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hflat : IsFlat B S hS f) (hqc : IsQuasiCompact B S hS f) (hsurj : IsSurjective B S hS f) :
    UniversallySubmersive B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsFinite.isIntegralHom
declarations.doc: A finite morphism of algebraic spaces is integral.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsFinite.isIntegralHom {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (hf : IsFinite B S hS f) : IsIntegralHom B S hS f
declarations.comment: first assertion: a finite morphism is integral

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFinite_of_isIntegralHom_of_isLocallyOfFiniteType
declarations.doc: An integral morphism of algebraic spaces which is locally of finite type is finite.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFinite_of_isIntegralHom_of_isLocallyOfFiniteType
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hf : IsIntegralHom B S hS f) (hft : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f) :
    IsFinite B S hS f
declarations.comment: second assertion: an integral morphism locally of finite type is finite

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIntegralHom_iff_isAffineHom_and_universallyClosed
declarations.doc:
A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is integral if and only if it is affine and
universally closed.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIntegralHom_iff_isAffineHom_and_universallyClosed
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    IsIntegralHom B S hS f ↔
      IsAffineHom B S hS f ∧ UniversallyClosed B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteLocallyFree_presheaf_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0416, conditions (1) and (2).** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is
representable and finite locally free exactly when it is finite, flat and locally of finite
presentation.

Both sides are conditions on the represented base changes of the morphism, so this is the
scheme-level equivalence Stacks 02KB applied to one represented base change at a time.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFree_presheaf_iff (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
        (@Stacks.Morphisms.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
        (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf f ↔
      IsFinite B S hS f ∧ IsFlat B S hS f ∧ IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS f
declarations.comment: conditions (1) and (2), finite local freeness in the representable sense

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteLocallyFree_presheaf_iff_of_isLocallyNoetherian
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0416, condition (3).** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` with locally
Noetherian target is representable and finite locally free exactly when it is finite and flat.

A finite morphism is locally of finite type, hence locally of finite presentation over a locally
Noetherian target by Stacks 06G4, part (1), so the finite presentation condition of conditions
(1) and (2) is automatic.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFree_presheaf_iff_of_isLocallyNoetherian
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hN : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS Y (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian T)) :
    (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
        (@Stacks.Morphisms.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
        (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf f ↔
      IsFinite B S hS f ∧ IsFlat B S hS f
declarations.comment: condition (3) over a locally Noetherian target

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.relativelyRepresentable_of_isLocallyQuasiFinite_isSeparated
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0418.** A separated, locally quasi-finite morphism of algebraic spaces over `S`
is relatively representable along the Yoneda embedding of the big fppf site.
declarations.statement:
theorem relativelyRepresentable_of_isLocallyQuasiFinite_isSeparated
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hf : IsLocallyQuasiFinite B S hS f)
    (hs : IsSeparated B S hS f) :
    yoneda.relativelyRepresentable f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_fpqc_scheme_refinement
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0419.** Every fpqc covering of an algebraic space over `S` by algebraic spaces
has an fpqc refinement by schemes, with each new member factoring through the corresponding
member of the original covering by a relatively étale morphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_fpqc_scheme_refinement
    {I : Type v} {X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    {Xᵢ : I → (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hXᵢ : ∀ i, IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS (Xᵢ i))
    (f : ∀ i, Xᵢ i ⟶ X) (hf : IsFpqcCovering B S hS f) :
    ∃ (T : I → BigFppfOver B S hS) (e : ∀ i, yoneda.obj (T i) ⟶ Xᵢ i),
      (∀ i, (MorphismProperty.inverseImage (@Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf (e i)) ∧
        IsFpqcCovering B S hS (fun i => e i ≫ f i)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsSyntomicCovering
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 041A.** A family of morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` with common target
is a *syntomic covering* when every member is syntomic and the family is jointly
surjective on points.
declarations.statement:
structure IsSyntomicCovering {I : Type v} {F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (X : I → (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (f : ∀ i, X i ⟶ F) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSyntomicCovering_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 041A.** Being a syntomic covering is exactly: the target and all the sources are
algebraic spaces, every member of the family is syntomic, and the images of the maps on points
exhaust the points of the target.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSyntomicCovering_iff {I : Type v} {F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (X : I → (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (f : ∀ i, X i ⟶ F) :
    IsSyntomicCovering B S hS X f ↔
      (IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F ∧ (∀ i, IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS (X i)) ∧
        (∀ i, IsSyntomic B S hS (f i)) ∧
        Set.univ = ⋃ i, Set.range (pointsMap B S hS (X i) (f i)))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSyntomicCovering_pullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 041B**, the base-change clause. The first projections of the presheaf fibre
products of a syntomic covering of an algebraic space over `S` with a morphism `g` into its
target form a syntomic covering of the source of `g`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSyntomicCovering_pullback {I : Type v}
    {X X' : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (g : X' ⟶ X) (hX' : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X')
    (Y : I → (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (f : ∀ i, Y i ⟶ X)
    (h : IsSyntomicCovering B S hS Y f) :
    IsSyntomicCovering B S hS (fun i => pullback g (f i))
      (fun i => pullback.fst g (f i))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSyntomicCovering_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 041B**, the composition clause. A syntomic covering of each member of a syntomic
covering composes to a syntomic covering of the original algebraic space.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSyntomicCovering_comp {I : Type v} (J : I → Type w)
    {X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (Xᵢ : I → (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (f : ∀ i, Xᵢ i ⟶ X)
    (Xᵢⱼ : ∀ i, J i → (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (g : ∀ i j, Xᵢⱼ i j ⟶ Xᵢ i)
    (hf : IsSyntomicCovering B S hS Xᵢ f)
    (hg : ∀ i, IsSyntomicCovering B S hS (Xᵢⱼ i) (g i)) :
    IsSyntomicCovering B S hS
      (fun ij : (i : I) × J i => Xᵢⱼ ij.1 ij.2)
      (fun ij => g ij.1 ij.2 ≫ f ij.1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSyntomicCovering_of_isIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 041B**, the isomorphism clause. An isomorphism of algebraic spaces over `S`,
regarded as a family indexed by a point, is a syntomic covering.
declarations.statement:
lemma isSyntomicCovering_of_isIso
    {X' X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : X' ⟶ X) [IsIso f]
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) :
    IsSyntomicCovering B S hS (fun _ : Unit ↦ X') (fun _ ↦ f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsSmoothCovering
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 041C.** A family of morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` with common target
is a *smooth covering* when every member is smooth and the family is jointly surjective on
points.
declarations.statement:
structure IsSmoothCovering {I : Type v} {F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (X : I → (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (f : ∀ i, X i ⟶ F) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSmoothCovering_of_isIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 041D**, the isomorphism clause. An isomorphism of algebraic spaces over `S`,
regarded as a family indexed by a point, is a smooth covering.
declarations.statement:
lemma isSmoothCovering_of_isIso
    {X' X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : X' ⟶ X) [IsIso f]
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) :
    IsSmoothCovering B S hS (fun _ : Unit ↦ X') (fun _ ↦ f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSmoothCovering_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 041D**, the composition clause. Composing a smooth covering of an algebraic space
over `S` with a smooth covering of each of its members gives a smooth covering.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSmoothCovering_comp
    {I : Type v} {J : I → Type w} {F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (X : I → (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (f : ∀ i, X i ⟶ F)
    (Y : ∀ i, J i → (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (g : ∀ i j, Y i j ⟶ X i)
    (hf : IsSmoothCovering B S hS X f)
    (hg : ∀ i, IsSmoothCovering B S hS (Y i) (g i)) :
    IsSmoothCovering B S hS (fun ij : Σ i, J i ↦ Y ij.1 ij.2)
      (fun ij : Σ i, J i ↦ g ij.1 ij.2 ≫ f ij.1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSmoothCovering_fiberProduct
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 041D**, the base-change clause. The first projections of the fibre products of a
smooth covering of an algebraic space over `S` with a morphism `g` into its target form a
smooth covering of the source of `g`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSmoothCovering_fiberProduct
    {I : Type v} {X X' : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (Xi : I → AlgebraicSpaces B S hS)
    (f : ∀ i, Xi i ⟶ X) (g : X' ⟶ X)
    (hf : IsSmoothCovering B S hS (fun i ↦ (Xi i).1) (fun i ↦ (f i).hom)) :
    IsSmoothCovering B S hS (fun i ↦ (AlgebraicSpaces.fiberProduct B S hS g (f i)).1)
      (fun i ↦ pullback.fst g.hom (f i).hom)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsEtaleCovering
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 041E.** A family of morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` with common target
is an *étale covering* when every member is étale and the family is jointly surjective on
points.
declarations.statement:
structure IsEtaleCovering {I : Type v} {F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (X : I → (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (f : ∀ i, X i ⟶ F) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isEtaleCovering_comp
declarations.doc:
An étale covering of each member of an étale covering composes to an
étale covering of the original algebraic space.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isEtaleCovering_comp
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {I : Type v} (J : I → Type w)
    {X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (Xᵢ : I → (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (f : ∀ i, Xᵢ i ⟶ X)
    (Xᵢⱼ : ∀ i, J i → (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (g : ∀ i j, Xᵢⱼ i j ⟶ Xᵢ i)
    (hf : IsEtaleCovering B S hS Xᵢ f)
    (hg : ∀ i, IsEtaleCovering B S hS (Xᵢⱼ i) (g i)) :
    IsEtaleCovering B S hS
      (fun ij : (i : I) × J i => Xᵢⱼ ij.1 ij.2)
      (fun ij => g ij.1 ij.2 ≫ f ij.1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isEtaleCovering_pullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 041F**, the base-change clause. The first projections of the presheaf fibre
products of an étale covering of an algebraic space over `S` with a morphism `g` into its
target form an étale covering of the source of `g`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEtaleCovering_pullback
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {I : Type v} {X X' : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (g : X' ⟶ X) (hX' : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X')
    (Y : I → (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (f : ∀ i, Y i ⟶ X)
    (h : IsEtaleCovering B S hS Y f) :
    IsEtaleCovering B S hS (fun i => CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback g (f i))
      (fun i => CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback.fst g (f i))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isEtaleCovering_of_isIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 041F**, the isomorphism clause. An isomorphism of algebraic spaces over `S`,
regarded as a family indexed by a point, is an étale covering.
declarations.statement:
lemma isEtaleCovering_of_isIso
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X' X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : X' ⟶ X) [IsIso f]
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) :
    IsEtaleCovering B S hS (fun _ : Unit ↦ X') (fun _ ↦ f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsZariskiCovering
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 041G.** A family of open immersions whose images cover every point of the
target.
declarations.statement:
abbrev IsZariskiCovering (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (I : Type v) (Xᵢ : I → (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (f : ∀ i, Xᵢ i ⟶ X) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isZariskiCovering_yoneda_of_openCover
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 041G for an open cover of an object of the big fppf site of `S`.** A family of
morphisms of the site whose underlying morphisms of schemes are open immersions covering the
underlying scheme of the target induces a Zariski covering of the presheaf represented by the
target.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZariskiCovering_yoneda_of_openCover
    {I : Type v} {T : BigFppfOver B S hS} (X : I → BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : ∀ i, X i ⟶ T)
    (hopen : ∀ i, _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.IsOpenImmersion
      ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map (g i)))
    (hcov : ∀ x : (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj T,
      ∃ i, x ∈ Set.range ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map (g i))) :
    IsZariskiCovering B S hS I (fun i => yoneda.obj (X i)) (fun i => yoneda.map (g i))
declarations.comment: an open cover of an object of the site

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isZariskiCovering_of_isIso
declarations.doc: **Stacks 041H.** An isomorphism gives a singleton Zariski covering.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZariskiCovering_of_isIso
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (X X' : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (f : X' ⟶ X) [IsIso f] :
    IsZariskiCovering B S hS PUnit (fun _ => X') (fun _ => f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isZariskiCovering_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 041H.** Composing a Zariski covering with a covering of each member gives a
Zariski covering.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZariskiCovering_comp
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (I : Type v) (J : I → Type w)
    (Xᵢ : I → (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (Xᵢⱼ : ∀ i, J i → (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (f : ∀ i, Xᵢ i ⟶ X)
    (g : ∀ i j, Xᵢⱼ i j ⟶ Xᵢ i)
    (hf : IsZariskiCovering B S hS I Xᵢ f)
    (hg : ∀ i, IsZariskiCovering B S hS (J i) (Xᵢⱼ i) (g i)) :
    IsZariskiCovering B S hS (Σ i, J i)
      (fun p => Xᵢⱼ p.1 p.2) (fun p => g p.1 p.2 ≫ f p.1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isZariskiCovering_pullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 041H.** Zariski coverings are stable under base change: the first projections of
the fibre products of a Zariski covering `{Xᵢ ⟶ X}` with a morphism `g : X' ⟶ X` form a
Zariski covering of `X'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZariskiCovering_pullback
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X X' : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (I : Type v) (Xᵢ : I → (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (f : ∀ i, Xᵢ i ⟶ X) (g : X' ⟶ X)
    (h : IsZariskiCovering B S hS I Xᵢ f) :
    IsZariskiCovering B S hS I (fun i => Limits.pullback g (f i))
      (fun i => Limits.pullback.fst g (f i))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocalAtTarget_fpqc_of_affineDescent
declarations.doc:
An affine-local morphism property which descends along surjective flat
maps of affine schemes and respects finite coproducts is fpqc local on the
target.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isLocalAtTarget_fpqc_of_affineDescent
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (P : MorphismProperty (AlgebraicSpaces B S hS))
    (hcoprod : ∀ (n : ℕ)
      (X Y : Fin n → AlgebraicSpaces B S hS)
      (f : ∀ i, X i ⟶ Y i)
      (X₀ Y₀ : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS)
      (ιX : ∀ i, X i ⟶ X₀) (ιY : ∀ i, Y i ⟶ Y₀)
      (g : X₀ ⟶ Y₀),
      IsColimit (Cofan.mk X₀ ιX) →
      IsColimit (Cofan.mk Y₀ ιY) →
      (∀ i, f i ≫ ιY i = ιX i ≫ g) →
      (∀ i, P (f i)) → P g)
    (haffine : ∀ {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS}
      (f : X ⟶ Y),
      P f ↔ ∀ (T : BigAffineFppf B S hS)
        (g : schemeSpace
          ((BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS).obj T) ⟶ Y),
        P (pullback.snd f g))
    (hdescent : ∀ (T T' : BigAffineFppf B S hS)
      (g : T' ⟶ T),
      Flat ((BigAffineFppf.toScheme B S hS).map g) →
      Surjective ((BigAffineFppf.toScheme B S hS).map g) →
      ∀ (X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS)
        (f : X ⟶ schemeSpace
          ((BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS).obj T)),
        P (pullback.snd f
          (schemeSpaceMap
            ((BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS).map g))) → P f) :
    P.IsLocalAtTarget (Space.Topology.precoverage.{u, v}
      .fpqc B S hS)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.quasiCompact_isLocalAtTarget_fpqc
declarations.doc:
Quasi-compactness of morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` is local on
the base for the fpqc topology.
declarations.statement:
instance quasiCompact_isLocalAtTarget_fpqc :
    (quasiCompactProperty B S hS).IsLocalAtTarget
      (Topology.precoverage.{u, v} .fpqc B S hS)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isQuasiSeparated_isLocalAtTarget_fpqc
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 041N.** Quasi-separatedness of a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is local on
the target for the fpqc topology.

One direction is stability under base change (**Stacks 03KL**). In the other, quasi-separatedness
of `f : X ⟶ Y` is quasi-compactness of `Δ_f : X ⟶ X ×_Y X`; the given fpqc covering of `Y` pulls
back to one of `X ×_Y X` by part (3) of **Stacks 03MR**, the base change of `Δ_f` along each
member of it is the relative diagonal of the corresponding base change of `f`, and so
quasi-compactness of `Δ_f` follows from **Stacks 041L**.
declarations.statement:
instance isQuasiSeparated_isLocalAtTarget_fpqc :
    (quasiSeparatedProperty B S hS).IsLocalAtTarget
      (Topology.fpqc.precoverage.{u, v} B S hS)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.universallyClosed_isLocalAtTarget_fpqc
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 041O.** Universal closedness of morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` is local on
the base for the fpqc topology.

Universal closedness is being universally a closed morphism, so the ascent half is formal. For
the descent half, condition (3) of Stacks 03IT reduces the assertion to closedness of the base
changes along morphisms from the *affine* objects of the site; over such an affine `T` the fpqc
condition of Stacks 03MQ supplies a finite affine family covering `T` and refining the given
covering, and closedness of a morphism to a representable algebraic space descends along it.
declarations.statement:
instance universallyClosed_isLocalAtTarget_fpqc :
    (universallyClosedProperty B S hS).IsLocalAtTarget
      (Topology.precoverage.{u, v} .fpqc B S hS)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.universallyOpen_isLocalAtTarget_fpqc
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 041P.** Universal openness of morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` is local on
the base for the fpqc topology.
declarations.statement:
instance universallyOpen_isLocalAtTarget_fpqc :
    (universallyOpenMorphismProperty B S hS).IsLocalAtTarget
      (Topology.precoverage.{u, v} .fpqc B S hS)

declarations.doc:
Surjectivity of morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` is local on the base for the fpqc

instance surjective_isLocalAtTarget_fpqc :

      (Topology.precoverage.{u, v} .fpqc B S hS)
