        (∀ (z w : H.arrows.obj.obj T) (h : H.source.hom.app T z = H.target.hom.app T w)
          (h' : G.source.hom.app T ((a ≫ pR).hom.app T z) =
            G.target.hom.app T ((a ≫ pR).hom.app T w)),
          H.arrowsToBase.hom.app T z = b → H.arrowsToBase.hom.app T w = b →
          H.arrowsToBase.hom.app T (H.toGroupoidInFunctors.compose T z w h) = b ∧
          H.target.hom.app T (H.toGroupoidInFunctors.compose T z w h) =
              H.target.hom.app T z ∧
            (a ≫ pR).hom.app T (H.toGroupoidInFunctors.compose T z w h) =
              G.toGroupoidInFunctors.compose T ((a ≫ pR).hom.app T z)
                ((a ≫ pR).hom.app T w) h' ∧
            H.source.hom.app T (H.toGroupoidInFunctors.compose T z w h) =
              H.source.hom.app T w) ∧
        ∃ F : ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory
              (fun x : H.toGroupoidInFunctors.Evaluation T => H.objectsToBase.hom.app T x = b) ⥤
            ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory
              (fun x : G.toGroupoidInFunctors.Evaluation T => G.objectsToBase.hom.app T x = b),
          (∀ x, (F.obj x).obj = g.hom.app T x.obj) ∧
          F ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι _ = ObjectProperty.ι _ ⋙ φ.toGroupoidHom.evaluation T ∧
          Nonempty F.FullyFaithful

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.restrict
declarations.doc:
Restriction along an arbitrary map to the object space, with its canonical
composition law and functor to the original groupoid.
declarations.comment: the restriction of the groupoid to U'

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.existsUnique_iso_restriction_groupoidPreRelation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044D**, restricting a groupoid and then taking its pre-relation. Let `G` be a
groupoid in algebraic spaces over `B` and `g : U' ⟶ U` a morphism to its space of objects. The
pre-relation `j' = (t', s') : R' ⟶ U' ×_B U'` of the restriction `G|_{U'}` of **Stacks 044C**,
whose arrow space is `R' = U' ×_{g, U, t} R ×_{s, U, g} U'`, is the restriction along `g`, in the
sense of **Stacks 043D**, of the pre-relation `j = (t, s) : R ⟶ U ×_B U` of `G` (**Stacks 043X**):
`R' = (U' ×_B U') ×_{U ×_B U} R`. Precisely, there is exactly one isomorphism from the arrow space
of `G|_{U'}` to the restricted pre-relation's arrow space taking the restricted pre-relation to
`j'` and its projection to `R` to the map on arrows of the morphism `G|_{U'} ⟶ G`.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_iso_restriction_groupoidPreRelation (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B)
    {U' : AlgebraicSpaces C S hS} (g : U' ⟶ G.objects) :
    ∃! e : (Over.mk (G.restrict g).groupoid.arrowsToBase.hom : Over B.obj) ≅
        Space.PreRelation.restriction (Space.groupoidPreRelation G) (restrictionObjectsHom G g),
      e.hom ≫ Space.PreRelation.restrict (Space.groupoidPreRelation G)
          (restrictionObjectsHom G g) = Space.groupoidPreRelation (G.restrict g).groupoid ∧
        e.hom ≫ pullback.snd (prod.map (restrictionObjectsHom G g) (restrictionObjectsHom G g))
            (Space.groupoidPreRelation G) =
          Over.homMk (G.restrict g).hom.toGroupoidHom.mapArrows (G.restrict g).hom.mapArrows_over
declarations.comment: restricting a groupoid, then taking its pre-relation

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.existsUnique_isomorphism_restrict_groupoidOfIsEquivalenceRelation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044D**, restricting an equivalence relation and then taking its groupoid. Let
`j : R ⟶ U ×_B U` be an equivalence relation of algebraic spaces over `B`, let
`(U, R, s, t, c)` be the groupoid in algebraic spaces it extends to (**Stacks 043Y**), and let
`g : U' ⟶ U` be a morphism of algebraic spaces. The groupoid in algebraic spaces of the
restricted equivalence relation `j' : R' = (U' ×_B U') ×_{U ×_B U} R ⟶ U' ×_B U'`
(**Stacks 043D**) is the restriction `(U, R, s, t, c)|_{U'}` of **Stacks 044C**: there is exactly
one isomorphism of groupoids in algebraic spaces between them which is the identity of `U'` on
objects, and it takes the projection `R' ⟶ R` to the map on arrows of the morphism
`(U, R, s, t, c)|_{U'} ⟶ (U, R, s, t, c)` of **Stacks 044B**.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_isomorphism_restrict_groupoidOfIsEquivalenceRelation
    (j : PreRelation (Over.mk qR.hom) (Over.mk qU.hom)) [IsEquivalenceRelation j.target j.source]
    (g : U' ⟶ U) :
    ∃! e : Isomorphism (groupoidOfIsEquivalenceRelation (restrictSpace j g))
        ((groupoidOfIsEquivalenceRelation j).restrict g).groupoid,
      e.hom.toGroupoidHom.mapObjects = 𝟙 U'.obj ∧
        e.hom.toGroupoidHom.mapArrows ≫
            ((groupoidOfIsEquivalenceRelation j).restrict g).hom.toGroupoidHom.mapArrows =
          (pullback.snd (prod.map (overHomOfComp qU g) (overHomOfComp qU g)) j).left
declarations.comment: restricting an equivalence relation, then taking its groupoid

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.IsInvariantOpen
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044F, part (1).** An open subspace of the object space of a groupoid in algebraic
spaces is *invariant* when every arrow whose source lies in it has its target in it.
declarations.statement:
abbrev IsInvariantOpen (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces site S hS B)
    (W : Subfunctor G.objects.obj) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.IsInvariantLocallyClosed
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044F, part (2).** A locally closed subspace of the object space of a groupoid in
algebraic spaces is *invariant* when its inverse images under the source and the target map agree
as subspaces of the space of arrows.
declarations.statement:
abbrev IsInvariantLocallyClosed (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces site S hS B)
    (Z : Subfunctor G.objects.obj) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.IsInvariantMonomorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044F, part (3).** A monomorphism into the object space of a groupoid in algebraic
spaces is *invariant* when its base change along the target map and its base change along the
source map are isomorphic as algebraic spaces over the space of arrows.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev IsInvariantMonomorphism (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces site S hS B)
    {T : AlgebraicSpaces site S hS} (i : T ⟶ G.objects) [Mono i] : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sourceSaturation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044G.** The *saturation* of a subspace `W` of the object space of a groupoid in
algebraic spaces: the subspace whose point set is `s(t⁻¹(W))`, the union of the orbits meeting
`W`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def sourceSaturation (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces B S hS A)
    (W : Subfunctor G.objects.obj) : Subfunctor G.objects.obj
declarations.comment: the saturation s(t⁻¹(W)) of a subspace of the object space

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isInvariantOpen_sourceSaturation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044G, part (1).** For an open source morphism the saturation of an open subspace of
the object space is an invariant open subspace.
declarations.statement:
theorem isInvariantOpen_sourceSaturation (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces B S hS A)
    (hs : IsOpenMorphism B S hS G.source.hom) (W : Subfunctor G.objects.obj)
    (hW : IsOpenSubspace B S hS W) :
    GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.IsInvariantOpen G (sourceSaturation B S hS G W)
declarations.comment: part (1): the saturation is an invariant open subspace

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_isZariskiCover_isInvariantOpen_isQuasiCompactSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044G, part (2).** For an open source morphism and a quasi-compact target morphism,
the object space of a groupoid in algebraic spaces has a Zariski covering by invariant
quasi-compact open subspaces: the saturations of the members of an affine Zariski covering
supplied by Stacks 03FY.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isZariskiCover_isInvariantOpen_isQuasiCompactSpace
    (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces B S hS A)
    (hs : IsOpenMorphism B S hS G.source.hom)
    (ht : IsQuasiCompact B S hS G.target.hom) :
    ∃ (I : Type u) (V : I → Subfunctor G.objects.obj),
      IsZariskiCover B S hS I V ∧
        ∀ i, GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.IsInvariantOpen G (V i) ∧
          IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS (V i).toFunctor
declarations.comment: part (2): covering by invariant quasi-compact open subspaces

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.quotientPresheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044I.** The presheaf quotient of `U` by the equivalence relation generated by the
image of the pre-relation `j`, as the coequalizer of its target and source maps.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def quotientPresheaf (j : PreRelation R U) :
    (BigFppfOver site S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.quotientPresheaf_obj_equiv
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044I.** At a test object `T`, the quotient presheaf is the quotient of `U(T)` by the
relation generated by the image of `R(T)`; the identification sends the canonical class of `x` to
the class of `x`.
declarations.statement:
theorem quotientPresheaf_obj_equiv (j : PreRelation R U) (T : BigFppfOver site S hS) :
    ∃ e : (quotientPresheaf j).obj (Opposite.op T) ≃
        Quot (fun x y : U.left.obj (Opposite.op T) =>
          ∃ r : R.left.obj (Opposite.op T),
            j.target.left.app (Opposite.op T) r = x ∧
            j.source.left.app (Opposite.op T) r = y),
      ∀ x, e ((coequalizer.π j.target.left j.source.left).app (Opposite.op T) x) =
        Quot.mk _ x

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.epi_toQuotientSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044J.** The projection of `U` onto the quotient sheaf of a pre-relation is an
epimorphism of fppf sheaves: a map out of the quotient sheaf is determined by its restriction
to `U`.
declarations.statement:
theorem epi_toQuotientSheaf (j : PreRelation R U)
    {hU : Presheaf.IsSheaf (BigFppfOver.topology site S hS) U.left}
    (p : (⟨U.left, hU⟩ : Sheaf (BigFppfOver.topology site S hS) (Type u)) ⟶ quotientSheaf j)
    (hp : p.hom = toQuotientSheaf j) : Epi p
declarations.comment: the quotient projection is an epimorphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.quotientSheaf
declarations.doc:
The quotient sheaf `U/R` of a pre-relation: the fppf sheafification of its quotient
presheaf.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev quotientSheaf (j : PreRelation R U) :
    Sheaf (BigFppfOver.topology site S hS) (Type u)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.target_toQuotientSheaf_eq_source
declarations.doc:
The quotient projection identifies the target and the source of every arrow of the
relation.
declarations.statement:
theorem target_toQuotientSheaf_eq_source (j : PreRelation R U) :
    j.target.left ≫ toQuotientSheaf j = j.source.left ≫ toQuotientSheaf j
declarations.comment: relation equalized by the quotient projection

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.toQuotientSheaf_quotientSheafDesc
declarations.doc: The descended map restricts to the original map on `U`.
declarations.statement:
theorem toQuotientSheaf_quotientSheafDesc (j : PreRelation R U)
    (A : Sheaf (BigFppfOver.topology site S hS) (Type u)) (k : U.left ⟶ A.obj)
    (h : j.target.left ≫ k = j.source.left ≫ k) :
    toQuotientSheaf j ≫ (quotientSheafDesc j A k h).hom = k
declarations.comment: descent of maps from the quotient

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.quotientSheafDesc_unique
declarations.doc: A map out of the quotient sheaf is determined by its restriction to `U`.
declarations.statement:
theorem quotientSheafDesc_unique (j : PreRelation R U)
    (A : Sheaf (BigFppfOver.topology site S hS) (Type u)) (k : U.left ⟶ A.obj)
    (h : j.target.left ≫ k = j.source.left ≫ k) (d : quotientSheaf j ⟶ A)
    (hd : toQuotientSheaf j ≫ d.hom = k) : d = quotientSheafDesc j A k h

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.quotientSheafToBase
declarations.doc: The canonical map from the quotient sheaf to the base.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def quotientSheafToBase
    (hZ : Presheaf.IsSheaf (BigFppfOver.topology site S hS) Z) (j : PreRelation R U) :
    quotientSheaf j ⟶ baseSheaf hZ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.toQuotientSheaf_quotientSheafToBase
declarations.doc: The map from the quotient to the base extends the structure map of `U`.
declarations.statement:
theorem toQuotientSheaf_quotientSheafToBase
    (hZ : Presheaf.IsSheaf (BigFppfOver.topology site S hS) Z) (j : PreRelation R U) :
    toQuotientSheaf j ≫ (quotientSheafToBase hZ j).hom = U.hom

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.actionQuotientSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044J** for a group action: the quotient `X/G` of an algebraic space by the action
of a group algebraic space, the quotient sheaf of the orbit pre-relation.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev actionQuotientSheaf (G X : Over B) [GrpObj G] [ModObj G X] :
    Sheaf (BigFppfOver.topology site S hS) (Type u)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.PreRelation.QuotientIsAlgebraicSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044L.** A pre-relation has *quotient representable by an algebraic space* when its
quotient sheaf is an algebraic space.
declarations.statement: noncomputable abbrev PreRelation.QuotientIsAlgebraicSpace (j : PreRelation R U) : Prop
declarations.comment: pre-relation: quotient representable by an algebraic space

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.PreRelation.HasRepresentableQuotient
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044L.** A pre-relation has a *representable quotient* when its quotient sheaf is
represented by a scheme of the site.
declarations.statement: noncomputable abbrev PreRelation.HasRepresentableQuotient (j : PreRelation R U) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.QuotientIsAlgebraicSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044L.** A groupoid in algebraic spaces has *quotient representable by an algebraic
space* when the quotient sheaf of its pre-relation `(t, s)` is an algebraic space.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev QuotientIsAlgebraicSpace (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces site S hS B) :
    Prop
declarations.comment: groupoid: quotient representable by an algebraic space

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.HasRepresentableQuotient
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044L.** A groupoid in algebraic spaces has a *representable quotient* when the
quotient sheaf of its pre-relation `(t, s)` is represented by a scheme of the site.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev HasRepresentableQuotient (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces site S hS B) :
    Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_quotientSheafDesc_of_isLocallySurjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044M.** If `U ⟶ A` is a surjection of sheaves equalizing the relation, and `R`
surjects onto the kernel pair of `U ⟶ A`, then the canonical map from the quotient sheaf to `A`
is an isomorphism, so `A` represents the quotient `U/R`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_quotientSheafDesc_of_isLocallySurjective (j : PreRelation R U)
    (A : Sheaf (BigFppfOver.topology site S hS) (Type u)) (k : U.left ⟶ A.obj)
    (heq : j.target.left ≫ k = j.source.left ≫ k)
    (hU : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (BigFppfOver.topology site S hS) k)
    (hR : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (BigFppfOver.topology site S hS)
      (pullback.lift j.target.left j.source.left heq)) :
    IsIso (quotientSheafDesc j A k heq)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.restrictionQuotientSheafMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044N.** The map `U'/R' ⟶ U/R` of fppf quotient sheaves induced by restricting a
groupoid in algebraic spaces along `g`, the arrow space `R'` of the restriction being the
restricted pre-relation by **Stacks 044D**.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev restrictionQuotientSheafMap (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B)
    {U' : AlgebraicSpaces C S hS} (g : U' ⟶ G.objects) :
    Space.quotientSheaf (Space.PreRelation.restrict (Space.groupoidPreRelation G)
        (restrictionObjectsHom G g)) ⟶
      Space.quotientSheaf (Space.groupoidPreRelation G)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.mono_restrictionQuotientSheafMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044N.** Restricting a groupoid in algebraic spaces gives an injective map of fppf
quotient sheaves: the pre-relation of a groupoid is a pre-equivalence relation by **Stacks
043X**, and restricting a pre-equivalence relation is injective on quotient sheaves by **Stacks
046P**.
declarations.statement:
theorem mono_restrictionQuotientSheafMap (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B)
    {U' : AlgebraicSpaces C S hS} (g : U' ⟶ G.objects) :
    Mono (restrictionQuotientSheafMap G g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.isIso_restrictionQuotientSheafMap_of_saturation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044N.** If every object of `U` is fppf-locally the source of an arrow of `G` whose
target lifts along `g`, then the map of quotient sheaves induced by the restriction is
bijective.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_restrictionQuotientSheafMap_of_saturation
    (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B)
    {U' : AlgebraicSpaces C S hS} (g : U' ⟶ G.objects)
    (hsat : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (BigFppfOver.topology C S hS)
      (restrictionSaturationMap G g).hom) :
    IsIso (restrictionQuotientSheafMap G g)
declarations.comment: bijectivity when the saturation map is surjective

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.isIso_restrictionQuotientSheafMap_of_saturation_isFppfCovering
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044N.** If the saturation map is a one-member fppf covering, then the map of
quotient sheaves induced by the restriction is bijective.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_restrictionQuotientSheafMap_of_saturation_isFppfCovering
    (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B)
    {U' : AlgebraicSpaces C S hS} (g : U' ⟶ G.objects)
    (hsat : Space.IsFppfCovering C S hS
      (fun _ : PUnit ↦ (AlgebraicSpaces.fiberProduct C S hS g G.target).obj)
      (fun _ ↦ (restrictionSaturationMap G g).hom)) :
    IsIso (restrictionQuotientSheafMap G g)
declarations.comment: the saturation map is an fppf covering

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.isIso_restrictionQuotientSheafMap_of_isLocallySurjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044N.** If `g` is surjective as a map of fppf sheaves, then the map of quotient
sheaves induced by the restriction is bijective.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_restrictionQuotientSheafMap_of_isLocallySurjective
    (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B)
    {U' : AlgebraicSpaces C S hS} (g : U' ⟶ G.objects)
    (hg : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (BigFppfOver.topology C S hS) g.hom) :
    IsIso (restrictionQuotientSheafMap G g)
declarations.comment: bijectivity when the restricting morphism is surjective

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.isIso_restrictionQuotientSheafMap_of_isFppfCovering
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044N.** If `g` is a one-member fppf covering, then the map of quotient sheaves
induced by the restriction is bijective.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_restrictionQuotientSheafMap_of_isFppfCovering
    (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B)
    {U' : AlgebraicSpaces C S hS} (g : U' ⟶ G.objects)
    (hg : Space.IsFppfCovering C S hS (fun _ : PUnit ↦ U'.obj) (fun _ ↦ g.hom)) :
    IsIso (restrictionQuotientSheafMap G g)
declarations.comment: the restricting morphism is an fppf covering

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.toGroupoidInFunctors
registrations.comment: the groupoid data on the fppf site

registrations.name: Deformation.evaluationFunctor_groupoid
registrations.comment: each pointwise value is a groupoid

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.quotientStackOfPointsAction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 044Q, part (2)** for an action given on points: the quotient stack
`[X/G]` of a presheaf of groups acting on a presheaf, both represented by objects of the big
fppf site over `S`, read over an algebraic space `B` over `S`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev quotientStackOfPointsAction (B : AlgebraicSpaces 𝒞 S hS)
    (F : (BigFppfOver 𝒞 S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ GrpCat.{u}) (P : (BigFppfOver 𝒞 S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    [ModObj (F ⋙ forget GrpCat) P] {a b : BigFppfOver 𝒞 S hS}
    (r : (F ⋙ forget GrpCat).RepresentableBy a) (s : P.RepresentableBy b) :
    BasedCategory (BigFppfOver 𝒞 S hS)
declarations.comment: part (2) for an action given on points

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isStackInGroupoids_quotientStackOfPointsAction
declarations.doc:
The quotient stack of an action given on points is a stack in groupoids over the big fppf
site.
declarations.statement:
theorem isStackInGroupoids_quotientStackOfPointsAction (B : AlgebraicSpaces 𝒞 S hS)
    (F : (BigFppfOver 𝒞 S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ GrpCat.{u}) (P : (BigFppfOver 𝒞 S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    [ModObj (F ⋙ forget GrpCat) P] {a b : BigFppfOver 𝒞 S hS}
    (r : (F ⋙ forget GrpCat).RepresentableBy a) (s : P.RepresentableBy b) :
    Functor.IsStackInGroupoids (quotientStackOfPointsAction 𝒞 S hS B F P r s).p
      (BigFppfOver.topology 𝒞 S hS)
declarations.comment: part (2) for an action given on points

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.quotientStack
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044Q, part (1).** The quotient stack `[U/R]` of a groupoid in algebraic spaces, as a
category over the original big fppf site: the stackification of the pointwise groupoid
fibration.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def quotientStack
    (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B) :
    BasedCategory (BigFppfOver C S hS)
declarations.comment: part (1): quotient stack of a groupoid

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.quotientStackOfAction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044Q, part (2).** The quotient stack `[X/G]` of an action of a group algebraic
space `G` over `B` on an algebraic space `X` over `B`, as a category over the big fppf site: the
quotient stack of part (1) of the action groupoid `(X, G ×_B X, pr₁, a, m)` of Stacks 0444, that
is, the stackification of the pointwise groupoid fibration of that groupoid.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev quotientStackOfAction
    (B : AlgebraicSpaces C S hS) (G X : Over B.obj) [GrpObj G] [ModObj G X]
    (hG : IsAlgebraicSpace C S hS G.left) (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace C S hS X.left) :
    BasedCategory (BigFppfOver C S hS)
declarations.comment: part (2): quotient stack of an action

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.quotientStackProjection
declarations.doc:
The canonical arrow from the object space of a groupoid in algebraic spaces
to its quotient stack, viewed as a functor over the big fppf site.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def quotientStackProjection
    (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B) :
    BasedFunctor
      (fibredCategory C S hS G.objects.obj).val
      (quotientStack G)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.quotientStackProjection_obj
declarations.doc:
The projection sends a point of the object space to its image under the
canonical map from the pointwise groupoid to its stackification.
declarations.statement:
theorem quotientStackProjection_obj
    (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B)
    (x : (fibredCategory C S hS G.objects.obj).val.obj) :
    (quotientStackProjection G).obj x =
        (pointwiseToQuotientStack G).obj
        ⟨x.base, Discrete.as x.fiber⟩

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.quotientStackProjection_map
declarations.doc:
The projection sends every arrow of the object-space fibration to the
corresponding identity-in-the-fibre arrow of the pointwise groupoid, followed by
stackification.
declarations.statement:
theorem quotientStackProjection_map
    (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B)
    {x y : (fibredCategory C S hS G.objects.obj).val.obj}
    (f : x ⟶ y) :
    ∃ g : (⟨x.base, Discrete.as x.fiber⟩ :
        (presheafOfGroupoids
          (evaluationGroupoidFunctor G.toGroupoidInFunctors)).obj) ⟶
        ⟨y.base, Discrete.as y.fiber⟩,
      g.base = f.base ∧
      (G.toGroupoidInFunctors.evaluationArrowEquiv
        (Opposite.op x.base) _ _ g.fiber).1 =
          G.toGroupoidInFunctors.identity
            (Opposite.op x.base) (Discrete.as x.fiber) ∧
      (quotientStackProjection G).map f =
        eqToHom (quotientStackProjection_obj G x) ≫
          (pointwiseToQuotientStack G).map g ≫
            eqToHom (quotientStackProjection_obj G y).symm

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.quotientStackToBase
declarations.doc:
The second canonical 1-morphism, the structure arrow `[U/R] ⟶ B` from the
quotient stack to the base: the descent of the structure morphism `U ⟶ B` of the object space,
which is invariant because the source and the target of the groupoid are morphisms over `B`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def quotientStackToBase (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B) :
    quotientStack G ⥤ᵇ (fibredCategory C S hS B.obj).val
declarations.comment: the canonical map to the base

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.quotientStackProjection_comp_toBase
declarations.doc:
The composition `U ⟶ [U/R] ⟶ B` is the 1-morphism associated to the
structure morphism `U ⟶ B`.
declarations.statement:
theorem quotientStackProjection_comp_toBase (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B) :
    BasedFunctor.comp (quotientStackProjection G) (quotientStackToBase G) =
      (associatedMap C S hS G.objectsToBase.hom).1.hom

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.quotientStackTwoArrow
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044S.** The canonical 2-morphism between the source and target maps to a quotient
stack, making the square of Stacks 044R 2-commutative. Its components are the images of the
groupoid arrows.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def quotientStackTwoArrow
    (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B) :
    BasedFunctor.comp (associatedMap C S hS G.source.hom).1.hom
        (quotientStackProjection G) ⟶
      BasedFunctor.comp (associatedMap C S hS G.target.hom).1.hom
        (quotientStackProjection G)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.quotientStackTwoArrow_app
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044S.** At a point of the arrow space, the canonical 2-morphism is the image of
that groupoid arrow under the pointwise-groupoid map to the quotient stack.
declarations.statement:
theorem quotientStackTwoArrow_app
    (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B)
    (x : (fibredCategory C S hS G.arrows.obj).val.obj) :
    ∃ g : (⟨x.base, G.source.hom.app (Opposite.op x.base) (Discrete.as x.fiber)⟩ :
          (presheafOfGroupoids
            (evaluationGroupoidFunctor G.toGroupoidInFunctors)).obj) ⟶
        ⟨x.base, G.target.hom.app (Opposite.op x.base) (Discrete.as x.fiber)⟩,
      g.base = 𝟙 x.base ∧
      (G.toGroupoidInFunctors.evaluationArrowEquiv
        (Opposite.op x.base) _ _ g.fiber).1 = Discrete.as x.fiber ∧
      HEq ((quotientStackTwoArrow G).app x) ((pointwiseToQuotientStack G).map g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.quotientStackTwoArrow_source_comp_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044T.** The composite arrow and the second arrow of a composable pair have the same
source in the quotient stack.
declarations.statement:
theorem quotientStackTwoArrow_source_comp_eq
    (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B) :
    let a₁ := (associatedMap C S hS
      (pullback.snd G.source.hom G.target.hom)).1.hom
    let ac := (associatedMap C S hS G.comp.hom).1.hom
    let Fs := BasedFunctor.comp
      (associatedMap C S hS G.source.hom).1.hom
      (quotientStackProjection G)
  BasedFunctor.comp ac Fs = BasedFunctor.comp a₁ Fs

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.quotientStackTwoArrow_middle_comp_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044T.** The target of the second arrow is the source of the first arrow of a
composable pair, as 1-morphisms to the quotient stack.
declarations.statement:
theorem quotientStackTwoArrow_middle_comp_eq
    (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B) :
    let a₀ := (associatedMap C S hS
      (pullback.fst G.source.hom G.target.hom)).1.hom
    let a₁ := (associatedMap C S hS
      (pullback.snd G.source.hom G.target.hom)).1.hom
    let Fs := BasedFunctor.comp
      (associatedMap C S hS G.source.hom).1.hom
      (quotientStackProjection G)
    let Ft := BasedFunctor.comp
      (associatedMap C S hS G.target.hom).1.hom
      (quotientStackProjection G)
  BasedFunctor.comp a₁ Ft = BasedFunctor.comp a₀ Fs

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.quotientStackTwoArrow_target_comp_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044T.** The first arrow of a composable pair and the composite arrow have the same
target in the quotient stack.
declarations.statement:
theorem quotientStackTwoArrow_target_comp_eq
    (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B) :
    let a₀ := (associatedMap C S hS
      (pullback.fst G.source.hom G.target.hom)).1.hom
    let ac := (associatedMap C S hS G.comp.hom).1.hom
    let Ft := BasedFunctor.comp
      (associatedMap C S hS G.target.hom).1.hom
      (quotientStackProjection G)
  BasedFunctor.comp a₀ Ft = BasedFunctor.comp ac Ft

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.quotientStackTwoArrow_cocycle
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044T.** The canonical 2-morphism of a quotient stack sends composition of groupoid
arrows to vertical composition of 2-morphisms.
declarations.statement:
theorem quotientStackTwoArrow_cocycle
    (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B) :
    let a₀ := (associatedMap C S hS
      (pullback.fst G.source.hom G.target.hom)).1.hom
    let a₁ := (associatedMap C S hS
      (pullback.snd G.source.hom G.target.hom)).1.hom
    let ac := (associatedMap C S hS G.comp.hom).1.hom
    let α := quotientStackTwoArrow G
    BasedCategory.whiskerLeft ac α =
      eqToHom (quotientStackTwoArrow_source_comp_eq G) ≫
        BasedCategory.whiskerLeft a₁ α ≫
          eqToHom (quotientStackTwoArrow_middle_comp_eq G) ≫
            BasedCategory.whiskerLeft a₀ α ≫
              eqToHom (quotientStackTwoArrow_target_comp_eq G)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.quotientStack_desc
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044U.** The quotient stack is a 2-coequalizer of the 2-commutative square of
Stacks 044S in the 2-category of stacks in groupoids over the big fppf site: given a stack in
groupoids `X`, a 1-morphism `f : 𝒮_U ⟶ X` out of the object space of a groupoid in algebraic
spaces and a 2-morphism `β : s ∘ f ⟶ t ∘ f` satisfying the composition cocycle on the arrows,
there are a 1-morphism `g : [U/R] ⟶ X` out of the quotient stack and a 2-isomorphism
`α : π ∘ g ≅ f` on the object space which carry the canonical 2-morphism of Stacks 044S to `β`.

The comparison 2-isomorphism is kept as data rather than replaced by the bare existence of some
1-morphism, since the compatibility with the 2-morphism of Stacks 044S is a statement about
it.
declarations.statement:
public theorem quotientStack_desc
    (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B)
    (X : BasedCategory (BigFppfOver C S hS))
    (hX : X.p.IsStackInGroupoids.{u + 1} (BigFppfOver.topology C S hS))
    (f : BasedFunctor (fibredCategory C S hS G.objects.obj).val X)
    (β : BasedFunctor.comp
      (associatedMap C S hS G.source.hom).1.hom f ⟶
      BasedFunctor.comp (associatedMap C S hS G.target.hom).1.hom f)
    (hβ : IsCocycle G X f β) :
    ∃ (g : BasedFunctor (quotientStack G) X)
      (α : BasedFunctor.comp (quotientStackProjection G) g ≅ f),
      BasedCategory.whiskerLeft
          (associatedMap C S hS G.source.hom).1.hom α.hom ≫ β =
        BasedCategory.whiskerRight (quotientStackTwoArrow G) g ≫
          BasedCategory.whiskerLeft
            (associatedMap C S hS G.target.hom).1.hom α.hom

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isomPresheaf_equiv_arrowFiber
declarations.doc:
The canonical map from pointwise groupoid arrows to isomorphisms between
their images in the quotient stack is an isomorphism of presheaves on the
fppf slice site. The pointwise-groupoid morphism presheaf is the fibre of
the arrow space over the chosen pair of object-space points.
declarations.statement:
theorem isomPresheaf_equiv_arrowFiber
    (C : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : C.Contains S)
    {B : AlgebraicSpaces C S hS}
    (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B)
    (T : BigFppfOver C S hS)
    (x y : (quotientPrestack G).p.Fiber T) :
    IsIso ((isFibredOneMorphism_toQuotientStack G).morPresheafMap x y)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isomPresheaf_iso_pullback
declarations.doc:
The isomorphism sheaf of two presented objects is canonically the slice
pullback of the arrow space along their two points. The identification sends
pointwise prestack arrows to their images under `pointwiseToQuotientStack`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isomPresheaf_iso_pullback
    (C : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : C.Contains S)
    {B : AlgebraicSpaces C S hS}
    (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B)
    (T : BigFppfOver C S hS)
    (x' y' : G.objects.obj.obj (Opposite.op T))
    (x y : (quotientStack G).p.Fiber T)
    (hx : x.1 = (pointwiseToQuotientStack G).obj ⟨T, x'⟩)
    (hy : y.1 = (pointwiseToQuotientStack G).obj ⟨T, y'⟩) :
    ∃ e : (arrowFiberOver G T x' y' ⋙ uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}) ≅
        (quotientStack G).p.isomPresheaf x y,
      IsCanonicalArrowFiberIso G T x' y' x y hx hy e
declarations.comment: pullback description of the isomorphism sheaf

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isomPresheafPullbackIso_inv_app
declarations.doc:
The inverse comparison recovers the arrow-space section of each pointwise
prestack arrow from its canonical image in the quotient stack.
declarations.statement:
theorem isomPresheafPullbackIso_inv_app (V : Over T)
    (r : (show G.toGroupoidInFunctors.Evaluation (op V.left) from
        G.objects.obj.map V.hom.op x') ⟶ G.objects.obj.map V.hom.op y') :
    arrowFiberOverSectionArrow G T x' y' V
      ((isomPresheafPullbackIso G T x' y' x y hx hy).inv.app (op V)
        (pointwiseArrowSection G T x' y' x y hx hy V r)).down =
      (G.toGroupoidInFunctors.evaluationArrowEquiv (op V.left) _ _ r).1
declarations.comment: canonical inverse comparison on prestack arrows

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isomPresheafPullbackIso_hom_app
declarations.doc:
The forward comparison sends an arrow-space section to the isomorphism
induced by that very prestack arrow. This rules out translating the identification
by a nonidentity automorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isomPresheafPullbackIso_hom_app (V : Over T)
    (r : (show G.toGroupoidInFunctors.Evaluation (op V.left) from
        G.objects.obj.map V.hom.op x') ⟶ G.objects.obj.map V.hom.op y')
    (s : (arrowFiberOver G T x' y').obj (op V))
    (hs : arrowFiberOverSectionArrow G T x' y' V s =
      (G.toGroupoidInFunctors.evaluationArrowEquiv (op V.left) _ _ r).1) :
    (isomPresheafPullbackIso G T x' y' x y hx hy).hom.app (op V) (ULift.up s) =
      pointwiseArrowSection G T x' y' x y hx hy V r
declarations.comment: canonical forward comparison on prestack arrows

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isomPresheaf_locallyAlgebraicSpace
declarations.doc:
The isomorphism sheaf of two quotient-stack objects is locally
representable by an algebraic space in the fppf topology.
declarations.statement:
theorem isomPresheaf_locallyAlgebraicSpace
    (C : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : C.Contains S)
    {B : AlgebraicSpaces C S hS}
    (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B)
    (T : BigFppfOver C S hS)
    (x y : (quotientStack G).p.Fiber T) :
    ∃ R ∈ BigFppfOver.topology C S hS T,
      ∀ ⦃V : BigFppfOver C S hS⦄ ⦃f : V ⟶ T⦄,
        R.arrows f →
          ∃ F : (BigFppfOver C V.left.1 V.left.2)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u,
            IsAlgebraicSpace C V.left.1 V.left.2 F ∧
              Nonempty (F ⋙ uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u} ≅
                (Over.iteratedSliceBackward V).op ⋙ (Over.map f).op ⋙
                  (quotientStack G).p.isomPresheaf x y)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.essImage_toQuotientStack
declarations.doc:
Every object of the quotient locally comes from the pointwise groupoid presentation: clause
(2) of Stacks 02ZN for this witness, and part (1) of Stacks 044X.
declarations.statement:
theorem essImage_toQuotientStack
    (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B)
    (U : BigFppfOver C S hS) (x : (quotientStack G).p.Fiber U) :
    ∃ R ∈ BigFppfOver.topology C S hS U,
      ∀ ⦃V : BigFppfOver C S hS⦄ ⦃f : V ⟶ U⦄, R.arrows f →
        (Functor.fiberFunctorOfCompEq (isFibredOneMorphism_toQuotientStack G).comp_eq V).essImage
          (Functor.pullbackFiber (quotientStack G).p x f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.fullyFaithful_fiberFunctor_toQuotientStack
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044X**, part (2). A transition isomorphism between two objects of a fibre of the
quotient stack that come from points of the object space is the image under `π` of a unique
arrow of the arrow space: the functor induced by `π` on the fibre over any test object is fully
faithful. This is Stacks 044V read through the identity map of the test object.
declarations.statement:
theorem fullyFaithful_fiberFunctor_toQuotientStack
    (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B)
    (T : BigFppfOver C S hS) :
    Nonempty (Functor.fiberFunctorOfCompEq
      (isFibredOneMorphism_toQuotientStack G).comp_eq T).FullyFaithful

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.presentingDescentFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044X**, parts (2) and (3). The functor on descent data relative to a fixed covering
of a test object induced by the canonical 1-morphism `π : 𝒮_U ⟶ [U/R]`: a system `(u i, r i j)`
of points of the object space and arrows of the arrow space is carried to the descent datum of
`[U/R]` whose local objects are the `π (u i)` and whose transition isomorphisms are the images
`π (r i j)`, conjugated by the canonical comparison between the chosen pullback of an image and
the image of a chosen pullback. Part (3), that `(u i, r i j)` *is* a descent datum, is the
hypothesis on the source; the content here is that its image is one for the quotient.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def presentingDescentFunctor
    (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B)
    {T : BigFppfOver C S hS} (𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{w} T) :
    Functor.FamilyDescentDatum (quotientPrestack G).p 𝒰 ⥤
      Functor.FamilyDescentDatum (quotientStack G).p 𝒰
declarations.comment: parts (2) and (3): projection of presenting data

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.presentingDescentFunctor_obj
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044X**, part (2). The local objects of the projected descent datum are the images
under `π` of the local points of the object space.
declarations.statement:
theorem presentingDescentFunctor_obj
    (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B)
    {T : BigFppfOver C S hS} (𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{w} T)
    (D : Functor.FamilyDescentDatum (quotientPrestack G).p 𝒰)
    (i : 𝒰.I₀) :
    ((presentingDescentFunctor G 𝒰).obj D).obj i =
      (Functor.fiberFunctorOfCompEq
        (isFibredOneMorphism_toQuotientStack G).comp_eq
        (𝒰.X i)).obj (D.obj i)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.presentingDescentFunctor_hom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044X**, part (2). The transition isomorphism of the projected descent datum on an
overlap is the image under `π` of the arrow of the arrow space, conjugated by the canonical
comparisons between the chosen pullbacks of the images and the images of the chosen
pullbacks.
declarations.statement:
theorem presentingDescentFunctor_hom
    (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B)
    {T : BigFppfOver C S hS} (𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{w} T)
    (D : Functor.FamilyDescentDatum (quotientPrestack G).p 𝒰)
    {W : BigFppfOver C S hS} (q : W ⟶ T)
    {i j : 𝒰.I₀} (a : W ⟶ 𝒰.X i) (b : W ⟶ 𝒰.X j)
    (ha : a ≫ 𝒰.f i = q) (hb : b ≫ 𝒰.f j = q) :
    HEq (((presentingDescentFunctor G 𝒰).obj D).hom q a b ha hb)
      (((isFibredOneMorphism_toQuotientStack G).mapPullbackFiberIso
        (D.obj i) a).hom ≫
      (Functor.fiberFunctorOfCompEq
        (isFibredOneMorphism_toQuotientStack G).comp_eq W).map
          (D.hom q a b ha hb) ≫
      ((isFibredOneMorphism_toQuotientStack G).mapPullbackFiberIso
        (D.obj j) b).inv)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.presentingDescentFunctor_map_hom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044X**, part (5). On morphisms the projection applies `π` to each local arrow of
the arrow space.
declarations.statement:
theorem presentingDescentFunctor_map_hom
    (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B)
    {T : BigFppfOver C S hS} (𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{w} T)
    {D E : Functor.FamilyDescentDatum (quotientPrestack G).p 𝒰}
    (f : D ⟶ E) (i : 𝒰.I₀) :
    HEq (((presentingDescentFunctor G 𝒰).map f).hom i)
      ((Functor.fiberFunctorOfCompEq
        (isFibredOneMorphism_toQuotientStack G).comp_eq
        (𝒰.X i)).map (f.hom i))
declarations.comment: part (5): local arrows of the projected morphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.exists_presentingDescentDatum
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044X**, parts (1)–(3). Every object `x` of a fibre of the quotient stack is, after
an fppf covering of the test object, the projection of a descent datum for the pointwise
groupoid presentation: there is a covering `𝒰` indexed in the universe of the site, a system
`(u i, r i j)` of points of the object space and arrows of the arrow space forming a descent
datum for the presentation relative to `𝒰`, and an isomorphism between the canonical descent
datum of `x` and the projection of that system. The local isomorphisms `f i ^* x ≅ π (u i)` and
their transition arrows are the components of that isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_presentingDescentDatum
    (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B)
    (T : BigFppfOver C S hS)
    (x : (quotientStack G).p.Fiber T) :
    ∃ (𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{u} T)
      (_ : 𝒰.sieve₀ ∈ BigFppfOver.topology C S hS T)
      (D : Functor.FamilyDescentDatum (quotientPrestack G).p 𝒰),
      Nonempty (((Functor.toFamilyDescentDatum
        (quotientStack G).p 𝒰).obj x) ≅
          (presentingDescentFunctor G 𝒰).obj D)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.effective_presentingDescentDatum
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044X**, part (4). Every descent datum for the pointwise groupoid presentation
relative to an fppf covering arises as in parts (1)–(3): its projection is the canonical descent
datum of an object of the fibre of the quotient stack over the test object. This is the
effectivity of descent data in the stack `[U/R]`.
declarations.statement:
theorem effective_presentingDescentDatum
    (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B)
    {T : BigFppfOver C S hS} (𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{w} T)
    (h𝒰 : 𝒰.sieve₀ ∈ BigFppfOver.topology C S hS T)
    (D : Functor.FamilyDescentDatum (quotientPrestack G).p 𝒰) :
    ∃ x : (quotientStack G).p.Fiber T,
      Nonempty (((Functor.toFamilyDescentDatum
        (quotientStack G).p 𝒰).obj x) ≅
          (presentingDescentFunctor G 𝒰).obj D)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.fullyFaithful_presentingDescentFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044X**, part (5). For a fixed covering the projection is fully faithful on descent
data for the presentation: a morphism of the projected data is the image of a unique compatible
family of arrows of the arrow space.
declarations.statement:
theorem fullyFaithful_presentingDescentFunctor
    (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B)
    {T : BigFppfOver C S hS} (𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{w} T) :
    Nonempty (presentingDescentFunctor G 𝒰).FullyFaithful

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.homEquiv_presentingDescentDatum
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044X**, part (5). The canonical bijection between the morphisms `x ⟶ y` of a fibre
of the quotient stack and the morphisms of the descent data for the presentation that represent
`x` and `y`, together with the equation that characterises it: the projection of the morphism of
descent data is the canonical descent datum morphism of `f`, conjugated by the two
representing isomorphisms.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def homEquiv_presentingDescentDatum
    (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B)
    {T : BigFppfOver C S hS} (𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{w} T)
    (h𝒰 : 𝒰.sieve₀ ∈ BigFppfOver.topology C S hS T)
    (x y : (quotientStack G).p.Fiber T)
    (D E : Functor.FamilyDescentDatum (quotientPrestack G).p 𝒰)
    (δ : (Functor.toFamilyDescentDatum (quotientStack G).p 𝒰).obj x ≅
      (presentingDescentFunctor G 𝒰).obj D)
    (ε : (Functor.toFamilyDescentDatum (quotientStack G).p 𝒰).obj y ≅
      (presentingDescentFunctor G 𝒰).obj E) :
    {e : (x ⟶ y) ≃ (D ⟶ E) //
      ∀ f, (presentingDescentFunctor G 𝒰).map (e f) = δ.inv ≫
        (Functor.toFamilyDescentDatum (quotientStack G).p 𝒰).map f ≫ ε.hom}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.presentingDescentFunctor_refinementIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044X**, part (6). The correspondence of parts (1)–(5) is compatible with refinement
of the fppf covering: projecting a descent datum for the presentation and then pulling it back
along a refinement is naturally isomorphic to pulling it back first and then projecting, and the
isomorphism is natural in the descent datum, hence compatible with the bijection of part (5).
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def presentingDescentFunctor_refinementIso
    (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B)
    {T : BigFppfOver C S hS}
    {𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{w} T} {𝒱 : PreZeroHypercover.{w} T}
    (Φ : 𝒱.HomOver 𝒰 (𝟙 T)) :
    presentingDescentFunctor G 𝒰 ⋙
        Functor.FamilyDescentDatum.pullFunctor (quotientStack G).p Φ ≅
      Functor.FamilyDescentDatum.pullFunctor (quotientPrestack G).p Φ ⋙
        presentingDescentFunctor G 𝒱

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.isInvariantOpen_largestOpenSubspace_source
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 044Z.** Let `G` be a groupoid in algebraic spaces whose source and target
morphisms are both coverings for a topology `τ` other than the fpqc topology, and let `P` be a
property of morphisms of algebraic spaces local on the target for `τ`. The largest open
subspace of the object space over which the restriction of the source morphism has `P` is
invariant under `G`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isInvariantOpen_largestOpenSubspace_source (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B)
    (τ : Space.Topology) (hτ : τ ≠ .fpqc) (P : MorphismProperty (AlgebraicSpaces C S hS))
    [P.IsLocalAtTarget (Space.Topology.precoverage.{u, u + 1} τ C S hS)]
    (hs : τ.IsCovering C S hS (fun _ : Unit => G.arrows.obj) (fun _ => G.source.hom))
    (ht : τ.IsCovering C S hS (fun _ : Unit => G.arrows.obj) (fun _ => G.target.hom)) :
    IsInvariantOpen G (Space.largestOpenSubspace C S hS τ hτ P G.source).1.1

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.commonTargetPairsIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0450.** The canonical comparison `(α, β) ↦ (α, α⁻¹ ∘ β)` of the space of pairs of
arrows of a groupoid in algebraic spaces with a common target with the space of composable pairs
of arrows.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def commonTargetPairsIso (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B) :
    AlgebraicSpaces.fiberProduct C S hS G.target G.target ≅
      AlgebraicSpaces.fiberProduct C S hS G.source G.target
declarations.comment: the comparison of the two upper rows

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.commonTargetPairsIso_hom_fst
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0450.** The comparison of pairs with a common target with composable pairs
preserves the first arrow.
declarations.statement:
theorem commonTargetPairsIso_hom_fst (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B) :
    (commonTargetPairsIso G).hom ≫
        (ObjectProperty.homMk (pullback.fst G.source.hom G.target.hom) :
          AlgebraicSpaces.fiberProduct C S hS G.source G.target ⟶ G.arrows) =
      ObjectProperty.homMk (pullback.fst G.target.hom G.target.hom)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.commonTargetPairsIso_hom_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0450.** Composing the comparison of pairs with a common target with composable pairs
and the composition of the groupoid recovers the second arrow.
declarations.statement:
theorem commonTargetPairsIso_hom_comp (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B) :
    (commonTargetPairsIso G).hom ≫ G.comp =
      ObjectProperty.homMk (pullback.snd G.target.hom G.target.hom)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.commonTargetPairsIso_inv_fst
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0450.** The inverse comparison, from composable pairs to pairs with a common target,
preserves the first arrow.
declarations.statement:
theorem commonTargetPairsIso_inv_fst (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B) :
    (commonTargetPairsIso G).inv ≫
        (ObjectProperty.homMk (pullback.fst G.target.hom G.target.hom) :
          AlgebraicSpaces.fiberProduct C S hS G.target G.target ⟶ G.arrows) =
      ObjectProperty.homMk (pullback.fst G.source.hom G.target.hom)
declarations.comment: the inverse comparison on the first projection

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.commonTargetPairsIso_inv_snd
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0450.** The inverse comparison, from composable pairs to pairs with a common target,
sends the second arrow to the composite.
declarations.statement:
theorem commonTargetPairsIso_inv_snd (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B) :
    (commonTargetPairsIso G).inv ≫
        (ObjectProperty.homMk (pullback.snd G.target.hom G.target.hom) :
          AlgebraicSpaces.fiberProduct C S hS G.target G.target ⟶ G.arrows) =
      G.comp
declarations.comment: the inverse comparison on the second projection

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.comp_source_eq_snd_source
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0450**, the commutativity of the lower square for composition: `c ≫ s = pr₁ ≫ s`.
The composite of a composable pair of arrows of a groupoid in algebraic spaces has the same
source as the second arrow of the pair.
declarations.statement:
theorem comp_source_eq_snd_source (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B) :
    G.comp ≫ G.source =
      (ObjectProperty.homMk (pullback.snd G.source.hom G.target.hom) :
        AlgebraicSpaces.fiberProduct C S hS G.source G.target ⟶ G.arrows) ≫ G.source
declarations.comment: commutativity of the lower square for composition, c ≫ s = pr₁ ≫ s

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.fst_source_eq_snd_target
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0450**, the commutativity of the lower square for the projections:
`pr₀ ≫ s = pr₁ ≫ t`. The first arrow of a composable pair of arrows of a groupoid in algebraic
spaces has as its source the target of the second arrow of the pair.
declarations.statement:
theorem fst_source_eq_snd_target (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B) :
    (ObjectProperty.homMk (pullback.fst G.source.hom G.target.hom) :
        AlgebraicSpaces.fiberProduct C S hS G.source G.target ⟶ G.arrows) ≫ G.source =
      (ObjectProperty.homMk (pullback.snd G.source.hom G.target.hom) :
        AlgebraicSpaces.fiberProduct C S hS G.source G.target ⟶ G.arrows) ≫ G.target
declarations.comment: commutativity of the lower square for the projections, pr₀ ≫ s = pr₁ ≫ t

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.isPullback_fst_snd_source_target
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0450**, the lower-left square for the projections. The two projections out of the
space of composable pairs of arrows of a groupoid in algebraic spaces form a cartesian square
with the source and the target morphisms: a composable pair is exactly a pair of arrows whose
first arrow has as its source the target of the second.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPullback_fst_snd_source_target (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B) :
    IsPullback
      (ObjectProperty.homMk (pullback.fst G.source.hom G.target.hom) :
        AlgebraicSpaces.fiberProduct C S hS G.source G.target ⟶ G.arrows)
      (ObjectProperty.homMk (pullback.snd G.source.hom G.target.hom) :
        AlgebraicSpaces.fiberProduct C S hS G.source G.target ⟶ G.arrows)
      G.source G.target
declarations.comment: the lower-left square for the projections is cartesian

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.AlgebraicSpaces.isPullback_fiberProduct
registrations.comment: the lower-left square for the projections

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.commonTargetPairsIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0450.** The canonical comparison `(α, β) ↦ (α, α⁻¹ ∘ β)` of the space of pairs of
arrows of a groupoid in algebraic spaces with a common target with the space of composable pairs
of arrows.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def commonTargetPairsIso (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B) :
    AlgebraicSpaces.fiberProduct C S hS G.target G.target ≅
      AlgebraicSpaces.fiberProduct C S hS G.source G.target
declarations.comment: the displayed diagram, through its vertical comparison pr_0 × c ∘ (i,1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.comp_source_eq_snd_source
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0450**, the commutativity of the lower square for composition: `c ≫ s = pr₁ ≫ s`.
The composite of a composable pair of arrows of a groupoid in algebraic spaces has the same
source as the second arrow of the pair.
declarations.statement:
theorem comp_source_eq_snd_source (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B) :
    G.comp ≫ G.source =
      (ObjectProperty.homMk (pullback.snd G.source.hom G.target.hom) :
        AlgebraicSpaces.fiberProduct C S hS G.source G.target ⟶ G.arrows) ≫ G.source
declarations.comment: commutativity of the upper of the two lower left squares

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.fst_source_eq_snd_target
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0450**, the commutativity of the lower square for the projections:
`pr₀ ≫ s = pr₁ ≫ t`. The first arrow of a composable pair of arrows of a groupoid in algebraic
spaces has as its source the target of the second arrow of the pair.
declarations.statement:
theorem fst_source_eq_snd_target (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B) :
    (ObjectProperty.homMk (pullback.fst G.source.hom G.target.hom) :
        AlgebraicSpaces.fiberProduct C S hS G.source G.target ⟶ G.arrows) ≫ G.source =
      (ObjectProperty.homMk (pullback.snd G.source.hom G.target.hom) :
        AlgebraicSpaces.fiberProduct C S hS G.source G.target ⟶ G.arrows) ≫ G.target
declarations.comment: commutativity of the lower of the two lower left squares

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.isPullback_fst_snd_source_target
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0450**, the lower-left square for the projections. The two projections out of the
space of composable pairs of arrows of a groupoid in algebraic spaces form a cartesian square
with the source and the target morphisms: a composable pair is exactly a pair of arrows whose
first arrow has as its source the target of the second.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPullback_fst_snd_source_target (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B) :
    IsPullback
      (ObjectProperty.homMk (pullback.fst G.source.hom G.target.hom) :
        AlgebraicSpaces.fiberProduct C S hS G.source G.target ⟶ G.arrows)
      (ObjectProperty.homMk (pullback.snd G.source.hom G.target.hom) :
        AlgebraicSpaces.fiberProduct C S hS G.source G.target ⟶ G.arrows)
      G.source G.target
declarations.comment: the lower of the two lower left squares is cartesian

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.commonTargetPairsComparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0451.** The vertical comparison `pr_0 × c ∘ (i, 1)` of the diagram: it sends a pair
`(α, β)` of arrows with a common target to the composable pair `(α, α⁻¹ ∘ β)`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def commonTargetPairsComparison (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B) :
    AlgebraicSpaces.fiberProduct C S hS G.target G.target ⟶
      AlgebraicSpaces.fiberProduct C S hS G.source G.target

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.commonTargetPairsComparison_comp_firstArrow
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0451**, the lower of the two squares on the left of the top two rows: the vertical
comparison preserves the first arrow.
declarations.statement:
theorem commonTargetPairsComparison_comp_firstArrow
    (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B) :
    commonTargetPairsComparison G ≫ firstArrow G = commonTargetFirstArrow G
declarations.comment: the lower square on the left of the top two rows

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.commonTargetPairsComparison_comp_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0451**, the upper of the two squares on the left of the top two rows: composing the
vertical comparison with the composition of the groupoid recovers the second arrow, because
`α ∘ (α⁻¹ ∘ β) = β`.
declarations.statement:
theorem commonTargetPairsComparison_comp_comp (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B) :
    commonTargetPairsComparison G ≫ G.comp = commonTargetSecondArrow G
declarations.comment: the upper square on the left of the top two rows

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.commonTargetPairsIso_hom_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0451.** The vertical comparison drawn in the diagram, `pr_0 × c ∘ (i, 1)`, is the
canonical comparison of the two fibre products, hence an isomorphism: this is the assertion that
the two top rows of the diagram are isomorphic via the vertical maps given, the other two
vertical maps being the identities.
declarations.statement:
theorem commonTargetPairsIso_hom_eq (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B) :
    (commonTargetPairsIso G).hom = commonTargetPairsComparison G
declarations.comment: the two top rows are isomorphic via the vertical maps given

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.id_comp_target
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0451**, the square on the right of the top two rows: both of its vertical maps are
identities, of the arrow space and of the object space, and its two horizontal maps are the
target.
declarations.statement:
theorem id_comp_target (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B) :
    𝟙 G.arrows ≫ G.target = G.target ≫ 𝟙 G.objects
declarations.comment: the square on the right of the top two rows

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isPullback_comp_source
registrations.comment: the upper of the two lower left squares is cartesian

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.sourceFibersIsoOfTargetEq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0452.** Two arrows of a groupoid in algebraic spaces over a test algebraic space
`X` with the same target have isomorphic source fibres over `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem sourceFibersIsoOfTargetEq (C : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : C.Contains S)
    (B : AlgebraicSpaces C S hS) (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B)
    (X : AlgebraicSpaces C S hS) (r r' : X ⟶ G.arrows)
    (h : r ≫ G.target = r' ≫ G.target) :
    Nonempty
      ((Over.mk
          (ObjectProperty.homMk (pullback.fst (r ≫ G.source).hom G.source.hom) :
            AlgebraicSpaces.fiberProduct C S hS (r ≫ G.source) G.source ⟶ X) :
          Over X) ≅
       (Over.mk
          (ObjectProperty.homMk (pullback.fst (r' ≫ G.source).hom G.source.hom) :
            AlgebraicSpaces.fiberProduct C S hS (r' ≫ G.source) G.source ⟶ X) :
          Over X))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.isIso_arrowToArrowsOverObjects
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0454.** The upper horizontal morphism `f ↦ (f, s f)` of the diagram is an
isomorphism, its inverse being the first projection of `R ×_{s, U} U`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_arrowToArrowsOverObjects (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B) :
    IsIso (arrowToArrowsOverObjects G)
declarations.comment: the upper horizontal morphism is an isomorphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.isIso_arrowPairsToArrowsOverStabilizer
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0454.** The lower horizontal morphism `(f, g) ↦ (f, f⁻¹ g)` of the diagram is an
isomorphism, its inverse being `(f, h) ↦ (f, f h)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_arrowPairsToArrowsOverStabilizer
    (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B) :
    IsIso (arrowPairsToArrowsOverStabilizer G)
declarations.comment: the lower horizontal morphism is an isomorphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.diagonal_comp_arrowPairsToArrowsOverStabilizer
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0454.** The left hand square of the diagram commutes: the relative diagonal of
`j = (t, s)`, followed by `(f, g) ↦ (f, f⁻¹ g)`, is `f ↦ (f, s f)` followed by the unit
section of the stabilizer.
declarations.statement:
theorem diagonal_comp_arrowPairsToArrowsOverStabilizer
    (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B) :
    pullback.diagonal (sourceTarget G).hom ≫ arrowPairsToArrowsOverStabilizer G =
      arrowToArrowsOverObjects G ≫ arrowsOverObjectsUnit G
declarations.comment: commutativity of the left hand square

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.isPullback_stabilizerUnit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0454.** The right hand square of the diagram is cartesian: `R ×_{s, U} S` is the
base change of the unit section `e : U ⟶ S` of the stabilizer along the projection
`R ×_{s, U} S ⟶ S`, the base change being `R ×_{s, U} U`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPullback_stabilizerUnit (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B) :
    IsPullback (arrowsOverObjectsToObjects G) (arrowsOverObjectsUnit G)
      (η[stabilizer G]).left (arrowsOverStabilizerToStabilizer G)
declarations.comment: the right hand square is cartesian

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.isSeparated_stabilizer_iff_unit_closedImmersion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0455.** The structure morphism of the stabilizer of a groupoid in algebraic spaces
is separated exactly when the unit section of the stabilizer is a closed immersion.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSeparated_stabilizer_iff_unit_closedImmersion
    (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B) :
    Space.IsSeparated C S hS (stabilizer G).hom ↔
      Space.IsClosedImmersion C S hS (η[stabilizer G]).left

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.isSeparated_sourceTarget_iff_stabilizer
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0455.** The source-target morphism of a groupoid in algebraic spaces is separated
exactly when the structure morphism of its stabilizer is separated.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSeparated_sourceTarget_iff_stabilizer (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B) :
    Space.IsSeparated C S hS (sourceTarget G).hom ↔
      Space.IsSeparated C S hS (stabilizer G).hom

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.isLocallySeparated_stabilizer_iff_unit_immersion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0455.** The structure morphism of the stabilizer of a groupoid in algebraic spaces
is locally separated exactly when the unit section of the stabilizer is an immersion.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallySeparated_stabilizer_iff_unit_immersion
    (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B) :
    Space.IsLocallySeparated C S hS (stabilizer G).hom ↔
      Space.IsImmersion C S hS (η[stabilizer G]).left

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.isLocallySeparated_sourceTarget_iff_stabilizer
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0455.** The source-target morphism of a groupoid in algebraic spaces is locally
separated exactly when the structure morphism of its stabilizer is locally separated.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallySeparated_sourceTarget_iff_stabilizer
    (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B) :
    Space.IsLocallySeparated C S hS (sourceTarget G).hom ↔
      Space.IsLocallySeparated C S hS (stabilizer G).hom

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.isQuasiSeparated_stabilizer_iff_unit_quasiCompact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0455.** The structure morphism of the stabilizer of a groupoid in algebraic spaces
is quasi-separated exactly when the unit section of the stabilizer is quasi-compact.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasiSeparated_stabilizer_iff_unit_quasiCompact
    (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B) :
    Space.IsQuasiSeparated C S hS (stabilizer G).hom ↔
      Space.IsQuasiCompact C S hS (η[stabilizer G]).left

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.isQuasiSeparated_sourceTarget_iff_stabilizer
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0455.** The source-target morphism of a groupoid in algebraic spaces is
quasi-separated exactly when the structure morphism of its stabilizer is quasi-separated.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasiSeparated_sourceTarget_iff_stabilizer
    (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B) :
    Space.IsQuasiSeparated C S hS (sourceTarget G).hom ↔
      Space.IsQuasiSeparated C S hS (stabilizer G).hom

declarations.name: Stacks.RepresentableMorphism.isRepresentableMorphism_iff_of_equivalences
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0456.** Representability of a 1-morphism of categories fibred in
groupoids is invariant under equivalences in a 2-commutative square.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isRepresentableMorphism_iff_of_equivalences
    (f' : 𝒳' ⟶ 𝒴') (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (a : 𝒳' ⟶ 𝒳) (b : 𝒴' ⟶ 𝒴)
    (α : a ≫ f ≅ f' ≫ b)
    [Functor.IsEquivalence (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor a)]
    [Functor.IsEquivalence (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor b)] :
    Stacks.RepresentableMorphism.IsRepresentableMorphism 𝒳.val.p 𝒴.val.p
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f) ↔
    Stacks.RepresentableMorphism.IsRepresentableMorphism 𝒳'.val.p 𝒴'.val.p
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f')

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_iff_of_equivalences
declarations.doc:
Representability by algebraic spaces of a morphism of categories fibred in groupoids is
invariant under horizontal equivalences in a 2-commutative square.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.associatedMap
declarations.doc:
The 1-morphism of categories fibred in groupoids induced by a map `a` of set-valued
presheaves, together with its value on objects: it sends `(U, x)` to `(U, a_U(x))`.
declarations.statement:
def associatedMap
    {F G : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (a : F ⟶ G) :
    {f : fibredCategory B S hS F ⟶ fibredCategory B S hS G //
      ∀ x : (fibredCategory B S hS F).val.obj,
      HEq ((CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f).obj x).fiber
          (Discrete.mk (a.app (Opposite.op x.base)
            (Discrete.as (show Discrete (F.obj (Opposite.op x.base)) from x.fiber))))}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.associatedMap_obj
declarations.doc:
The 1-morphism attached to a map `a : F ⟶ G` of set-valued presheaves sends the pair
`(U, x)` to the pair `(U, a_U(x))`.
declarations.statement:
theorem associatedMap_obj
    {F G : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (a : F ⟶ G)
    (x : (fibredCategory B S hS F).val.obj) :
    (associatedMap B S hS a).1.hom.obj x =
      ⟨x.base, Discrete.mk (a.app (Opposite.op x.base) x.fiber.as)⟩

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.associatedMap_comp
declarations.doc:
The 1-morphism attached to a composite of maps of presheaves is the composite of the two
attached 1-morphisms.
declarations.statement:
theorem associatedMap_comp {F G H : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (a : F ⟶ G) (b : G ⟶ H) :
    (associatedMap B S hS (a ≫ b)).1 =
      (associatedMap B S hS a).1 ≫ (associatedMap B S hS b).1

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_iff_associatedMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0458**, representability equivalence. A map `a : F ⟶ G` of set-valued presheaves on
the big fppf site of `S` is representable by algebraic spaces exactly when the 1-morphism of
categories fibred in groupoids it induces, `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.associatedMap`, is.

A scheme-valued point of the category of elements of `G` over a scheme `U` over `S` and a section
of `G` over `U` naming the same family of elements have the same base change of `a`: the presheaf
representing the base change of the 1-morphism along the point is the fibre of `a` over the
section, and the relocalization of that fibre along the structure morphism of `U` is the base
change of `a` along the section.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_iff_associatedMap
    {F G : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (a : F ⟶ G) :
    Space.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS a ↔
      IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS (associatedMap B S hS a).1.hom

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.hasRelativeProperty_iff_of_equivalences
declarations.doc:
In a 2-commutative square of categories fibred in groupoids over the big fppf site of `S`
whose two horizontal 1-morphisms are equivalences, a vertical 1-morphism representable by
algebraic spaces has the relative property `P` of Stacks 03YK if and only if the other vertical
1-morphism does. Representability of `f'` is deduced from that of `f`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasRelativeProperty_iff_of_equivalences
    (P : MorphismProperty (AlgebraicSpaces B S hS))
    [P.IsStableUnderBaseChange]
    [P.IsLocalAtTarget (Space.Topology.fppf.precoverage B S hS)]
    (f' : 𝒳' ⟶ 𝒴') (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (a : 𝒳'.val ⥤ᵇ 𝒳.val) (b : 𝒴'.val ⥤ᵇ 𝒴.val)
    (α : BasedFunctor.comp a f.hom ≅ BasedFunctor.comp f'.hom b)
    [Functor.IsEquivalence a.toFunctor] [Functor.IsEquivalence b.toFunctor]
    (hf : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS f.hom) :
    HasRelativeProperty.{u, v₂, w₂} B S hS P f hf ↔
      HasRelativeProperty.{u, v₁, w₁} B S hS P f'
        ((isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_iff_of_equivalences B S hS f'.hom f.hom a b α).mp
          hf)
declarations.comment: a vertical 1-morphism of a 2-commutative square whose horizontals are equivalences has the relative property exactly when the other vertical one does

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.hasRelativeProperty_iff_of_equivalences'
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0459.** In a 2-commutative square of categories fibred in groupoids over the big fppf
site of `S` whose two horizontal 1-morphisms are equivalences, a vertical 1-morphism representable
by algebraic spaces has the relative property at `P` of **Stacks 03YK** exactly when the other
one does.

The forward direction is `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.hasRelativeProperty_of_equivalences` and the
reverse one `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.relativeProperty_of_equivalences_symm`; neither uses any
hypothesis on `P`, which is carried only because the statement mentions the abbreviation.

The representability witness for `f'` is an arbitrary one, which is what distinguishes this from
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.hasRelativeProperty_iff_of_equivalences` of
`StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.Stacks.RelativePropertyEquivalence`: that form reads the witness
for `f'` off the one for `f` through Stacks 0457, and is the special case of this one at that
witness.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasRelativeProperty_iff_of_equivalences' (P : MorphismProperty (AlgebraicSpaces B S hS))
    [P.IsStableUnderBaseChange]
    [P.IsLocalAtTarget (Space.Topology.fppf.precoverage B S hS)]
    (f' : 𝒳' ⟶ 𝒴') (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (a : 𝒳'.val ⥤ᵇ 𝒳.val) (b : 𝒴'.val ⥤ᵇ 𝒴.val)
    (α : BasedFunctor.comp a f.hom ≅ BasedFunctor.comp f'.hom b)
    [Functor.IsEquivalence a.toFunctor] [Functor.IsEquivalence b.toFunctor]
    (hf : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS f.hom)
    (hf' : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS f'.hom) :
    HasRelativeProperty.{u, v₂, w₂} B S hS P f hf ↔
      HasRelativeProperty.{u, v₁, w₁} B S hS P f' hf'
declarations.comment: the same biconditional assembled from the two one-directional statements

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.holdsOnEverySchemePoint_iff_hasRelativeProperty
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 045A.** Let `P` be a property of morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` which is
stable under base change and local on the target for the fppf precoverage. A map `a : F ⟶ G` of
presheaves on the big fppf site of `S` which is representable by algebraic spaces has `P` in the
sense of Stacks 03XZ exactly when the 1-morphism of categories fibred in groupoids attached to it
by Stacks 0458 has the relative property `P` of Stacks 03YK.
declarations.statement:
theorem holdsOnEverySchemePoint_iff_hasRelativeProperty
    (P : MorphismProperty (AlgebraicSpaces B S hS))
    [P.IsStableUnderBaseChange]
    [P.IsLocalAtTarget (Space.Topology.fppf.precoverage B S hS)]
    {F G : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (a : F ⟶ G)
    (ha : Space.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS a) :
    Space.HasProperty B S hS P a ha ↔
      HasRelativeProperty B S hS P (associatedMap B S hS a).1
        ((isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_iff_associatedMap B S hS a).1 ha)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.hasRelativeProperty_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 045B.** Let `P` be a property of morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` which is
stable under base change, local on the target for the fppf precoverage, and stable under
composition. If two composable 1-morphisms of categories fibred in groupoids over the big fppf
site of `S` are representable by algebraic spaces and have the relative property `P` of Stacks
03YK, then so does their composite.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasRelativeProperty_comp
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (P : MorphismProperty (AlgebraicSpaces B S hS))
    [P.IsStableUnderBaseChange]
    [P.IsLocalAtTarget (Space.Topology.fppf.precoverage.{u, t} B S hS)]
    [P.IsStableUnderComposition]
    {𝒳 𝒴 𝒵 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, v, u + 1, w} (BigFppfOver B S hS)}
    (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (g : 𝒴 ⟶ 𝒵)
    (hf : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS f.hom)
    (hg : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS g.hom)
    (hPf : HasRelativeProperty B S hS P f hf)
    (hPg : HasRelativeProperty B S hS P g hg) :
    HasRelativeProperty B S hS P (f ≫ g)
      (isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_comp B S hS f g hf hg)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isImmersion_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 045C at the immersion property of Stacks 04XB.** In a 2-fibre product square over a
cospan `g : 𝒵 ⟶ 𝒴`, `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` of categories fibred in groupoids over the big fppf site of `S`,
the projection to `𝒵` is an immersion as soon as `f` is.
declarations.statement:
theorem isImmersion_baseChange
    (𝒳 𝒴 𝒵 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, max u v, u + 1, max (max (u + 1) w) v}
      (BigFppfOver B S hS))
    (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (g : 𝒵 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (R : Bicategory.TwoCommSq g f) (hR : Bicategory.IsTwoFibreProduct R)
    (hf : Stack.IsImmersion B S hS f) :
    Stack.IsImmersion B S hS R.fst
declarations.comment: the immersion property of Stacks 04XB, for the first projection

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isImmersion_twoFibreProductSnd
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 045C at the immersion property, for the second projection.** The second projection
of the canonical 2-fibre product square over a cospan `(g, f)` of categories fibred in groupoids
is an immersion as soon as `g` is.
declarations.statement:
theorem isImmersion_twoFibreProductSnd
    {𝒵 𝒴 𝒳 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, u, u + 1, u + 1} (BigFppfOver B S hS)}
    (g : 𝒵 ⟶ 𝒴) (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (hg : Stack.IsImmersion B S hS g) :
    Stack.IsImmersion B S hS
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.twoFibreProductSquare.{u, u, u + 1, u + 1} g f).snd
declarations.comment: the immersion property of Stacks 04XB, for the canonical second projection

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isImmersion_snd_of_isTwoFibreProduct
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 045C at the immersion property, for the second projection of a 2-fibre product
square of algebraic stacks.** If `g : 𝒵 ⟶ 𝒴` is an immersion in the sense of Stacks 04XB and `P`
is a 2-fibre product of the cospan `(g, f)` in the 2-category of algebraic stacks, then so is
`P.snd : P.pt ⟶ 𝒳`.

The statement is obtained at the canonical square — where the stronger terminality hypothesis of
Stacks 045C holds unconditionally — and transported to `P` along the comparison 1-morphism by
Stacks 0457 for the relative property.
declarations.statement:
theorem isImmersion_snd_of_isTwoFibreProduct
    (P : Bicategory.TwoCommSq g f) (hP : Bicategory.IsTwoFibreProduct P)
    (hg : Stack.IsImmersion B S hS g.hom) :
    Stack.IsImmersion B S hS P.snd.hom
declarations.comment: the immersion property of Stacks 04XB, at a 2-fibre product of algebraic stacks

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isImmersion_snd_of_isTwoFibreProduct
declarations.doc:
Base change of an immersion of algebraic stacks. If `g : 𝒵 ⟶ 𝒴` is an immersion of
algebraic stacks over `S` and `P` is a 2-fibre product of the cospan `(g, f)` in the 2-category of
algebraic stacks, then `P.snd : P.pt ⟶ 𝒳` is an immersion of algebraic stacks.

Both halves are base-change statements: representability by algebraic spaces is Stacks 0302 and
the immersion property of Stacks 04XB is Stacks 045C. The attribute records the latter, at the
level of algebraic stacks. It deliberately does **not** record Stacks 04YL: that tag is a
definition — its three parts define open immersions, closed immersions and immersions in terms
of Section 04XB — and says nothing about stability under base change, so a theorem must not
carry it. The definition itself is carried by `AlgebraicStacks.IsImmersion`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isImmersion_snd_of_isTwoFibreProduct
    (P : Bicategory.TwoCommSq g f) (hP : Bicategory.IsTwoFibreProduct P)
    (hg : IsImmersion B S hS g) :
    IsImmersion B S hS P.snd
declarations.comment: the immersion property of Stacks 04XB, conjoined with representability, at a 2-fibre product of algebraic stacks

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.hasRelativeProperty_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 045C.** Let `P` be a property of morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` which is
stable under base change and local on the target for the fppf precoverage. In a 2-fibre product
square over a cospan `g : 𝒵 ⟶ 𝒴`, `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` of categories fibred in groupoids over the big
fppf site of `S`, the projection to `𝒵` has the relative property `P` of Stacks 03YK as soon as
`f` does.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasRelativeProperty_baseChange
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (P : MorphismProperty (AlgebraicSpaces B S hS))
    [P.IsStableUnderBaseChange]
    [P.IsLocalAtTarget (Space.Topology.fppf.precoverage B S hS)]
    (𝒳 𝒴 𝒵 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, max u v, u + 1, max (max (u + 1) w) v}
      (BigFppfOver B S hS))
    (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (g : 𝒵 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (R : Bicategory.TwoCommSq g f)
    (hR : Bicategory.IsTwoFibreProduct R)
    (hf : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS f.hom)
    (hPf : HasRelativeProperty B S hS P f hf) :
    HasRelativeProperty B S hS P R.fst
      (isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_baseChange.{u, v, w} B S hS 𝒳 𝒴 𝒵 f g R hR hf)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.hasRelativeProperty_of_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 045D.** Let `P` be a property of morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` which is
stable under base change and local on the target for the fppf precoverage, let `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` be a
1-morphism of categories fibred in groupoids over the big fppf site of `S` representable by
algebraic spaces and let `g : 𝒵 ⟶ 𝒴` be any 1-morphism. Assume that every object of a fibre of
`𝒴` becomes, after restriction to a covering sieve, isomorphic to the image of an object of `𝒵`.
Then in a 2-fibre product square over the cospan `(g, f)`, if the projection to `𝒵` has the
relative property `P` of Stacks 03YK, so does `f`.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.relativeProperty_of_baseChange` with the representability of `f`
assumed as the source assumes it, which is what names the relative property of Stacks 03YK on
both sides.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasRelativeProperty_of_baseChange
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (𝒳 𝒴 𝒵 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, max u v, u + 1, max (max (u + 1) w) v}
      (BigFppfOver B S hS))
    (P : MorphismProperty (AlgebraicSpaces B S hS))
    [P.IsStableUnderBaseChange]
    [P.IsLocalAtTarget (Space.Topology.fppf.precoverage.{u, max u t} B S hS)]
    (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (g : 𝒵 ⟶ 𝒴)
