    (D : Bicategory.TwoCommSq g f)
    (hD : Bicategory.IsTwoFibreProduct D)
    (hf : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS f.hom)
    (hg : ∀ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (y : 𝒴.val.p.Fiber U),
      ∃ R ∈ BigFppfOver.topology B S hS U,
        ∀ ⦃V : BigFppfOver B S hS⦄ ⦃k : V ⟶ U⦄, R.arrows k →
          ∃ z : 𝒵.val.obj, ∃ φ : (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor g).obj z ⟶ y.1,
            𝒴.val.p.IsHomLift k φ)
    (hP : HasRelativeProperty B S hS P D.fst
      (isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_baseChange.{u, v, w} B S hS 𝒳 𝒴 𝒵 f g D hD hf)) :
    HasRelativeProperty B S hS P f hf

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.hasRelativeProperty_productMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 045E.** A property of morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` which is stable under
base change, local on the target for the fppf precoverage and stable under composition, and which
holds relatively for two 1-morphisms of categories fibred in groupoids over the big fppf site of
`S` representable by algebraic spaces, holds relatively for their product.

The product factors as `(f₁ × id_{𝒳₂}) ∘ (id_{𝒴₁} × f₂)`; the two factors are handled by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.hasRelativeProperty_productMap_id_right` and `…_id_left`, and the
composite by Stacks 045B.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasRelativeProperty_productMap (f₁ : 𝒳₁ ⟶ 𝒴₁) (f₂ : 𝒳₂ ⟶ 𝒴₂)
    (hf₁ : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS f₁.hom)
    (hf₂ : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS f₂.hom)
    (hP₁ : HasRelativeProperty.{u, _, _, t} B S hS P f₁ hf₁)
    (hP₂ : HasRelativeProperty.{u, _, _, t} B S hS P f₂ hf₂) :
    HasRelativeProperty.{u, _, _, t} B S hS P (productMap f₁ f₂)
      (isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_productMap B S hS f₁ f₂ hf₁ hf₂)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.hasRelativeProperty_mono
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 045F.** If a property `P` of morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` implies a
property `P'`, then a 1-morphism of categories fibred in groupoids over `(Sch/S)_fppf` which is
representable by algebraic spaces and has the relative property `P` of Stacks 03YK also has the
relative property `P'`.

The relative property is a universally quantified statement in which the property occurs only in
the conclusion, so the implication applies under the quantifiers.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasRelativeProperty_mono
    {P P' : MorphismProperty (AlgebraicSpaces B S hS)}
    [P.IsStableUnderBaseChange] [P.IsLocalAtTarget (Space.Topology.fppf.precoverage B S hS)]
    [P'.IsStableUnderBaseChange] [P'.IsLocalAtTarget (Space.Topology.fppf.precoverage B S hS)]
    (hPP' : P ≤ P')
    {𝒳 𝒴 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, v, u + 1, w} (BigFppfOver B S hS)} {f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴}
    (hf : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS f.hom)
    (hP : HasRelativeProperty B S hS P f hf) :
    HasRelativeProperty B S hS P' f hf

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isRepresentableFromSchemes_iff_isRepresentableFromRepresentableCategories
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 045G, conditions (3) and (5).** For a category fibred in groupoids `𝒳` over the big
fppf site of `S`, every 1-morphism to `𝒳` out of a slice of the site is representable by
algebraic spaces if and only if every 1-morphism to `𝒳` out of a representable category fibred
in groupoids is.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.hasRepresentableDiagonal_iff_isAlgebraicSpaceIsomPresheaf
declarations.doc:
The diagonal of a category fibred in groupoids over the big fppf site of `S` is representable
by algebraic spaces if and only if every isomorphism sheaf `Isom(x, y)` of two objects of a fibre
is an algebraic space over the scheme the fibre sits over.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasRepresentableDiagonal_iff_isAlgebraicSpaceIsomPresheaf :
    HasRepresentableDiagonal B S hS 𝒳 ↔ IsAlgebraicSpaceIsomPresheaf B S hS 𝒳

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isRepresentableFromAlgebraicSpaces_iff_hasAlgebraicSpaceProducts
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 045G, the equivalence of conditions (7) and (8).** Every 1-morphism to `𝒳` out of a
category fibred in groupoids representable by an algebraic space over `S` is representable by
algebraic spaces if and only if the 2-fibre product over `𝒳` of any two such 1-morphisms is
representable by an algebraic space.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRepresentableFromAlgebraicSpaces_iff_hasAlgebraicSpaceProducts :
    IsRepresentableFromAlgebraicSpaces.{u, v, w, v₁, w₁} B S hS 𝒳 ↔
      HasAlgebraicSpaceProducts.{u, v, w, v₁, w₁, v₂, w₂} B S hS 𝒳

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.hasAlgebraicSpaceRepresentableProducts_iff_isRepresentableFromAlgebraicSpaces
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 045G, the equivalence of conditions (6) and (7).** The 2-fibre product over `𝒳` of
any two 1-morphisms out of representable categories fibred in groupoids is representable by an
algebraic space if and only if every 1-morphism to `𝒳` out of a category fibred in groupoids
representable by an algebraic space is representable by algebraic spaces.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasAlgebraicSpaceRepresentableProducts_iff_isRepresentableFromAlgebraicSpaces :
    HasAlgebraicSpaceRepresentableProducts.{u, v, w, v₁, w₁, v₂, w₂} B S hS 𝒳 ↔
      IsRepresentableFromAlgebraicSpaces.{u, v, w, v₁, w₁} B S hS 𝒳

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isAlgebraicSpaceIsomPresheaf_iff_isRepresentableFromSchemes
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 045G, the equivalence of conditions (2) and (3).** Every isomorphism sheaf
`Isom(x, y)` of two objects of a fibre of `𝒳` is an algebraic space over the scheme the fibre sits
over if and only if every 1-morphism to `𝒳` from the category represented by a scheme over `S` is
representable by algebraic spaces.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAlgebraicSpaceIsomPresheaf_iff_isRepresentableFromSchemes :
    IsAlgebraicSpaceIsomPresheaf B S hS 𝒳 ↔ IsRepresentableFromSchemes B S hS 𝒳

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.representableFromCategories_iff_algebraicSpaceProducts
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 045G, the equivalence of conditions (5) and (6).** Every 1-morphism to `𝒳` from a
representable category fibred in groupoids is representable by algebraic spaces if and only if the
2-fibre product over `𝒳` of any two such 1-morphisms is representable by an algebraic space.
declarations.statement:
theorem representableFromCategories_iff_algebraicSpaceProducts :
    IsRepresentableFromRepresentableCategories.{u, v, w, v₁, w₁} B S hS 𝒳 ↔
      HasAlgebraicSpaceRepresentableProducts.{u, v, w, v₁, w₁, v₂, w₂} B S hS 𝒳

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.hasAlgebraicSpaceSchemePointProducts_iff_isRepresentableFromRepresentableCategories
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 045G, the equivalence of conditions (4) and (5).** The 2-fibre product over `𝒳` of
any two scheme-valued points of `𝒳` is representable by an algebraic space if and only if every
1-morphism to `𝒳` from a representable category fibred in groupoids is representable by algebraic
spaces.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasAlgebraicSpaceSchemePointProducts_iff_isRepresentableFromRepresentableCategories :
    HasAlgebraicSpaceSchemePointProducts B S hS 𝒳 ↔
      IsRepresentableFromRepresentableCategories.{u, v, w, v₁, w₁} B S hS 𝒳

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isRepresentableFromSchemes_iff_hasAlgebraicSpaceSchemePointProducts
declarations.doc:
Every 1-morphism to `𝒳` from the category represented by a scheme over `S` is representable
by algebraic spaces if and only if the 2-fibre product over `𝒳` of any two such 1-morphisms is
representable by an algebraic space.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRepresentableFromSchemes_iff_hasAlgebraicSpaceSchemePointProducts :
    IsRepresentableFromSchemes B S hS 𝒳 ↔ HasAlgebraicSpaceSchemePointProducts B S hS 𝒳

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isDeligneMumfordStack_and_isStackInSetoids_of_isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 045H, the implication (3) ⟹ (1).** A category fibred in groupoids over the big fppf
site of `S` which is representable by an algebraic space over `S` is a Deligne-Mumford stack and
a stack in setoids for the fppf topology.

The first conjunct is Stacks 03YS part (1) and the second is the implication (3) ⟹ (1) of Stacks
04SZ; neither uses algebraicity as a hypothesis, so none is assumed.
declarations.statement:
theorem isDeligneMumfordStack_and_isStackInSetoids_of_isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpace
    (h : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpace B S hS 𝒳) :
    IsDeligneMumfordStack.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳.val ∧
      𝒳.val.p.IsStackInSetoids (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isDeligneMumfordStack_and_inertiaProjection_isEquivalence_of_isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 045H, the implication (3) ⟹ (2).** A category fibred in groupoids over the big fppf
site of `S` which is representable by an algebraic space over `S` is a Deligne-Mumford stack
whose canonical projection from the inertia category is an equivalence.

This is the implication (3) ⟹ (1) with its second conjunct passed through Stacks 04ZM, which is
the implication (3) ⟹ (2) of Stacks 04SZ.
declarations.statement:
theorem isDeligneMumfordStack_and_inertiaProjection_isEquivalence_of_isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpace
    (h : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpace B S hS 𝒳) :
    IsDeligneMumfordStack.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳.val ∧
      (RelativeInertia.π 𝒳.val.p :
        AbsoluteInertia 𝒳.val.p ⥤ 𝒳.val.obj).IsEquivalence

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isStackInSetoids_iff_inertiaProjection_isEquivalence_of_isDeligneMumfordStack
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 045H, the equivalence of parts (1) and (2).** A Deligne-Mumford stack over the big
fppf site of `S` is a stack in setoids if and only if the canonical projection from its inertia
category is an equivalence.

The Deligne-Mumford condition contains the algebraic-stack condition, which supplies the stack
hypothesis of Stacks 04ZM through
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isStackInSetoids_iff_inertiaProjection_isEquivalence_of_isAlgebraicStack`;
the Deligne-Mumford conjunct is then common to both sides.
declarations.statement:
theorem isStackInSetoids_iff_inertiaProjection_isEquivalence_of_isDeligneMumfordStack
    (h𝒳 : IsDeligneMumfordStack.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳.val) :
    𝒳.val.p.IsStackInSetoids (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) ↔
      (RelativeInertia.π 𝒳.val.p :
        AbsoluteInertia 𝒳.val.p ⥤ 𝒳.val.obj).IsEquivalence

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpace_of_isDeligneMumfordStack_isStackInSetoids
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 045H, the implication (1) ⟹ (3).** A Deligne-Mumford stack over the big fppf site
of `S` which is a stack in setoids for the fppf topology is representable by an algebraic space
over `S`.

The surjective étale presentation by a scheme that the Deligne-Mumford condition provides is the
presentation the étale engine consumes, and the fibres of an algebraic stack are essentially
small.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpace_of_isDeligneMumfordStack_isStackInSetoids
    (h𝒳 : IsDeligneMumfordStack.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳.val)
    (hset : 𝒳.val.p.IsStackInSetoids (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS)) :
    IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpace B S hS 𝒳

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isDeligneMumfordStack_isStackInSetoids_tfae
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 045H.** For a category fibred in groupoids over the big fppf site of `S` the
following are equivalent: it is a Deligne-Mumford stack and a stack in setoids for the fppf
topology; it is a Deligne-Mumford stack whose canonical projection from the inertia is an
equivalence; it is representable by an algebraic space over `S`.

No algebraicity hypothesis is assumed: algebraicity is part of the Deligne-Mumford condition of
the first two parts, and the third implies it by Stacks 03YS part (1).
declarations.statement:
theorem isDeligneMumfordStack_isStackInSetoids_tfae :
    List.TFAE
      [IsDeligneMumfordStack.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳.val ∧
          𝒳.val.p.IsStackInSetoids (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS),
        IsDeligneMumfordStack.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳.val ∧
          (RelativeInertia.π 𝒳.val.p :
            AbsoluteInertia 𝒳.val.p ⥤ 𝒳.val.obj).IsEquivalence,
        IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpace B S hS 𝒳]
declarations.comment: the equivalence of all three parts

registrations.name: CategoryTheory.RelativeInertia.π_isEquivalence_iff
registrations.comment: parts (1) and (2), the general inertia criterion

registrations.name: CategoryTheory.RelativeInertia.π_comp_neutralSection_eq_id
registrations.comment: inverse over the base in part (2)

declarations.name: tensorProduct_isNoetherianRing_of_finitelyGenerated_fieldExtension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Tag 045I.** Let `k` be a field and `R` a Noetherian commutative
`k`-algebra. If `K/k` is a finitely generated field extension (finitely
generated *as a field*, expressed by `(⊤ : IntermediateField k K).FG`), then the
`k`-algebra `K ⊗[k] R` is Noetherian.
declarations.statement:
theorem tensorProduct_isNoetherianRing_of_finitelyGenerated_fieldExtension
    (k : Type*) [Field k]
    (R : Type*) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (K : Type*) [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (hK : (⊤ : IntermediateField k K).FG) :
    IsNoetherianRing (K ⊗[k] R)

declarations.name: Module.isMaximalCohenMacaulay_self_iff_of_flat
declarations.doc:
**Cohen–Macaulayness along a flat local homomorphism.** Let `R → S` be a flat local
homomorphism of local rings with `S` Noetherian. Then `S` is Cohen–Macaulay, that is
`depth_{𝔪_S}(S) = dim(S)`, if and only if `R` is Cohen–Macaulay and the fibre ring `S/𝔪_R S` is
Cohen–Macaulay, the latter written as `depth_{𝔪_S}(S/𝔪_R S) = dim(S/𝔪_R S)` with the depth taken
over `S`, which is the depth of `S/𝔪_R S` as a local ring in its own right.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isMaximalCohenMacaulay_self_iff_of_flat (R S : Type*) [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsLocalRing S] [IsNoetherianRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [IsLocalHom (algebraMap R S)] [Module.Flat R S] :
    IsMaximalCohenMacaulay S S ↔
      IsMaximalCohenMacaulay R R ∧
        (depth S (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S)
              (S ⧸ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R S)) : WithBot ℕ∞) =
          ringKrullDim (S ⧸ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R S))
declarations.comment: Cohen-Macaulayness of a Noetherian local ring `A` (Definition 00N8) is `Module.IsMaximalCohenMacaulay A A`, i.e. `depth_{𝔪_A}(A) = dim A`; for the fibre that equation is written out, with its depth taken over `S` along `𝔪_S` as in Tag 0337, since a quotient of a local ring carries no `IsLocalRing` instance. `IsNoetherianRing R` is dropped, being a consequence of faithful flatness. See the module docstring.

declarations.name: Algebra.TensorProduct.isNoetherianRing_and_isCohenMacaulay_of_essFiniteType
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 045M.** Let `k` be a field and let `K/k` and `L/k` be field extensions one of which
is of finite type as a field extension. Then `K ⊗[k] L` is a Noetherian Cohen–Macaulay ring.
declarations.statement:
public theorem Algebra.TensorProduct.isNoetherianRing_and_isCohenMacaulay_of_essFiniteType
    (k K L : Type*) [Field k] [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra k K] [Algebra k L]
    (h : Algebra.EssFiniteType k K ∨ Algebra.EssFiniteType k L) :
    IsNoetherianRing (K ⊗[k] L) ∧ Module.IsCohenMacaulay (K ⊗[k] L) (K ⊗[k] L)
declarations.comment:
Finite generation of a field extension is `Algebra.EssFiniteType`
(`IntermediateField.fg_top_iff`), and "one of them" is the disjunction `h`. Cohen-Macaulayness
of the ring (Definition 00NC) is `Module.IsCohenMacaulay R R` for `R = K ⊗[k] L`, the notion of
tag 0AAH for `R` over itself, which at each prime is Cohen-Macaulayness of `R_𝔭`. See the module
docstring.

declarations.name: Algebra.TensorProduct.isMaximalCohenMacaulay_self_iff_of_essFiniteType
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 045N.** Let `k` be a field, `S` a Noetherian `k`-algebra and `K/k` a finitely
generated field extension. Let `𝔮 ⊆ S` be a prime and let `𝔮_K ⊆ K ⊗[k] S` be a prime lying over
it along `s ↦ 1 ⊗ s`. Then the local ring `S_𝔮` is Cohen–Macaulay, that is
`depth_{𝔪}(S_𝔮) = dim S_𝔮`, if and only if the local ring `(K ⊗[k] S)_{𝔮_K}` is.
declarations.statement:
public theorem Algebra.TensorProduct.isMaximalCohenMacaulay_self_iff_of_essFiniteType
    {k S : Type*} [Field k] [CommRing S] [Algebra k S] [IsNoetherianRing S]
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [Algebra k K] [Algebra.EssFiniteType k K]
    (q : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime] (qK : Ideal (K ⊗[k] S)) [qK.IsPrime]
    (hqK : q = qK.comap Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom)
    (Sq : Type*) [CommRing Sq] [Algebra S Sq] [IsLocalization.AtPrime Sq q] [IsLocalRing Sq]
    (SKqK : Type*) [CommRing SKqK] [Algebra (K ⊗[k] S) SKqK]
    [IsLocalization.AtPrime SKqK qK] [IsLocalRing SKqK] :
    Module.IsMaximalCohenMacaulay Sq Sq ↔ Module.IsMaximalCohenMacaulay SKqK SKqK
declarations.comment: Cohen-Macaulayness of a Noetherian local ring (Definition 00N8) is `Module.IsMaximalCohenMacaulay A A` (Tag 00NF); finite generation of the field extension is `Algebra.EssFiniteType k K` (`IntermediateField.fg_top_iff`), as in Tag 045M; both localisations are abstract `IsLocalization.AtPrime`s as in Tag 00ND; lying over is contraction along `Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight`, there being no `Algebra S (K ⊗[k] S)` instance; and `IsNoetherianRing (K ⊗[k] S)` is not assumed, being a consequence by Tag 045I. See the module docstring.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isCohenMacaulayLocalRing_stalk_iff_of_finiteType_fieldExtension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 045P.** Cohen-Macaulayness of local rings is unchanged after a
finitely generated extension of the ground field of a locally Noetherian scheme.

The extension may be transcendental: `K = k(x₁, …, xₙ)` is finitely generated as a field
extension, which is `Algebra.EssFiniteType k K` by `IntermediateField.fg_top_iff`, and not
finitely generated as a `k`-algebra. The base change is again locally Noetherian, by Tag 038R;
that is what makes the local ring on the right a Noetherian local ring.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isCohenMacaulayLocalRing_stalk_iff_of_finiteType_fieldExtension
    (k K : Type u) [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K] [Algebra.EssFiniteType k K]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (x : X)
    (x' : (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) : Scheme))
    (hx' : (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).base x' = x) :
    letI : IsLocallyNoetherian
        (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) : Scheme) :=
      (isLocallyNoetherian_baseChange_iff k K X f).mp inferInstance
    IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x) ↔
      IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing
        ((pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).presheaf.stalk x')

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isCohenMacaulayLocalRing_stalk_iff_of_locallyOfFiniteType
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 045P.** Cohen-Macaulayness of local rings is unchanged after an
arbitrary extension of the ground field when the scheme is locally of finite type over that
field.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isCohenMacaulayLocalRing_stalk_iff_of_locallyOfFiniteType
    (k K : Type u) [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (x : X)
    (x' : (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) : Scheme))
    (hx' : (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).base x' = x) :
    letI : IsLocallyNoetherian X := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian f
    IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x) ↔
      IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing
        ((pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).presheaf.stalk x')
declarations.comment: arbitrary field extension for a locally finite type scheme

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.flat_of_isCohenMacaulay
declarations.doc:
A Cohen--Macaulay morphism is flat: flatness of the stalk map at a point is the first
conjunct of Cohen--Macaulayness there, and flatness of a morphism is flatness of every stalk
map.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.IsCohenMacaulayAt
declarations.doc:
A morphism of schemes with locally Noetherian fibres is Cohen–Macaulay at `x` if it is flat
at `x` and the local ring of the fibre over `f x` at the point corresponding to `x` is
Cohen–Macaulay.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev IsCohenMacaulayAt {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : ∀ y : Y, IsLocallyNoetherian (f.fiber y)) (x : X) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.IsCohenMacaulay
declarations.doc:
A morphism of schemes with locally Noetherian fibres is Cohen–Macaulay if it is
Cohen–Macaulay at every point of its source.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev IsCohenMacaulay {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : ∀ y : Y, IsLocallyNoetherian (f.fiber y)) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isCohenMacaulay_iff_flat_and_fibers
declarations.doc:
A morphism with locally Noetherian fibres is Cohen–Macaulay precisely when it is flat and
every fibre is a Cohen–Macaulay scheme.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isCohenMacaulay_iff_flat_and_fibers {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : ∀ y : Y, IsLocallyNoetherian (f.fiber y)) :
    Scheme.Hom.IsCohenMacaulay f hf ↔
      Flat f ∧ (∀ y : Y, IsCohenMacaulay (f.fiber y))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isCohenMacaulayAt_pullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 045T (1).** Cohen–Macaulayness at a point is preserved under locally
finite-type base change.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isCohenMacaulayAt_pullback {X Y Y' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFiniteType g]
    (hf : ∀ y : Y, IsLocallyNoetherian (f.fiber y)) (x' : (pullback f g : Scheme))
    (h : Scheme.Hom.IsCohenMacaulayAt f hf ((pullback.fst f g).base x')) :
    Scheme.Hom.IsCohenMacaulayAt (pullback.snd f g)
      (fun y' => isLocallyNoetherian_fiber_pullback f g hf y') x'

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isCohenMacaulayAt_of_pullback_of_flat
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 045T (2).** Cohen–Macaulayness descends from a base change when the
original morphism is flat at the point in question.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isCohenMacaulayAt_of_pullback_of_flat {X Y Y' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFiniteType g]
    (hf : ∀ y : Y, IsLocallyNoetherian (f.fiber y)) (x' : (pullback f g : Scheme))
    (hflat : IsFlatAt f.toLRSHom.toShHom ((pullback.fst f g).base x'))
    (h : Scheme.Hom.IsCohenMacaulayAt (pullback.snd f g)
      (fun y' => isLocallyNoetherian_fiber_pullback f g hf y') x') :
    Scheme.Hom.IsCohenMacaulayAt f hf ((pullback.fst f g).base x')

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isCohenMacaulayAt_of_pullback_of_flat_base
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 045T (3).** Cohen–Macaulayness descends from a base change flat at the
relevant base point.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isCohenMacaulayAt_of_pullback_of_flat_base {X Y Y' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFiniteType g]
    (hf : ∀ y : Y, IsLocallyNoetherian (f.fiber y)) (x' : (pullback f g : Scheme))
    (hflat : IsFlatAt g.toLRSHom.toShHom ((pullback.snd f g).base x'))
    (h : Scheme.Hom.IsCohenMacaulayAt (pullback.snd f g)
      (fun y' => isLocallyNoetherian_fiber_pullback f g hf y') x') :
    Scheme.Hom.IsCohenMacaulayAt f hf ((pullback.fst f g).base x')

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isCohenMacaulayAt_set_eq_fiberLocalRing
declarations.doc:
The Cohen–Macaulay locus of a flat, locally finitely presented morphism is exactly the locus
where the local ring of its fibre is Cohen–Macaulay.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isCohenMacaulayAt_set_eq_fiberLocalRing
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] :
    let hf : ∀ y : S, IsLocallyNoetherian (f.fiber y) := fun y =>
      isLocallyNoetherian_fiber_of_locallyOfFinitePresentation f y
    {x : X | Scheme.Hom.IsCohenMacaulayAt f hf x} =
      {x : X | letI := hf (f x)
        IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing ((f.fiber (f x)).presheaf.stalk (f.asFiber x))}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.dense_cohenMacaulayAt_fiber
declarations.doc:
The Cohen–Macaulay locus of a flat, locally finitely presented morphism is dense in every
fibre.
declarations.statement:
public theorem dense_cohenMacaulayAt_fiber
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] :
    let hf : ∀ s : S, IsLocallyNoetherian (f.fiber s) := fun s =>
      isLocallyNoetherian_fiber_of_locallyOfFinitePresentation f s
    ∀ s : S, Dense ((f.fiberι s) ⁻¹' {x : X | Scheme.Hom.IsCohenMacaulayAt f hf x})

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isCohenMacaulayAt_pullback_locus
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 045U (base change).** The Cohen–Macaulay locus of a flat, locally
finitely presented morphism commutes with arbitrary base change.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isCohenMacaulayAt_pullback_locus {X S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S) [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] :
    let f' := pullback.snd f g
    let g' := pullback.fst f g
    let hf : ∀ s : S, IsLocallyNoetherian (f.fiber s) := fun s =>
      isLocallyNoetherian_fiber_of_locallyOfFinitePresentation f s
    let hf' : ∀ s' : S', IsLocallyNoetherian (f'.fiber s') := fun s' =>
      isLocallyNoetherian_fiber_of_locallyOfFinitePresentation f' s'
    {x' : (pullback f g : Scheme) | Scheme.Hom.IsCohenMacaulayAt f' hf' x'} =
      g'.base ⁻¹' {x : X | Scheme.Hom.IsCohenMacaulayAt f hf x}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isOpen_setOf_isCohenMacaulayAt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 045U (Cohen–Macaulay locus).** For a flat morphism locally of finite
presentation, the locus of points at which the morphism is Cohen–Macaulay is open.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isOpen_setOf_isCohenMacaulayAt
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] :
    let hf : ∀ y : S, IsLocallyNoetherian (f.fiber y) := fun y =>
      isLocallyNoetherian_fiber_of_locallyOfFinitePresentation f y
    IsOpen {x : X | Scheme.Hom.IsCohenMacaulayAt f hf x}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.cohenMacaulayWithLocallyNoetherianFibers_isLocalAtTarget_fppf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 045V.** Having locally Noetherian fibres and being Cohen–Macaulay is
local on the target for the fppf topology.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.cohenMacaulayWithLocallyNoetherianFibers_isLocalAtSource_syntomic
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 045V.** Having locally Noetherian fibres and being Cohen–Macaulay is
local on the source for the syntomic topology.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.equidimensional_of_groupScheme
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 045X.** A group scheme locally of finite type over a field is
equidimensional.
declarations.statement:
theorem equidimensional_of_groupScheme (k : Type u) [Field k] (G : Scheme.{u})
    [G.Over (Spec (.of k))] [GrpObj (G.asOver (Spec (.of k)))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (G ↘ Spec (.of k))] :
    Equidimensional G

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.topologicalKrullDim_eq_topologicalKrullDimAt_of_groupScheme
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 045X.** The dimension of a group scheme locally of finite type over a
field is its dimension at every point.
declarations.statement:
theorem topologicalKrullDim_eq_topologicalKrullDimAt_of_groupScheme (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (G : Scheme.{u}) [G.Over (Spec (.of k))] [GrpObj (G.asOver (Spec (.of k)))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (G ↘ Spec (.of k))] (g : G) :
    topologicalKrullDim G = topologicalKrullDimAt G g

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.topologicalKrullDim_eq_ringKrullDim_stalk_of_groupScheme
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 045X.** At a closed point of a group scheme locally of finite type
over a field, the dimension of the scheme is the Krull dimension of the local ring.
declarations.statement:
theorem topologicalKrullDim_eq_ringKrullDim_stalk_of_groupScheme (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (G : Scheme.{u}) [G.Over (Spec (.of k))] [GrpObj (G.asOver (Spec (.of k)))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (G ↘ Spec (.of k))] (g : G) (hg : IsClosed ({g} : Set G)) :
    topologicalKrullDim G = ringKrullDim (G.presheaf.stalk g)

declarations.name: Stacks.Groupoids.toQuotientSheaf_apply_eq_iff_locally_related
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 045Y.** Two `T`-valued points of `U` have the same image in the quotient sheaf
of a pre-equivalence relation if and only if, on some covering sieve of `T`, their
restrictions are the source and the target of a point of the relation scheme.
declarations.statement:
theorem toQuotientSheaf_apply_eq_iff_locally_related
    {S : Scheme.{u}} {C : Type v} [Category.{w} C]
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C) [HasSheafify J (Type u)]
    [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective (Type u)]
    (F : C ⥤ Over S) {R U : Over S} (j : PreRelation R U)
    (hj : IsPreEquivalenceRelation j)
    (T : C) (a b : F.obj T ⟶ U) :
    (toQuotientSheaf J F j).app (op T) a = (toQuotientSheaf J F j).app (op T) b ↔
      ∃ W : Sieve T, W ∈ J T ∧
        ∀ (X : C) (f : X ⟶ T), W.arrows f →
          ∃ r : F.obj X ⟶ R,
            (r ≫ j.source = F.map f ≫ a) ∧ (r ≫ j.target = F.map f ≫ b)

declarations.name: Stacks.Groupoids.restrictQuotientSheafMap_mono
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 045Z, injectivity.** Restricting a pre-equivalence relation induces an injective
map `U'/R' ⟶ U/R` of quotient sheaves.
declarations.statement:
theorem restrictQuotientSheafMap_mono (hj : IsPreEquivalenceRelation j) :
    Mono (restrictQuotientSheafMap J F j g)

declarations.name: Stacks.Groupoids.restrictQuotientSheafMap_isIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 045Z, bijectivity.** If `g` induces a local surjection on restricted functors of
points, then the induced map `U'/R' ⟶ U/R` of quotient sheaves is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem restrictQuotientSheafMap_isIso (hj : IsPreEquivalenceRelation j)
    (hg : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective J (F.op.whiskerLeft (yoneda.map g))) :
    IsIso (restrictQuotientSheafMap J F j g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_open_source_cohenMacaulay_locus
declarations.doc:
There is an open of objects whose inverse image under the target is the
greatest open on which the source map is Cohen–Macaulay.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_open_source_cohenMacaulay_locus {S : Scheme.{u}}
    (G : GroupoidScheme S)
    [Flat G.source.left] [Flat G.target.left]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation G.source.left]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation G.target.left] :
    ∃ W : G.objects.left.Opens,
      IsGreatest
        {V : G.arrows.left.Opens |
          ∃ hf : ∀ y : G.objects.left,
            IsLocallyNoetherian ((V.ι ≫ G.source.left).fiber y),
            Scheme.Hom.IsCohenMacaulay (V.ι ≫ G.source.left) hf}
        (G.target.left ⁻¹ᵁ W)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.target_cohenMacaulay_locus
declarations.doc:
The inverse image of the object open under the source is the greatest
open on which the target map is Cohen–Macaulay.
declarations.statement:
public theorem target_cohenMacaulay_locus {S : Scheme.{u}} (G : GroupoidScheme S)
    [Flat G.source.left] [Flat G.target.left]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation G.source.left]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation G.target.left] :
    IsGreatest
      {V : G.arrows.left.Opens |
        ∃ hf : ∀ y : G.objects.left,
          IsLocallyNoetherian ((V.ι ≫ G.target.left).fiber y),
          Scheme.Hom.IsCohenMacaulay (V.ι ≫ G.target.left) hf}
      (G.source.left ⁻¹ᵁ cohenMacaulayOpen G)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.target_from_source_surjective
declarations.doc: The target remains surjective on the inverse image of the open under the source.
declarations.statement:
public theorem target_from_source_surjective {S : Scheme.{u}} (G : GroupoidScheme S)
    [Flat G.source.left] [Flat G.target.left]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation G.source.left]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation G.target.left] :
    Surjective ((G.source.left ⁻¹ᵁ cohenMacaulayOpen G).ι ≫ G.target.left)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.source_from_target_surjective
declarations.doc: The source remains surjective on the inverse image of the open under the target.
declarations.statement:
public theorem source_from_target_surjective {S : Scheme.{u}} (G : GroupoidScheme S)
    [Flat G.source.left] [Flat G.target.left]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation G.source.left]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation G.target.left] :
    Surjective ((G.target.left ⁻¹ᵁ cohenMacaulayOpen G).ι ≫ G.source.left)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.restricted_source_cohenMacaulay
declarations.doc: The source map of the restricted groupoid is Cohen–Macaulay.
declarations.statement:
public theorem restricted_source_cohenMacaulay {S : Scheme.{u}} (G : GroupoidScheme S)
    [Flat G.source.left] [Flat G.target.left]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation G.source.left]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation G.target.left] :
    let U' := cohenMacaulayOpen G
    let g : Over.mk (U'.ι ≫ G.objects.hom) ⟶ G.objects := Over.homMk U'.ι
    let f := (GroupoidScheme.restrict G g).groupoid.source.left
    ∃ hf : ∀ y, IsLocallyNoetherian (f.fiber y),
      Scheme.Hom.IsCohenMacaulay f hf

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.restricted_target_cohenMacaulay
declarations.doc: The target map of the restricted groupoid is Cohen–Macaulay.
declarations.statement:
public theorem restricted_target_cohenMacaulay {S : Scheme.{u}} (G : GroupoidScheme S)
    [Flat G.source.left] [Flat G.target.left]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation G.source.left]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation G.target.left] :
    let U' := cohenMacaulayOpen G
    let g : Over.mk (U'.ι ≫ G.objects.hom) ⟶ G.objects := Over.homMk U'.ι
    let f := (GroupoidScheme.restrict G g).groupoid.target.left
    ∃ hf : ∀ y, IsLocallyNoetherian (f.fiber y),
      Scheme.Hom.IsCohenMacaulay f hf

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.restricted_source_locallyOfFinitePresentation
declarations.doc: The source map of the restricted groupoid is locally of finite presentation.
declarations.statement:
public theorem restricted_source_locallyOfFinitePresentation {S : Scheme.{u}}
    (G : GroupoidScheme S) [Flat G.source.left] [Flat G.target.left]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation G.source.left]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation G.target.left] :
    let U' := cohenMacaulayOpen G
    let g : Over.mk (U'.ι ≫ G.objects.hom) ⟶ G.objects := Over.homMk U'.ι
    LocallyOfFinitePresentation (GroupoidScheme.restrict G g).groupoid.source.left
declarations.comment: part (5): source locally of finite presentation

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.restricted_target_locallyOfFinitePresentation
declarations.doc: The target map of the restricted groupoid is locally of finite presentation.
declarations.statement:
public theorem restricted_target_locallyOfFinitePresentation {S : Scheme.{u}}
    (G : GroupoidScheme S) [Flat G.source.left] [Flat G.target.left]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation G.source.left]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation G.target.left] :
    let U' := cohenMacaulayOpen G
    let g : Over.mk (U'.ι ≫ G.objects.hom) ⟶ G.objects := Over.homMk U'.ι
    LocallyOfFinitePresentation (GroupoidScheme.restrict G g).groupoid.target.left
declarations.comment: part (5): target locally of finite presentation

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_affine_slice_dim_sub_one
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0461.** Let `(U, R, s, t, c)` be a groupoid scheme with `s` and `t`
Cohen--Macaulay and locally of finite presentation, let `u` be a finite type point of `U`, and
suppose the source fibre `F_u` has larger dimension at the identity arrow than the stabilizer
fibre `G_u`. Then there are an affine scheme `U'` and a morphism `g : U' ⟶ U` which is an
immersion through `u` and locally of finite presentation, such that `h : U' ×_{g,U,t} R ⟶ U`
is Cohen--Macaulay at the identity arrow and the restricted source fibre has dimension one
less at the restricted identity arrow.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_affine_slice_dim_sub_one {S : Scheme.{u}}
    (G : GroupoidScheme S) (u : G.objects.left)
    (hs : ∃ h : ∀ y : G.objects.left, IsLocallyNoetherian (G.source.left.fiber y),
      Scheme.Hom.IsCohenMacaulay G.source.left h)
    (_ht : ∃ h : ∀ y : G.objects.left, IsLocallyNoetherian (G.target.left.fiber y),
      Scheme.Hom.IsCohenMacaulay G.target.left h)
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation G.source.left]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation G.target.left]
    (hu : IsFiniteTypePoint u)
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim ((stabilizer G).hom.fiber u) <
      topologicalKrullDimAt (G.source.left.fiber u) (sourceFiberIdentity G u))
    :
    ∃ (U' : Over S) (g : U' ⟶ G.objects) (u' : U'.left) (hu' : g.left u' = u),
      let E : SliceSituation := ⟨S, G, U', g, u, u', hu'⟩
      IsAffine U'.left ∧ IsImmersion g.left ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation g.left ∧
        (∃ (x : E.arrowSource.left)
          (_ : (pullback.fst E.g E.groupoid.target).left x = u')
          (_ : (pullback.snd E.g E.groupoid.target).left x = E.groupoid.identity.left E.u)
          (hnoeth : ∀ y : E.groupoid.objects.left,
            IsLocallyNoetherian (E.sourceMap.left.fiber y)),
          Scheme.Hom.IsCohenMacaulayAt E.sourceMap.left hnoeth x) ∧
        topologicalKrullDimAt E.restrictedSourceFiber
            E.sliceIdentityPoints.restrictedSourceIdentity + 1 =
          topologicalKrullDimAt (G.source.left.fiber u) (sourceFiberIdentity G u)

declarations.name: Module.IsMaximalCohenMacaulay.exists_mem_notMem_minimalPrimes_of_ringKrullDim_quotient_lt
declarations.doc:
**Minimal-prime avoidance in a Cohen–Macaulay local ring.** Let `R` be a Noetherian local
Cohen–Macaulay ring, `u : A →+* R` a ring map and `I` an ideal of `A` such that the ideal
`u(I)R` already cuts the dimension, `dim(R/u(I)R) < dim(R)`. Then there is `f ∈ I` whose image
`u f` lies in no minimal prime of `R`.
declarations.statement:
theorem Module.IsMaximalCohenMacaulay.exists_mem_notMem_minimalPrimes_of_ringKrullDim_quotient_lt
    {A R : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    (hR : Module.IsMaximalCohenMacaulay R R) (u : A →+* R) (I : Ideal A)
    (hlt : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ I.map u) < ringKrullDim R) :
    ∃ f ∈ I, ∀ p ∈ minimalPrimes R, u f ∉ p
declarations.comment:
step 2 of the proof: the minimal-prime avoidance, from equidimensionality of a
Cohen--Macaulay local ring (Tag 00NA) and prime avoidance (Tag 00DS). The ideal is not assumed
maximal and the source ring is not assumed Noetherian or local

declarations.name: Module.IsMaximalCohenMacaulay.exists_mem_isSMulRegular_map_quotient_isMaximalCohenMacaulay
declarations.doc:
**Slicing a Cohen–Macaulay local ring, the commutative-algebra core of Stacks 0461.** Let
`(R, 𝔪_R)` be a Noetherian local Cohen–Macaulay ring, let `u : A →+* R` be a ring map and let `I`
be an ideal of `A` with `u(I)R ⊆ 𝔪_R` and `dim(R/u(I)R) < dim(R)`. Then there is `f ∈ I` such
that `dim(R/u(f)R) < dim(R)`, the element `u f` is a nonzerodivisor on `R`, and `R/u(f)R` is a
Cohen–Macaulay local ring of dimension `dim(R) - 1`.
declarations.statement:
theorem Module.IsMaximalCohenMacaulay.exists_mem_isSMulRegular_map_quotient_isMaximalCohenMacaulay
    {A R : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    (hR : Module.IsMaximalCohenMacaulay R R) (u : A →+* R) (I : Ideal A)
    (hu : I.map u ≤ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)
    (hlt : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ I.map u) < ringKrullDim R) :
    ∃ f ∈ I, ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.span {u f}) < ringKrullDim R ∧ IsSMulRegular R (u f) ∧
      ∃ _ : IsLocalRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span {u f}),
        Module.IsMaximalCohenMacaulay (R ⧸ Ideal.span {u f}) (R ⧸ Ideal.span {u f}) ∧
          ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.span {u f}) + 1 = ringKrullDim R
declarations.comment:
the commutative-algebra core, conclusions (a), (b) and (c), over an abstract
Noetherian local Cohen--Macaulay ring and a ring map into it; no groupoid, scheme or
localisation data appears, and the dimension drop is stated additively

declarations.name: IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.exists_mem_maximalIdeal_isSMulRegular_map_of_ringKrullDim_lt
declarations.doc:
**Slicing along a local homomorphism.** Let `φ : A →+* C` be a local homomorphism of local
rings with `C` Noetherian and Cohen–Macaulay, and suppose the ideal `φ(𝔪_A)C` already cuts the
dimension, `dim(C/φ(𝔪_A)C) < dim(C)`. Then some `a ∈ 𝔪_A` has `φ a` a nonzerodivisor on `C` with
`dim(C/φ(a)C) + 1 = dim(C)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.exists_mem_maximalIdeal_isSMulRegular_map_of_ringKrullDim_lt
    (A C : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C]
    [IsNoetherianRing C] (hC : IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing C) (φ : A →+* C) (hφ : IsLocalHom φ)
    (hlt : ringKrullDim (C ⧸ Ideal.map φ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)) < ringKrullDim C) :
    ∃ a ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A, IsSMulRegular C (φ a) ∧
      ringKrullDim (C ⧸ Ideal.span {φ a}) + 1 = ringKrullDim C
declarations.comment:
the commutative-algebra core along a local homomorphism, at the maximal ideal
of the source, in the Tag 00N8 spelling of Cohen--Macaulayness; this is the form the geometric
argument consumes

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallyOfFiniteType_of_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0462.** If a composite of morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` is locally of
finite type, then so is its first factor.

This is also the locally-of-finite-type clause of part (1) of **Stacks 0AGC**, whose other
clauses are in
`StacksFrontier/AlgebraicGeometry/Spaces/Morphisms/Immersions.lean`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyOfFiniteType_of_comp
    {F G H : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F) (hG : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS G)
    (hH : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS H)
    (f : F ⟶ G) (g : G ⟶ H)
    (hfg : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS (f ≫ g)) :
    IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallyQuasiFinite_of_mono
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0463**, the local quasi-finiteness clause: a monomorphism of algebraic spaces over
`S` which is locally of finite type is locally quasi-finite.

The relative diagonal of a monomorphism is an isomorphism, hence an open immersion after every
represented base change, so part (2) of [Stacks Project, Tag 05W1] makes the morphism
unramified and [Stacks Project, Tag 05W0] makes it locally quasi-finite.

The separatedness clause of the tag is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSeparated_of_mono`, which is
[Stacks Project, Tag 042N] and needs no finite-type hypothesis.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyQuasiFinite_of_mono {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hmono : Mono f) (hft : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f) :
    IsLocallyQuasiFinite B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSeparated_of_mono
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 042N.** A monomorphism of presheaves on the big fppf site of `S` is a separated
morphism of algebraic spaces over `S`: its relative diagonal is an isomorphism, and an
isomorphism is a closed immersion. The statement is made for an arbitrary morphism of presheaves
on the big fppf site of `S`; no algebraic-space hypothesis is used.

This strictly generalises `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSeparated_of_isIso`, which is the same
statement for an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSeparated_of_mono {F G : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (m : F ⟶ G) (hm : Mono m) :
    IsSeparated B S hS m

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSeparated_isLocallyQuasiFinite_of_isLocallyOfFiniteType_mono
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0463.** A monomorphism of algebraic spaces over `S` which is locally of finite type
is separated and locally quasi-finite.

Separatedness is [Stacks Project, Tag 042N], already available as
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSeparated_of_mono`; local quasi-finiteness goes through
unramifiedness, which a monomorphism locally of finite type has by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isUnramified_of_isLocallyOfFiniteType_of_mono`.

These are two of the three assertions of the "moreover" clause of
[Stacks Project, Tag 05W6], reached from its condition (3); the equivalence of conditions (1)
and (3) carries them over to condition (1), and the two unconditional equivalences below carry
them over to conditions (2) and (4).
declarations.statement:
theorem isSeparated_isLocallyQuasiFinite_of_isLocallyOfFiniteType_mono (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (h : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f ∧ Mono f) :
    IsSeparated B S hS f ∧ IsLocallyQuasiFinite B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSeparated_of_mono
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 042N.** A monomorphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is separated: its relative
diagonal is an isomorphism, and an isomorphism is a closed immersion.

The statement is made for an arbitrary morphism of presheaves on the big fppf site of `S`; no
algebraic-space hypothesis is used.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSeparated_of_mono {F G : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (g : F ⟶ G) (hg : Mono g) :
    IsSeparated B S hS g

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallyOfFiniteType_of_isLocallyOfFinitePresentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0464**, first assertion. A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` which is locally of
finite presentation is locally of finite type.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyOfFiniteType_of_isLocallyOfFinitePresentation
    {F G : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} {f : F ⟶ G}
    (hf : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS f) :
    IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteType_of_isFinitePresentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0464**, second assertion. A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` of finite
presentation is of finite type.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteType_of_isFinitePresentation
    {F G : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} {f : F ⟶ G}
    (hf : IsFinitePresentation B S hS f) :
    IsFiniteType B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isEtale_comp
declarations.doc: The composite of two étale morphisms of presheaves on the big fppf site of `S` is étale.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEtale_comp {F G H : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} {f : F ⟶ G} {g : G ⟶ H}
    (hf : IsEtale B S hS f) (hg : IsEtale B S hS g) : IsEtale B S hS (f ≫ g)
declarations.comment: the composition of two etale morphisms of algebraic spaces is etale

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isEtale_of_isPullback
declarations.doc: A base change of an étale morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is étale.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEtale_of_isPullback {X' X Z Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS}
    (p : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ Z) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Z ⟶ Y)
    (h : IsPullback p f' f g) (hf : IsEtale B S hS f.hom) :
    IsEtale B S hS f'.hom
declarations.comment: the base change of an étale morphism of algebraic spaces is étale

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFlat_of_isEtale
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0467.** An étale morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is flat: in every commuting
square of étale charts the chart morphism of schemes is étale, by cancellation
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.etale_of_comp_etale_chart`), and an étale morphism of schemes is
flat.

Nothing is asked of the target.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFlat_of_isEtale {F G : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} {f : F ⟶ G}
    (hf : IsEtale B S hS f) : IsFlat B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallyOfFinitePresentation_of_isEtale
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0468.** An étale morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is locally of finite
presentation: the chart morphism of schemes in every commuting square of étale charts is étale,
hence locally of finite presentation.

Nothing is asked of the target.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyOfFinitePresentation_of_isEtale
    {F G : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} {f : F ⟶ G} (hf : IsEtale B S hS f) :
    IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallySurjective_coproductDesc_of_isFppfCovering
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0469.** The map from the coproduct of an fppf covering family of algebraic spaces
over `S`, taken in the category of fppf sheaves of sets, to its target is surjective as a map
of fppf sheaves.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallySurjective_coproductDesc_of_isFppfCovering
    {I : Type v} {F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (X : I → (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (f : ∀ i, X i ⟶ F)
    (hf : IsFppfCovering B S hS X f)
    (G : Sheaf (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) (Type u))
    (ι : ∀ i, (⟨X i, (hf.source_isAlgebraicSpace i).isSheaf⟩ :
      Sheaf (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) (Type u)) ⟶ G)
    (hG : IsColimit (Cofan.mk G ι)) :
    Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective
      (hG.desc (Cofan.mk
        (⟨F, hf.target_isAlgebraicSpace.isSheaf⟩ :
          Sheaf (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) (Type u))
        (fun i =>
          (Sheaf.homEquiv (X :=
            (⟨X i, (hf.source_isAlgebraicSpace i).isSheaf⟩ :
              Sheaf (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) (Type u)))
            (Y :=
            (⟨F, hf.target_isAlgebraicSpace.isSheaf⟩ :
              Sheaf (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) (Type u)))).symm (f i))))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_prod_map
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 046D.** The product of two morphisms of presheaves on the big fppf site of `S`
representable by algebraic spaces is representable by algebraic spaces.

The product `a₁ ⨯ a₂` is the composite of `a₁ ⨯ 𝟙` with `𝟙 ⨯ a₂`, and each of these is a
base change of one of the two factors along a projection.
declarations.statement:
lemma isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_prod_map
    {F₁ F₂ G₁ G₂ : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (a₁ : F₁ ⟶ G₁) (a₂ : F₂ ⟶ G₂)
    (h₁ : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS a₁)
    (h₂ : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS a₂) :
    IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS (prod.map a₁ a₂)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasProperty.of_isPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 046F.** In a Cartesian square of presheaves on the big fppf site of `S` whose
right-hand column `a` is representable by algebraic spaces and has a property `P` of morphisms
of algebraic spaces over `S`, the left-hand column `a'` is representable by algebraic spaces
(Stacks 03Y0) and has `P`.

Only invariance of `P` under isomorphism is used, which is weaker than the two conditions
Stacks imposes on `P` in Definition 03XZ.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasProperty_of_isPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 046F.** A property of morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` which is stable
under base change is inherited, as a property of a morphism of presheaves representable by
algebraic spaces, by every cartesian base change of that morphism.
declarations.statement:
lemma hasProperty_of_isPullback (P : MorphismProperty (AlgebraicSpaces B S hS))
    [P.IsStableUnderBaseChange]
    {F G G' H : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (p : H ⟶ F) (a' : H ⟶ G') (a : F ⟶ G) (g : G' ⟶ G) (h : IsPullback p a' a g)
    (ha : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS a)
    (hP : HasProperty B S hS P a ha) :
    HasProperty B S hS P a'
      (isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_of_isPullback B S hS p a' a g h ha)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasProperty_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 046G.** A composite of morphisms of presheaves on the big fppf site of `S`
representable by algebraic spaces has a property `P` of morphisms of algebraic spaces over
`S` as soon as both factors do, provided `P` is stable under base change, local on the base
for the fppf topology, and stable under composition.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasProperty_comp (P : MorphismProperty (AlgebraicSpaces B S hS))
    [P.IsStableUnderBaseChange] [P.IsLocalAtTarget (Topology.fppf.precoverage B S hS)]
    [P.IsStableUnderComposition]
    {F G H : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (a : F ⟶ G) (b : G ⟶ H)
    (ha : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS a)
    (hb : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS b)
    (hPa : HasProperty B S hS P a ha) (hPb : HasProperty B S hS P b hb) :
    HasProperty B S hS P (a ≫ b)
      (isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_comp B S hS a b ha hb)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasProperty_prod_map
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 046H.** The product of two morphisms of presheaves on the big fppf site of `S`
representable by algebraic spaces has a property `P` of morphisms of algebraic spaces over
`S` as soon as both factors do, provided `P` is stable under base change, local on the base
for the fppf topology, and stable under composition.

The product is the composite of two base changes of the two factors, so this follows from
Stacks 046F and Stacks 046G.
declarations.statement:
lemma hasProperty_prod_map (P : MorphismProperty (AlgebraicSpaces B S hS))
    [P.IsStableUnderBaseChange] [P.IsLocalAtTarget (Topology.fppf.precoverage B S hS)]
    [P.IsStableUnderComposition]
    {F₁ F₂ G₁ G₂ : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (a₁ : F₁ ⟶ G₁) (a₂ : F₂ ⟶ G₂)
    (h₁ : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS a₁)
    (h₂ : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS a₂)
    (ha₁ : HasProperty B S hS P a₁ h₁) (ha₂ : HasProperty B S hS P a₂ h₂) :
    HasProperty B S hS P (prod.map a₁ a₂)
      (isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_prod_map B S hS a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.relativelyRepresentable_separated_locallyQuasiFinite_of_isPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 046J**, conditional only on the fppf locality of separatedness.

In a cartesian square of sheaves on the big fppf site of `S` whose right-hand column `g` is
representable by algebraic spaces, surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation and
whose top row `a` is representable by algebraic spaces, separated and locally quasi-finite,
the bottom row `b` is representable by objects of the site, separated and locally
quasi-finite.

Representability of `b` by objects of the site is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.relativelyRepresentable_of_isPullback_of_flat_surjective`, the
source's own argument by effective fppf descent of schemes.  Separatedness and local
quasi-finiteness descend by Stacks 0421 and Stacks 0427, each read at the fppf precoverage
from its fpqc form.
declarations.statement:
theorem relativelyRepresentable_separated_locallyQuasiFinite_of_isPullback
    {E F H G : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (a : E ⟶ F) (f : E ⟶ H) (g : F ⟶ G) (b : H ⟶ G) (sq : IsPullback a f g b)
    (hH : Presheaf.IsSheaf (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) H)
    (hG : Presheaf.IsSheaf (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) G)
    (hgRep : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS g)
    (hgSurj : HasProperty B S hS (surjectiveMorphismProperty B S hS) g hgRep)
    (hgFlat : HasProperty B S hS (flatProperty B S hS) g hgRep)
    (hgLfp : HasProperty B S hS (locallyOfFinitePresentationProperty B S hS) g hgRep)
    (haRep : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS a)
    (haSep : HasProperty B S hS (separatedProperty B S hS) a haRep)
    (haLqf : HasProperty B S hS (locallyQuasiFiniteProperty B S hS) a haRep) :
    ∃ hbRep : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS b,
      yoneda.relativelyRepresentable b ∧
        HasProperty B S hS (separatedProperty B S hS) b hbRep ∧
          HasProperty B S hS (locallyQuasiFiniteProperty B S hS) b hbRep

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.relativelyRepresentable_diag_of_flat_presentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 046K.** Let `F` be a sheaf on the big fppf site of a scheme `S` which admits a
morphism `f : X ⟶ F` from an algebraic space over `S` that is representable by algebraic
spaces, surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation.  Then the absolute diagonal
`Δ_F : F ⟶ F × F` is representable *by objects of the site*, that is, every fibre product of
`Δ_F` with a scheme-valued point of `F × F` is again a scheme over `S` — not merely an
algebraic space, as **Stacks 03Y2** would give.

Let `d = Δ_F` and let `k = f × f : X ⨯ X ⟶ F × F`, which is representable by algebraic spaces,
surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation by **Stacks 046D** and **Stacks 046H**.  The
fibre product `W = (X ⨯ X) ×_{F × F} F` is the kernel pair `X ×_F X` of `f`, so its projection
to `X ⨯ X` is representable by algebraic spaces, separated and locally quasi-finite.  Given a
scheme-valued point `η : h_T ⟶ F × F`, the base change `T' = h_T ×_{F × F} (X ⨯ X) ⟶ h_T` of
`k` inherits the three properties by **Stacks 046F**, and `T' ×_{X ⨯ X} W ⟶ T'` inherits
separatedness and local quasi-finiteness from the projection of `W`; that fibre product is at
the same time the base change of `Z = h_T ×_{F × F} F ⟶ h_T` along `T' ⟶ h_T`.  **Stacks 046J**
applied to the resulting cartesian square makes `Z ⟶ h_T` representable by objects of the site,
and `Z` is the fibre product of `Δ_F` with `η`.
declarations.statement:
theorem relativelyRepresentable_diag_of_flat_presentation
    {F X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hF : Presheaf.IsSheaf (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) F)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (f : X ⟶ F)
    (hf : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS f)
    (hfSurj : HasProperty B S hS (surjectiveMorphismProperty B S hS) f hf)
    (hfFlat : HasProperty B S hS (flatProperty B S hS) f hf)
    (hfLfp : HasProperty B S hS (locallyOfFinitePresentationProperty B S hS) f hf) :
    yoneda.relativelyRepresentable (diag F)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidScheme.isOpenImmersion_restrictionQuotientMap_of_open_image
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 046M.** Let `G` be a groupoid scheme over `S` and let `g : U' ⟶ U` be a morphism
to its scheme of objects whose saturation is the range of an open immersion `i : W ⟶ U`. If
the reach map factors as `k ≫ i` with `k` inducing a surjection of fppf sheaves, then the map
of quotient sheaves `U'/R' ⟶ U/R` induced by the restriction of `G` along `g` is a
representable open immersion.
declarations.statement:
theorem isOpenImmersion_restrictionQuotientMap_of_open_image
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    [HasSheafify (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) (Type u)]
    (G : GroupoidScheme S) {U' W : Over S}
    (g : U' ⟶ G.objects) (i : W ⟶ G.objects)
    [IsOpenImmersion i.left]
    (k : pullback g G.target ⟶ W)
    (hk : k ≫ i = restrictionReachMap G g)
    (himage : Set.range i.left.base =
      Set.range (restrictionReachMap G g).left.base)
    (hsurj : Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective
      ((presheafToSheaf (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) (Type u)).map
        ((Over.post B.inclusion).op.whiskerLeft (yoneda.map k)))) :
    Space.IsOpenImmersion B S hS
      (restrictionQuotientMap (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) (Over.post B.inclusion) G g
        (restrict G g)).1

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Functor.isEquivalenceOver_iff_locallyEssSurjOnFibers
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 046N**. Let `(𝒞, J)` be a site, let `p : 𝒳 ⥤ 𝒞` and `q : 𝒴 ⥤ 𝒞` be stacks over `𝒞`
and let `F : 𝒳 ⥤ 𝒴` be a fully faithful 1-morphism of fibred categories over `𝒞`. Then the
following are equivalent:

1. `F` is an equivalence over `𝒞`;
2. for every object `U` of `𝒞` and every object `x` of the fibre of `𝒴` over `U` there is a
   covering sieve of `U` along each member `f` of which `f^* x` is in the essential image of the
   functor induced by `F` on the fibres over the source of `f`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEquivalenceOver_iff_locallyEssSurjOnFibers
    {p : 𝒳 ⥤ 𝒞} {q : 𝒴 ⥤ 𝒞} {F : 𝒳 ⥤ 𝒴} {J : GrothendieckTopology 𝒞}
    (h₁ : p.IsStack J) (h₂ : q.IsStack J) (hF : IsFibredOneMorphism p q F)
    [F.Full] [F.Faithful] :
    Nonempty (IsEquivalenceOver p q F) ↔ LocallyEssSurjOnFibers h₂.isFibered hF.comp_eq J

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.toQuotientSheaf_eq_iff_locally_related
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 046O.** Two sections of `U` have the same image in the quotient sheaf if and only
if, on an fppf covering, they are the source and the target of a common section of `R`.
declarations.statement:
theorem toQuotientSheaf_eq_iff_locally_related (T : BigFppfOver site S hS)
    (a b : U.left.obj (op T)) :
    ((toQuotientSheaf j).app (op T) a = (toQuotientSheaf j).app (op T) b) ↔
      ∃ E : PreZeroHypercover.{u + 1} T,
        BigFppfOver.IsCovering site S hS ⟨T, E⟩ ∧
          ∀ i : E.I₀, ∃ r : R.left.obj (op (E.X i)),
            (U.left.map (E.f i).op a = j.source.left.app (op (E.X i)) r) ∧
              (U.left.map (E.f i).op b = j.target.left.app (op (E.X i)) r)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.quotientPointwiseMapData
declarations.doc:
The strict natural map between the presenting pseudofunctors of the two pointwise groupoid
fibrations: its component at a test object is the evaluated functor of the given groupoid
morphism, and its naturality isomorphisms are transports.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def quotientPointwiseMapData {G H : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B}
    (f : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.Hom G H) :
    { α : (evaluationGroupoidFunctor G.toGroupoidInFunctors ⋙
            Grpd.forgetToCat).toPseudofunctor' ⟶
          (evaluationGroupoidFunctor H.toGroupoidInFunctors ⋙
            Grpd.forgetToCat).toPseudofunctor' //
      (∀ T : BigFppfOver C S hS,
        (α.app ⟨op T⟩).toFunctor = f.toGroupoidHom.evaluation (op T)) ∧
      (∀ {a b} (g : a ⟶ b),
        ∃ h : ((evaluationGroupoidFunctor G.toGroupoidInFunctors ⋙
              Grpd.forgetToCat).toPseudofunctor').map g ≫ α.app b =
            α.app a ≫ ((evaluationGroupoidFunctor H.toGroupoidInFunctors ⋙
              Grpd.forgetToCat).toPseudofunctor').map g,
          α.naturality g = eqToIso h) }
declarations.comment: the strict map on the presenting groupoids

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.quotientStackMap
declarations.doc:
The canonical 1-morphism `[f] : [U/R] ⟶ [U'/R']` of quotient stacks induced
by a morphism of groupoids in algebraic spaces over the same base.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.quotientStackMap_commutes
declarations.doc:
The induced 1-morphism intertwines the pointwise groupoid map with the two
stackification maps, naturally and over the site.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def quotientStackMap_commutes {G H : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B}
    (f : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.Hom G H) :
    BasedFunctor.comp (quotientPointwiseMap f) (pointwiseToQuotientStackBased H) ≅
      BasedFunctor.comp (pointwiseToQuotientStackBased G) (quotientStackMap f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.fullyFaithful_quotientStackMap_iff_isPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 046S.** The induced morphism of quotient stacks `[f] : [U/R] ⟶ [U'/R']` is fully
faithful if and only if `R` is the restriction of `R'` along `f : U ⟶ U'`, i.e. if and only if
the square formed by the arrow map of `f` and the two source–target maps is cartesian.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fullyFaithful_quotientStackMap_iff_isPullback
    {G H : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B}
    (f : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.Hom G H) :
    Nonempty (quotientStackMap f).toFunctor.FullyFaithful ↔
      IsPullback f.toGroupoidHom.mapArrows
        (prod.lift G.toGroupoidInFunctors.source G.toGroupoidInFunctors.target)
        (prod.lift H.toGroupoidInFunctors.source H.toGroupoidInFunctors.target)
        (prod.map f.toGroupoidHom.mapObjects f.toGroupoidHom.mapObjects)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallySurjective_source_pullback_snd
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 046T.** A map on objects which is surjective as a map of fppf sheaves stays
surjective after passing to the arrows of the target groupoid whose target lifts through it and
taking their sources.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallySurjective_source_pullback_snd
    {C : BigFppfSite.{u}} {S : Scheme.{u}} {hS : C.Contains S}
    {B : AlgebraicSpaces C S hS} {G H : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B}
    (f : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.Hom G H)
    (hf : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (BigFppfOver.topology C S hS)
      f.toGroupoidHom.mapObjects) :
    Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (BigFppfOver.topology C S hS)
      (pullback.snd f.toGroupoidHom.mapObjects H.target.hom ≫ H.source.hom)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallySurjective_source_pullback_of_isFppfCovering_mapObjects
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 046T.** If the map on objects of a morphism of groupoids in algebraic spaces is an
fppf covering, then every object of the target groupoid is fppf-locally the source of an arrow
whose target lifts to the source groupoid.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallySurjective_source_pullback_of_isFppfCovering_mapObjects
    (C : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : C.Contains S)
    (B : AlgebraicSpaces C S hS)
    (G H : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B)
    (f : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.Hom G H)
    (hf : IsFppfCovering C S hS (fun _ : PUnit => G.objects.obj)
      (fun _ => f.toGroupoidHom.mapObjects)) :
    Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (BigFppfOver.topology C S hS)
      (pullback.snd f.toGroupoidHom.mapObjects H.target.hom ≫ H.source.hom)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallySurjective_source_pullback_of_isFppfCovering_self
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 046T.** If the arrows of the target groupoid whose target lifts to the source
groupoid form an fppf covering of the object space of the target through their sources, then that
saturation map is surjective as a map of fppf sheaves.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallySurjective_source_pullback_of_isFppfCovering_self
    {C : BigFppfSite.{u}} {S : Scheme.{u}} {hS : C.Contains S}
    {B : AlgebraicSpaces C S hS} {G H : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B}
    (f : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.Hom G H)
    (hf : IsFppfCovering C S hS
      (fun _ : PUnit => pullback f.toGroupoidHom.mapObjects H.target.hom)
      (fun _ => pullback.snd f.toGroupoidHom.mapObjects H.target.hom ≫ H.source.hom)) :
    Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (BigFppfOver.topology C S hS)
      (pullback.snd f.toGroupoidHom.mapObjects H.target.hom ≫ H.source.hom)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.quotientStackMap_isEquivalenceOver_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 046T.** The induced morphism of quotient stacks `[f] : [U/R] ⟶ [U'/R']` is an
equivalence over the big fppf site if and only if (1) `(U, R, s, t, c)` is the restriction of
`(U', R', s', t', c')` along `f : U ⟶ U'`, i.e. the square formed by the arrow map of `f` and the
two source–target maps is cartesian, and (2) the saturation map
`U ×_{f, U', t'} R' ⟶ R' ⟶ U'` is a surjection of fppf sheaves.
declarations.statement:
public theorem quotientStackMap_isEquivalenceOver_iff
    {G H : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B}
    (f : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.Hom G H) :
    Nonempty (Functor.IsEquivalenceOver (quotientStack G).p (quotientStack H).p
      (quotientStackMap f).toFunctor) ↔
      (IsPullback f.toGroupoidHom.mapArrows
          (prod.lift G.toGroupoidInFunctors.source G.toGroupoidInFunctors.target)
          (prod.lift H.toGroupoidInFunctors.source H.toGroupoidInFunctors.target)
          (prod.map f.toGroupoidHom.mapObjects f.toGroupoidHom.mapObjects) ∧
        Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (BigFppfOver.topology C S hS)
          ((GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.fiberProductSnd
              (ObjectProperty.homMk f.toGroupoidHom.mapObjects : G.objects ⟶ H.objects)
              H.target ≫ H.source).hom))
