**The surjectivity clause of [Stacks Project, Tag 04CQ].**  Let
```
Z --i--→ X
|        |
f        g
↓        ↓
Z' -i'-→ X'
```
be a fibre product square of algebraic spaces over `S` in which `Z ⊆ X` and `Z' ⊆ X'` are closed
subspaces and `i`, `i'` are their inclusions.  Then the canonical map of conormal modules
`f^*𝒞_{Z'/X'} ⟶ 𝒞_{Z/X}` of [Stacks Project, Tag 04CP] is an epimorphism of `𝒪_Z`-modules.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.epi_conormalMap` released from the canonical inverse-image
square: by `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.closedSubspaces_eq_preimageSubspace_of_isPullback` the
cartesian hypothesis makes `Z` the inverse image `g⁻¹(Z')` and by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.vertical_eq_preimageProjection_of_isPullback` it makes `f` the
projection, after which the square's commutativity proof and the canonical one are proofs of the
same proposition.

The horizontal arrows are closed immersions, where the source takes immersions; the
implementation notes of this file record what the passage to the immersion case still needs.
declarations.statement:
theorem epi_conormalMap_of_isPullback
    (Z : ClosedSubspaces B S hS X.1) (Z' : ClosedSubspaces B S hS X'.1) (g : X ⟶ X')
    (f : (⟨Z.1.toFunctor, Z.2.1⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS) ⟶
      (⟨Z'.1.toFunctor, Z'.2.1⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS))
    (hsq : subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z ≫ g = f ≫ subspaceInclusion B S hS X' Z')
    (hcart : IsPullback Z.1.ι f.hom g.hom Z'.1.ι) :
    Epi (conormalMap B S hS Z Z' g f hsq)
declarations.comment: surjectivity, at an arbitrary fibre product square

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_conormalMap_of_isPullback_of_isFlat
declarations.doc:
**The flat clause of [Stacks Project, Tag 04CQ].**  For a fibre product square as in
`AgebraicGeometry.Space.epi_conormalMap_of_isPullback`, if `g` is flat — that is, if the
morphism of small étale ringed topoi it induces is flat in the sense of
[Stacks Project, Tag 04JB] — then the canonical map of conormal modules
`f^*𝒞_{Z'/X'} ⟶ 𝒞_{Z/X}` of [Stacks Project, Tag 04CP] is an isomorphism.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_conormalMap_of_isFlat` released from the canonical
inverse-image square, by the same two identifications.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_conormalMap_of_isPullback_of_isFlat
    (Z : ClosedSubspaces B S hS X.1) (Z' : ClosedSubspaces B S hS X'.1) (g : X ⟶ X')
    (f : (⟨Z.1.toFunctor, Z.2.1⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS) ⟶
      (⟨Z'.1.toFunctor, Z'.2.1⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS))
    (hsq : subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z ≫ g = f ≫ subspaceInclusion B S hS X' Z')
    (hcart : IsPullback Z.1.ι f.hom g.hom Z'.1.ι)
    (hg : (smallEtaleRingedToposHom B S hS g).IsFlat) :
    IsIso (conormalMap B S hS Z Z' g f hsq)
declarations.comment: flat isomorphism, at an arbitrary fibre product square

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.epi_conormalMap
declarations.doc:
**The surjectivity clause of [Stacks Project, Tag 04CQ], for closed immersions.**  Let `Z'`
be a closed subspace of an algebraic space `X'` and let `g : X ⟶ X'` be a morphism of algebraic
spaces.  For the fibre product square — the one whose upper closed subspace is the inverse image
`g⁻¹(Z') ⊆ X` of [Stacks Project, Tag 083Q] and whose vertical morphism is the projection
`g⁻¹(Z') ⟶ Z'` — the canonical map of conormal modules
`f^*𝒞_{Z'/X'} ⟶ 𝒞_{g⁻¹(Z')/X}` of [Stacks Project, Tag 04CP] is an epimorphism of
`𝒪_{g⁻¹(Z')}`-modules.

The source states the lemma for immersions and reduces it to closed immersions at the start of
the proof of [Stacks Project, Tag 04CP]; the closed case is the one this development carries,
for the reasons recorded in the implementation notes of
`StacksFrontier/AlgebraicGeometry/Spaces/ConormalModule.lean`.  The flat clause of the tag is not
proved; see the "What is not proved" section of this file.

Surjectivity of a map of modules on the small étale site means that the map is an epimorphism,
which by [Stacks Project, Tag 01AH] is local surjectivity; the chartwise statement behind it is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.surjective_idealSheafMap_val_app`.
declarations.statement:
theorem epi_conormalMap (g : X ⟶ X') (Z' : ClosedSubspaces B S hS X'.1) :
    Epi (conormalMap B S hS (preimageSubspace B S hS g Z') Z' g
      (preimageProjection B S hS g Z')
      (conormalEtaleRestrictionSquare B S hS g Z'))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_conormalMap_of_isFlat
declarations.doc:
**The flat clause of [Stacks Project, Tag 04CQ], for closed immersions.**  If `g` is flat —
that is, if the morphism of small étale ringed topoi it induces is flat in the sense of
[Stacks Project, Tag 04JB] — then the canonical map of conormal modules
`f^*𝒞_{Z'/X'} ⟶ 𝒞_{g⁻¹(Z')/X}` of [Stacks Project, Tag 04CP] attached to the fibre product
square is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_conormalMap_of_isFlat (g : X ⟶ X') (Z' : ClosedSubspaces B S hS X'.1)
    (hg : (smallEtaleRingedToposHom B S hS g).IsFlat) :
    IsIso (conormalMap B S hS (preimageSubspace B S hS g Z') Z' g
      (preimageProjection B S hS g Z')
      (conormalEtaleRestrictionSquare B S hS g Z'))
declarations.comment: isomorphism when the morphism of small etale ringed topoi is flat

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.epi_conormalMap_of_epi_idealSheafMap
declarations.doc:
**The surjectivity clause of Stacks 04CQ, reduced to the map of defining ideal sheaves.**
If the map `g^*𝓘' ⟶ 𝓘` of `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.idealSheafMap` attached to a commutative
square of closed subspaces is surjective, then so is the map `f^*𝒞_{Z'/X'} ⟶ 𝒞_{Z/X}` of
conormal modules of [Stacks Project, Tag 04CP].

`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.conormalMap` is the isomorphism
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.conormalPullbackComparison` followed by the inverse image along the
inclusion of `Z` of the map of defining ideal sheaves.  The inverse image of modules is a left
adjoint, by the adjunction of [Stacks Project, Tag 03LU], and a left adjoint preserves
epimorphisms.

Surjectivity of `g^*𝓘' ⟶ 𝓘` is what [Stacks Project, Tag 04CQ] obtains from cartesianness of the
square, by reduction to the scheme-level [Stacks Project, Tag 0473]; that reduction is not
carried in this development, so the hypothesis is assumed.  The invertibility clause reduces the
same way, by `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_conormalMap_of_isIso_idealSheafMap`.
declarations.statement:
theorem epi_conormalMap_of_epi_idealSheafMap
    (hsq : subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z ≫ g = f ≫ subspaceInclusion B S hS X' Z')
    (h : Epi (idealSheafMap B S hS Z Z' g f hsq)) :
    Epi (conormalMap B S hS Z Z' g f hsq)
declarations.comment: surjectivity, reduced to surjectivity of the map of defining ideal sheaves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.epi_conormalMapOfImmersions_of_isPullback
declarations.doc:
**The surjectivity clause of [Stacks Project, Tag 04CQ].**  Let
```
Z --i--→ X
|        |
f        g
↓        ↓
Z' -i'-→ X'
```
be a fibre product square of algebraic spaces over `S` in which `i` and `i'` are immersions.  Then
the canonical map `f^*𝒞_{Z'/X'} ⟶ 𝒞_{Z/X}` of [Stacks Project, Tag 04CP] between the conormal
modules of the two immersions is an epimorphism of `𝒪_Z`-modules.
declarations.statement:
theorem epi_conormalMapOfImmersions_of_isPullback
    (i : Z ⟶ X) (i' : Z' ⟶ X') (f : Z ⟶ Z') (g : X ⟶ X')
    (hi : IsImmersion B S hS i.hom) (hi' : IsImmersion B S hS i'.hom)
    (hcart : IsPullback i f g i') :
    Epi (conormalMapOfImmersions B S hS i i' f g hi hi' hcart.w)
declarations.comment: surjectivity, for a fibre product square of immersions

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_conormalMapOfImmersions_of_isPullback_of_isFlat
declarations.doc:
**The flat clause of [Stacks Project, Tag 04CQ].**  For a fibre product square as in
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.epi_conormalMapOfImmersions_of_isPullback`, if `g` is flat as a
morphism of algebraic spaces (Stacks 03ML), then the canonical map `f^*𝒞_{Z'/X'} ⟶ 𝒞_{Z/X}` of
[Stacks Project, Tag 04CP] is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_conormalMapOfImmersions_of_isPullback_of_isFlat
    (i : Z ⟶ X) (i' : Z' ⟶ X') (f : Z ⟶ Z') (g : X ⟶ X')
    (hi : IsImmersion B S hS i.hom) (hi' : IsImmersion B S hS i'.hom)
    (hcart : IsPullback i f g i') (hg : IsFlat B S hS g.hom) :
    IsIso (conormalMapOfImmersions B S hS i i' f g hi hi' hcart.w)
declarations.comment: isomorphism when g is flat, for a fibre product square of immersions

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.differentialsComparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04CS**, the comparison map.  Let `D` be a derivation of `𝒪_{X_étale}` with values
in a sheaf of `𝒪_{X_étale}`-modules `𝓕` which annihilates every function pulled back from an
open of `Y`.  This is the morphism `c'' : (Ω_{X/Y})^a ⟶ 𝓕` of `𝒪_{X_étale}`-modules adjoint,
under the adjunction between the associated-module functor of Stacks 03DU (4) and restriction to
the small Zariski site, to the morphism `c' : Ω_{X/Y} ⟶ ε_* 𝓕` through which the small Zariski
restriction of `D` factors.

At `𝓕 = Ω_{X_étale/Y_étale}` and `D` its universal derivation this is the map the source's proof
calls `c''`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def differentialsComparison
    (hD : ∀ (W : Y.Opens) (b : Γ(Y, W)), D.d (pullbackSection B hX f W b) = 0) :
    associatedRelativeDifferentials B hX f ⟶ F
declarations.comment:
the comparison map `c'' : (Ω_{X/Y})^a ⟶ 𝓕` of the source's proof, for a
  derivation of `𝒪_{X_étale}` annihilating the functions pulled back from `Y`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.differentialsComparison_adjunct
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04CS**, compatibility with the universal derivations on the small Zariski site.
The adjunct `c' : Ω_{X/Y} ⟶ ε_* 𝓕` of the comparison map carries the universal derivation
`d_{X/Y}` of `Ω_{X/Y}` to the small Zariski restriction of `D`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem differentialsComparison_adjunct
    (hD : ∀ (W : Y.Opens) (b : Γ(Y, W)), D.d (pullbackSection B hX f W b) = 0) :
    (f.universalRelativeDerivation).postcomp
        ((((associatedModuleAdjunction B X hX).homEquiv
          (Scheme.Hom.relativeDifferentials f) F)
            (differentialsComparison B hX f D hD))).val =
      zariskiRestriction B hX f D hD
declarations.comment:
compatibility of the comparison map with the universal derivation `d_{X/Y}` on
  the small Zariski site

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.eq_differentialsComparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04CS**, canonicity of the comparison map.  It is the only morphism
`(Ω_{X/Y})^a ⟶ 𝓕` whose adjunct carries the universal derivation `d_{X/Y}` to the small Zariski
restriction of `D`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem eq_differentialsComparison
    (hD : ∀ (W : Y.Opens) (b : Γ(Y, W)), D.d (pullbackSection B hX f W b) = 0)
    (g : associatedRelativeDifferentials B hX f ⟶ F)
    (hg : (f.universalRelativeDerivation).postcomp
        ((((associatedModuleAdjunction B X hX).homEquiv
          (Scheme.Hom.relativeDifferentials f) F) g)).val =
      zariskiRestriction B hX f D hD) :
    g = differentialsComparison B hX f D hD
declarations.comment:
canonicity: the comparison map is the unique morphism whose adjunct carries
  `d_{X/Y}` to the small Zariski restriction of the derivation

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.differentialsComparison_postcomp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04CS**, naturality of the comparison map in the coefficient sheaf: the comparison
map of a derivation postcomposed with `α : 𝓕 ⟶ 𝓖` is the comparison map of the derivation
followed by `α`.  So the comparison maps form a natural transformation out of `(Ω_{X/Y})^a`, and
in particular an isomorphism `(Ω_{X/Y})^a ≅ 𝓕` exhibited by one of them is canonical.
declarations.statement:
public theorem differentialsComparison_postcomp
    (hD : ∀ (W : Y.Opens) (b : Γ(Y, W)), D.d (pullbackSection B hX f W b) = 0) (α : F ⟶ G) :
    differentialsComparison B hX f (D.postcomp α.val)
        (postcomp_pullbackSection_eq_zero B hX f D hD α) =
      differentialsComparison B hX f D hD ≫ α
declarations.comment: naturality of the comparison map in the coefficient sheaf of modules

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.existsUnique_postcomp_associatedRelativeDifferentialsDerivation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04CS.**  The associated module `(Ω_{X/Y})^a` of the relative differentials of
`f : X ⟶ Y`, together with the derivation `d^a`, is the module of differentials of
`𝒪_{X_étale}` over `Y` in the sense of Stacks 04BN: every derivation `D` of `𝒪_{X_étale}` with
values in a sheaf of `𝒪_{X_étale}`-modules `𝓖` which annihilates the functions pulled back from
`Y` factors as `D = d^a ∘ g` for exactly one morphism `g : (Ω_{X/Y})^a ⟶ 𝓖` of sheaves of
modules.

The factorization is the comparison map `c''` of
`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.differentialsComparison`; that it *is* a factorization, and that it
is the only one, both come from the injectivity of restriction to the small Zariski site
together with the identity
`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.differentialsComparison_associatedRelativeDifferentialsDerivation`.

The derivation is taken relative to the constant presheaf of integers, which imposes nothing
beyond the Leibniz rule, so that the `Y`-linearity is carried by the hypothesis `hD` alone; see
the implementation notes of
`StacksFrontier/AlgebraicGeometry/Descent/AssociatedModule/SmallEtaleDifferentials.lean`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem existsUnique_postcomp_associatedRelativeDifferentialsDerivation
    {G : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheaf B X hX)}
    (D : PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing.Derivation' (R := (commRingStructureSheaf B X hX).obj) G.val
      (constIntMap (commRingStructureSheaf B X hX).obj))
    (hD : ∀ (W : Y.Opens) (b : Γ(Y, W)), D.d (pullbackSection B hX f W b) = 0) :
    ∃! g : associatedRelativeDifferentials B hX f ⟶ G,
      (associatedRelativeDifferentialsDerivation B hX f).postcomp g.val = D
declarations.comment: corepresentability: `(Ω_{X/Y})^a` with `d^a` is the module of differentials

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.associatedRelativeDifferentialsDerivation
declarations.doc:
**The derivation `d^a` of the source's proof of Stacks 04CS**, on `(Ω_{X/Y})^a` itself:
`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.sectionsDerivation` transported along the identification of the
associated module with its sections description.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def associatedRelativeDifferentialsDerivation :
    PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing.Derivation' (R := (commRingStructureSheaf B X hX).obj)
      (associatedRelativeDifferentials B hX f).val
      (constIntMap (commRingStructureSheaf B X hX).obj)
declarations.comment: the derivation `d^a` into the associated module of differentials

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.differentialsIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04CS.**  The canonical isomorphism `(Ω_{X/Y})^a ≅ Ω_{X_étale/Y_étale}`: both sides
corepresent the functor of `Y_étale`-derivations of `𝒪_{X_étale}`, the left one by
`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.existsUnique_postcomp_etaleAssociatedDerivation` and the right one
by `AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.universalDerivation_isUniversal`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def differentialsIso :
    associatedRelativeDifferentials B X.property (schemeHom B f) ≅ sheafOfDifferentials B f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.postcomp_differentialsIso_hom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04CS**, compatibility with the universal derivations: the canonical isomorphism
carries `d^a` to the universal `Y_étale`-derivation `d_{X_étale/Y_étale}`.
declarations.comment: compatibility of the canonical isomorphism with the universal derivations

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.isIso_universalDifferentialsComparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04CS, the invertibility clause.**  The comparison map
`c'' : (Ω_{X/Y})^a ⟶ 𝓕` of `AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.differentialsComparison` is an
isomorphism at `𝓕 = Ω_{X_étale/Y_étale}` carrying its universal derivation.  This is the
statement the tag's "canonical isomorphism" amounts to for the map the source's proof
produces.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_universalDifferentialsComparison :
    IsIso (universalDifferentialsComparison B f)
declarations.comment: the comparison map `c''` is an isomorphism at `𝓕 = Ω_{X_étale/Y_étale}`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sheafOfDifferentialsSchemeComparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04CS, the invertibility clause, for every morphism of schemes of the big fppf site
over `S`.**  For a morphism `α : U ⟶ V` of schemes of the site, the sheaf of differentials of
`α` read as a morphism of represented algebraic spaces — the module of differentials on the
small étale site of `yoneda.obj U` — is the small-étale module attached by Stacks 03DU (4) to
the Zariski sheaf of relative differentials `Ω_{U/V}` of Stacks 01US.

This is the hypothesis `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SheafOfDifferentialsSchemeComparison`, which the
consumers of the final sentence of Stacks 04CU need.  It is
`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.differentialsIso`, the canonical isomorphism
`(Ω_{U/V})^a ≅ Ω_{U_étale/V_étale}` of Stacks 04CS, transported along the identification of the
small étale site of `yoneda.obj U` with the small étale site of the scheme underlying `U`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.schemeDifferentialsIso`).
declarations.statement:
theorem sheafOfDifferentialsSchemeComparison :
    SheafOfDifferentialsSchemeComparison B S hS
declarations.comment:
the invertibility clause, for a morphism of schemes of the site read on the small
  étale site of the represented algebraic space

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sheafOfDifferentialsSchemeVanishing
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04CS at zero objects**, the vanishing comparison that Stacks 04G9 needs:
for a morphism `ψ : U ⟶ V` of schemes of the site, the spaces-level sheaf of differentials of
`ψ` vanishes exactly when `Ω_{U/V}` does.
declarations.statement:
theorem sheafOfDifferentialsSchemeVanishing :
    SheafOfDifferentialsSchemeVanishing B S hS
declarations.comment: the vanishing comparison for a morphism of schemes of the site

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sheafOfDifferentials
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04CT.** The sheaf of differentials `Ω_{X/Y}` of a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic
spaces: the module of differentials of `f♯ : f⁻¹𝒪_Y ⟶ 𝒪_X`, realized as the associated sheaf of
modules of the presheaf of sectionwise Kähler differentials of `f♯`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def sheafOfDifferentials (f : X ⟶ Y) : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2
declarations.comment: the sheaf of differentials of a morphism of algebraic spaces

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.universalDerivation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04CT.** The universal `Y`-derivation `d_{X/Y} : 𝒪_X ⟶ Ω_{X/Y}`: the sectionwise
Kähler differential followed by the unit of sheafification.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def universalDerivation (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing.Derivation' (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS f).val
      (structureSharpInverseImage B S hS f).hom

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_of_isSheafOfDifferentialsMap_etaleSquare
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04CU, the invertibility clause on a full square of étale charts.**  Let

```
U --ψ--> V
|        |
a        b
v        v
X --f--> Y
```

be a commutative square of algebraic spaces over `S` whose vertical arrows `a` and `b` are
étale.  Then every comparison map `c : a^*Ω_{X/Y} ⟶ Ω_{U/V}` of Stacks 04CX for that square is
an isomorphism.

`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_of_isSheafOfDifferentialsMap_etale` is this statement for
`b = 𝟙 Y`.  The step to an arbitrary étale `b` is the étale-base comparison
`Ω_{U/V} ≅ Ω_{U/(ψ ≫ b)}` of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sheafOfDifferentialsIsoOfSharpIso`, built from Stacks 03G8 and the
clause `b^{-1}𝒪_Y = 𝒪_V` of Stacks 03LV: composing `c` with it produces, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSheafOfDifferentialsMap_comp_sharpIsoHom`, a comparison map of the
square with left edge `ψ ≫ b = a ≫ f`, which is invertible by the case already proved.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_of_isSheafOfDifferentialsMap_etaleSquare (f : X ⟶ Y) (a : U ⟶ X) (ψ : U ⟶ V)
    (b : V ⟶ Y) (ha : IsEtale B S hS a.hom) (hb : IsEtale B S hS b.hom)
    (hcomm : a ≫ f = ψ ≫ b)
    {c : (modulePullback B S hS a).obj (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS f) ⟶
      sheafOfDifferentials B S hS ψ}
    (hc : IsSheafOfDifferentialsMap B S hS a f ψ c) : IsIso c
declarations.comment:
the identification `Ω_{X/Y}|_{U_étale} ≅ Ω_{U/V}` is the canonical one on a full
  square of étale charts: every comparison map of 04CX for a commutative square whose two
  vertical arrows are étale is an isomorphism.  The already registered clause is the case of a
  square whose bottom edge is an identity

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_of_isSheafOfDifferentialsMap_etale
declarations.doc:
**The comparison map of Stacks 04CX along an étale morphism is an isomorphism.**  By
uniqueness of the comparison map it is the identification of Stacks 04CU,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sheafOfDifferentialsEtaleSourceLocalizationIso`.

The left edge of the square is taken as a morphism `p' : U ⟶ Y` together with an equality
`a ≫ f = p'`, so that the statement applies at whatever spelling of the composite a caller
has.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_of_isSheafOfDifferentialsMap_etale (a : U ⟶ X) (ha : IsEtale B S hS a.hom)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (p' : U ⟶ Y) (hp' : a ≫ f = p')
    {c : (modulePullback B S hS a).obj (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS f) ⟶
      sheafOfDifferentials B S hS p'}
    (hc : IsSheafOfDifferentialsMap B S hS a f p' c) : IsIso c
declarations.comment:
the identification `Ω_{X/Y}|_{U_étale} ≅ Ω_{U/V}` is the canonical one: every
  comparison map of 04CX along an étale `a : U ⟶ X`, for a square whose bottom edge is an
  identity, is an isomorphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sheafOfDifferentialsIsoOfSharpIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04CU, the étale-base step.**  If the structure maps of `p : X ⟶ Y` and `q : X ⟶ Z`
differ by an isomorphism `e` of their sources, then the two sheaves of differentials agree:
`Ω_{X/Y} ≅ Ω_{X/Z}`.

Both sheaves corepresent the same functor of derivations — a `Y`-derivation and a `Z`-derivation
are the same additive map, by `PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing.Derivation'.precompBase` applied to `e`
and to its inverse — so the identification is the one matching the two universal derivations.

Applied to `ψ : U ⟶ V` and `ψ ≫ b : U ⟶ Y` for an étale `b : V ⟶ Y` this is the equality
`Ω_{U/V} = Ω_{U/Y}` which the final sentence of the source's proof uses.
declarations.statement:
def sheafOfDifferentialsIsoOfSharpIso
    (he : e.hom ≫ structureSharpInverseImage B S hS p =
      structureSharpInverseImage B S hS q) :
    sheafOfDifferentials B S hS p ≅ sheafOfDifferentials B S hS q
declarations.comment:
the étale-base step: Ω_{X/Y} = Ω_{X/Z} when the two structure maps differ by an
  isomorphism of their sources, which is what 03G8 and the clause `b⁻¹𝒪_Y = 𝒪_V` of 03LV supply
  for an étale `b : V ⟶ Y` at `p = ψ`, `q = ψ ≫ b`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.universalDerivation_sheafOfDifferentialsIsoOfSharpIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04CU, the étale-base step is canonical.**  The identification of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sheafOfDifferentialsIsoOfSharpIso` carries the universal
`Y`-derivation `d_{X/Y}` of a local section to the universal `Z`-derivation `d_{X/Z}` of the
same section, so it is the comparison the source names and not merely some isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
lemma universalDerivation_sheafOfDifferentialsIsoOfSharpIso
    (he : e.hom ≫ structureSharpInverseImage B S hS p =
      structureSharpInverseImage B S hS q)
    {W : (SmallEtale B S hS X.1)ᵒᵖ} (x : (structureRingSheaf B S hS X).obj.obj W) :
    (((sharpIsoHom B S hS p q e he).val.app W).hom)
        ((universalDerivation B S hS p).d x) =
      (universalDerivation B S hS q).d x
declarations.comment: the étale-base step carries one universal derivation to the other

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sheafOfDifferentialsEtaleLocalizationIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04CU.**  Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` and let
`a ≫ f = ψ ≫ b` be a commutative square with `a : U ⟶ X` and `b : V ⟶ Y` étale.  Then the
restriction of `Ω_{X/Y}` to the small étale site of `U` — the pullback of `𝒪_X`-modules along
`a`, by the abuse of notation of Stacks' Equation 03LW — is `Ω_{U/V}`.

The source's proof has two steps and both are carried out here.  Its first step is the
étale-source localization `Ω_{X/Y}|_{U_étale} = Ω_{U/Y}` of Stacks 03LP, 03LQ and 04BO, which is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sheafOfDifferentialsEtaleSourceLocalizationIso` at the étale `a`.  Its
second step is the identification `ψ^{-1}𝒪_V = (ψ ≫ b)^{-1}𝒪_Y` under the structure maps, which
is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.etaleBaseInverseImageStructureSheafIso` and its compatibility, from
the composition law of Stacks 03G8 and the clause `b^{-1}𝒪_Y = 𝒪_V` of Stacks 03LV for the
étale `b`.  The square then identifies `Ω_{U/Y}` with `Ω_{U/(ψ ≫ b)}`, and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sheafOfDifferentialsIsoOfSharpIso` identifies that with `Ω_{U/V}`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def sheafOfDifferentialsEtaleLocalizationIso (f : X ⟶ Y) (a : U ⟶ X) (ψ : U ⟶ V)
    (b : V ⟶ Y) (ha : IsEtale B S hS a.hom) (hb : IsEtale B S hS b.hom)
    (hcomm : a ≫ f = ψ ≫ b) :
    (modulePullback B S hS a).obj (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS f) ≅
      sheafOfDifferentials B S hS ψ
declarations.comment:
the identification Ω_{X/Y}|_{U_étale} ≅ Ω_{U/V} on a square of étale charts, from
  the étale-source localization of 03LP, 03LQ and 04BO and the étale-base comparison of 03G8 and
  03LV

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_of_isSheafOfDifferentialsMap_of_isEtale
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04CU: the comparison map of a triangle over `Y` whose upper edge is étale is an
isomorphism.**  Let `a : U ⟶ X` be étale, let `f : X ⟶ Y`, and let `q : U ⟶ Y` be the
composite.  Any morphism `c : a^*Ω_{X/Y} ⟶ Ω_{U/Y}` with the characterizing property of
Stacks 04CX is an isomorphism.

By `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.eq_of_isSheafOfDifferentialsMap` there is at most one such `c`, and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSheafOfDifferentialsMap_etaleSourceLocalizationHom` exhibits one
which is the forward map of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sheafOfDifferentialsEtaleSourceLocalizationIso`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_of_isSheafOfDifferentialsMap_of_isEtale (a : U ⟶ X) (ha : IsEtale B S hS a.hom)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (q : U ⟶ Y) (haq : a ≫ f = q)
    {c : (modulePullback B S hS a).obj (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS f) ⟶
      sheafOfDifferentials B S hS q}
    (hc : IsSheafOfDifferentialsMap B S hS a f q c) : IsIso c
declarations.comment: the comparison map of an étale triangle over the base is an isomorphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.pullbackDifferentialsMap_eq_etaleSourceLocalizationHom
declarations.doc:
**The comparison map of Stacks 04CX along an étale morphism is the étale-source
localization of Stacks 04CU.**  The two morphisms `a^*Ω_{X/Y} ⟶ Ω_{U/Y}` both have the
characterizing property of Stacks 04CX, and at most one morphism does, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.eq_of_isSheafOfDifferentialsMap`.
declarations.statement:
theorem pullbackDifferentialsMap_eq_etaleSourceLocalizationHom (a : U ⟶ X)
    (ha : IsEtale B S hS a.hom) (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    pullbackDifferentialsMap B S hS a f = etaleSourceLocalizationHom B S hS a ha f
declarations.comment: the étale-source localization is the comparison map of Stacks 04CX

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_pullbackDifferentialsMap_of_isEtale
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04CU, the étale-source localization as an invertibility.**  For an étale
`a : U ⟶ X` and any `f : X ⟶ Y`, the comparison map
`c_a : a^*Ω_{X/Y} ⟶ Ω_{U/Y}` of Stacks 04CX — the first map
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.pullbackDifferentialsMap` of the transitivity sequence of Stacks 05Z8
at the square over the identity of `Y` — is an isomorphism.

It is the forward map of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sheafOfDifferentialsEtaleSourceLocalizationIso`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_pullbackDifferentialsMap_of_isEtale (a : U ⟶ X) (ha : IsEtale B S hS a.hom)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) : IsIso (pullbackDifferentialsMap B S hS a f)
declarations.comment: the comparison map `a^*Ω_{X/Y} ⟶ Ω_{U/Y}` along an étale `a` is invertible

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivationEtalePullbackEquiv_etaleSourceLocalizationHom
declarations.doc:
**The defining property of the forward comparison.**  Read as a `Y`-derivation of `𝒪_U`
through the four bijections, it is the universal `Y`-derivation `d_{U/Y}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivationEtalePullbackEquiv_etaleSourceLocalizationHom (a : U ⟶ X)
    (ha : IsEtale B S hS a.hom) (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    derivationEtalePullbackEquiv B S hS a ha f (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS (a ≫ f))
        (etaleSourceLocalizationHom B S hS a ha f) =
      universalDerivation B S hS (a ≫ f)
declarations.comment: the étale-source comparison is the one matching the universal derivations

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sheafOfDifferentialsEtaleSourceLocalizationIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04CU, the étale-source localization.**  Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic
spaces over `S` and let `a : U ⟶ X` be étale.  The restriction of `Ω_{X/Y}` to the small étale
site of `U` — the pullback of `𝒪_X`-modules along `a`, by the abuse of notation of Stacks'
Equation 03LW — is the sheaf of differentials of the composite:

`a^*Ω_{X/Y} ≅ Ω_{U/Y}`.

Both sides corepresent the functor of `Y`-derivations of `𝒪_U`, the left-hand side by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivationEtalePullbackEquiv` and the right-hand side by its own
universal property, so they are canonically isomorphic; the two morphisms are the ones through
which the two universal derivations factor.

This is the clause of Stacks 04CU that
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sheafOfDifferentialsEtaleLocalizationIso` consumes directly.  Together
with the étale-base step `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sheafOfDifferentialsIsoOfSharpIso` it gives the
identification `Ω_{X/Y}|_{U_étale} ≅ Ω_{U/V}` on a square of étale charts that the source
states.
declarations.statement:
def sheafOfDifferentialsEtaleSourceLocalizationIso (a : U ⟶ X) (ha : IsEtale B S hS a.hom)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (modulePullback B S hS a).obj (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS f) ≅
      sheafOfDifferentials B S hS (a ≫ f)
declarations.comment:
the étale-source localization `a^*Ω_{X/Y} ≅ Ω_{U/Y}` along an étale `a : U ⟶ X`:
  the first step of the source's proof, Properties of Spaces 03LP and Equation 03LQ together with
  Modules on Sites 04BO

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.universalDerivation_etaleSourceLocalizationHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04CU, the étale-source localization on local sections.**  Reading the forward map of
the identification `a^*Ω_{X/Y} ≅ Ω_{U/Y}` as a `Y`-derivation of `𝒪_U`, by the four bijections of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivationEtalePullbackEquiv`, returns the universal differential
`d_{U/Y}(x)` of every local section `x` of `𝒪_U`.  So the identification is the canonical
comparison and not merely some isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem universalDerivation_etaleSourceLocalizationHom (a : U ⟶ X) (ha : IsEtale B S hS a.hom)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) {W : (SmallEtale B S hS U.1)ᵒᵖ}
    (x : (structureRingSheaf B S hS U).obj.obj W) :
    (derivationEtalePullbackEquiv B S hS a ha f (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS (a ≫ f))
        (sheafOfDifferentialsEtaleSourceLocalizationIso B S hS a ha f).hom).d x =
      (universalDerivation B S hS (a ≫ f)).d x
declarations.comment:
the étale-source localization carries the universal derivation of the restriction
  to the universal derivation `d_{U/Y}`, on local sections

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSheafOfDifferentialsMap_etaleBase
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04CU, the étale-base step for the comparison map of Stacks 04CX.**  Let
`ψ : U ⟶ V` be a morphism of algebraic spaces, `q : V ⟶ W` a structure morphism and
`cw : W ⟶ Z` étale.  The comparison map `c_ψ : ψ^*Ω_{V/W} ⟶ Ω_{U/W}` of the square over `W`,
read through the étale-base identifications `Ω_{V/W} ≅ Ω_{V/Z}` of the right edge and
`Ω_{U/W} ≅ Ω_{U/Z}` of the left edge, has the characterizing property of the comparison map of
the same square over `Z`.

`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sheafOfDifferentialsIsoOfSharpIso` supplies those identifications as
isomorphisms of objects; what makes them compatible with the comparison map is that each carries
one universal derivation to the other, so that
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsSheafOfDifferentialsMap.map_comp` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsSheafOfDifferentialsMap.comp_right` apply.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSheafOfDifferentialsMap_etaleBase :
    IsSheafOfDifferentialsMap B S hS ψ (q ≫ cw) ((ψ ≫ q) ≫ cw)
      ((modulePullback B S hS ψ).map (etaleBaseDifferentialsIso B S hS q cw hcw).inv ≫
        pullbackDifferentialsMap B S hS ψ q ≫
          (etaleBaseDifferentialsIso B S hS (ψ ≫ q) cw hcw).hom)
declarations.comment: the étale-base step for the comparison map of 04CX: the comparison map over `W` read through the identifications `Ω_{V/W} ≅ Ω_{V/Z}` and `Ω_{U/W} ≅ Ω_{U/Z}` is the comparison map over `Z`

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSheafOfDifferentialsMap_etaleSourceLocalizationHom
registrations.comment: the étale-source identification is the comparison map of 04CX

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sheafOfDifferentialsSchemeComparison
registrations.comment:
the 'in particular' clause: for `U` and `V` schemes of the site the sheaf of
  differentials of `U ⟶ V` read on the small étale site agrees with the usual sheaf of
  differentials of the morphism of schemes, through the associated module of 03DU (4).  The
  identification `Ω_{X/Y}|_{U_étale} = Ω_{U/V}` itself is elsewhere, on
  `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sheafOfDifferentialsEtaleLocalizationIso` and its chart form

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isQuasicoherentOnSite_sheafOfDifferentials
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04CV.**  The sheaf of differentials `Ω_{X/Y}` of a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of
algebraic spaces over a scheme `S` is a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module on the small étale site
of `X`.

The proof follows the source.  An atlas `q : V ⟶ Y` of the target lifts, by Stacks 02X1, to a
surjective étale chart `p : U ⟶ X` of the source together with a morphism `α : U ⟶ V` of
schemes making the square commute.  The identification of Stacks 04CU then reads the pullback
of `Ω_{X/Y}` along `p` as the sheaf of differentials of `α`, which
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sheafOfDifferentialsSchemeComparison` identifies with the small-étale
module associated to the Zariski sheaf of
relative differentials of `α`; that module is quasi-coherent because `Ω_{U/V}` is
(Stacks 08S2) and because the associated module of a quasi-coherent module is quasi-coherent
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isQuasicoherentOnSite_representedAssociatedModule`).  Finally
Stacks 03M0, conditions (1) and (2), returns quasi-coherence on `X` from quasi-coherence of the
pullback along one surjective étale chart, the pullback of modules and étale restriction being
matched by Equation 03LW.

Nothing is carried: the two clauses of Stacks 04CU proper are used through
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sheafOfDifferentialsEtaleLocalizationIso`, and the final sentence,
read through Stacks 04CS, through
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sheafOfDifferentialsSchemeComparison`; see the implementation
notes.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasicoherentOnSite_sheafOfDifferentials
    {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS f).IsQuasicoherentOnSite

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.differentialsDescentIso
declarations.doc:
The descent isomorphism `α : s^*Ω_{U/Y} ⟶ Ω_{R/Y} ⟶ t^*Ω_{U/Y}` attached to two étale
morphisms `s, t : R ⟶ U` of schemes over `Y` inducing the same morphism to `Y`. Both comparison
maps are isomorphisms because `s` and `t` are étale.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def differentialsDescentIso (p : U ⟶ Y) (s t : R ⟶ U) (q : R ⟶ Y)
    (hs : s ≫ p = q) (ht : t ≫ p = q) [Etale s] [Etale t] :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback s).obj (relativeDifferentials p) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback t).obj (relativeDifferentials p)
declarations.comment: the descent isomorphism `α : s^*Ω_{U/Y} ⟶ Ω_{R/Y} ⟶ t^*Ω_{U/Y}`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.differentialsDescentIso_cocycle
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04CW**, the cocycle condition.  Let `T` carry three étale legs `a₀, a₁, a₂ : T ⟶ U`
over `Y` and three morphisms `g₀₁, g₁₂, g₀₂ : T ⟶ R` realizing the pairs `(a₀, a₁)`, `(a₁, a₂)`
and `(a₀, a₂)` through `(s, t)`.  Then the pullback of `α` along `g₀₂` is the composite of its
pullbacks along `g₀₁` and `g₁₂`, each normalized by the canonical factorization isomorphisms.
So `α` is a descent datum.
declarations.statement:
theorem differentialsDescentIso_cocycle {T : Scheme.{u}} (p : U ⟶ Y) (s t : R ⟶ U) (q : R ⟶ Y)
    (hs : s ≫ p = q) (ht : t ≫ p = q) [Etale s] [Etale t]
    (g₀₁ g₁₂ g₀₂ : T ⟶ R) {a₀ a₁ a₂ : T ⟶ U} (r : T ⟶ Y) [Etale a₀] [Etale a₁] [Etale a₂]
    (h₀₁s : g₀₁ ≫ s = a₀) (h₀₁t : g₀₁ ≫ t = a₁) (h₁₂s : g₁₂ ≫ s = a₁)
    (h₁₂t : g₁₂ ≫ t = a₂) (h₀₂s : g₀₂ ≫ s = a₀) (h₀₂t : g₀₂ ≫ t = a₂)
    (h₀ : a₀ ≫ p = r) (h₁ : a₁ ≫ p = r) (h₂ : a₂ ≫ p = r) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackFactorIso g₀₂ s h₀₂s (relativeDifferentials p)).inv ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback g₀₂).map (differentialsDescentIso p s t q hs ht).hom ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullbackFactorIso g₀₂ t h₀₂t (relativeDifferentials p)).hom =
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackFactorIso g₀₁ s h₀₁s (relativeDifferentials p)).inv ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback g₀₁).map (differentialsDescentIso p s t q hs ht).hom ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.pullbackFactorIso g₀₁ t h₀₁t (relativeDifferentials p)).hom) ≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackFactorIso g₁₂ s h₁₂s (relativeDifferentials p)).inv ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback g₁₂).map (differentialsDescentIso p s t q hs ht).hom ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.pullbackFactorIso g₁₂ t h₁₂t (relativeDifferentials p)).hom)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.differentialsDescentIso_pullbackDescentIso
declarations.doc:
**For a quotient which is a scheme, `α` is the canonical descent datum of `π^*Ω_{X/Y}`.**
For `π : U ⟶ X` over `Y` with `s ≫ π = t ≫ π`, the canonical map `π^*Ω_{X/Y} ⟶ Ω_{U/Y}` of
Stacks 01UV carries the canonical descent isomorphism of `π^*Ω_{X/Y}` to `α`; when `π` is étale
that map is an isomorphism, so the module `α` descends to is `Ω_{X/Y}`.  The same identification
for a quotient which is an algebraic space is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sheafOfDifferentialsDescentIso_canonicalComparison` in
`StacksFrontier/AlgebraicGeometry/Spaces/SheafOfDifferentialsDescent.lean`; here the comparison map
is constructed rather than hypothesized, so no input beyond the square is needed.
declarations.statement:
theorem differentialsDescentIso_pullbackDescentIso {X : Scheme.{u}} (pX : X ⟶ Y) (π : U ⟶ X)
    (p : U ⟶ Y) (hp : π ≫ pX = p) (s t : R ⟶ U) (q : R ⟶ Y) (hs : s ≫ p = q)
    (ht : t ≫ p = q) [Etale s] [Etale t] (hπ : s ≫ π = t ≫ π) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackDescentIso π hπ (relativeDifferentials pX)).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback t).map (triangleDifferentialsMap π pX p hp) =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback s).map (triangleDifferentialsMap π pX p hp) ≫
        (differentialsDescentIso p s t q hs ht).hom
declarations.comment: for a quotient which is a scheme, `α` agrees with the canonical descent datum of `π^*Ω_{X/Y}`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sheafOfDifferentialsDescentIso_canonicalComparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04CW.** For a presentation `π : U ⟶ X` of an algebraic space over `Y` and
`s, t : R ⟶ U` with `s ≫ π = t ≫ π`, the descent isomorphism `α` is the transition isomorphism
of the canonical descent datum of `Ω_{X/Y}`: the comparison map `c_π : π^*Ω_{X/Y} ⟶ Ω_{U/Y}`
carries the canonical comparison of the two inverse images of `Ω_{X/Y}` to `α`.  So the module
`α` descends to is `Ω_{X/Y}`.

Invertibility of `c_s` and `c_t` is the étale-localization clause of Stacks 04CU; the identity
it is divided out of,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.canonicalComparison_comp_sheafOfDifferentialsMap`, needs no
invertibility.
declarations.statement:
theorem sheafOfDifferentialsDescentIso_canonicalComparison (pX : X ⟶ Y) (π : U ⟶ X) (p : U ⟶ Y)
    {s t : R ⟶ U} (q : R ⟶ Y) (hπ : s ≫ π = t ≫ π)
    {cπ : (modulePullback B S hS π).obj (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS pX) ⟶
      sheafOfDifferentials B S hS p}
    {cs : (modulePullback B S hS s).obj (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS p) ⟶
      sheafOfDifferentials B S hS q}
    {ct : (modulePullback B S hS t).obj (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS p) ⟶
      sheafOfDifferentials B S hS q}
    (hcπ : IsSheafOfDifferentialsMap B S hS π pX p cπ)
    (hcs : IsSheafOfDifferentialsMap B S hS s p q cs)
    (hct : IsSheafOfDifferentialsMap B S hS t p q ct) [IsIso cs] [IsIso ct] :
    (QuasiCoherentDescent.canonicalComparison s t π π hπ
          (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS pX)).hom ≫
        (modulePullback B S hS t).map cπ =
      (modulePullback B S hS s).map cπ ≫
        (sheafOfDifferentialsDescentIso B S hS cs ct).hom
declarations.comment: the module `α` descends to is `Ω_{X/Y}`: `α` is the transition isomorphism of the canonical descent datum of `Ω_{X/Y}` on a presentation `π : U ⟶ X` of an algebraic space

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sheafOfDifferentialsDescentIsoOfEtale
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04CW.** The descent isomorphism `α : s^*Ω_{U/Y} ⟶ Ω_{R/Y} ⟶ t^*Ω_{U/Y}` attached to
two *étale* morphisms `s, t : R ⟶ U` of algebraic spaces inducing the same morphism `q : R ⟶ Y`.

It is the comparison map `c_s` of Stacks 04CX for the triangle `s ≫ p = q`, namely
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sheafOfDifferentialsMap`, followed by the inverse of the comparison map
`c_t` of the triangle `t ≫ p = q`.  Both comparison maps are isomorphisms because `s` and `t`
are étale: that is the étale-localization clause of Stacks 04CU, in the form
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_of_isSheafOfDifferentialsMap_of_isEtale`.
declarations.statement:
def sheafOfDifferentialsDescentIsoOfEtale (p : U ⟶ Y) {s t : R ⟶ U} {q : R ⟶ Y}
    (hs : IsEtale B S hS s.hom) (ht : IsEtale B S hS t.hom) (hsq : s ≫ p = q)
    (htq : t ≫ p = q) :
    (modulePullback B S hS s).obj (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS p) ≅
      (modulePullback B S hS t).obj (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS p)
declarations.comment: the descent isomorphism itself: `alpha : s^*Omega_{U/Y} -> t^*Omega_{U/Y}`, built from the two etale projections of the groupoid

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sheafOfDifferentialsDescentIsoOfEtale_cocycle
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04CW**, the cocycle condition.  Let the test space `T` carry three étale legs
`a₀, a₁, a₂ : T ⟶ U` over `Y` and three morphisms `g₀₁, g₁₂, g₀₂ : T ⟶ R` realizing the pairs
`(a₀, a₁)`, `(a₁, a₂)` and `(a₀, a₂)` through `(s, t)` — the situation of the three projections
of a triple fibre product.  Then the pullback of `α` along `g₀₂` is the composite of its
pullbacks along `g₀₁` and `g₁₂`, each normalized by the comparisons of iterated inverse images.
So `α` is a descent datum, which is the check the source leaves to the reader.
declarations.statement:
theorem sheafOfDifferentialsDescentIsoOfEtale_cocycle {T : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (p : U ⟶ Y)
    {s t : R ⟶ U} (q : R ⟶ Y)
    (hs : IsEtale B S hS s.hom) (ht : IsEtale B S hS t.hom) (hsq : s ≫ p = q)
    (htq : t ≫ p = q) (g₀₁ g₁₂ g₀₂ : T ⟶ R) {a₀ a₁ a₂ : T ⟶ U} (r : T ⟶ Y)
    (h₀ : IsEtale B S hS a₀.hom) (h₁ : IsEtale B S hS a₁.hom) (h₂ : IsEtale B S hS a₂.hom)
    (h₀₁s : g₀₁ ≫ s = a₀) (h₀₁t : g₀₁ ≫ t = a₁) (h₁₂s : g₁₂ ≫ s = a₁)
    (h₁₂t : g₁₂ ≫ t = a₂) (h₀₂s : g₀₂ ≫ s = a₀) (h₀₂t : g₀₂ ≫ t = a₂)
    (hr₀ : a₀ ≫ p = r) (hr₁ : a₁ ≫ p = r) (hr₂ : a₂ ≫ p = r) :
    (QuasiCoherentDescent.pullbackComparison B S hS g₀₂ s a₀ h₀₂s
          (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS p)).hom ≫
        (modulePullback B S hS g₀₂).map
          (sheafOfDifferentialsDescentIsoOfEtale B S hS p hs ht hsq htq).hom ≫
        (QuasiCoherentDescent.pullbackComparison B S hS g₀₂ t a₂ h₀₂t
          (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS p)).inv =
      ((QuasiCoherentDescent.pullbackComparison B S hS g₀₁ s a₀ h₀₁s
            (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS p)).hom ≫
          (modulePullback B S hS g₀₁).map
            (sheafOfDifferentialsDescentIsoOfEtale B S hS p hs ht hsq htq).hom ≫
          (QuasiCoherentDescent.pullbackComparison B S hS g₀₁ t a₁ h₀₁t
            (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS p)).inv) ≫
        ((QuasiCoherentDescent.pullbackComparison B S hS g₁₂ s a₁ h₁₂s
            (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS p)).hom ≫
          (modulePullback B S hS g₁₂).map
            (sheafOfDifferentialsDescentIsoOfEtale B S hS p hs ht hsq htq).hom ≫
          (QuasiCoherentDescent.pullbackComparison B S hS g₁₂ t a₂ h₁₂t
            (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS p)).inv)
declarations.comment: the cocycle condition for that isomorphism, which is what the remark leaves to the reader to verify

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sheafOfDifferentialsDescentIsoOfEtale_canonicalComparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04CW.** For a presentation `π : U ⟶ X` of an algebraic space `X` over `Y`, with
`p = π ≫ pX`, and étale `s, t : R ⟶ U` with `s ≫ π = t ≫ π` inducing the same morphism
`q : R ⟶ Y`, the descent isomorphism `α` is the transition isomorphism of the canonical descent
datum of `Ω_{X/Y}`: the comparison map `c_π : π^*Ω_{X/Y} ⟶ Ω_{U/Y}` of Stacks 04CX, namely
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sheafOfDifferentialsMap`, carries the canonical comparison of the two
inverse images of `Ω_{X/Y}` to `α`.  When `π` is étale `c_π` is an isomorphism, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_of_isSheafOfDifferentialsMap_of_isEtale`, so for a presentation
the module `α` descends to is `Ω_{X/Y}`; étaleness of `π` is not needed for the identity itself
and is not assumed.

The identity `α` is divided out of,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.canonicalComparison_comp_sheafOfDifferentialsMap`, needs no
invertibility; the invertibility of `c_s` and `c_t` that forms `α` is derived from étaleness of
`s` and `t` by Stacks 04CU.

The cocycle condition is the separate statement
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sheafOfDifferentialsDescentIsoOfEtale_cocycle` above, and in the
scheme-level vocabulary `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.differentialsDescentIso_cocycle` in
`StacksFrontier/AlgebraicGeometry/Morphisms/Differentials/EtaleDescentDatum.lean`.  Together with
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sheafOfDifferentialsDescentIsoOfEtale` and that cocycle condition, this
is the source's remark in the vocabulary of algebraic spaces: the module obtained by gluing
`Ω_{U/Y}` along `α` is `Ω_{X/Y}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem sheafOfDifferentialsDescentIsoOfEtale_canonicalComparison (pX : X ⟶ Y) (π : U ⟶ X)
    (p : U ⟶ Y) {s t : R ⟶ U} (q : R ⟶ Y) (hπ : s ≫ π = t ≫ π) (hπp : π ≫ pX = p)
    (hs : IsEtale B S hS s.hom) (ht : IsEtale B S hS t.hom) (hsq : s ≫ p = q)
    (htq : t ≫ p = q) :
    (QuasiCoherentDescent.canonicalComparison s t π π hπ
          (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS pX)).hom ≫
        (modulePullback B S hS t).map
          (sheafOfDifferentialsMap B S hS π pX p (𝟙 Y) (by rw [hπp, Category.comp_id])) =
      (modulePullback B S hS s).map
          (sheafOfDifferentialsMap B S hS π pX p (𝟙 Y) (by rw [hπp, Category.comp_id])) ≫
        (sheafOfDifferentialsDescentIsoOfEtale B S hS p hs ht hsq htq).hom
declarations.comment: the module `α` descends to is `Ω_{X/Y}`: `α` is the transition isomorphism of the canonical descent datum of `Ω_{X/Y}` on a presentation `π : U ⟶ X` which the two étale projections equalize

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.pushforwardUniversalDerivationHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04CX.** For a commutative square with top edge `f : X' ⟶ X` and left edge
`p' : X' ⟶ Y'`, the structure map `f♯ : 𝒪_X ⟶ f_*𝒪_{X'}` followed by the direct image of the
universal `Y'`-derivation `d_{X'/Y'}`, on underlying sheaves of sets.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def pushforwardUniversalDerivationHom (f : X' ⟶ X) (p' : X' ⟶ Y') :
    CategoryTheory.Sheaf.ringSheaf.{u, u, u + 1} (structureRingSheaf B S hS X) ⟶
      CategoryTheory.Sheaf.moduleSheaf.{u, u, u + 1} (structureRingSheaf B S hS X)
        ((modulePushforward B S hS f).obj (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS p'))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsSheafOfDifferentialsMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04CX**, the characterizing property of the comparison map
`c_f : f^*Ω_{X/Y} ⟶ Ω_{X'/Y'}` of a commutative square: its adjoint transpose carries the
universal differential `d_{X/Y}(t)` of a local section `t` of `𝒪_X` to `d_{X'/Y'}(f♯ t)`.
declarations.comment: the characterizing property of `c_f` on universal local sections

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.eq_of_isSheafOfDifferentialsMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04CX**, uniqueness: at most one morphism `f^*Ω_{X/Y} ⟶ Ω_{X'/Y'}` of
`𝒪_{X'}`-modules carries the pulled-back universal differentials to the universal differentials
of the pulled-back local sections.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_of_isSheafOfDifferentialsMap (f : X' ⟶ X) (p : X ⟶ Y) (p' : X' ⟶ Y')
    {c₁ c₂ : (modulePullback B S hS f).obj (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS p) ⟶
      sheafOfDifferentials B S hS p'}
    (h₁ : IsSheafOfDifferentialsMap B S hS f p p' c₁)
    (h₂ : IsSheafOfDifferentialsMap B S hS f p p' c₂) : c₁ = c₂

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.pushforwardUniversalDerivation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04CX.**  For a commutative square with top edge `f : X' ⟶ X`, the composite
`D = f_*d_{X'/Y'} ∘ f♯ : 𝒪_X ⟶ f_*Ω_{X'/Y'}` is a `Y`-derivation of `𝒪_X` with values in the
direct image of the sheaf of differentials of `p'`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def pushforwardUniversalDerivation (f : X' ⟶ X) (p : X ⟶ Y) (p' : X' ⟶ Y')
    (q : Y' ⟶ Y) (hcomm : f ≫ p = p' ≫ q) :
    PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing.Derivation'
      ((modulePushforward B S hS f).obj (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS p')).val
      (structureSharpInverseImage B S hS p).hom

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sheafOfDifferentialsMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04CX.**  The comparison map `c_f : f^*Ω_{X/Y} ⟶ Ω_{X'/Y'}` of a commutative square
of algebraic spaces: the `Y`-derivation `f_*d_{X'/Y'} ∘ f♯` read through Equation 0619.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def sheafOfDifferentialsMap (f : X' ⟶ X) (p : X ⟶ Y) (p' : X' ⟶ Y') (q : Y' ⟶ Y)
    (hcomm : f ≫ p = p' ≫ q) :
    (modulePullback B S hS f).obj (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS p) ⟶
      sheafOfDifferentials B S hS p'
declarations.comment: the existence of the canonical map

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSheafOfDifferentialsMap_sheafOfDifferentialsMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04CX.**  The comparison map has the characterizing property of Stacks 04CX: its
adjoint transpose carries the universal differential `d_{X/Y}(t)` of a local section `t` of
`𝒪_X` to `d_{X'/Y'}(f♯ t)`.

With `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.eq_of_isSheafOfDifferentialsMap` this identifies
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sheafOfDifferentialsMap` with any morphism having that property.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSheafOfDifferentialsMap_sheafOfDifferentialsMap (f : X' ⟶ X) (p : X ⟶ Y)
    (p' : X' ⟶ Y') (q : Y' ⟶ Y) (hcomm : f ≫ p = p' ≫ q) :
    IsSheafOfDifferentialsMap B S hS f p p'
      (sheafOfDifferentialsMap B S hS f p p' q hcomm)
declarations.comment: the canonical map has the characterizing property

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.formallyEtale_comp_of_etale
declarations.doc: An étale transformation followed by a formally étale transformation is formally étale.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.formallySmooth_comp_of_etale
declarations.doc: An étale transformation followed by a formally smooth transformation is formally smooth.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_etale_affine_local_lift
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04CY, the local form of the descent half.** In a representable, surjective, étale
situation `F ⟶ G ⟶ H` over an affine square-zero thickening `i : T ⟶ T'`, a formally smooth
composite admits, over every point of `T`, an affine étale neighbourhood `U' ⟶ T'` of its
image and a section of `G` over `U'` which lifts the given section of `H` and agrees with the
given section of `G` over `T` after restriction to every common refinement.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_etale_affine_local_lift
    (D : RepresentableSurjectiveEtaleSituation.{u})
    (T T' : BigFppfOver D.B D.S D.hS) (i : T ⟶ T')
    (_hT' : IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme D.B D.S D.hS).obj T'))
    (hi : IsSquareZeroClosedImmersion D.B D.S D.hS i)
    (x : D.G.obj (op T)) (y : D.H.obj (op T'))
    (hxy : D.b.app (op T) x = D.H.map i.op y)
    (hsmooth : FormallySmooth (D.a ≫ D.b))
    (t : (BigFppfOver.toScheme D.B D.S D.hS).obj T) :
    ∃ (U' : BigFppfOver D.B D.S D.hS) (j : U' ⟶ T') (z : D.G.obj (op U')),
      IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme D.B D.S D.hS).obj U') ∧
      Etale ((BigFppfOver.toScheme D.B D.S D.hS).map j) ∧
      (∃ u : (BigFppfOver.toScheme D.B D.S D.hS).obj U',
        ((BigFppfOver.toScheme D.B D.S D.hS).map j).base u =
          ((BigFppfOver.toScheme D.B D.S D.hS).map i).base t) ∧
      D.b.app (op U') z = D.H.map j.op y ∧
      ∀ (V : BigFppfOver D.B D.S D.hS) (f : V ⟶ T) (g : V ⟶ U'),
        f ≫ i = g ≫ j → D.G.map f.op x = D.G.map g.op z

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.formallyUnramified_comp_of_etale
declarations.doc:
A formally unramified transformation remains formally unramified after
precomposition with an étale transformation.
declarations.statement:
public theorem formallyUnramified_comp_of_etale
    {B : BigFppfSite.{u}} {S : Scheme.{u}} {hS : B.Contains S}
    {F G H : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (a : F ⟶ G) (b : G ⟶ H)
    (ha : (MorphismProperty.inverseImage (@Etale :
      MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf a)
    (hb : FormallyUnramified b) :
    FormallyUnramified (a ≫ b)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.formallyUnramified_of_comp_of_isSeparated
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04CY**, the corrected part (5) of the tag. In a
representable, surjective, étale situation, a formally unramified composite forces the second
transformation to be formally unramified as soon as the intermediate presheaf is separated for
the étale topology.

Separatedness is the whole of what is used, and it is exactly the step the tag's own proof
takes: having identified two sections of `G` after pullback along an étale covering, that proof
concludes "hence `f = g` as `W' → T'` is an étale covering".

It cannot be dropped: the tag states this part for arbitrary set-valued functors, and in that
generality it is false. The counterexample is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.DoubledSection.exists_not_formallyUnramified_of_comp`, which doubles
the sections of the functor of points of the thickening that factor through neither the étale
cover nor the thickened object. This is an erratum to the source statement.

An intermediate presheaf which is an algebraic space over `S` is separated for the étale
topology, so `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.formallyUnramified_of_formallyUnramified_comp` is the
special case of this result at such a presheaf, as is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.formallyUnramified_of_comp`, which asks the full sheaf condition.
declarations.statement:
public theorem formallyUnramified_of_comp_of_isSeparated
    (s : RepresentableSurjectiveEtaleSituation.{u})
    (hG : Presieve.IsSeparated ((etaleTopology s.B).over (s.B.obj s.hS)) s.G)
    (hba : FormallyUnramified (s.a ≫ s.b)) :
    FormallyUnramified s.b
declarations.comment: part (5), corrected form: G separated for the étale topology; false as written, see DoubledSection.Rational.not_forall_descend

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.formallyUnramified_of_comp
declarations.doc:
In a representable, surjective, étale situation, a formally unramified composite forces the
second transformation to be formally unramified as soon as the intermediate presheaf is a sheaf
for the étale topology.

This is the special case of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.formallyUnramified_of_comp_of_isSeparated` at a presheaf which
satisfies the full sheaf condition rather than merely separatedness, so it is a weaker statement
than the corrected part (5) of Stacks 04CY, whose registration as that part sits on that
result.
declarations.statement:
public theorem formallyUnramified_of_comp
    (s : RepresentableSurjectiveEtaleSituation.{u})
    (hG : Presheaf.IsSheaf ((etaleTopology s.B).over (s.B.obj s.hS)) s.G)
    (hba : FormallyUnramified (s.a ≫ s.b)) :
    FormallyUnramified s.b

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.formallyEtale_of_comp_of_isSeparated
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04CY**, the corrected part (6) of the tag. In
a representable, surjective, étale situation, a formally étale composite forces the second
transformation to be formally étale as soon as the intermediate presheaf is a sheaf for the
étale topology and the target presheaf is separated for it.

Separatedness is all that the target presheaf contributes, and it is all the tag's own proof
asks of it: `H` enters only to compare two sections of `H` that already agree over an étale
covering. The intermediate presheaf genuinely needs the full sheaf condition, since the proof
glues the étale-local solutions produced by part (4) — "hence we may glue the local solutions
to get assertion (6)" in the tag.

The tag states this part for arbitrary set-valued functors, and in that generality it is
false: the situation of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.DoubledSection.exists_not_formallyUnramified_of_comp` has a formally
étale composite and a second transformation that is not formally étale. This is an erratum to
the source statement.
declarations.statement:
public theorem formallyEtale_of_comp_of_isSeparated
    (s : RepresentableSurjectiveEtaleSituation.{u})
    (hG : Presheaf.IsSheaf ((etaleTopology s.B).over (s.B.obj s.hS)) s.G)
    (hH : Presieve.IsSeparated ((etaleTopology s.B).over (s.B.obj s.hS)) s.H)
    (hba : FormallyEtale (s.a ≫ s.b)) :
    FormallyEtale s.b
declarations.comment: part (6), corrected form: G a sheaf and H separated for the étale topology; false as written, see DoubledSection.Rational.not_forall_descend

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.formallyEtale_of_comp
declarations.doc:
In a representable, surjective, étale situation, a formally étale composite forces the
second transformation to be formally étale as soon as the intermediate and target presheaves
are sheaves for the étale topology.

This is the corollary of `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.formallyEtale_of_comp_of_isSeparated`
obtained by strengthening separatedness of the target presheaf to the full sheaf condition, so
it states a special case of the corrected part (6) of Stacks 04CY, whose registration as that
part sits on that result.
declarations.statement:
public theorem formallyEtale_of_comp
    (s : RepresentableSurjectiveEtaleSituation.{u})
    (hG : Presheaf.IsSheaf ((etaleTopology s.B).over (s.B.obj s.hS)) s.G)
    (hH : Presheaf.IsSheaf ((etaleTopology s.B).over (s.B.obj s.hS)) s.H)
    (hba : FormallyEtale (s.a ≫ s.b)) :
    FormallyEtale s.b

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.formallyUnramified_of_formallyUnramified_comp
declarations.doc:
Let `p : F ⟶ G` be a representable, surjective and étale transformation of set-valued
functors on the big fppf site of `S`, let `q : G ⟶ H` and let `G` be an algebraic space over `S`.
If `p ≫ q` is formally unramified in the sense of [Stacks Project, Tag 049S], then so is `q`.

The corrected part (5) asks `G` to be separated for the étale topology, and an algebraic space
is (see the implementation notes of this file), so this is a special case of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.formallyUnramified_of_comp_of_isSeparated`, which carries the
corrected part (5). This proof uses a hypothesis of a different kind — separatedness for the
fpqc topology, which follows from the representable diagonal alone. The composition direction
is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.formallyUnramified_comp_of_etale`.
declarations.statement:
theorem formallyUnramified_of_formallyUnramified_comp (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains S) {F G H : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (p : F ⟶ G) (q : G ⟶ H)
    (hG : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS G)
    (hps : (MorphismProperty.inverseImage (@Surjective.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
      (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf p)
    (hpe : (MorphismProperty.inverseImage (@Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
      (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf p)
    (hpq : FormallyUnramified (p ≫ q)) :
    FormallyUnramified q
declarations.comment: part (5), for a middle functor which is an algebraic space

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.DoubledSection.Rational.not_forall_descend_formallyEtale_of_isSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Part (6) of Stacks 04CY is false when only the intermediate functor is asked to be an
étale sheaf.** The universal statement "for every representable, surjective, étale `a : F ⟶ G`
and every `b : G ⟶ H` with `F` and `G` étale sheaves, `b` is formally étale when `b ∘ a` is"
fails, already over `Spec ℚ`.

So the corrected part (6), `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.formallyEtale_of_comp_of_isSeparated`, needs
its hypothesis on the target functor `H` as well as its hypothesis on `G`; the latter is shown
necessary by `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.DoubledSection.Rational.not_forall_descend`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem not_forall_descend_formallyEtale_of_isSheaf :
    ¬ (∀ s : RepresentableSurjectiveEtaleSituation.{0},
        Presheaf.IsSheaf ((etaleTopology s.B).over (s.B.obj s.hS)) s.F →
        Presheaf.IsSheaf ((etaleTopology s.B).over (s.B.obj s.hS)) s.G →
        FormallyEtale (s.a ≫ s.b) → FormallyEtale s.b)
declarations.comment: counterexample to part (6) with G an étale sheaf and H arbitrary: the condition on H in the corrected form cannot be dropped

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.DoubledSection.Rational.not_forall_descend
declarations.doc:
**Parts (5) and (6) of Stacks 04CY are false as written.** The source states, for an
arbitrary representable, surjective, étale `a : F ⟶ G` and any `b : G ⟶ H` of set-valued
functors on a big fppf site, that `b` is formally unramified when `b ∘ a` is (part (5)) and
formally étale when `b ∘ a` is (part (6)). Both universal statements fail, already over
`Spec ℚ`.

The corrected forms are `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.formallyUnramified_of_comp_of_isSeparated`
and `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.formallyEtale_of_comp_of_isSeparated`.
declarations.statement:
theorem not_forall_descend :
    ¬ (∀ s : RepresentableSurjectiveEtaleSituation.{0},
        FormallyUnramified (s.a ≫ s.b) → FormallyUnramified s.b) ∧
      ¬ (∀ s : RepresentableSurjectiveEtaleSituation.{0},
        FormallyEtale (s.a ≫ s.b) → FormallyEtale s.b)

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.hasPullbacks_bigAffineFppf
registrations.comment: fibre products in the big affine fppf site

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.preservesPullbacks_bigAffineFppfToScheme
registrations.comment: preservation by the big affine fppf functor to schemes

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_hom_restrictedSharpThroughThickening_eq_restrictedLiftSolutionOfHom_of_square
declarations.doc:
**The existence clause of [Stacks Project, Tag 04D0] at the source's hypotheses, with no
appeal to Properties of Spaces, Theorem [Stacks Project, Tag 04KL].**

Let `Z ⊆ X` be a first order thickening of algebraic spaces, `W₀ ⊆ W` a closed subspace with
inclusion `j`, `e₀ : Z ⟶ W₀` a morphism that `c : X ⟶ W` restricts to, and let `c` be a morphism
over `Bas` along `r : W ⟶ Bas`.  Let `b : W₀ ⟶ Bas₀` and `ib : Bas₀ ⟶ Bas` satisfy the square
`j ≫ r = b ≫ ib`, so that the differentials `Ω_{W₀/Bas₀}` are the ones of the source.  Then
**every** `𝒪_Z`-linear map `θ : (e₀)^*Ω_{W₀/Bas₀} ⟶ 𝒞_{Z/X}` is realized: there is a morphism
`c' : X ⟶ W` over `Bas`, agreeing with `c` on `Z`, whose comorphism read in the common target of
the morphisms agreeing on the thickening is the modification
`c^♯ − ι ∘ (d_{W₀/Bas₀} ∘ θ) ∘ j^♯` of the comorphism of `c` by the derivation attached to `θ`.
The uniqueness half of the tag is not claimed here.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_hom_restrictedSharpThroughThickening_eq_restrictedLiftSolutionOfHom_of_square
    (hZ : IsFirstOrderThickening B S hS X Z.1) (c : X ⟶ W)
    (W₀ : ClosedSubspaces B S hS W.1)
    (e₀ : (⟨Z.1.toFunctor, Z.2.1⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS) ⟶
      (⟨W₀.1.toFunctor, W₀.2.1⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS))
    (hce : subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z ≫ c = e₀ ≫ subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)
    {Bas₀ : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS}
    (b : (⟨W₀.1.toFunctor, W₀.2.1⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS) ⟶ Bas₀)
    (θ : (modulePullback B S hS e₀).obj (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS b) ⟶
      conormalModule B S hS X Z)
    (r : W ⟶ Bas) (ib : Bas₀ ⟶ Bas)
    (hsq : subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀ ≫ r = b ≫ ib)
    (p : X ⟶ Bas) (hp : c.hom ≫ r.hom = p.hom) :
    ∃ (c' : X ⟶ W) (hcc : subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z ≫ c' =
        e₀ ≫ subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀),
      c'.hom ≫ r.hom = p.hom ∧
        restrictedSharpThroughThickening B S hS Z W₀ c' e₀ hcc =
          restrictedLiftSolutionOfHom B S hS Z hZ c W₀ e₀ hce b θ
declarations.comment: the existence clause at the source's hypotheses: a prescribed O_X-linear map theta is realized by a morphism over the base agreeing with the given one on the thickening, its comorphism being the modification of the given one by the derivation d o theta of Equation 0619 -- with no appeal to Theorem 04KL. Uniqueness is not claimed here

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.existsUnique_thickeningLiftOver_sub_eq
declarations.doc:
Let `(e₀, c) : (Z ⊂ X) ⟶ (W₀ ⊂ W)` be a morphism of first order thickenings over `Bas` and
let `θ : e₀^*Ω_{W₀/Bas₀} ⟶ 𝒞_{Z/X}` be `𝒪_Z`-linear.  Then
there is exactly one morphism of thickenings `(e₀, c')` over `Bas` — so condition (1) of
[Stacks Project, Tag 0618], `b = a`, holds — such that

* condition (2) of Tag 0618 holds: the comorphisms of `c` and `c'` agree on the sections killed
  by `j^♯`, and
* the derivation by which the comorphisms differ is related to `θ` by Equation (0619):
  `c^♯ s − c'^♯ s = ι (D (j^♯ s))` with `D = d_{W₀/Bas₀} ∘ θ`.

It is `θ · c`.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_thickeningLiftOver_sub_eq
    (θ : (modulePullback B S hS e₀).obj (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS b) ⟶
      conormalModule B S hS X Z)
    (c : ThickeningLiftOver B S hS Z W₀ e₀ r p) :
    ∃! c' : ThickeningLiftOver B S hS Z W₀ e₀ r p,
      (∀ (V : (SmallEtale B S hS (⟨W₀.1.toFunctor, W₀.2.1⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS).1)ᵒᵖ)
        (x : (structureRingSheafInverseImage B S hS
          (subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)).obj.obj V),
        (structureSharpRingInverseImage B S hS (subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)).hom.app V x =
            0 →
          (thickeningLiftSharp B S hS Z hZ W₀ e₀ c.1 c.2.1).hom.app V x =
            (thickeningLiftSharp B S hS Z hZ W₀ e₀ c'.1 c'.2.1).hom.app V x) ∧
      ∀ (V : (SmallEtale B S hS (⟨W₀.1.toFunctor, W₀.2.1⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS).1)ᵒᵖ)
        (x : (structureRingSheafInverseImage B S hS
          (subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)).obj.obj V),
        (thickeningLiftSharp B S hS Z hZ W₀ e₀ c.1 c.2.1).hom.app V x -
            (thickeningLiftSharp B S hS Z hZ W₀ e₀ c'.1 c'.2.1).hom.app V x =
          thickeningDerivationValue B S hS Z hZ W₀ e₀ b θ V x
declarations.comment: existence and uniqueness of the morphism of pairs (a, b') satisfying (1) and (2) of 0618 whose comorphism differs from that of a' by the derivation d o theta of Equation 0619

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.existsUnique_hom_of_derivationModificationHomOfMap
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks Project, Tag 04D0], with the recovery of morphisms over the base as its only
argument.**  For a morphism `(a, a')` of first order thickenings over `T` and an `𝒪_X`-linear
map `θ : a^*Ω_{Y/T} ⟶ 𝒞_{X/X'}` there is exactly one morphism `b' : X' ⟶ Y'` whose structure
map is `α = (a')^♯ + D`, and the pair `(a, b')` is a morphism of thickenings over `T`.

Setting `b = a` this is the unique morphism of pairs `(b, b')` of the source: conditions (1) and
(2) of [Stacks Project, Tag 0618] are the two displayed equations, and the derivation `D` is
related to `θ` by Equation (0619) because that is how
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivationModificationHomOfMap` is built.

Unlike
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.existsUnique_hom_of_derivationModification` this takes **no datum** for
the modified structure map: `α` is constructed from `θ`, and its three properties that
[Stacks Project, Tag 05ZN] consumes — that it is locally ringed, that it fits the square and
that it is a map of `𝒪_T`-algebras — are proved above, and the recovery of
morphisms of algebraic spaces from morphisms of their small étale ringed topoi over a base is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isRecoveredFromSmallEtale_holds`.  So nothing is assumed.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_hom_of_derivationModificationHomOfMap
    (hW : IsFirstOrderThickening B S hS Y' W.1) :
    ∃! b' : X' ⟶ Y', InducesSmallEtaleRingedToposHom B S hS b'
        (derivationModificationHomOfMap B S hS Z hZ a' W p a hcompat θ) ∧
      subspaceInclusion B S hS X' Z ≫ b' = a ≫ subspaceInclusion B S hS Y' W ∧
      b' ≫ p = a' ≫ p
declarations.comment: the morphism of pairs (b, b') and its uniqueness, for the modified structure map alpha = (a')^sharp + D BUILT from theta by Equation 0619: alpha is constructed, and its three properties that Stacks 05ZN consumes -- locally ringed, the square, the O_T-algebra condition -- are proved outright, as is the recovery of morphisms of algebraic spaces from morphisms of their small etale ringed topoi over a base, isRecoveredFromSmallEtale_holds; the uniqueness alone is also eq_of_derivationModificationHomOfMap_induces

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.eq_of_derivationModificationHomOfMap_induces
declarations.doc:
**The uniqueness half of [Stacks Project, Tag 04D0], with nothing assumed.**  Two morphisms
`b₁', b₂' : X' ⟶ Y'` whose structure maps are both the modification `α = (a')^♯ + D` of the
structure map of `a'` by the derivation attached to an `𝒪_X`-linear map
`θ : a^*Ω_{Y/T} ⟶ 𝒞_{X/X'}` are equal.

This is the "unique" of the source's "there exists a unique morphism of pairs `(b, b')`", and it
needs neither [Stacks Project, Tag 04KL] nor any property of `α`: two morphisms inducing the
same morphism of small étale ringed topoi are 2-isomorphic to one another, and
[Stacks Project, Tag 04M6] identifies them.  Since the source's construction fixes `b = a`,
uniqueness of `b'` is uniqueness of the pair.

The hypotheses are exactly the source's: `X ⊂ X'` and `Y ⊂ Y'` closed subspaces with `X ⊂ X'` of
first order, `(a, a')` a morphism of the pairs, `p` the structure morphism to the base, and `θ`
an `𝒪_X`-linear map `a^*Ω_{Y/T} ⟶ 𝒞_{X/X'}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_of_derivationModificationHomOfMap_induces (b₁' b₂' : X' ⟶ Y')
    (h₁ : InducesSmallEtaleRingedToposHom B S hS b₁'
      (derivationModificationHomOfMap B S hS Z hZ a' W p a hcompat θ))
    (h₂ : InducesSmallEtaleRingedToposHom B S hS b₂'
      (derivationModificationHomOfMap B S hS Z hZ a' W p a hcompat θ)) :
    b₁' = b₂'
declarations.comment: the uniqueness of the morphism of pairs (b, b'), for the modified structure map alpha = (a')^sharp + D built from theta by Equation 0619: no recovery of morphisms over the base (Stacks 04KL) and no property of alpha is used, only Stacks 04M6

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.existsUnique_hom_conormalMap_eq_derivation_eq
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks Project, Tag 04D0].**  Let `(e₀, c) : (Z ⊂ X) ⟶ (W₀ ⊂ W)` be a morphism of first
order thickenings over `T` (`i ≫ c = e₀ ≫ j` and `c ≫ q = p`), and let
`θ : e₀^*Ω_{W₀/T} ⟶ 𝒞_{Z/X}` be `𝒪_Z`-linear.  Then there is exactly one morphism `b' : X ⟶ W`
such that `(e₀, b')` is a morphism of thickenings over `T` (`i ≫ b' = e₀ ≫ j` and `b' ≫ q = p`:
condition (1) of [Stacks Project, Tag 0618], `b = a`), the two maps `e₀^*𝒞_{W₀/W} ⟶ 𝒞_{Z/X}` of
[Stacks Project, Tag 04CP] are equal (condition (2)), and the comorphisms, read as maps
`j^{-1}𝒪_W ⟶ (e₀)_*(i^{-1}𝒪_X)`, differ by `ι ∘ D ∘ j^♯` with `D = d_{W₀/T} ∘ θ` the derivation of
Equation [Stacks Project, Tag 0619].
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_hom_conormalMap_eq_derivation_eq
    (θ : (modulePullback B S hS e₀).obj
        (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS (subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀ ≫ q)) ⟶
      conormalModule B S hS X Z)
    (p : X ⟶ T) (hcq : c ≫ q = p) :
    ∃! b' : X ⟶ W, ∃ (hb : subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z ≫ b' =
        e₀ ≫ subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀),
      b' ≫ q = p ∧
        conormalMap B S hS Z W₀ c e₀ hc = conormalMap B S hS Z W₀ b' e₀ hb ∧
        ∀ (V : (SmallEtale B S hS (⟨W₀.1.toFunctor, W₀.2.1⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS).1)ᵒᵖ)
          (x : ToType ((structureRingSheafInverseImage B S hS
            (subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)).obj.obj V)),
          (restrictedSquareZeroValues B S hS Z W₀ e₀ hZ).ι
              (derivationFamilyOfHom B S hS (subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀ ≫ q) e₀
                (conormalModule B S hS X Z) θ V
                ((structureSharpRingInverseImage B S hS
                  (subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)).hom.app V x)) =
            (restrictedSharpThroughThickening B S hS Z W₀ c e₀ hc).hom.app V x -
              (restrictedSharpThroughThickening B S hS Z W₀ b' e₀ hb).hom.app V x
declarations.comment: the morphism of pairs (b, b') = (a, b') moved by θ: conditions (1) and (2) of 0618, with the derivation D of 0618 equal to d_{Y/B} ∘ θ (Equation 0619)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_undeformedLiftDiff_eq
declarations.doc:
**The existence half of [Stacks Project, Tag 04D0] for an undeformed target.**  Every
`𝒪_Z`-linear map `θ : a^*Ω_{W/V} ⟶ 𝒞_{Z/X}` is the difference from `c` of some lift `c'` of
`a = i ≫ c` over `V`.

The comorphism of `c` moved by the derivation attached to `θ` is a solution of the lifting
problem whose descended difference from the comorphism of `c` is `θ`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_liftDifferenceData_solution_of_hom`); that solution is the
comorphism of an honest lift `c'`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_hom_structureSharpThroughThickeningAt_eq_of_solution`); and the
pair `(c, c')` then has the same two comorphisms as the pair `(c^♯, g)`, hence the same descended
difference, the comparison being made against the pair `(c', c')` whose descended difference
vanishes.

With `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.eq_of_undeformedLiftDiff_eq_zero` this is the whole of
[Stacks Project, Tag 04D0] in this situation, and it is unconditional.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_undeformedLiftDiff_eq :
    ∃ (c' : X ⟶ W) (h' : subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z ≫ c' =
        subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z ≫ c) (hb : c ≫ b = c' ≫ b),
      undeformedLiftDiff B S hS Z hZ (subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z ≫ c) b c c' rfl h' hb = θ
declarations.comment: the existence half: every linear map is the difference from a given lift of some lift, for an UNDEFORMED target

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.existsUnique_undeformedLiftDiff_eq
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks Project, Tag 04D0] for an undeformed target.**  For every `𝒪_Z`-linear map
`θ : a^*Ω_{W/V} ⟶ 𝒞_{Z/X}` there is exactly one lift of `a = i ≫ c` over `V` whose difference
from `c` is `θ`.

Existence is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_undeformedLiftDiff_eq` and uniqueness is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.undeformedLiftDiff_injective`.  Together with the additivity of the
difference this is the simple transitivity of [Stacks Project, Tag 061C] over the ambient space
of the thickening, in the case where the target is not deformed.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_undeformedLiftDiff_eq :
    ∃! p : {c' : X ⟶ W //
        (subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z ≫ c' = subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z ≫ c) ∧
          c ≫ b = c' ≫ b},
      undeformedLiftDiff B S hS Z hZ (subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z ≫ c) b c p.1 rfl
        p.2.1 p.2.2 = θ
declarations.comment: existence and uniqueness of the lift with a prescribed difference from a given lift, for an UNDEFORMED target

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.eq_of_undeformedLiftDiff_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
**The uniqueness half of [Stacks Project, Tag 04D0] for an undeformed target.**  Two lifts
of `a` over `V` along the first order thickening `Z ⊂ X` whose difference vanishes are equal.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_of_undeformedLiftDiff_eq_zero (c c' : X ⟶ W)
    (h : subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z ≫ c = a)
    (h' : subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z ≫ c' = a) (hb : c ≫ b = c' ≫ b)
    (hzero : undeformedLiftDiff B S hS Z hZ a b c c' h h' hb = 0) :
    c = c'
declarations.comment: the uniqueness half: a lift is determined by its difference from a given lift, for an UNDEFORMED target

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.eq_of_restrictedLiftDifferenceHom_eq
declarations.doc:
**The difference determines the companion:** two morphisms which restrict on the thickening
to the same morphism, agree with `c₀` over `Bas`, induce the same map of conormal modules as
`c₀` does, and have the same difference from `c₀`, are equal.

This is the uniqueness clause of [Stacks Project, Tag 04D0], and it is unconditional: the
cocycle identity makes the difference of the two zero, a pair of lifts with zero descended
difference has equal comorphisms by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.eq_of_liftDifferenceDifferentialsHom_eq_zero`, and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.eq_of_restrictedSharpThroughThickening_eq` recovers the equality of
the two morphisms from that.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_of_restrictedLiftDifferenceHom_eq (c₀ c c' : X ⟶ W)
    (h₀ : subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z ≫ c₀ = e₀ ≫ subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)
    (h : subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z ≫ c = e₀ ≫ subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)
    (h' : subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z ≫ c' = e₀ ≫ subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)
    (hker : ∀ (V : (SmallEtale B S hS
        (⟨W₀.1.toFunctor, W₀.2.1⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS).1)ᵒᵖ)
      (x : (structureRingSheafInverseImage B S hS
        (subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)).obj.obj V),
      (structureSharpRingInverseImage B S hS
          (subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)).hom.app V x = 0 →
        (restrictedSharpThroughThickening B S hS Z W₀ c₀ e₀ h₀).hom.app V x =
          (restrictedSharpThroughThickening B S hS Z W₀ c e₀ h).hom.app V x)
    (hker' : ∀ (V : (SmallEtale B S hS
        (⟨W₀.1.toFunctor, W₀.2.1⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS).1)ᵒᵖ)
      (x : (structureRingSheafInverseImage B S hS
        (subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)).obj.obj V),
      (structureSharpRingInverseImage B S hS
          (subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)).hom.app V x = 0 →
        (restrictedSharpThroughThickening B S hS Z W₀ c₀ e₀ h₀).hom.app V x =
          (restrictedSharpThroughThickening B S hS Z W₀ c' e₀ h').hom.app V x)
    (hcc : c₀ ≫ qb = c ≫ qb) (hcc' : c₀ ≫ qb = c' ≫ qb)
    (heq : restrictedLiftDifferenceHom B S hS Z W₀ hZ e₀ qb c₀ c h₀ h hker hcc =
      restrictedLiftDifferenceHom B S hS Z W₀ hZ e₀ qb c₀ c' h₀ h' hker' hcc') :
    c = c'
declarations.comment: the uniqueness clause: a companion of the given morphism of thickenings is determined by its difference

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_hom_restrictedLiftDifferenceHom_eq
declarations.doc:
**Every linear map is a difference.**  For an `𝒪_Z`-linear map
`θ : e₀^*Ω_{W₀/Bas} ⟶ 𝒞_{Z/X}` there is a morphism `c : X ⟶ W` restricting on the thickening
to `e₀ ≫ j`, agreeing with `c₀` over `Bas`, inducing the same map of conormal modules as `c₀`
does, and whose difference from `c₀` is `θ`.

This is the existence clause of [Stacks Project, Tag 04D0], and it is unconditional:
