`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_hom_of_movedThickeningLift` produces the morphism and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.restrictedSharpThroughThickening_eq_movedThickeningLift_g` identifies
its transported comorphism with the moved solution.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_hom_restrictedLiftDifferenceHom_eq (c₀ : X ⟶ W)
    (h₀ : subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z ≫ c₀ = e₀ ≫ subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)
    (θ : (modulePullback B S hS e₀).obj
        (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS (subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀ ≫ qb)) ⟶
      conormalModule B S hS X Z) :
    ∃ (c : X ⟶ W)
      (h : subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z ≫ c = e₀ ≫ subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)
      (hker : ∀ (V : (SmallEtale B S hS
          (⟨W₀.1.toFunctor, W₀.2.1⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS).1)ᵒᵖ)
        (x : (structureRingSheafInverseImage B S hS
          (subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)).obj.obj V),
        (structureSharpRingInverseImage B S hS
            (subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)).hom.app V x = 0 →
          (restrictedSharpThroughThickening B S hS Z W₀ c₀ e₀ h₀).hom.app V x =
            (restrictedSharpThroughThickening B S hS Z W₀ c e₀ h).hom.app V x)
      (hcc : c₀ ≫ qb = c ≫ qb),
      restrictedLiftDifferenceHom B S hS Z W₀ hZ e₀ qb c₀ c h₀ h hker hcc = θ
declarations.comment: the existence clause: every linear map out of the pulled back differentials is the difference of the given morphism of thickenings and a second one

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.existsUnique_hom_restrictedLiftDifferenceHom_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04D0.**  For a morphism `c₀ : X ⟶ W` restricting on the first order thickening
`Z ⊂ X` to `e₀` read through the inclusion of the closed subspace `W₀ ⊆ W`, and for an
`𝒪_Z`-linear map `θ : e₀^*Ω_{W₀/Bas} ⟶ 𝒞_{Z/X}`, there is **exactly one** morphism
`c : X ⟶ W` which restricts on `Z` to the same morphism, agrees with `c₀` over `Bas` and
induces the same map of conormal modules as `c₀` does — hypotheses (1) and (2) of
[Stacks Project, Tag 0618] — and whose difference from `c₀` is `θ`.

This is the whole of [Stacks Project, Tag 04D0], unconditionally: the existence clause is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_hom_restrictedLiftDifferenceHom_eq` and the uniqueness clause
is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.eq_of_restrictedLiftDifferenceHom_eq`.  It is also the simple
transitivity of [Stacks Project, Tag 061C] read at one object of the étale site, with the
acting group the global `𝒪_Z`-linear maps; see the "Scope" section of the module doc for the
relativisation that is still owed.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_hom_restrictedLiftDifferenceHom_eq (c₀ : X ⟶ W)
    (h₀ : subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z ≫ c₀ = e₀ ≫ subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)
    (θ : (modulePullback B S hS e₀).obj
        (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS (subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀ ≫ qb)) ⟶
      conormalModule B S hS X Z) :
    ∃! c : X ⟶ W, ∃ (h : subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z ≫ c = e₀ ≫ subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)
      (hker : ∀ (V : (SmallEtale B S hS
          (⟨W₀.1.toFunctor, W₀.2.1⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS).1)ᵒᵖ)
        (x : (structureRingSheafInverseImage B S hS
          (subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)).obj.obj V),
        (structureSharpRingInverseImage B S hS
            (subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)).hom.app V x = 0 →
          (restrictedSharpThroughThickening B S hS Z W₀ c₀ e₀ h₀).hom.app V x =
            (restrictedSharpThroughThickening B S hS Z W₀ c e₀ h).hom.app V x)
      (hcc : c₀ ≫ qb = c ≫ qb),
      restrictedLiftDifferenceHom B S hS Z W₀ hZ e₀ qb c₀ c h₀ h hker hcc = θ
declarations.comment: the unique second morphism of thickenings with a prescribed difference, with no stand-in: the existence of the moved solution and the faithfulness of the transported comorphism replace the recovery of a morphism from its comorphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.existsUnique_hom_of_derivationModification_of_mono_toSpecΓ
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04D0**, with the recovery of morphisms over the base and the modification datum
taken as arguments.  For a morphism `(a, a')`
of first order thickenings over `T` and an `𝒪_X`-linear map `θ : a^*Ω_{Y/T} ⟶ 𝒞_{X/X'}` there
is exactly one morphism `b' : X' ⟶ Y'` whose structure map is `(a')^♯ + d_{Y/T} ∘ θ`, and the
pair `(a, b')` is a morphism of thickenings over `T`.

Setting `b = a` this is the unique morphism of pairs `(b, b')` of the source: conditions (1)
and (2) of [Stacks Project, Tag 0618] are the two displayed equations, and the derivation `D`
is related to `θ` by Equation (0619) because that is how the datum `hom θ` is built.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_hom_of_derivationModification_of_mono_toSpecΓ (hSmono : Mono S.toSpecΓ)
    (M : DerivationModification B S hS hG hH pX' pY' a a')
    (θ : ThickeningDerivationMap B S hS hG hH pY' a) :
    ∃! b' : X' ⟶ Y', InducesSmallEtaleRingedToposHom B S hS b' (M.hom θ) ∧
      IsThickening.inclusion B S hS hG ≫ b' = a ≫ IsThickening.inclusion B S hS hH ∧
      b' ≫ pY' = pX'
declarations.comment: over a base SCHEME whose canonical morphism to the spectrum of its global functions is a monomorphism -- an affine base, a quasi-affine base: the morphism of pairs and its uniqueness, with the modified structure map (a')^sharp + D taken as an argument (`DerivationModification`), which packages that sum as a morphism of ringed topoi together with the two 2-isomorphisms Stacks 05ZN consumes. The recovery of morphisms over the base is NOT taken as an argument any more: it is proved for such a base scheme by `isRecoveredFromSmallEtale_of_mono_toSpecGamma`, which is where the hypothesis on the base enters and the only place it enters

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.existsUnique_hom_of_derivationModification
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04D0 with the recovery of morphisms over the base taken as an argument.**

This is the shape in which the statement was first written.  The argument `hKL` is now available
without being assumed, for a base scheme whose canonical morphism to the spectrum of its global
functions is a monomorphism, so the tag is registered on
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.existsUnique_hom_of_derivationModification_of_mono_toSpecΓ` above rather
than here.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_hom_of_derivationModification (hKL : IsRecoveredFromSmallEtale B S hS)
    (M : DerivationModification B S hS hG hH pX' pY' a a')
    (θ : ThickeningDerivationMap B S hS hG hH pY' a) :
    ∃! b' : X' ⟶ Y', InducesSmallEtaleRingedToposHom B S hS b' (M.hom θ) ∧
      IsThickening.inclusion B S hS hG ≫ b' = a ≫ IsThickening.inclusion B S hS hH ∧
      b' ≫ pY' = pX'
declarations.comment: the morphism of pairs and its uniqueness, with the recovery of morphisms over the base taken as an argument (`IsRecoveredFromSmallEtale`, which is Stacks 04KL over a base) and with the modified structure map (a')^sharp + D taken as an argument (`DerivationModification`), since forming that sum needs the structure-sheaf half of 05ZM

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.eq_of_derivationModification_eq
declarations.doc:
**The correspondence of [Stacks Project, Tag 04D0] is injective.**  Two `𝒪_X`-linear maps
`θ` which modify the structure map of `a'` to the same morphism of thickenings are equal.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_of_derivationModification_eq (M : DerivationModification B S hS hG hH pX' pY' a a')
    (θ₁ θ₂ : ThickeningDerivationMap B S hS hG hH pY' a) (b' : X' ⟶ Y')
    (h₁ : InducesSmallEtaleRingedToposHom B S hS b' (M.hom θ₁))
    (h₂ : InducesSmallEtaleRingedToposHom B S hS b' (M.hom θ₂)) :
    θ₁ = θ₂
declarations.comment: injectivity of the correspondence theta -> b', with the modified structure map taken as an argument (`DerivationModification`)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.eq_of_derivationModification_base_of_induces
declarations.doc:
**The zero map of [Stacks Project, Tag 04D0] does not move `a'`.**  The morphism of
thickenings whose structure map is the modification of `(a')^♯` by the zero map is `a'`
itself.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_of_derivationModification_base_of_induces
    (M : DerivationModification B S hS hG hH pX' pY' a a') (b' : X' ⟶ Y')
    (h : InducesSmallEtaleRingedToposHom B S hS b' (M.hom M.base)) :
    b' = a'
declarations.comment: that the zero map returns the given morphism of thickenings, with the modified structure map taken as an argument (`DerivationModification`). The recovery of morphisms over the base is NOT taken as an argument: only the faithfulness half of 04KL is used here, and that is proved, by `eq_of_inducesCommonSmallEtaleRingedToposHom`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.eq_of_derivationModification_base
declarations.doc:
**The zero map of [Stacks Project, Tag 04D0] does not move `a'`**, with the recovery of
morphisms over the base taken as an argument.

This is the shape in which the statement was first written.  The argument `hKL` is not needed:
only the faithfulness half of Stacks 04KL over a base is used, and that is proved for every base,
so the tag is registered on
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.eq_of_derivationModification_base_of_induces` above rather than here.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_of_derivationModification_base (hKL : IsRecoveredFromSmallEtale B S hS)
    (M : DerivationModification B S hS hG hH pX' pY' a a') (b' : X' ⟶ Y')
    (h : InducesSmallEtaleRingedToposHom B S hS b' (M.hom M.base)) :
    b' = a'
declarations.comment: that the zero map returns the given morphism of thickenings, with the recovery of morphisms over the base taken as an argument (`IsRecoveredFromSmallEtale`, which is Stacks 04KL over a base) and with the modified structure map taken as an argument (`DerivationModification`)

declarations.name: etale_lift_along_surjection
declarations.doc:
Étale ring maps lift along surjections of rings: if `A' → A` is a surjection of commutative
rings with kernel `I` and `B` is an étale `A`-algebra, then `B` is the reduction of an étale
`A'`-algebra, in the sense that there are an étale `A'`-algebra `C` and a surjection of
`A'`-algebras `ψ : C → B` with `RingHom.ker ψ = I C`.
declarations.statement:
theorem etale_lift_along_surjection (A' : Type u) (A : Type v) (B : Type w)
    [CommRing A'] [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A' A] [Algebra A B] [Algebra A' B]
    [IsScalarTower A' A B] (hA : Function.Surjective (algebraMap A' A)) [Algebra.Etale A B] :
    ∃ (C : Type u) (_ : CommRing C) (_ : Algebra A' C), Algebra.Etale A' C ∧
      ∃ ψ : C →ₐ[A'] B, Function.Surjective ψ ∧
        RingHom.ker (ψ : C →+* B) = (RingHom.ker (algebraMap A' A)).map (algebraMap A' C)

declarations.name: presheafPushforward_yoneda_iso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04D2.** The pushforward `u_p` sends `h_U` to `h_{u(U)}`.
Both `(presheafPushforward04D2 u).obj (yoneda.obj U)` and `yoneda.obj (u.obj U)` are
left Kan extensions of `yoneda.obj U` along `u.op`, so they are canonically isomorphic.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def presheafPushforward_yoneda_iso (U : C) :
    (presheafPushforward04D2 u).obj (yoneda.obj U) ≅ yoneda.obj (u.obj U)

declarations.name: sheafPullback_sheafify_yoneda_iso
declarations.doc:
Stacks Tag 04D3 (Lemma 7.13.5), pointwise form.

For a continuous functor `u : C ⥤ D` between sites `(C, J)` and `(D, K)` and an
object `U` of `C`, applying the left-adjoint sheaf functor `u_s = u.sheafPullback`
to the sheafification of the representable presheaf `h_U` yields the sheafification
of the representable presheaf `h_{u(U)}` on `D`:
  `u_s (h_U^#) ≅ h_{u(U)}^#`.
declarations.statement:
theorem sheafPullback_sheafify_yoneda_iso (U : C) :
    Nonempty
      ((u.sheafPullback (Type v) J K).obj
        ((presheafToSheaf J (Type v)).obj (yoneda.obj U)) ≅
      (presheafToSheaf K (Type v)).obj (yoneda.obj (u.obj U)))

declarations.name: MorphismOfTopoi.pushforward_exactness_implications
declarations.statement:
theorem pushforward_exactness_implications
    (f : MorphismOfTopoi (Sheaf J (Type max u v)) (Sheaf K (Type max u' v'))) :
    -- (a) (2) ⇒ (1)
    (f.pushforward.Full ∧ f.pushforward.Faithful → f.pushforward.Faithful) ∧
    -- (b) (3) ⇒ (1)
    ((∀ F, Epi (f.adj.counit.app F)) → f.pushforward.Faithful) ∧
    -- (c) (7) ⇒ (1), (2), (3), (8), (9), (10)
    ((∀ F, IsIso (f.adj.counit.app F)) →
      f.pushforward.Faithful ∧ (f.pushforward.Full ∧ f.pushforward.Faithful) ∧
      (∀ F, Epi (f.adj.counit.app F)) ∧ f.pushforward.ReflectsMonomorphisms ∧
      f.pushforward.ReflectsEpimorphisms ∧ f.pushforward.ReflectsIsomorphisms) ∧
    -- (d) (3) ⇔ (9)
    ((∀ F, Epi (f.adj.counit.app F)) ↔ f.pushforward.ReflectsEpimorphisms) ∧
    -- (e) (6) ⇒ (4) and (5) ⇒ (4)
    ((PreservesColimitsOfShape WalkingSpan f.pushforward → f.pushforward.PreservesEpimorphisms) ∧
      (PreservesColimitsOfShape WalkingParallelPair f.pushforward →
        f.pushforward.PreservesEpimorphisms)) ∧
    -- (f) (4) ⇔ (11)
    (f.pushforward.PreservesEpimorphisms ↔
      ∀ (G : Sheaf K (Type max u' v')) (F : Sheaf J (Type max u v))
        (p : F ⟶ f.inverseImage.obj G), Epi p →
        ∃ (G' : Sheaf K (Type max u' v')) (q : G' ⟶ G), Epi q ∧
          ∃ r : f.inverseImage.obj G' ⟶ F, r ≫ p = f.inverseImage.map q) ∧
    -- (g) (9) ⇒ (8), (10)
    (f.pushforward.ReflectsEpimorphisms →
      f.pushforward.ReflectsMonomorphisms ∧ f.pushforward.ReflectsIsomorphisms) ∧
    -- (h) (2) ⇔ (7)
    (f.pushforward.Full ∧ f.pushforward.Faithful ↔ ∀ F, IsIso (f.adj.counit.app F))

declarations.name: isLocallySurjective_sheafPushforwardContinuous_map
declarations.doc:
Let `u : C ⥤ D` be a continuous functor between sites `(C, J)` and
`(D, K)` (the continuous functor underlying a morphism of sites
`f : (D, K) → (C, J)`). Assume that for every object `U` of `C` and every
covering `{V j ⟶ u(U)}` in `D` there is a covering `{W i ⟶ U}` in `C` such
that `∐ h_{u(W i)}^# → h_{u(U)}^#` factors through `∐ h_{V j}^# → h_{u(U)}^#`
(`FactorizationCondition`). Then `f_* = u.sheafPushforwardContinuous _ J K`
transforms surjective maps of sheaves of sets into surjective maps of
sheaves.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallySurjective_sheafPushforwardContinuous_map (u : C ⥤ D)
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (K : GrothendieckTopology D) [u.IsContinuous J K]
    (h : FactorizationCondition u J K) {F G : Sheaf K (Type (max w₁ w₂))} (a : F ⟶ G)
    [Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective a] :
    Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective ((u.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type (max w₁ w₂)) J K).map a)
declarations.comment:
Stated for a continuous functor `u`; the exactness of `u_s`
making it a morphism of sites is not used. Coverings are families generating
a covering sieve, and surjective maps of sheaves are the locally surjective
ones.

declarations.name: sheafPushforwardContinuous_reflectsMonomorphisms_of_isCoverDense
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04D9.** If `u : C ⥤ D` is a continuous functor between sites
which is also cover dense (i.e. every object of `D` is covered by
images of objects of `C` under `u`), then the pushforward functor on
sheaves `f_* : Sheaf K A ⥤ Sheaf J A` reflects monomorphisms. For sheaves of sets these are
the injections (Stacks 00WN); the componentwise form is
`injective_app_of_injective_sheafPushforwardContinuous_map`.
declarations.statement:
theorem sheafPushforwardContinuous_reflectsMonomorphisms_of_isCoverDense
    [u.IsContinuous J K] [u.IsCoverDense K] :
    (u.sheafPushforwardContinuous A J K).ReflectsMonomorphisms

declarations.name: sheafPushforwardContinuous_reflectsEpimorphisms_of_isCoverDense
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04D9.** If `u : C ⥤ D` is a continuous functor between sites
which is also cover dense (i.e. every object of `D` is covered by
images of objects of `C` under `u`), then the pushforward functor on
sheaves `f_* : Sheaf K A ⥤ Sheaf J A` reflects epimorphisms. For sheaves of sets these are
the surjections (Stacks 00WN); the local form is
`isLocallySurjective_of_isLocallySurjective_sheafPushforwardContinuous_map`.
declarations.statement:
theorem sheafPushforwardContinuous_reflectsEpimorphisms_of_isCoverDense
    [u.IsContinuous J K] [u.IsCoverDense K] :
    (u.sheafPushforwardContinuous A J K).ReflectsEpimorphisms

declarations.name: injective_app_of_injective_sheafPushforwardContinuous_map
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04D9, injections.** Let `u : C ⥤ D` be a continuous functor between sites such that
every object of `D` is covered by images of objects of `C`. If `α : 𝓕 ⟶ 𝓖` is a map of sheaves of
sets on `D` such that `f_* α` is injective (Stacks 00WM: injective on sections over every object
of `C`), then `α` is injective on sections over every object of `D`.
declarations.statement:
theorem injective_app_of_injective_sheafPushforwardContinuous_map
    [u.IsContinuous J K] [u.IsCoverDense K] {X Y : Sheaf K (Type w)} (α : X ⟶ Y)
    (hα : ∀ U : C, Function.Injective
      (((u.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type w) J K).map α).hom.app (op U)))
    (V : D) : Function.Injective (α.hom.app (op V))
declarations.comment: f_* reflects injections, in the sense of Stacks 00WM

declarations.name: isLocallySurjective_of_isLocallySurjective_sheafPushforwardContinuous_map
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04D9, surjections.** Let `u : C ⥤ D` be a continuous functor between sites such that
every object of `D` is covered by images of objects of `C`. If `α : 𝓕 ⟶ 𝓖` is a map of sheaves of
sets on `D` such that `f_* α` is surjective (Stacks 00WM: every section is locally in the image),
then `α` is surjective.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallySurjective_of_isLocallySurjective_sheafPushforwardContinuous_map
    [u.IsContinuous J K] [u.IsCoverDense K] {X Y : Sheaf K (Type w)} (α : X ⟶ Y)
    (hα : Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective ((u.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type w) J K).map α)) :
    Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective α
declarations.comment: f_* reflects surjections, in the sense of Stacks 00WM

declarations.name: main_statement_equivalence
declarations.doc:
**Statement 1 (Equivalence).** Let `f : Sh(C) → Sh(D)` be a morphism of
topoi. The following are equivalent:
1. For all `F` in `Ab(C)`, the counit `ε_F : f^{-1} f_* F → F` is surjective
   (an epimorphism) in `Ab(C)`.
2. The functor `f_* : Ab(C) → Ab(D)` reflects surjections.
declarations.statement:
theorem main_statement_equivalence (f : MorphismOfTopoiAb JC JD) :
    (∀ F : AbSh JC, Epi (f.counit F)) ↔ f.ReflectsSurjections

declarations.name: main_statement_faithful
declarations.doc:
**Statement 2 (Faithfulness).** If the equivalent conditions of Statement 1
hold (we phrase the hypothesis via condition (1): the counit is surjective for
every abelian sheaf `F`), then `f_* : Ab(C) → Ab(D)` is faithful.
declarations.statement:
theorem main_statement_faithful (f : MorphismOfTopoiAb JC JD)
    (h : ∀ F : AbSh JC, Epi (f.counit F)) : f.IsFaithful

declarations.name: Stacks.Topos.AbelianPushforward.abelianPushforward_exact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04DB.** Let `f : Sh(C) ⟶ Sh(D)` be a morphism of topoi and assume at least one of

1. `f_*` takes surjections of sheaves of sets to surjections,
2. `f_*` takes surjections of abelian sheaves to surjections,
3. `f_*` commutes with coequalizers of sheaves of sets,
4. `f_*` commutes with pushouts of sheaves of sets.

Then `f_* : Ab(C) ⟶ Ab(D)` is exact.

Each of (1), (3) and (4) is reduced to (2): (3) and (4) give (1) because every epimorphism of
sheaves of sets is a regular epimorphism, and (1) gives (2) through the identification of the
underlying sheaf of sets of a direct image with the direct image of the underlying sheaf.
declarations.statement:
theorem abelianPushforward_exact [HasSheafify J (Type w)]
    (h : f.pushforward.PreservesEpimorphisms ∨
      (abelianPushforward J f).PreservesEpimorphisms ∨
      PreservesColimitsOfShape WalkingParallelPair f.pushforward ∨
      PreservesColimitsOfShape WalkingSpan f.pushforward) :
    exactFunctor (Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{w}) (Sheaf K AddCommGrpCat.{w'})
      (abelianPushforward J f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.UniversalHomeomorphism
declarations.doc:
A morphism of schemes is a universal homeomorphism if every base change is
a homeomorphism on the underlying topological spaces.
declarations.statement: class UniversalHomeomorphism {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.universalHomeomorphism_iff_integral_universallyInjective_surjective
declarations.doc:
A morphism of schemes is a universal homeomorphism if and only if it is integral,
universally injective, and surjective.
declarations.statement:
theorem universalHomeomorphism_iff_integral_universallyInjective_surjective
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    UniversalHomeomorphism f ↔
      IsIntegralHom f ∧ UniversallyInjective f ∧ Surjective f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_open_restrict_isClosedImmersion_of_finite_unramified_fiber_eq_singleton
declarations.doc:
A finite unramified morphism with a singleton fibre and purely inseparable residue-field
extension is a closed immersion over some neighbourhood of the point in the target.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_open_restrict_isClosedImmersion_of_finite_unramified_fiber_eq_singleton
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsFinite f] [Unramified f]
    (s : S) (x : X) (hfiber : f ⁻¹' {s} = {x})
    (hpure :
      let hxs : f x = s := by
        have : x ∈ f ⁻¹' {s} := by simp [hfiber]
        simpa only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using this
      letI := ((S.residueFieldCongr hxs).inv ≫ f.residueFieldMap x).hom.toAlgebra
      IsPurelyInseparable (S.residueField s) (X.residueField x)) :
    ∃ U : S.Opens, s ∈ U ∧ IsClosedImmersion (f ∣_ U)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_open_restrict_isIso_of_finite_etale_fiber_eq_singleton
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04DH.** A finite étale morphism with a singleton fibre and purely
inseparable residue-field extension is an isomorphism over some open neighbourhood of the
point in the target.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_open_restrict_isIso_of_finite_etale_fiber_eq_singleton
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsFinite f] [Etale f]
    (s : S) (x : X) (hfiber : f ⁻¹' {s} = {x})
    (hpure :
      let hxs : f x = s := by
        have : x ∈ f ⁻¹' {s} := by simp [hfiber]
        simpa only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using this
      letI := ((S.residueFieldCongr hxs).inv ≫ f.residueFieldMap x).hom.toAlgebra
      IsPurelyInseparable (S.residueField s) (X.residueField x)) :
    ∃ U : S.Opens, s ∈ U ∧ IsIso (f ∣_ U)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.smallEtalePushforwardAb_properties_of_hasPropertyA
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04DK.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of schemes with property (A).
Then direct image of abelian sheaves on the small étale sites reflects injections and
surjections, the counit `f^{-1} f_* F ⟶ F` is surjective for every abelian sheaf `F` on the
small étale site of `X`, and direct image is faithful.
declarations.statement:
public theorem smallEtalePushforwardAb_properties_of_hasPropertyA {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : HasPropertyA f) :
    (smallEtalePushforwardAb f).ReflectsMonomorphisms ∧
      (smallEtalePushforwardAb f).ReflectsEpimorphisms ∧
      (∀ F : Sheaf (smallEtaleTopology X) Ab.{u + 1},
          Epi ((smallEtaleAdjunctionAb f).counit.app F)) ∧
      (smallEtalePushforwardAb f).Faithful

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.hasPropertyA_of_locallyQuasiFinite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04DL.** A separated locally quasi-finite morphism of schemes has
property (A).
declarations.statement:
theorem hasPropertyA_of_locallyQuasiFinite {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [LocallyQuasiFinite f] : HasPropertyA f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.hasPropertyA_of_isIntegralHom
declarations.doc: **Stacks Project, Tag 04DM.** Every integral morphism of schemes has property (A).
declarations.statement:
theorem hasPropertyA_of_isIntegralHom {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsIntegralHom f] :
    HasPropertyA f

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.smallEtalePushforward_preservesEpimorphisms_of_hasPropertyB
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04DO.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of schemes with property (B).
Then direct image along the induced morphism of small étale sites transforms surjections of
sheaves of sets into surjections.
declarations.statement:
theorem smallEtalePushforward_preservesEpimorphisms_of_hasPropertyB {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : HasPropertyB f) :
    ((smallEtaleBaseChange f).sheafPushforwardContinuous
      (Type v) (smallEtaleTopology Y) (smallEtaleTopology X)).PreservesEpimorphisms

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.hasPropertyB_of_etaleNeighborhood_decomposition
declarations.doc:
A morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` has property (B) as soon as, for every étale `g : V ⟶ Y`, every étale
covering `U` of `X ×ₗᵧ V` and every point `v` of `V`, there is a single étale neighborhood of `v`
over which `X ×ₗᵧ V` breaks up into pieces subordinate to `U`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasPropertyB_of_etaleNeighborhood_decomposition
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (h : ∀ {V : Scheme.{u}} (g : V ⟶ Y) [Etale g]
      (U : (pullback f g).Cover.{u} Scheme.etalePrecoverage) (v : V),
      ∃ (N : EtaleNeighborhood V v)
        (q : pullback f (N.toBase ≫ g) ⟶ pullback f g),
        q ≫ pullback.fst f g = pullback.fst f (N.toBase ≫ g) ∧
        q ≫ pullback.snd f g = pullback.snd f (N.toBase ≫ g) ≫ N.toBase ∧
        ∃ (W : U.I₀ → Scheme.{u}) (e : (∐ W) ≅ pullback f (N.toBase ≫ g))
          (a : ∀ i, W i ⟶ U.X i),
          ∀ i, a i ≫ U.f i = Sigma.ι W i ≫ e.hom ≫ q) :
    HasPropertyB f

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.hasPropertyB_of_isFinite
declarations.doc:
**Property (B) for a finite morphism of schemes.** Every étale covering of the base change of
a finite morphism admits, after a further étale covering of the base, a componentwise subordinate
disjoint-union decomposition.

This is [Stacks, Tag 04DQ]. It is
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.hasPropertyB_of_isFinite_of_idempotents` with its one remaining input,
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.HasFiniteCaseDecompositionOfIdempotents`, discharged by
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.hasFiniteCaseDecompositionOfIdempotents`.
declarations.statement: theorem hasPropertyB_of_isFinite {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite f] : HasPropertyB f

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.hasPropertyB_of_isIntegralHom
declarations.doc:
**Property (B) for an integral morphism of schemes.** Every étale covering of the base change
of an integral morphism admits, after a further étale covering of the base, a componentwise
subordinate disjoint-union decomposition.

This is [Stacks, Tag 04DR]. The integral case is deduced from the finite case
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.hasPropertyB_of_isFinite` by the limit argument
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.hasPropertyB_of_isIntegralHom_of_finite`: an integral morphism over an
affine base is a directed limit of finite ones, a finite affine étale cover of the limit descends
to a finite stage, and the decomposition supplied there is transported back.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasPropertyB_of_isIntegralHom {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsIntegralHom f] :
    HasPropertyB f

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.smallEtalePushforward_reflectsMonomorphisms_of_hasPropertyC
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04DT.** If `f : X ⟶ Y` has property (C), then direct image
`f_{small, *} : Sh(X_étale) ⥤ Sh(Y_étale)` on sheaves of sets reflects injections.
declarations.statement:
theorem smallEtalePushforward_reflectsMonomorphisms_of_hasPropertyC
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (hC : HasPropertyC f) :
    ((smallEtaleBaseChange f).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type v)
      (smallEtaleTopology Y) (smallEtaleTopology X)).ReflectsMonomorphisms

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.smallEtalePushforward_reflectsEpimorphisms_of_hasPropertyC
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04DT.** If `f : X ⟶ Y` has property (C), then direct image
`f_{small, *} : Sh(X_étale) ⥤ Sh(Y_étale)` on sheaves of sets reflects surjections.
declarations.statement:
theorem smallEtalePushforward_reflectsEpimorphisms_of_hasPropertyC
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (hC : HasPropertyC f) :
    ((smallEtaleBaseChange f).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type v)
      (smallEtaleTopology Y) (smallEtaleTopology X)).ReflectsEpimorphisms

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.smallEtaleBaseChange_isAlmostCocontinuous
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04DV.** If every étale base change `X ×_Y V ⟶ V` of `f : X ⟶ Y` has
property (C) and is a closed map, then base change `Y.Etale ⥤ X.Etale`, `V ↦ X ×_Y V`, is an
almost cocontinuous functor of small étale sites.
declarations.statement:
theorem smallEtaleBaseChange_isAlmostCocontinuous
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hC : ∀ {V : Scheme.{u}} (v : V ⟶ Y), Etale v →
      HasPropertyC (pullback.snd f v))
    (hclosed : ∀ {V : Scheme.{u}} (v : V ⟶ Y), Etale v →
      IsClosedMap (pullback.snd f v).base) :
    IsAlmostCocontinuous (smallEtaleBaseChange f)
      (smallEtaleTopology Y) (smallEtaleTopology X)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.hasPropertyC_of_isIntegralHom_of_isClosedEmbedding
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04DW.** An integral morphism of schemes which is a homeomorphism onto a
closed subset of its target has property (C): every scheme étale over the source is dominated, by
a surjection over the source, by the base change of a scheme étale over the target.

The étale scheme over the target is the coproduct of the one-point constructions of
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.exists_etale_dominating_at_point`, indexed by the points of the given
étale scheme; its base change is the coproduct of their base changes by
`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.isPullback_pullbackFactorMap`, so the one-point morphisms assemble into a
single morphism, and it is surjective because every point was hit.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasPropertyC_of_isIntegralHom_of_isClosedEmbedding
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsIntegralHom f] (hf : Topology.IsClosedEmbedding f) :
    HasPropertyC f

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.smallEtaleBaseChange_isAlmostCocontinuous_of_isIntegralHom_of_universallyInjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04DX, part (7).** For an integral universally injective morphism of
schemes `f : X ⟶ Y`, base change `Y.Etale ⥤ X.Etale`, `V ↦ X ×_Y V`, is almost cocontinuous as a
functor of small étale sites.

Every étale base change of `f` has property (C) and is a closed map, which is the hypothesis of
[Stacks, Tag 04DV].
declarations.statement:
public theorem
    smallEtaleBaseChange_isAlmostCocontinuous_of_isIntegralHom_of_universallyInjective
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsIntegralHom f] [UniversallyInjective f] :
    IsAlmostCocontinuous (smallEtaleBaseChange f) (smallEtaleTopology Y) (smallEtaleTopology X)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.smallEtalePushforward_reflectsMonomorphisms_of_isIntegralHom_of_universallyInjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04DX, part (1).** For an integral universally injective morphism of
schemes `f : X ⟶ Y`, direct image `f_{small, *} : Sh(X_étale) ⥤ Sh(Y_étale)` on sheaves of sets
reflects injections.

This is property (C) fed to [Stacks, Tag 04DT].
declarations.statement:
public theorem
    smallEtalePushforward_reflectsMonomorphisms_of_isIntegralHom_of_universallyInjective
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsIntegralHom f] [UniversallyInjective f] :
    ((smallEtaleBaseChange f).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type v) (smallEtaleTopology Y)
      (smallEtaleTopology X)).ReflectsMonomorphisms

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.smallEtalePushforward_reflectsEpimorphisms_of_isIntegralHom_of_universallyInjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04DX, part (1).** For an integral universally injective morphism of
schemes `f : X ⟶ Y`, direct image `f_{small, *} : Sh(X_étale) ⥤ Sh(Y_étale)` on sheaves of sets
reflects surjections.

This is property (C) fed to [Stacks, Tag 04DT].
declarations.statement:
public theorem
    smallEtalePushforward_reflectsEpimorphisms_of_isIntegralHom_of_universallyInjective
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsIntegralHom f] [UniversallyInjective f] :
    ((smallEtaleBaseChange f).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type v) (smallEtaleTopology Y)
      (smallEtaleTopology X)).ReflectsEpimorphisms

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.smallEtalePushforward_preservesConnectedColimits_of_isIntegralHom_of_universallyInjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04DX, part (2).** For an integral universally injective morphism of
schemes `f : X ⟶ Y`, direct image `f_{small, *} : Sh(X_étale) ⥤ Sh(Y_étale)` on sheaves of sets
preserves colimits of every connected shape whose colimits exist. In particular it commutes with
pushouts and coequalizers, and more generally with finite connected colimits.

This is almost cocontinuity of the base-change functor fed to [Stacks, Tag 04BA].
declarations.statement:
public theorem
    smallEtalePushforward_preservesConnectedColimits_of_isIntegralHom_of_universallyInjective
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsIntegralHom f] [UniversallyInjective f]
    (I : Type) [SmallCategory I] [IsConnected I]
    [HasColimitsOfShape I (Type (max (u + 1) v))] :
    PreservesColimitsOfShape I
      ((smallEtaleBaseChange f).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type (max (u + 1) v))
        (smallEtaleTopology Y) (smallEtaleTopology X))

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.smallEtalePushforward_preservesEpimorphisms_of_isIntegralHom_of_universallyInjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04DX, part (3).** For an integral universally injective morphism of
schemes `f : X ⟶ Y`, direct image `f_{small, *} : Sh(X_étale) ⥤ Sh(Y_étale)` carries surjections
of sheaves of sets to surjections.

Universal injectivity is not needed here: integrality alone gives property (B), which is the
hypothesis of [Stacks, Tag 04DO].
declarations.statement:
public theorem
    smallEtalePushforward_preservesEpimorphisms_of_isIntegralHom_of_universallyInjective
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsIntegralHom f] [UniversallyInjective f] :
    ((smallEtaleBaseChange f).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type v) (smallEtaleTopology Y)
      (smallEtaleTopology X)).PreservesEpimorphisms

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.smallEtalePushforwardAb_preservesEpimorphisms_of_isIntegralHom_of_universallyInjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04DX, part (3).** For an integral universally injective morphism of
schemes `f : X ⟶ Y`, direct image `f_{small, *} : Ab(X_étale) ⥤ Ab(Y_étale)` carries surjections
of abelian sheaves to surjections.

A morphism of abelian sheaves is epimorphic exactly when it is locally surjective, and local
surjectivity is a property of the underlying morphism of sheaves of sets. Since the underlying
sheaf of sets of a direct image is the direct image of the underlying sheaf of sets, the statement
reduces to its set-valued counterpart.
declarations.statement:
public theorem
    smallEtalePushforwardAb_preservesEpimorphisms_of_isIntegralHom_of_universallyInjective
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsIntegralHom f] [UniversallyInjective f] :
    (smallEtalePushforwardAb f).PreservesEpimorphisms

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.smallEtaleAdjunction_counit_epi_of_isIntegralHom_of_universallyInjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04DX, part (4).** For an integral universally injective morphism of
schemes `f : X ⟶ Y`, the counit `f^{-1} f_* F ⟶ F` of the inverse-image/direct-image adjunction is
surjective for every sheaf of sets `F` on the small étale site of `X`.

A right adjoint which reflects surjections has surjective counit, by [Stacks, Tag 04D6]; direct
image reflects surjections by part (1).
declarations.statement:
public theorem smallEtaleAdjunction_counit_epi_of_isIntegralHom_of_universallyInjective
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsIntegralHom f] [UniversallyInjective f]
    (F : Sheaf (smallEtaleTopology X) (Type (max (u + 1) v))) :
    Epi ((Functor.sheafAdjunctionContinuous (smallEtaleBaseChange f) (Type (max (u + 1) v))
      (smallEtaleTopology Y) (smallEtaleTopology X)).counit.app F)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.smallEtaleAdjunctionAb_counit_epi_of_isIntegralHom_of_universallyInjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04DX, part (4).** For an integral universally injective morphism of
schemes `f : X ⟶ Y`, the counit `f^{-1} f_* F ⟶ F` of the inverse-image/direct-image adjunction is
surjective for every abelian sheaf `F` on the small étale site of `X`.

Integrality alone gives property (A), from which this is one of the conclusions of
[Stacks, Tag 04DK].
declarations.statement:
public theorem smallEtaleAdjunctionAb_counit_epi_of_isIntegralHom_of_universallyInjective
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsIntegralHom f] [UniversallyInjective f]
    (F : Sheaf (smallEtaleTopology X) Ab.{u + 1}) :
    Epi ((smallEtaleAdjunctionAb f).counit.app F)

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.smallEtalePushforward_faithful_of_isIntegralHom_of_universallyInjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04DX, part (5).** For an integral universally injective morphism of
schemes `f : X ⟶ Y`, direct image `f_{small, *} : Sh(X_étale) ⥤ Sh(Y_étale)` on sheaves of sets is
faithful.

A right adjoint with surjective counit is faithful, by [Stacks, Tag 04D6]; the counit is surjective
by part (4).
declarations.statement:
public theorem smallEtalePushforward_faithful_of_isIntegralHom_of_universallyInjective
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsIntegralHom f] [UniversallyInjective f] :
    ((smallEtaleBaseChange f).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type (max (u + 1) v))
      (smallEtaleTopology Y) (smallEtaleTopology X)).Faithful

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.smallEtalePushforwardAb_faithful_of_isIntegralHom_of_universallyInjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04DX, part (5).** For an integral universally injective morphism of
schemes `f : X ⟶ Y`, direct image `f_{small, *} : Ab(X_étale) ⥤ Ab(Y_étale)` on abelian sheaves is
faithful.

Integrality alone gives property (A), from which this is one of the conclusions of
[Stacks, Tag 04DK].
declarations.statement:
public theorem smallEtalePushforwardAb_faithful_of_isIntegralHom_of_universallyInjective
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsIntegralHom f] [UniversallyInjective f] :
    (smallEtalePushforwardAb f).Faithful

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.smallEtalePushforwardAb_exact_of_isIntegralHom_of_universallyInjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04DX, part (6).** For an integral universally injective morphism of
schemes `f : X ⟶ Y`, direct image `f_{small, *} : Ab(X_étale) ⥤ Ab(Y_étale)` is an exact functor.

Direct image is a right adjoint, so it preserves finite limits and is therefore additive; it
preserves epimorphisms by part (3); and an additive functor between abelian categories which
preserves finite limits and epimorphisms preserves finite colimits as well.
declarations.statement:
public theorem smallEtalePushforwardAb_exact_of_isIntegralHom_of_universallyInjective
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsIntegralHom f] [UniversallyInjective f] :
    exactFunctor (Sheaf (smallEtaleTopology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (Sheaf (smallEtaleTopology Y) Ab.{u + 1}) (smallEtalePushforwardAb f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallBaseChange_isAlmostCocontinuous_of_isIntegralHom_of_universallyInjective
declarations.doc:
**The space-level analogue of [Stacks, Tag 04DX], part (7).** Let `f : Z ⟶ X` be a
representable morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` such that every base-change projection of
schemes `U ×_X Z ⟶ U` at an étale chart `U` of `X` is integral and universally injective — for
instance a closed immersion. Then base change of étale scheme charts along `f`,

`X_étale ⥤ Z_étale`, `U ↦ U ×_X Z`,

is almost cocontinuous for the small étale topologies.

Integrality makes each chart base change universally closed, hence a closed map, and together
with universal injectivity a homeomorphism onto a closed subset of the chart, which is the
hypothesis of [Stacks, Tag 04DW] and so gives property (C). Those are the two inputs of the
space-level [Stacks, Tag 04DV].
declarations.statement:
theorem smallBaseChange_isAlmostCocontinuous_of_isIntegralHom_of_universallyInjective
    (f : Z ⟶ X) (hf : yoneda.relativelyRepresentable f.hom)
    (hint : ∀ U : SmallEtale B S hS X.1, AlgebraicGeometry.IsIntegralHom
      ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map (hf.snd U.1.hom)))
    (huniv : ∀ U : SmallEtale B S hS X.1, AlgebraicGeometry.UniversallyInjective
      ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map (hf.snd U.1.hom))) :
    IsAlmostCocontinuous (smallBaseChange B S hS f hf)
      (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1) (SmallEtale.topology B S hS Z.1)
declarations.comment: part (7) for algebraic spaces: chart base change is almost cocontinuous

declarations.name: Stacks.Etale.isEquivalence_etalePullback_of_integral_universallyInjective_surjective
declarations.doc:
**Topological invariance of the small étale site, Stacks Project, Tag 04DZ.** Let
`f : X ⟶ Y` be integral, universally injective and surjective. Then `V ↦ X ×_Y V` is an
equivalence from the category of schemes étale over `Y` to the category of schemes étale over
`X`.

The reduction to the affine case,
`Stacks.Etale.exists_etale_pullback_iso_of_essSurjAffine`, is
supplied with that affine case (Stacks Project, Tag 04E0), obtained here from
`Stacks.Etale.essSurjAffineEtalePullback_of_etaleDescent` and the descent step
`Stacks.Etale.etaleDescentAlongAffineEtaleSurjection`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEquivalence_etalePullback_of_integral_universallyInjective_surjective
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsIntegralHom f] [UniversallyInjective f] [Surjective f] :
    letI : MorphismProperty.HasPullbacksAlong
        (@Etale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) f := ⟨fun _ _ ↦ inferInstance⟩
    letI : MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChangeAlong
        (@Etale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) f :=
      ⟨fun pb hg ↦ MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange.of_isPullback pb hg⟩
    (show Y.Etale ⥤ X.Etale from
      MorphismProperty.Over.pullback
        (@Etale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) ⊤ f).IsEquivalence
declarations.comment:
base change `V ↦ X ×_Y V` along an integral, universally injective and surjective
morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` is an equivalence `Y_étale ⥤ X_étale`: full faithfulness is Tag 0BTY, and
essential surjectivity is glued, by Schemes 01JA and 01JC, from the affine case, the induction
`Stacks.Etale.essSurjAffineEtalePullback_of_etaleDescent` of the source's second proof on a
bound for the degree of the fibres, descending at each step by Tag 0245 as
`Stacks.Etale.etaleDescentAlongAffineEtaleSurjection`.

declarations.name: Stacks.Etale.etalePullback_isEquivalence
declarations.doc:
**Topological invariance of the small étale site.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be integral, universally
injective and surjective. Then `V ↦ X ×_Y V` is an equivalence from the category of schemes étale
over `Y` to the category of schemes étale over `X`.

Essential surjectivity is `Stacks.Etale.exists_etale_pullback_iso_of_essSurjAffine` with its
hypothesis discharged by `Stacks.Etale.essSurjAffineEtalePullback`.
declarations.statement:
theorem etalePullback_isEquivalence (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsIntegralHom f]
    [UniversallyInjective f] [Surjective f] :
    letI : MorphismProperty.HasPullbacksAlong
        (@Etale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) f := ⟨fun _ _ ↦ inferInstance⟩
    letI : MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChangeAlong
        (@Etale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) f :=
      ⟨fun pb hg ↦ MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange.of_isPullback pb hg⟩
    (show Y.Etale ⥤ X.Etale from
      MorphismProperty.Over.pullback
        (@Etale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) ⊤ f).IsEquivalence
declarations.comment:
the equivalence, unconditionally. Full faithfulness is Tag 0BTY; essential
surjectivity is the affine case `Stacks.Etale.essSurjAffineEtalePullback` glued over an affine
cover by `Stacks.Etale.exists_etale_pullback_iso_of_essSurjAffine`. The name
`Stacks.Etale.etalePullback_isEquivalence_of_integral_universallyInjective_surjective` is an
alias of this declaration and keeps the tag as well.

declarations.name: Stacks.Etale.etalePullback_isEquivalence_of_integral_universallyInjective_surjective
declarations.doc:
**Topological invariance of the small étale site.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be integral, universally
injective and surjective. Then `V ↦ X ×_Y V` is an equivalence from the category of schemes
étale over `Y` to the category of schemes étale over `X`.
declarations.statement: alias etalePullback_isEquivalence_of_integral_universallyInjective_surjective
declarations.comment:
Full faithfulness is unconditional, from Tag 0BTY. A scheme etale over `X` is
covered by affine opens lying over affine opens of `Y`, and the glueing of Schemes 01JA and
01JC -- in this library `exists_etale_pullback_iso_of_descendedOpens_cover` -- assembles the
local descents into a global one. Essential surjectivity is thereby reduced to the affine case,
the essential surjectivity of the correspondence displayed as Tag 04E0, which is proved
unconditionally as `Stacks.Etale.essSurjAffineEtalePullback` by the source's induction on a
bound for the degree of the fibres of an etale morphism of affine schemes. This name is an alias
of `Stacks.Etale.etalePullback_isEquivalence`. The source's hypotheses are stated in their own
form, as integrality, universal injectivity and surjectivity, and converted by Tag 04DF.

declarations.name: Stacks.Etale.affineEtalePullback_isEquivalence
declarations.doc:
**The affine correspondence of Stacks Project, Tag 04E0.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a universal
homeomorphism of affine schemes. Base change along `f` carries an affine scheme étale over `Y` to
an affine scheme étale over `X`, and the induced functor between the affine objects of the two
small étale sites is an equivalence.

This is `Stacks.Etale.affineEtalePullback_isEquivalence_of_essSurjAffine` with its hypothesis
discharged by `Stacks.Etale.essSurjAffineEtalePullback`.
declarations.statement:
theorem affineEtalePullback_isEquivalence (f : X ⟶ Y) [UniversalHomeomorphism f]
    [IsAffine X] [IsAffine Y] :
    letI : MorphismProperty.HasPullbacksAlong
        (@Etale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) f := ⟨fun _ _ ↦ inferInstance⟩
    letI : MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChangeAlong
        (@Etale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) f :=
      ⟨fun pb hg ↦ MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange.of_isPullback pb hg⟩
    let F : Y.Etale ⥤ X.Etale :=
      MorphismProperty.Over.pullback (@Etale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) ⊤ f
    let PY : ObjectProperty Y.Etale := fun V ↦ IsAffine V.left
    let PX : ObjectProperty X.Etale := fun U ↦ IsAffine U.left
    ∃ h : ∀ V : PY.FullSubcategory, PX (F.obj V.obj),
      (PX.lift (PY.ι ⋙ F) h).IsEquivalence
declarations.comment:
the displayed correspondence, in full and unconditionally. Its three clauses are
covered as follows. Preservation of affineness and full faithfulness are
`Stacks.Etale.affineEtalePullback_fullyFaithful`. Essential
surjectivity -- the content the source proves, by induction on a bound for the degree of the
fibres of an etale morphism of affine schemes, descending at each step by effectivity of
descent -- is `Stacks.Etale.essSurjAffineEtalePullback`. This declaration is the equivalence the
three together give, assembled by
`Stacks.Etale.affineEtalePullback_isEquivalence_of_essSurjAffine`. The source's induction runs
through `Stacks.Etale.essSurjAffineEtalePullback_of_inductiveStep_surjective`, whose step is
`Stacks.Etale.exists_affine_etale_pullback_iso_of_surjective`; its one descent along an etale
covering of the target is
`Stacks.Etale.exists_affine_etale_pullback_iso_of_descentIso`, where effectivity enters as
Tag 02W8 rather than as the source's Tag 0245.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_etale_zariskiCover_baseChange_of_isClosedImmersion
declarations.doc:
An étale scheme over a closed subscheme has a Zariski covering by base changes of étale
schemes over the ambient scheme.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_etale_zariskiCover_baseChange_of_isClosedImmersion
    {X Y U : Scheme.{u}} (i : X ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (p : U ⟶ X) [Etale p] :
    ∃ (I : Type u) (V : I → Scheme.{u}) (q : ∀ j, V j ⟶ Y)
      (g : ∀ j, pullback (q j) i ⟶ U),
      (∀ j, Etale (q j)) ∧
        (∀ j, g j ≫ p = pullback.snd (q j) i) ∧
          Presieve.ofArrows (fun j ↦ pullback (q j) i) g ∈ Scheme.zariskiPrecoverage U

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_smooth_zariskiCover_baseChange_of_isClosedImmersion
declarations.doc:
If `X ⟶ Y` is a closed immersion and `U ⟶ X` is smooth, then `U` has a Zariski covering
by schemes obtained by base change from smooth schemes over `Y`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_smooth_zariskiCover_baseChange_of_isClosedImmersion
    {X Y U : Scheme.{u}} (i : X ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (p : U ⟶ X) [Smooth p] :
    ∃ (I : Type u) (V : I → Scheme.{u}) (q : ∀ j, V j ⟶ Y)
      (g : ∀ j, pullback (q j) i ⟶ U),
      (∀ j, Smooth (q j)) ∧
        (∀ j, g j ≫ p = pullback.snd (q j) i) ∧
          Presieve.ofArrows (fun j ↦ pullback (q j) i) g ∈ Scheme.zariskiPrecoverage U

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_syntomic_zariskiCover_baseChange_of_isClosedImmersion
declarations.doc:
If `X ⟶ Y` is a closed immersion and `U ⟶ X` is syntomic, then `U` has a Zariski
covering by schemes obtained by base change from syntomic schemes over `Y`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_syntomic_zariskiCover_baseChange_of_isClosedImmersion
    {X Y U : Scheme.{u}} (i : X ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (p : U ⟶ X) (hp : AlgebraicGeometry.Syntomic p) :
    ∃ (I : Type u) (V : I → Scheme.{u}) (q : ∀ j, V j ⟶ Y)
      (g : ∀ j, pullback (q j) i ⟶ U),
      (∀ j, AlgebraicGeometry.Syntomic (q j)) ∧
        (∀ j, g j ≫ p = pullback.snd (q j) i) ∧
          Presieve.ofArrows (fun j ↦ pullback (q j) i) g ∈ Scheme.zariskiPrecoverage U

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_syntomicCovering_subordinate_to_closedImmersion
declarations.doc:
A syntomic covering of a closed subscheme can be prepared by a syntomic covering of the
ambient scheme, with each base-changed member empty or subordinate to the original covering.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_syntomicCovering_subordinate_to_closedImmersion
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion f]
    {I : Type v} (U : I → Scheme.{u}) (p : ∀ i, U i ⟶ X)
    (hp : AlgebraicGeometry.IsSyntomicCovering U p) :
    ∃ (J : Type (max u v)) (V : J → Scheme.{u}) (q : ∀ j, V j ⟶ Y),
      AlgebraicGeometry.IsSyntomicCovering V q ∧
        ∀ j, (IsEmpty (pullback (q j) f : Scheme.{u}) ∨
          ∃ i, ∃ h : pullback (q j) f ⟶ U i,
            h ≫ p i = pullback.snd (q j) f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_smoothCovering_subordinate_to_closedImmersion
declarations.doc:
A smooth covering of a closed subscheme can be prepared by a smooth covering of the
ambient scheme, with each base-changed member empty or subordinate to the original covering.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_smoothCovering_subordinate_to_closedImmersion
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion f]
    {I : Type v} (U : I → Scheme.{u}) (p : ∀ i, U i ⟶ X)
    (hp : Presieve.ofArrows U p ∈ Scheme.precoverage (@Smooth.{u}) X) :
    ∃ (J : Type (max u v)) (V : J → Scheme.{u}) (q : ∀ j, V j ⟶ Y),
      Presieve.ofArrows V q ∈ Scheme.precoverage (@Smooth.{u}) Y ∧
        ∀ j, (IsEmpty (pullback (q j) f : Scheme.{u}) ∨
          ∃ i, ∃ h : pullback (q j) f ⟶ U i,
            h ≫ p i = pullback.snd (q j) f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_etaleCovering_subordinate_to_closedImmersion
declarations.doc:
An étale covering of a closed subscheme can be prepared by an étale covering of the
ambient scheme, with each base-changed member empty or subordinate to the original covering.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_etaleCovering_subordinate_to_closedImmersion
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion f]
    {I : Type v} (U : I → Scheme.{u}) (p : ∀ i, U i ⟶ X)
    (hp : Presieve.ofArrows U p ∈ Scheme.etalePrecoverage X) :
    ∃ (J : Type (max u v)) (V : J → Scheme.{u}) (q : ∀ j, V j ⟶ Y),
      Presieve.ofArrows V q ∈ Scheme.etalePrecoverage Y ∧
        ∀ j, (IsEmpty (pullback (q j) f : Scheme.{u}) ∨
          ∃ i, ∃ h : pullback (q j) f ⟶ U i,
            h ≫ p i = pullback.snd (q j) f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.fullyFaithfulSmallEtalePushforwardOfIsClosedImmersion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04E5, part (1).** For a closed immersion `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces over `S`,
the direct image of sheaves of sets along the morphism of small étale topoi of Stacks 03G2,
part (3) is fully faithful.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def fullyFaithfulSmallEtalePushforwardOfIsClosedImmersion (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : IsClosedImmersion B S hS f.hom) :
    (smallToposMorphismTypeU B S hS f).pushforward.FullyFaithful
declarations.comment: part (1): full faithfulness on sheaves of sets

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallEtalePullbackPushforwardCounitIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04E5, part (1).** For a closed immersion `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces over `S`
the inverse image of sheaves of sets is a *left inverse* of the direct image: the counit
`f^{-1}f_*G ⟶ G` of the adjunction of the morphism of small étale topoi of Stacks 03G2, part (3)
is an isomorphism for every sheaf `G` on the small étale site of `X`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def smallEtalePullbackPushforwardCounitIso (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : IsClosedImmersion B S hS f.hom) :
    (smallToposMorphismTypeU B S hS f).pushforward ⋙
        (smallToposMorphismTypeU B S hS f).inverseImage ≅
      𝟭 (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1) (Type u))
declarations.comment: part (1): inverse image is a left inverse

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.fullyFaithfulSmallEtaleAbelianPushforwardOfIsClosedImmersion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04E5, part (2), full faithfulness.** For a closed immersion `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic
spaces over `S`, the direct image of sheaves of *abelian groups* along `f` — restriction along
the chart base-change morphism of small étale sites of Stacks 03G2, part (4) — is fully faithful.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def fullyFaithfulSmallEtaleAbelianPushforwardOfIsClosedImmersion (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : IsClosedImmersion B S hS f.hom) :
    letI := (smallBaseChange_isMorphismOfSites B S hS f hf.rep).toIsContinuous
    ((smallBaseChange B S hS f hf.rep).sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{w}
      (SmallEtale.topology B S hS Y.1) (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1)).FullyFaithful
declarations.comment: part (2): full faithfulness on abelian sheaves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallEtaleAbelianPullbackPushforwardCounitIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04E5, part (2).** For a closed immersion `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces over `S`
the inverse image of sheaves of abelian groups is a *left inverse* of the direct image: the
counit of the adjunction of `CategoryTheory.Functor.sheafAdjunctionContinuous` for chart base
change is a natural isomorphism `f_* ⋙ f^{-1} ≅ 𝟭`. The abelian groups are taken at the
universe `u + 1`, at which the small étale site has sheafification.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def smallEtaleAbelianPullbackPushforwardCounitIso (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : IsClosedImmersion B S hS f.hom) :
    letI := (smallBaseChange_isMorphismOfSites B S hS f hf.rep).toIsContinuous
    letI : ((smallBaseChange B S hS f hf.rep).sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (SmallEtale.topology B S hS Y.1) (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1)).IsRightAdjoint :=
      (Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous _ _ _ _).isRightAdjoint
    (smallBaseChange B S hS f hf.rep).sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (SmallEtale.topology B S hS Y.1) (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1) ⋙
      (smallBaseChange B S hS f hf.rep).sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (SmallEtale.topology B S hS Y.1) (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1) ≅
      𝟭 (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
declarations.comment: part (2): inverse image is a left inverse

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallBaseChange_isCoverDense_of_isClosedImmersion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04E5, part (1).** Let `i : Z ⟶ X` be a closed immersion of algebraic spaces over a
scheme `S`. Base change along `i` of étale scheme charts of `X` is cover dense for the small
étale topology of `Z`: every étale chart of `Z` is covered by base changes along `i` of étale
charts of `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem smallBaseChange_isCoverDense_of_isClosedImmersion
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {Z X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (i : Z ⟶ X)
    (hi : IsClosedImmersion B S hS i.hom) :
    (smallBaseChange B S hS i hi.rep).IsCoverDense (SmallEtale.topology B S hS Z.1)
declarations.comment: part (1): cover density of chart base change

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallBaseChange_isLocallyFull_of_isClosedImmersion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04E5, part (1)**, local fullness. For a closed immersion `i : Z ⟶ X` of algebraic
spaces over a scheme `S`, base change along `i` of étale scheme charts is a locally full functor
from the small étale site of `X` to the small étale site of `Z`: a morphism over `Z` between the
base changes of two étale charts of `X` is, locally on the source, the base change of a morphism
of charts of `X`.

No covering family has to be produced: the chart of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_isIso_smallBaseChange_map_of_isClosedImmersion` already has
invertible base change, so the sieve it generates is the whole sieve.
declarations.statement:
theorem smallBaseChange_isLocallyFull_of_isClosedImmersion
    {Z X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (i : Z ⟶ X)
    (hi : IsClosedImmersion B S hS i.hom) :
    (smallBaseChange B S hS i hi.rep).IsLocallyFull (SmallEtale.topology B S hS Z.1)
declarations.comment: part (1), local fullness of base change on scheme charts

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallEtalePushforward_essImage_iff_of_isClosedImmersion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04E5, part (1), the essential image.** For a closed immersion `i : Z ⟶ X` of
algebraic spaces over `S`, a sheaf of sets on the small étale site of `X` lies in the essential
image of the direct image along `i` exactly when it has exactly one section over every étale
chart of `X` whose points avoid the point set of `Z`, that is exactly when its restriction to
`X ∖ Z` is a singleton.

The forward direction is Étale Cohomology 04FX away from `Z`,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.nonempty_isTerminal_smallEtaleDirectImage_obj_of_chartPreimage_eq_empty`.
The converse is Étale Cohomology 04CA: the unit of the adjunction is invertible on the fibre at
every geometric point of `X`, on the point set of `Z` by the triangle identity and Stacks 04K2,
part (4), and off it because both fibres are singletons; the geometric points are a conservative
family, and the unit of a fully faithful right adjoint is invertible exactly on its essential
image.
declarations.statement:
theorem smallEtalePushforward_essImage_iff_of_isClosedImmersion (i : Z ⟶ X)
    (hi : IsClosedImmersion B S hS i.hom)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1) (Type u)) :
    (smallToposMorphismTypeU B S hS i).pushforward.essImage F ↔
      ∀ V : SmallEtale B S hS X.1, chartPreimage B S hS i V = ∅ →
        Nonempty (IsTerminal (F.obj.obj (op V)))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallEtalePushforward_essImage_iff_abelian_of_isClosedImmersion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04E5, part (2), the essential image.** For a closed immersion `i : Z ⟶ X` of
algebraic spaces over `S`, an abelian sheaf on the small étale site of `X` lies in the essential
image of the direct image along `i` exactly when its support is contained in the point set
of `Z`.

Both directions are now unconditional: the forward one is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.supportOfSheaf_subset_of_essImage`, resting on Étale Cohomology 04FX
for algebraic spaces, and the converse is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_unit_app_of_supportOfSheaf_subset`, Étale Cohomology 04CA for
algebraic spaces, together with the characterization of the essential image of a fully faithful
right adjoint by invertibility of the unit.
declarations.statement:
theorem smallEtalePushforward_essImage_iff_abelian_of_isClosedImmersion (i : Z ⟶ X)
    (hi : IsClosedImmersion B S hS i.hom)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    (smallEtaleAbelianPushforward.{u + 1} B S hS i hi.rep).essImage F ↔
      supportOfSheaf B S hS X.1 F ⊆ Set.range (pointsMap B S hS Z.1 i.hom)

declarations.name: formally_unramified_local
declarations.doc:
Formally unramified is a local property: for a ring map `R → S`, being formally
unramified is equivalent to all the localized maps `R → S_𝔮` being formally
unramified, which in turn is equivalent to all the maps `R_𝔭 → S_𝔮` (with
`𝔭 = R ∩ 𝔮`) being formally unramified.
declarations.statement:
theorem formally_unramified_local
    (R S : Type*) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] :
    List.TFAE
      [ Algebra.FormallyUnramified R S,
        ∀ (𝔮 : Ideal S) [𝔮.IsPrime],
          Algebra.FormallyUnramified R (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮),
        ∀ (𝔮 : Ideal S) [𝔮.IsPrime],
          haveI : (𝔮.comap (algebraMap R S)).IsPrime := Ideal.IsPrime.comap _
          haveI : 𝔮.LiesOver (𝔮.comap (algebraMap R S)) := ⟨rfl⟩
          haveI : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime (𝔮.comap (algebraMap R S)))
              (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮) := Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver _ 𝔮
          Algebra.FormallyUnramified
            (Localization.AtPrime (𝔮.comap (algebraMap R S)))
            (Localization.AtPrime 𝔮) ]

declarations.name: Algebra.FormallyUnramified.exists_extension_ker_sq_eq_bot_and_existsUnique_lift
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04EB.** Let `R → S` be a formally unramified ring map. There is a surjection of
`R`-algebras `S' → S` whose kernel is an ideal of square zero and which is universal: for every
`R`-algebra `A`, every ideal `I ⊆ A` with `I ^ 2 = 0` and every `R`-algebra map `a : S → A/I`,
there is a unique `R`-algebra map `a' : S' → A` such that `S' → A → A/I` equals `S' → S → A/I`.
The surjection `S' → S` is `algebraMap P.Ring S` for the produced `Algebra.Extension P`.
declarations.statement:
theorem Algebra.FormallyUnramified.exists_extension_ker_sq_eq_bot_and_existsUnique_lift
    (R : Type u) (S : Type v) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [Algebra.FormallyUnramified R S] :
    ∃ P : Algebra.Extension.{max u v} R S, P.ker ^ 2 = ⊥ ∧
      ∀ ⦃A : Type w⦄ [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] (I : Ideal A), I ^ 2 = ⊥ →
        ∀ a : S →ₐ[R] A ⧸ I, ∃! a' : P.Ring →ₐ[R] A,
          (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I).comp a' = a.comp (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R P.Ring S)
declarations.comment:
The surjection of `R`-algebras `S' → S` is an `Algebra.Extension R S` (the
structure whose data is exactly a surjection onto `S` of `R`-algebras). The source's square is
encoded by `A` being an `R`-algebra — its `b : R → A` is `algebraMap R A` — and `a` being an
`R`-algebra map, so that commutativity of the square is `a`'s `R`-linearity. The test algebra
lives in a universe of its own; see the module docstring.

declarations.name: Algebra.FormallyUnramified.universalFirstOrderThickening
declarations.doc:
The **universal first order thickening** `S' → S` of `S` over a formally unramified base
`R`: the surjection of `R`-algebras onto `S` with square-zero kernel through which every
square-zero situation over `S` lifts uniquely, provided by Tag 04EB. It is determined up to
unique isomorphism by `Algebra.FormallyUnramified.isUniversalFirstOrderThickening`, which is all
that is ever used about it.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def universalFirstOrderThickening : Extension.{max u v} R S
declarations.comment:
Part (1). The surjection `S' → S` is an `Algebra.Extension R S`, the structure
whose data is exactly a surjection of `R`-algebras onto `S`; the surjection is
`algebraMap S'.Ring S`. Only determined up to unique isomorphism, so defined by choosing one of
the thickenings produced by Tag 04EB and used only through
`Algebra.FormallyUnramified.isUniversalFirstOrderThickening`. See the module docstring.

declarations.name: Algebra.FormallyUnramified.conormal
declarations.doc:
The **conormal module** `C_{S/R}` of a formally unramified ring map `R → S`: the kernel of
the universal first order thickening `S' → S`, as a module over `S`. Being an ideal of square
zero in `S'`, that kernel equals its own image in `S' / (ker) ^ 2`, which is where the `S`-action
lives.
declarations.statement: abbrev conormal : Type (max u v)
declarations.comment:
Part (2). The kernel of `algebraMap S'.Ring S` seen as an `S`-module is
`Algebra.Extension.Cotangent`, the quotient of the kernel by its square — equal to the kernel
because the square is zero, and the object on which `S` acts. See the module docstring.

declarations.name: UniversalThickening.isUniversalFirstOrderThickening_pi_and_nonempty_conormal_linearEquiv
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04ED.** Let `I ⊆ R` be an ideal. The universal first order thickening of `R/I` over
`R` is the surjection `π : R/I² → R/I`, and the conormal module `C_{(R/I)/R}` of `R/I` over `R`
is `I/I²`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isUniversalFirstOrderThickening_pi_and_nonempty_conormal_linearEquiv :
    (piExtension I).IsUniversalFirstOrderThickening ∧
      Nonempty (Algebra.FormallyUnramified.conormal R (R ⧸ I) ≃ₗ[R ⧸ I] I.Cotangent)
declarations.comment:
The surjection `R/I² → R/I` is packaged as an `Algebra.Extension R (R ⧸ I)`, and
being the universal first order thickening is `Algebra.Extension.IsUniversalFirstOrderThickening`
(Tag 04EC); the conormal module is `Algebra.FormallyUnramified.conormal`, and `I/I²` is
`Ideal.Cotangent I`, both as `R/I`-modules.

declarations.name: Algebra.Extension.IsUniversalFirstOrderThickening.localization
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04EE.** Let `A → B` be a ring map, let `φ : P.Ring → B` be a universal first order
thickening of `B` over `A`, let `M ⊆ A` and `N ⊆ B` be multiplicative subsets, and let `Aₘ` and
`Bₙ` be localizations of `A` at `M` and of `B` at `N`, compatibly. Then the localization
`φ⁻¹(N)⁻¹P.Ring → N⁻¹B` of `φ` is a universal first order thickening of `N⁻¹B` over `Aₘ`, and its
kernel is the extension of `ker φ`, so that the conormal module localizes:
`N⁻¹C_{B/A} = C_{N⁻¹B/Aₘ}`. Taking `N` to be the image of `M` gives the source's part (1), and
taking `M = ⊥`, so that `Aₘ = A`, gives its part (2).
declarations.statement:
theorem Algebra.Extension.IsUniversalFirstOrderThickening.localization {A : Type u} {B : Type v}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    {P : Extension.{w} A B} (hP : P.IsUniversalFirstOrderThickening)
    (M : Submonoid A) (N : Submonoid B)
    {Aₘ : Type*} [CommRing Aₘ] [Algebra A Aₘ] [IsLocalization M Aₘ]
    {Bₙ : Type*} [CommRing Bₙ] [Algebra B Bₙ] [IsLocalization N Bₙ]
    [Algebra A Bₙ] [IsScalarTower A B Bₙ] [Algebra Aₘ Bₙ] [IsScalarTower A Aₘ Bₙ]
    (Q : Extension.{w} Aₘ Bₙ) [Algebra P.Ring Q.Ring] [IsScalarTower A P.Ring Q.Ring]
    [IsLocalization (N.comap (algebraMap P.Ring B)) Q.Ring]
    (algebraMap_comp : (algebraMap Q.Ring Bₙ).comp (algebraMap P.Ring Q.Ring)
      = (algebraMap B Bₙ).comp (algebraMap P.Ring B)) :
    Q.IsUniversalFirstOrderThickening ∧ Q.ker = P.ker.map (algebraMap P.Ring Q.Ring)
declarations.comment:
Both parts at once: part (1) is `N = Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid B M`, part (2) is
`M = ⊥`, whose instance `IsLocalization (⊥ : Submonoid A) A` is not found by synthesis and is
supplied as `IsLocalization.of_le_isUnit bot_le`. The localized thickening is an arbitrary
`Q : Algebra.Extension Aₘ Bₙ` pinned by the `IsLocalization` and `IsScalarTower` hypotheses and
by `algebraMap_comp`, because Mathlib's `Algebra.Extension.localization` does not localize the
base. The `In particular` on conormal modules is the ideal equation,
`Algebra.idealMap_isLocalizedModule` supplying the rest. That `φ⁻¹(N)` is multiplicative is
`Submonoid.comap`. See the module docstring.

declarations.name: Algebra.Extension.IsUniversalFirstOrderThickening.formallyUnramified_ring_and_bijective_map
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04EF.** Let `R → A → B` be ring maps and let `B' → B` be the universal first order
thickening of `B` over `A`. Then `B'` is formally unramified over `A`, and the canonical map
`Ω_{A/R} ⊗_A B → Ω_{B'/R} ⊗_{B'} B`, which sends `b ⊗ D a` to `b ⊗ D (algebraMap A B' a)`, is
an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
public theorem formallyUnramified_ring_and_bijective_map (R : Type u) {A : Type v} {B : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra A B] [Algebra R B]
    [IsScalarTower R A B] {P : Extension.{w} A B} (hP : P.IsUniversalFirstOrderThickening) :
    FormallyUnramified A P.Ring ∧
      Function.Bijective
        ((((TensorProduct.mk P.Ring B Ω[P.Ring⁄R] 1).restrictScalars A).comp
          (KaehlerDifferential.map R R A P.Ring)).liftBaseChange B)
declarations.comment:
The thickening `B' → B` is an `Algebra.Extension A B` satisfying
`Algebra.Extension.IsUniversalFirstOrderThickening` (04EC); existence is 04EB. Tensor products
carry the scalars on the left, as in `KaehlerDifferential.mapBaseChange`, and the source's
canonical map is spelled as the `B`-linear extension of `ω ↦ 1 ⊗ₜ KaehlerDifferential.map ω`.
Formal unramifiedness of `A → B` is not assumed: it follows from `hP`. See the module docstring.

registrations.name: Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_isLocalization

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Functor.presheafStalk
declarations.doc:
The stalk `F_u = colim_{{(U, x)}ᵒᵖ} F(U)` of a presheaf `F` at an arbitrary functor
`u : C ⥤ Type w`: the colimit of `F(U)` over the opposite of the category of neighbourhoods
`(U, x)`, `x ∈ u(U)`, of `u`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def presheafStalk (F : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ A) [HasColimit ((CategoryOfElements.π u).op ⋙ F)] : A
declarations.comment:
The stalk `F_p = colim_{{(U, x)}^opp} F(U)` of a presheaf at an arbitrary
  functor `p = u : C → Sets`, with no conditions on `u`; the presheaf takes values in any
  category `A` in which this colimit exists (the case of presheaves of sets is
  `A := Type _`, see `presheafStalkEquivColimitType`).

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Functor.toPresheafStalk
declarations.doc: The canonical map `F(U) ⟶ F_u` attached to a neighbourhood `(U, x)` of `u`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def toPresheafStalk (U : C) (x : u.obj U) (F : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ A)
    [HasColimit ((CategoryOfElements.π u).op ⋙ F)] : F.obj (op U) ⟶ u.presheafStalk F
declarations.comment: The canonical map `F(U) → F_p` sending `s` to the class of `(U, x, s)`.

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Functor.toPresheafStalk_w
declarations.doc:
The canonical maps are compatible with morphisms of neighbourhoods: for
`α : (V, y) ⟶ (U, x)`, i.e. `α : V ⟶ U` with `u(α)(y) = x`, the class of `(U, x, s)` equals the
class of `(V, y, α^* s)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem toPresheafStalk_w {V U : C} (α : V ⟶ U) (y : u.obj V) (F : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ A)
    [HasColimit ((CategoryOfElements.π u).op ⋙ F)] :
    F.map α.op ≫ u.toPresheafStalk V y F = u.toPresheafStalk U (u.map α y) F
declarations.comment:
The relation `(U, x, s) ∼ (V, y, α^* s)` for a morphism of neighbourhoods
  `α : (V, y) → (U, x)`.

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Functor.presheafStalkFunctor
declarations.doc: The stalk functor `PSh(C, A) ⥤ A`, `F ↦ F_u`, at an arbitrary functor `u : C ⥤ Type w`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def presheafStalkFunctor [HasColimitsOfShape u.Elementsᵒᵖ A] :
    (Cᵒᵖ ⥤ A) ⥤ A
declarations.comment:
The stalk functor `PSh(C) → Sets`, `F ↦ F_p`, here for presheaves with values
  in a category `A` with colimits of shape `u.Elementsᵒᵖ`.

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Functor.presheafStalkEquivColimitType
declarations.doc:
For a presheaf of sets, an element of the stalk `F_u` is the class of a triple `(U, x, s)`
with `(U, x)` a neighbourhood of `u` and `s ∈ F(U)`, for the equivalence relation generated by
`(U, x, s) ∼ (V, y, α^* s)`: the quotient `Functor.ColimitType` of the diagram
`(CategoryOfElements.π u).op ⋙ F`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def presheafStalkEquivColimitType :
    u.presheafStalk F ≃ ((CategoryOfElements.π u).op ⋙ F).ColimitType
declarations.comment:
Description of the stalk of a presheaf of sets: elements are triples
  `(U, x, s)` modulo the equivalence relation generated by `(U, x, s) ∼ (V, y, α^* s)`.

declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04EI.** The presheaf `u^p E` attached to a functor `u : C ⥤ Type` and a type `E`:

precomposition with `u f`.
declarations.statement:
def pushforwardPresheaf04EI {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] (u : Functor C (Type v)) (E : Type v) :

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.Point.exists_equivalence_isMorphismOfSites_pushforward_iso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04EL.** Let `Φ` be a point of a locally `w`-small site `(C, J)`, with fibre functor
`u = Φ.fiber`. Let `ι : S ⥤ Type w` be a full subcategory of the category of sets in which some
object `pt` is a singleton, let `K` be the topology on `S` whose covering sieves are the jointly
surjective ones, and suppose the fibre functor factors as `u ⋙ ι` for some `u : C ⥤ S`. Then

1. there is an equivalence `i : Sh(pt) → Sh(S, K)` whose inverse image is `F ↦ F(pt)`, hence
   whose forward functor sends a set `E` to the sheaf `V ↦ Mor(ι V, E)`;
2. `u : C ⥤ S` defines a morphism of sites `f : (S, K) → (C, J)`; and
3. the composition `Sh(pt) → Sh(S, K) → Sh(C, J)` is the morphism of topoi `(p_*, p⁻¹)` of the
   point, in the sense that `i_* ⋙ f_*` is isomorphic to the skyscraper sheaf functor `p_*`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_equivalence_isMorphismOfSites_pushforward_iso {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C]
    {J : GrothendieckTopology C} [LocallySmall.{w} C] (Φ : Point.{w} J) {S : Type w}
    [SmallCategory S] (ι : S ⥤ Type w) [ι.Full] [ι.Faithful] (pt : S) (hpt : Unique (ι.obj pt))
    (K : GrothendieckTopology S)
    (hK :
      ∀ (V : S) (R : Sieve V),
        R ∈ K V ↔ ∀ x : ι.obj V, ∃ (W : S) (f : W ⟶ V) (y : ι.obj W), R.arrows f ∧ ι.map f y = x)
    (u : C ⥤ S) (hu : u ⋙ ι ≅ Φ.fiber) :
    ∃ (e : Type w ≌ Sheaf K (Type w)) (_ : _root_.IsMorphismOfSites.{w} u J K),
      e.inverse = sheafToPresheaf K (Type w) ⋙ (evaluation Sᵒᵖ (Type w)).obj (Opposite.op pt) ∧
        Nonempty
          (e.functor ⋙ u.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type w) J K ≅
            Φ.skyscraperSheafFunctor (A := Type w))
