declarations.name: Stacks.isIso_moduleFiberSheafificationComparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04EQ, part (3).** Sheafification of a presheaf of modules does not
change its module-valued stalk.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_moduleFiberSheafificationComparison :
    IsIso (moduleFiberSheafificationComparison Φ R)

declarations.name: Stacks.Sheaves.LocallyRingedSite.condition1_iff_condition2_and_condition2_iff_condition3
declarations.doc:
**Theorem (Stacks Tag 04ES).** For a ringed site `(C, O)`, conditions (1), (2),
(3) are equivalent. We state the equivalence as the conjunction of the two
biconditionals `(1) ↔ (2)` and `(2) ↔ (3)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem condition1_iff_condition2_and_condition2_iff_condition3
    (O : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{v}) :
    (Condition1 O ↔ Condition2 O) ∧ (Condition2 O ↔ Condition3 O)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.stalksAreZeroOrLocal_of_locallyUnitOrOneSubUnit
declarations.doc:
The local unit-or-unit-complement condition makes every stalk of the structure sheaf either
the zero ring or a local ring.
declarations.statement:
theorem stalksAreZeroOrLocal_of_locallyUnitOrOneSubUnit (X : RingedSite.{u, u, u})
    (h : LocallyUnitOrOneSubUnit X) : StalksAreZeroOrLocal X

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.locallyUnitOrOneSubUnit_iff_stalksAreZeroOrLocal
declarations.doc:
On a site with a conservative family of points, the local unit-or-unit-complement condition
is equivalent to all stalks of the structure sheaf being zero rings or local rings.
declarations.statement:
theorem locallyUnitOrOneSubUnit_iff_stalksAreZeroOrLocal (X : RingedSite.{u, u, u})
    (hX : X.J.HasConservativeFamily.{u}) :
    LocallyUnitOrOneSubUnit X ↔ StalksAreZeroOrLocal X
declarations.comment: equivalence when the site has enough points

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.IsLocallyRinged
declarations.doc:
A ringed site is locally ringed when the sections `0` and `1` of its structure sheaf are
nowhere equal and every section is locally either a unit or has unit complement.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsLocallyRinged (X : RingedSite.{u, v, w}) : Prop

declarations.name: Stacks.Sheaves.LocallyRingedSite.isLocallyRingedSite_iff
declarations.doc:
Definition 18.40.4 in the source's own spelling (the morphism of Tag 05D7 is an isomorphism,
and the equivalent conditions of Tag 04ES hold) is equivalent to the sections-level predicate
`IsLocallyRingedSite`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyRingedSite_iff :
    IsIso (oneIsNeverZero X.J X.O) ∧ Stacks.Sheaves.LocallyRingedSite.Condition1 X.O ↔
      LocalizedRingedTopos.IsLocallyRingedSite X
declarations.comment: Definition 18.40.4 in the source's spelling (05D7 an isomorphism, plus 04ES)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.unramified_iff_gUnramified
declarations.doc:
Over a locally Noetherian target, a morphism of schemes is unramified if and only if it is
G-unramified.
declarations.statement:
theorem unramified_iff_gUnramified {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsLocallyNoetherian S] :
    Unramified f ↔ GUnramified f

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.IsThickening
declarations.doc:
A **thickening** is a closed immersion `i : X ⟶ X'` whose underlying map of topological
spaces is surjective, so that the closed subscheme `X` and the ambient scheme `X'` have the
same underlying topological space.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsThickening {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (i : X ⟶ X') : Prop

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.IsFirstOrderThickening
declarations.doc:
A **first-order thickening** is a closed immersion whose kernel ideal sheaf is
square-zero.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsFirstOrderThickening {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (i : X ⟶ X') : Prop

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.IsFiniteOrderThickening
declarations.doc:
A **finite-order thickening** is a closed immersion whose kernel ideal sheaf is
nilpotent.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsFiniteOrderThickening {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (i : X ⟶ X') : Prop

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.IsNthOrderThickening
declarations.doc:
An **`n`th-order thickening** is a closed immersion whose kernel ideal sheaf has vanishing
`(n+1)`st power.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsNthOrderThickening {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (n : ℕ) (i : X ⟶ X') : Prop

registrations.name: CategoryTheory.Arrow.Hom
registrations.comment: parts (5) and (6): morphisms of thickenings, also over a base

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.nthOrderInfinitesimalNeighbourhood
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04EY, part (2).** The `n`th-order infinitesimal neighbourhood of `Z`
in `X` for an immersion `i : Z ⟶ X`: the closed subscheme of the canonical open neighbourhood
`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.coborderRange` of the image of `i` cut out by the `(n+1)`st power
of the defining ideal sheaf of `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.liftCoborder`.
declarations.statement: def nthOrderInfinitesimalNeighbourhood (n : ℕ) : Scheme.{u}

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.firstOrderInfinitesimalNeighbourhood
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04EY, part (1).** The first-order infinitesimal neighbourhood of `Z`
in `X`, cut out by the square of the defining ideal sheaf of the immersion.
declarations.statement: abbrev firstOrderInfinitesimalNeighbourhood : Scheme.{u}

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.nthOrderInclusion
declarations.doc: The inclusion of `Z` into its `n`th-order infinitesimal neighbourhood.
declarations.statement: def nthOrderInclusion (n : ℕ) : Z ⟶ nthOrderInfinitesimalNeighbourhood i n
declarations.comment: part (2): inclusion into the nth-order neighbourhood

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.nthOrderToBase
declarations.doc:
The structure morphism from the `n`th-order infinitesimal neighbourhood of `Z` in `X`
to `X`.
declarations.statement: def nthOrderToBase (n : ℕ) : nthOrderInfinitesimalNeighbourhood i n ⟶ X
declarations.comment: part (2): map from the nth-order neighbourhood to the base

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.nthOrderInclusion_toBase
declarations.doc:
The inclusion of `Z` into its `n`th-order infinitesimal neighbourhood, followed by the
structure morphism to `X`, is the original immersion.
declarations.statement:
theorem nthOrderInclusion_toBase (n : ℕ) :
    nthOrderInclusion i n ≫ nthOrderToBase i n = i

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.nthOrderInclusion_isNthOrderThickening
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04EY, part (2).** The inclusion of `Z` into its `n`th-order
infinitesimal neighbourhood is an `n`th-order thickening: it is a closed immersion whose
defining ideal sheaf has vanishing `(n+1)`st power.

Affine-locally on the open neighbourhood `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.coborderRange`, the
`(n+1)`st power of the ideal sheaf of `i.liftCoborder` is the kernel of the surjection onto the
sections of the neighbourhood, so the `(n+1)`st power of its image vanishes.
declarations.statement:
theorem nthOrderInclusion_isNthOrderThickening (n : ℕ) :
    IsNthOrderThickening n (nthOrderInclusion i n)

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.nthOrderInclusion_isFirstOrderThickening
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04EY, part (1).** The inclusion of `Z` into its first-order
infinitesimal neighbourhood is a first-order thickening.
declarations.statement:
theorem nthOrderInclusion_isFirstOrderThickening :
    IsFirstOrderThickening (nthOrderInclusion i 1)

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.existsUnique_nthOrderLift
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04EZ, part (2).** The universal property of the `n`th-order
infinitesimal neighbourhood: given an `n`th-order thickening `j : T ⟶ T'`, a morphism
`a : T ⟶ Z` and a morphism `b : T' ⟶ X` making the square commute, there is a unique morphism
`T' ⟶ Z_n` extending `a` and lying over `b`.

Since `j` is surjective on points, `b` lands in the open subscheme
`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.coborderRange` and so factors as `f ≫ i.coborderRange.ι`. The
square then reads `j ≫ f = a ≫ i.liftCoborder`, so
`Stacks.Thickenings.ker_pow_le_ker_of_comm_square` gives `i.liftCoborder.ker ^ (n + 1) ≤ f.ker`
and `f` factors through the closed subscheme cut out by `i.liftCoborder.ker ^ (n + 1)`, which is
`Z_n`. Uniqueness is monomorphicity of the two immersions.

The source's hypothesis `1 ≤ n` is retained for faithfulness but is not needed: the argument is
uniform in `n`, and at `n = 0` both sides degenerate to `Z` itself.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_nthOrderLift {T T' : Scheme.{u}}
    (n : ℕ) (_hn : 1 ≤ n) (j : T ⟶ T') (hj : IsNthOrderThickening n j)
    (a : T ⟶ Z) (b : T' ⟶ X) (h : j ≫ b = a ≫ i) :
    ∃! a' : T' ⟶ nthOrderInfinitesimalNeighbourhood i n,
      (j ≫ a' = a ≫ nthOrderInclusion i n) ∧ (a' ≫ nthOrderToBase i n = b)

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.existsUnique_firstOrderLift
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04EZ, part (1).** The universal property of the first-order
infinitesimal neighbourhood, the case `n = 1` of
`Stacks.Thickenings.existsUnique_nthOrderLift`.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_firstOrderLift {T T' : Scheme.{u}}
    (j : T ⟶ T') (hj : IsFirstOrderThickening j)
    (a : T ⟶ Z) (b : T' ⟶ X) (h : j ≫ b = a ≫ i) :
    ∃! a' : T' ⟶ firstOrderInfinitesimalNeighbourhood i,
      (j ≫ a' = a ≫ nthOrderInclusion i 1) ∧ (a' ≫ nthOrderToBase i 1 = b)

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.isIso_conormalTransitivityMap_nthOrderInclusion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04F0.** For an immersion `i : Z ⟶ X` with first-order infinitesimal
neighbourhood `Z ⊂ Z'` of [Stacks Project, Tag 04EY], the canonical map of conormal sheaves
`𝒞_{Z/X} ⟶ 𝒞_{Z/Z'}` of [Stacks Project, Tag 01R4] is an isomorphism.

The map is `Stacks.ConormalSequenceTwoImmersions.conormalTransitivityMap` for the factorization
`Z ⟶ Z' ⟶ X` of `i`, which is the map of [Stacks Project, Tag 01R4] for the square with
horizontal arrows `Z ⟶ Z'` and `Z ⟶ X` and vertical arrows the identity of `Z` and `Z' ⟶ X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_conormalTransitivityMap_nthOrderInclusion :
    IsIso (Stacks.ConormalSequenceTwoImmersions.conormalTransitivityMap
      (nthOrderInclusion i 1) i (nthOrderToBase i 1) (nthOrderInclusion_toBase i 1))

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.nonempty_universalFirstOrderThickening
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04F3.** A formally unramified morphism of schemes admits a universal
first-order thickening. It is constructed by gluing the thickenings of the charts of an affine
open cover of `Z` subordinate to an affine open cover of `X`; the affine charts come from the
algebraic universal first-order thickening
(`Algebra.FormallyUnramified.universalFirstOrderThickening`, Tag 04EB).
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_universalFirstOrderThickening {Z X : Scheme.{u}} (h : Z ⟶ X)
    [FormallyUnramified h] : Nonempty (UniversalFirstOrderThickening h)

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.universalFirstOrderThickening
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04F3.** *The* universal first-order thickening of a formally
unramified morphism `h : Z ⟶ X`, chosen by
`Stacks.Thickenings.nonempty_universalFirstOrderThickening`.

The universal property is part of the data, as the field
`Stacks.Thickenings.UniversalFirstOrderThickening.isUniversal`; it is spelled out in
`Stacks.Thickenings.universalFirstOrderThickening_isUniversal` and its consequences below.
Nothing beyond that property should be used: by
`Stacks.Thickenings.UniversalFirstOrderThickening.canonicalIso` the choice is unique up to
unique isomorphism, which is why the ambient scheme is left opaque here rather than exposed as
the glued scheme.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def universalFirstOrderThickening {Z X : Scheme.{u}} (h : Z ⟶ X)
    [FormallyUnramified h] : UniversalFirstOrderThickening h

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.universalConormalSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04F4, part (2).** The conormal sheaf `𝒞_{Z/X}` of a formally
unramified morphism `h : Z ⟶ X`: the conormal sheaf, in the sense of
`Stacks.Thickenings.immersionConormalSheaf` ([Stacks Project, Tag 01R2]), of the inclusion of
`Z` into the universal first-order thickening of `Z` over `X` chosen by
`Stacks.Thickenings.universalFirstOrderThickening`.

The inclusion is a closed immersion, hence an immersion, by
`Stacks.Thickenings.UniversalFirstOrderThickening.isClosedImmersion_inclusion`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev universalConormalSheaf {Z X : Scheme.{u}} (h : Z ⟶ X)
    [FormallyUnramified h] :
    SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing Z.toLocallyRingedSpace.toRingedSpace)

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.universalThickeningIsoFirstOrderNeighbourhood
declarations.doc:
The ambient scheme of the universal first-order thickening of an immersion `i : Z ⟶ X` chosen
by `Stacks.Thickenings.universalFirstOrderThickening` is isomorphic to the first-order
infinitesimal neighbourhood of `Z` in `X` of [Stacks Project, Tag 04EY].

The isomorphism is the canonical one between two universal first-order thickenings of the same
morphism, `Stacks.Thickenings.UniversalFirstOrderThickening.canonicalIso`. It is the unique
isomorphism of thickenings of `Z` over `X`, by
`Stacks.Thickenings.UniversalFirstOrderThickening.existsUnique_canonicalMap`.
declarations.statement:
def universalThickeningIsoFirstOrderNeighbourhood :
    (universalFirstOrderThickening i).ambient ≅ firstOrderInfinitesimalNeighbourhood i
declarations.comment:
part (2): the chosen universal first-order thickening is the first-order
  infinitesimal neighbourhood

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.immersionConormalSheafIsoUniversalConormalSheaf
declarations.doc:
For an immersion `i : Z ⟶ X`, the conormal sheaf of `i` in the sense of
[Stacks Project, Tag 01R2], `Stacks.Thickenings.immersionConormalSheaf i`, agrees with the
conormal sheaf of `i` in the sense of [Stacks Project, Tag 04F4],
`Stacks.Thickenings.universalConormalSheaf i`, built from the universal first-order thickening
chosen by `Stacks.Thickenings.universalFirstOrderThickening`.

It is the composite of the comparison `Stacks.Thickenings.infinitesimalConormalTransitivityMap`
of [Stacks Project, Tag 04F0], `Stacks.Immersion.conormalSheafSelfIso` for the inclusion
`Z ⟶ Z₁`, and `Stacks.Thickenings.universalConormalSheafIsoFirstOrderNeighbourhood`.
declarations.statement:
def immersionConormalSheafIsoUniversalConormalSheaf :
    immersionConormalSheaf i ≅ universalConormalSheaf i
declarations.comment: part (3): the two conormal sheaves agree

registrations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.formallyUnramified_of_isImmersion
registrations.comment: part (1): an immersion of schemes is formally unramified

registrations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.isUniversalFirstOrderThickening_nthOrderInclusion_one
registrations.comment:
part (2): the first-order infinitesimal neighbourhood has the universal
  property of a first-order thickening over the base

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.UniversalFirstOrderThickening.formallyUnramified_toBase
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04F6.** The ambient scheme of a universal first-order thickening of a
formally unramified morphism `h : Z ⟶ X` is formally unramified over `X`.

The thickening produced by the gluing construction of [Stacks Project, Tag 04F3] has this
property, by
`Stacks.Thickenings.exists_universalFirstOrderThickening_formallyUnramified_toBase`, and any
other universal first-order thickening of `h` is isomorphic to it over `X` by
`Stacks.Thickenings.UniversalFirstOrderThickening.canonicalIso`.

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.UniversalFirstOrderThickening.existsUnique_map
declarations.doc:
There is a unique morphism between the ambient schemes of two universal first-order
thickenings which restricts to `f` on the closed subschemes and is compatible with the
structure morphisms over `g`. This is the unique-existence statement behind the canonical
morphism of Tag 04F7, obtained by applying the universal property of `tW` to the first-order
thickening `tZ.inclusion`.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_map (tZ : UniversalFirstOrderThickening h)
    (tW : UniversalFirstOrderThickening h')
    (f : Z ⟶ W) (g : X ⟶ Y) (comm : h ≫ g = f ≫ h') :
    ∃! k : tZ.ambient ⟶ tW.ambient,
      (tZ.inclusion ≫ k = f ≫ tW.inclusion) ∧ (k ≫ tW.toBase = tZ.toBase ≫ g)
declarations.comment: unique existence of the canonical morphism of thickenings

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.universalFirstOrderThickeningMap
declarations.doc:
The canonical morphism between the ambient schemes of two universal first-order thickenings
associated to a commutative square. It is selected by the unique lifting property of the target
thickening.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def universalFirstOrderThickeningMap
    (tZ : UniversalFirstOrderThickening h) (tW : UniversalFirstOrderThickening h')
    (f : Z ⟶ W) (g : X ⟶ Y) (comm : h ≫ g = f ≫ h') :
    tZ.ambient ⟶ tW.ambient

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.universalFirstOrderThickeningMap_inclusion
declarations.doc: The canonical morphism restricts to `f` on the closed subscheme.
declarations.statement:
theorem universalFirstOrderThickeningMap_inclusion
    (tZ : UniversalFirstOrderThickening h) (tW : UniversalFirstOrderThickening h')
    (f : Z ⟶ W) (g : X ⟶ Y) (comm : h ≫ g = f ≫ h') :
    tZ.inclusion ≫ universalFirstOrderThickeningMap tZ tW f g comm = f ≫ tW.inclusion

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.universalFirstOrderThickeningMap_toBase
declarations.doc: The canonical morphism is a morphism over `Y`.
declarations.statement:
theorem universalFirstOrderThickeningMap_toBase
    (tZ : UniversalFirstOrderThickening h) (tW : UniversalFirstOrderThickening h')
    (f : Z ⟶ W) (g : X ⟶ Y) (comm : h ≫ g = f ≫ h') :
    universalFirstOrderThickeningMap tZ tW f g comm ≫ tW.toBase = tZ.toBase ≫ g

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.universalFirstOrderThickeningMap_unique
declarations.doc:
The canonical morphism is the unique extension of `f` over `Y`: any morphism of the ambient
schemes restricting to `f` and compatible with the structure morphisms over `g` equals it.
declarations.statement:
theorem universalFirstOrderThickeningMap_unique
    (tZ : UniversalFirstOrderThickening h) (tW : UniversalFirstOrderThickening h')
    (f : Z ⟶ W) (g : X ⟶ Y) (comm : h ≫ g = f ≫ h')
    (k : tZ.ambient ⟶ tW.ambient)
    (hk₁ : tZ.inclusion ≫ k = f ≫ tW.inclusion)
    (hk₂ : k ≫ tW.toBase = tZ.toBase ≫ g) :
    k = universalFirstOrderThickeningMap tZ tW f g comm

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.isInducedConormalSheafMap_universalImmersionConormalSheafMap
declarations.doc:
**The affine characterization of the induced morphism of conormal sheaves.** Let
`h : Z ⟶ X` and `h' : W ⟶ Y` be formally unramified, let `Z ⊂ Z'` and `W ⊂ W'` be universal
first-order thickenings of `h` and of `h'`, and let `h ≫ g = f ≫ h'` be a commutative square. The
morphism of conormal sheaves `f^* 𝒞_{W/Y} ⟶ 𝒞_{Z/X}` induced by the canonical morphism `(f, f')`
of thickenings is *the* map of [Stacks Project, Tag 01R4] for the square `(Z ⊂ Z') → (W ⊂ W')`:
on a compatible pair of affine opens `V ⊆ W'` and `U ⊆ Z'` cut out by ideals `J` and `I`, it
carries the class of `a : J` in `J/J²` to the class in `I/I²` of the image of `a` under the ring
map of `f'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isInducedConormalSheafMap_universalImmersionConormalSheafMap
    (tZ : UniversalFirstOrderThickening h) (tW : UniversalFirstOrderThickening h')
    (f : Z ⟶ W) (g : X ⟶ Y) (comm : h ≫ g = f ≫ h') :
    IsInducedConormalSheafMap tZ.inclusion tW.inclusion f
      (universalFirstOrderThickeningMap tZ tW f g comm)
      (universalFirstOrderThickeningMap_inclusion tZ tW f g comm)
      (universalImmersionConormalSheafMap tZ tW f g comm)
declarations.comment: affine characterization of the induced conormal-sheaf morphism

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.existsUnique_universalFirstOrderThickening_map
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04F7, the canonical morphism of thickenings.** Let
`h : Z ⟶ X` and `h' : W ⟶ Y` be formally unramified and let `h ≫ g = f ≫ h'` be a commutative
square. Writing `Z ⊂ Z'` and `W ⊂ W'` for the universal first-order thickenings of `h` over `X`
and of `h'` over `Y` ([Stacks Project, Tag 04F3], chosen by
`Stacks.Thickenings.universalFirstOrderThickening`), there is exactly one morphism
`f' : Z' ⟶ W'` with `f'|_Z = f` and which is a morphism over `Y`, i.e. exactly one morphism of
thickenings `(f, f') : (Z, Z') ⟶ (W, W')` over `Y` making the diagram of the tag commute. It is
`Stacks.Thickenings.universalFirstOrderThickeningMap`.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_universalFirstOrderThickening_map [FormallyUnramified h]
    [FormallyUnramified h'] (f : Z ⟶ W) (g : X ⟶ Y) (comm : h ≫ g = f ≫ h') :
    ∃! f' : (universalFirstOrderThickening h).ambient ⟶
        (universalFirstOrderThickening h').ambient,
      ((universalFirstOrderThickening h).inclusion ≫ f' =
          f ≫ (universalFirstOrderThickening h').inclusion) ∧
        (f' ≫ (universalFirstOrderThickening h').toBase =
          (universalFirstOrderThickening h).toBase ≫ g)
declarations.comment: the canonical morphism of thickenings, for formally unramified morphisms

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.universalConormalSheafPullbackMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04F7, the induced morphism of conormal sheaves.** Let `h : Z ⟶ X` and
`h' : W ⟶ Y` be formally unramified and let `h ≫ g = f ≫ h'` be a commutative square. The
canonical morphism of universal first-order thickenings `(f, f') : (Z, Z') ⟶ (W, W')` over `Y`
of `Stacks.Thickenings.existsUnique_universalFirstOrderThickening_map` induces the morphism of
sheaves of `𝒪_Z`-modules

`f^* 𝒞_{W/Y} ⟶ 𝒞_{Z/X}`

between the conormal sheaves `Stacks.Thickenings.universalConormalSheaf` of
[Stacks Project, Tag 04F4]. It is the map of [Stacks Project, Tag 01R4] for the square of
immersions `(Z ⊂ Z') ⟶ (W ⊂ W')`, namely `Stacks.Immersion.immersionConormalSheafMap`; its
affine characterization is
`Stacks.Thickenings.isInducedConormalSheafMap_universalConormalSheafPullbackMap`.
declarations.statement:
def universalConormalSheafPullbackMap [FormallyUnramified h] [FormallyUnramified h']
    (f : Z ⟶ W) (g : X ⟶ Y) (comm : h ≫ g = f ≫ h') :
    (modulePullback f.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj (universalConormalSheaf h') ⟶
      universalConormalSheaf h
declarations.comment: the induced morphism of conormal sheaves `f^* 𝒞_{W/Y} ⟶ 𝒞_{Z/X}`

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.isInducedConormalSheafMap_universalConormalSheafPullbackMap
declarations.doc:
**The morphism of conormal sheaves of [Stacks Project, Tag 04F7] is the one induced by
`(f, f')`.** For formally unramified `h` and `h'` and a commutative square `h ≫ g = f ≫ h'`, the
morphism `f^* 𝒞_{W/Y} ⟶ 𝒞_{Z/X}` of
`Stacks.Thickenings.universalConormalSheafPullbackMap` is the map of [Stacks Project, Tag 01R4]
for the morphism of thickenings `(f, f') : (Z ⊂ Z') ⟶ (W ⊂ W')`: on a compatible pair of affine
opens `V ⊆ W'` and `U ⊆ f'⁻¹V` cut out by ideals `J` and `I`, it carries the class of `a : J` in
`J/J²` to the class in `I/I²` of the image of `a` under the ring map of `f'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isInducedConormalSheafMap_universalConormalSheafPullbackMap [FormallyUnramified h]
    [FormallyUnramified h'] (f : Z ⟶ W) (g : X ⟶ Y) (comm : h ≫ g = f ≫ h') :
    IsInducedConormalSheafMap (universalFirstOrderThickening h).inclusion
      (universalFirstOrderThickening h').inclusion f
      (universalFirstOrderThickeningMap (universalFirstOrderThickening h)
        (universalFirstOrderThickening h') f g comm)
      (universalFirstOrderThickeningMap_inclusion (universalFirstOrderThickening h)
        (universalFirstOrderThickening h') f g comm)
      (universalConormalSheafPullbackMap f g comm)
declarations.comment: the conormal-sheaf morphism is the one induced by the morphism of thickenings

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.formallyUnramified_of_isPullback
declarations.doc:
In a cartesian square of schemes, the base change of a formally unramified morphism is
formally unramified.
declarations.statement:
theorem formallyUnramified_of_isPullback (sq : IsPullback h f g h')
    [FormallyUnramified h'] : FormallyUnramified h
declarations.comment: part (1): the base change of a formally unramified morphism

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.isUniversal_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**The fibre product `X ×_Y W'` is a universal first-order thickening of `Z = X ×_Y W` over
`X`.**
declarations.statement:
theorem isUniversal_baseChange (sq : IsPullback h f g h')
    (t : UniversalFirstOrderThickening h') :
    IsUniversalFirstOrderThickening h (baseChangeInclusion sq t) (baseChangeToBase g t)
declarations.comment: part (2): X ×_Y W' is the universal first-order thickening of Z over X

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.epi_immersionConormalSheafMap_of_isPullback
declarations.doc:
For a cartesian square of schemes, with no flatness hypothesis on `g`, the canonical map of
conormal sheaves `f^* 𝒞_{W/Y} ⟶ 𝒞_{Z/X}` of [Stacks Project, Tag 01R4] between the inclusions of
universal first-order thickenings is surjective.
declarations.statement:
theorem epi_immersionConormalSheafMap_of_isPullback (sq : IsPullback h f g h')
    (t : UniversalFirstOrderThickening h') :
    Epi (Stacks.Immersion.immersionConormalSheafMap tZ.inclusion t.inclusion f
      (universalFirstOrderThickeningMap tZ t f g sq.w)
      (Stacks.Immersion.toShHom_square
        (universalFirstOrderThickeningMap_inclusion tZ t f g sq.w)))
declarations.comment: part (3): the canonical map f^* 𝒞_{W/Y} ⟶ 𝒞_{Z/X} is surjective

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.epi_universalConormalSheafMap_of_isPullback
declarations.doc:
For a cartesian square of schemes, the morphism of conormal sheaves
`Stacks.Thickenings.universalConormalSheafMap` of [Stacks Project, Tag 04F7], induced by the
canonical morphism of universal first-order thickenings, is surjective.
declarations.statement:
theorem epi_universalConormalSheafMap_of_isPullback (sq : IsPullback h f g h')
    (t : UniversalFirstOrderThickening h') :
    Epi (universalConormalSheafMap tZ t f g sq.w)
declarations.comment: part (3): the canonical map of conormal sheaves of Tag 04F7 is surjective

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.flat_universalFirstOrderThickeningMap
declarations.doc:
Let
```
Z --h--→ X
|        |
f        g
↓        ↓
W --h'-→ Y
```
be a cartesian square of schemes with `g` flat, let `Z ⊂ Z'` be a universal first-order
thickening of `h` over `X` and `W ⊂ W'` one of `h'` over `Y`. Then the canonical morphism
`Z' ⟶ W'` of [Stacks Project, Tag 04F7] is flat.
declarations.statement:
theorem flat_universalFirstOrderThickeningMap (sq : IsPullback h f g h')
    (t : UniversalFirstOrderThickening h') [Flat g] :
    Flat (universalFirstOrderThickeningMap tZ t f g sq.w)
declarations.comment: the morphism Z' ⟶ W' of universal first-order thickenings is flat

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.isIso_immersionConormalSheafMap_of_isPullback_of_flat
declarations.doc:
For a cartesian square of schemes with `g` flat, the canonical map of conormal sheaves
`f^* 𝒞_{W/Y} ⟶ 𝒞_{Z/X}` of [Stacks Project, Tag 01R4] between the inclusions of the two
universal first-order thickenings is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_immersionConormalSheafMap_of_isPullback_of_flat (sq : IsPullback h f g h')
    (t : UniversalFirstOrderThickening h') [Flat g] :
    IsIso (Stacks.Immersion.immersionConormalSheafMap tZ.inclusion t.inclusion f
      (universalFirstOrderThickeningMap tZ t f g sq.w)
      (Stacks.Immersion.toShHom_square
        (universalFirstOrderThickeningMap_inclusion tZ t f g sq.w)))
declarations.comment: the induced map f^* 𝒞_{W/Y} ⟶ 𝒞_{Z/X} of conormal sheaves is an isomorphism

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.isIso_universalConormalSheafMap_of_isPullback_of_flat
declarations.doc:
For a cartesian square of schemes with `g` flat, the morphism of conormal sheaves
`Stacks.Thickenings.universalConormalSheafMap` of [Stacks Project, Tag 04F7], induced by the
canonical morphism of universal first-order thickenings, is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_universalConormalSheafMap_of_isPullback_of_flat (sq : IsPullback h f g h')
    (t : UniversalFirstOrderThickening h') [Flat g] :
    IsIso (universalConormalSheafMap tZ t f g sq.w)
declarations.comment: the induced map of conormal sheaves of Tag 04F7 is an isomorphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.universalConormalSheafRestrictIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04FA, the restriction of the conormal sheaf, as an isomorphism.** For opens `U` of
the source and `V` of the target of a formally unramified morphism `f : X ⟶ S` with
`f (U) ⊆ V`, the restriction to `U` of the conormal sheaf of `f` is the conormal sheaf of the
restriction of `f` to a morphism `U ⟶ V`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def universalConormalSheafRestrictIso {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [FormallyUnramified f] {V : S.Opens} {U : X.Opens} (hUV : U ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    [FormallyUnramified (f.resLE V U hUV)] :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj (universalConormalSheaf f) ≅
      universalConormalSheaf (f.resLE V U hUV)
declarations.comment:
restriction of the conormal sheaf to an open, as an isomorphism of sheaves of
modules on that open

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.isUniversalFirstOrderThickening_resLE
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04FA, the second assertion.** Let `i : Z ⟶ Z'` with structure morphism
`p : Z' ⟶ X` be a universal first-order thickening of `h : Z ⟶ X` over `X`. Let `U ⊆ X` and
`V ⊆ Z` be opens with `h(V) ⊆ U`, and let `W ⊆ Z'` be an open with `Z ∩ W = V` and `p(W) ⊆ U`.
Then the restrictions `i.resLE W V : V ⟶ W` and `p.resLE U W : W ⟶ U` are a universal
first-order thickening of `h|_V : V ⟶ U` over `U`.

That `V ⟶ W` is a first-order thickening is the statement that the restriction of a first-order
thickening to an open subscheme of the ambient scheme is again one. The lifting property is the
lifting property of `Z'` followed by the observation that the resulting lift `T' ⟶ Z'` factors
through the open `W`: the points of `T'` are the points of `T`, which land in `V`, hence in
`W`.
declarations.comment: the universal first-order thickening of an open is the corresponding open

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.formallyUnramified_resLE
declarations.doc:
**Formal unramifiedness restricts to opens.** If `h : Z ⟶ X` is formally unramified and
`V ⊆ Z`, `U ⊆ X` are opens with `h(V) ⊆ U`, then `h|_V : V ⟶ U` is formally unramified.
declarations.statement:
theorem formallyUnramified_resLE (h : Z ⟶ X) [FormallyUnramified h] {U : X.Opens} {V : Z.Opens}
    (hVU : V ≤ h ⁻¹ᵁ U) : FormallyUnramified (h.resLE U V hVU)

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.isIso_universalImmersionConormalSheafMap_resLE
declarations.doc:
**`𝒞_{Z/X}|_V = 𝒞_{V/U}`.** For universal first-order thickenings `Z ⊂ Z'` of `h : Z ⟶ X`
and `V ⊂ V''` of `h|_V : V ⟶ U`, the canonical morphism of conormal sheaves
`(ι_V)^* 𝒞_{Z/X} ⟶ 𝒞_{V/U}` of [Stacks Project, Tag 04F7] is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_universalImmersionConormalSheafMap_resLE
    (t : UniversalFirstOrderThickening h) {U : X.Opens} {V : Z.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ h ⁻¹ᵁ U)
    (tV : UniversalFirstOrderThickening (h.resLE U V hVU)) :
    IsIso (universalImmersionConormalSheafMap tV t V.ι U.ι (Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι h hVU))

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.isIso_universalConormalSheafMap_resLE
declarations.doc:
**`𝒞_{Z/X}|_V = 𝒞_{V/U}` at the chosen thickenings.** For a formally unramified
`h : Z ⟶ X` and opens `V ⊆ Z`, `U ⊆ X` with `h(V) ⊆ U`, the canonical morphism
`(ι_V)^* 𝒞_{Z/X} ⟶ 𝒞_{V/U}` between the conormal sheaves
`Stacks.Thickenings.universalConormalSheaf h` and
`Stacks.Thickenings.universalConormalSheaf (h|_V)` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_universalConormalSheafMap_resLE (h : Z ⟶ X) [FormallyUnramified h] {U : X.Opens}
    {V : Z.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ h ⁻¹ᵁ U) :
    letI : FormallyUnramified (h.resLE U V hVU) := formallyUnramified_resLE h hVU
    IsIso (universalImmersionConormalSheafMap
      (universalFirstOrderThickening (h.resLE U V hVU)) (universalFirstOrderThickening h)
      V.ι U.ι (Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι h hVU))
declarations.comment: restriction of the conormal sheaf, at the chosen thickenings

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.isIso_thickeningRelativeDifferentialsMap
declarations.doc:
Let `h : Z ⟶ X` be a morphism of schemes over `S` and let `i : Z ⟶ Z'` with structure
morphism `h' : Z' ⟶ X` be a universal first-order thickening of `Z` over `X`. The canonical map
`c_{h'} : (h')^* Ω_{X/S} ⟶ Ω_{Z'/S}` induces an isomorphism `h^* Ω_{X/S} ⟶ Ω_{Z'/S} ⊗ 𝒪_Z`,
namely its restriction along `i`.

Formal unramifiedness of `h`, a hypothesis of the source, is not needed here: it is what makes a
universal first-order thickening exist, and one is given.
declarations.comment:
the restriction along the inclusion of a universal first-order thickening of the
canonical map on relative differentials is an isomorphism; formal unramifiedness of `h` is not
assumed, a universal first-order thickening being given

declarations.name: Stacks.ConormalSequenceRight.epi_relativeDifferentialsMap_of_formallyUnramified
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 04FC], exactness at the right term.** For a formally unramified morphism
`h : Z ⟶ X` of schemes over `S`, the canonical map `h^*Ω_{X/S} ⟶ Ω_{Z/S}` of
[Stacks, Tag 01UV] is an epimorphism, so the differential sequence of `h` ends in zero.

A formally unramified morphism has `Ω_{Z/X} = 0` by [Stacks, Tag 02G4], so this is
`epi_relativeDifferentialsMap_of_isZero_relativeDifferentials`.
declarations.statement:
theorem epi_relativeDifferentialsMap_of_formallyUnramified (h : Z ⟶ X) [FormallyUnramified h]
    (p : X ⟶ S) :
    Epi (Scheme.Hom.relativeDifferentialsMap h p (h ≫ p) (𝟙 S) (by simp))

declarations.name: Stacks.ConormalSequenceRight.universalConormalDifferential
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 04FC], the first arrow.** For a formally unramified morphism `h : Z ⟶ X` of
schemes over `S`, the canonical morphism `𝒞_{Z/X} ⟶ h^*Ω_{X/S}` induced by the universal
derivation `d_{Z'/S}` on the ambient scheme of the universal first-order thickening of `Z` over
`X`.

It is the first arrow of [Stacks, Tag 01UZ] for the closed immersion `ι : Z ⟶ Z'` over
`h' ≫ p`, whose source is the conormal sheaf of `ι`, that is `𝒞_{Z/X}` by the definition
[Stacks, Tag 04F4] makes, and whose target is moved onto `h^*Ω_{X/S}` by [Stacks, Tag 04FB].
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def universalConormalDifferential :
    Stacks.ConormalSequenceUnramifiedPair.conormalSheafModules h ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback h).obj (Scheme.Hom.relativeDifferentials p)
declarations.comment: the first arrow induced by the universal derivation

declarations.name: Stacks.ConormalSequenceRight.universalConormalShortComplex_exact
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 04FC], exactness at the middle term.** For a formally unramified morphism
`h : Z ⟶ X` of schemes over `S` the sequence `𝒞_{Z/X} ⟶ h^*Ω_{X/S} ⟶ Ω_{Z/S}` is exact at
`h^*Ω_{X/S}`.

This is [Stacks, Tag 01UZ] for the closed immersion of `Z` into the ambient scheme of its
universal first-order thickening over `X`, transported along the identifications of
`Stacks.ConormalSequenceRight.universalConormalShortComplexIso`.
declarations.statement:
theorem universalConormalShortComplex_exact :
    (universalConormalShortComplex h p).Exact

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormallyEtale.existsUnique_lift
declarations.doc:
A formally étale morphism admits a unique lift across any first-order
thickening of schemes over its base, without affineness assumptions.
declarations.statement:
theorem FormallyEtale.existsUnique_lift
    {X S T T' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (hf : FormallyEtale f)
    (i : T ⟶ T') (hi : IsFirstOrderThickening i)
    (p : T' ⟶ S) (g : T ⟶ X) (hg : g ≫ f = i ≫ p) :
    ∃! h : T' ⟶ X, i ≫ h = g ∧ h ≫ f = p

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.formallyEtale_iff_isIso_inclusion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04FE, equivalence of (1) and (2).** A morphism of schemes is formally
étale if and only if it is formally unramified and the inclusion of its source into its universal
first-order thickening is an isomorphism, that is, the universal first-order thickening of `X`
over `S` is `X` itself.

Formal unramifiedness is part of the right-hand side because the universal first-order
thickening is only defined under it; for a formally étale morphism it comes from
[Stacks Project, Tag 02HH].

Forwards, the unique lifting property of [Stacks Project, Tag 04FD] applied to the thickening
itself produces a retraction of the inclusion, and the universal property of the thickening
identifies the other composite with the identity. Backwards, a lifting problem for `f` is
transported along the isomorphism and solved by the universal property, uniquely because the
universal property's lift is unique.
declarations.statement:
public theorem formallyEtale_iff_isIso_inclusion (f : X ⟶ S) :
    FormallyEtale f ↔
      ∃ hf : FormallyUnramified f,
        letI : FormallyUnramified f := hf
        IsIso (universalFirstOrderThickening f).inclusion

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.formallyEtale_iff_isZero_universalConormalSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04FE, equivalence of (1) and (3).** A morphism of schemes is formally
étale if and only if it is formally unramified and its conormal sheaf `𝒞_{X/S}` vanishes.

This is the equivalence of (1) and (2) combined with
`AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_inclusion_iff_isZero_universalConormalSheaf`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem formallyEtale_iff_isZero_universalConormalSheaf (f : X ⟶ S) :
    FormallyEtale f ↔
      ∃ hf : FormallyUnramified f,
        letI : FormallyUnramified f := hf
        IsZero (universalConormalSheaf f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.formallyEtale_iff_isZero_relativeDifferentials_and_universalConormalSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04FE, equivalence of (1) and (4).** A morphism of schemes is formally
étale if and only if both its sheaf of relative differentials `Ω_{X/S}` and its conormal sheaf
`𝒞_{X/S}` vanish.

The formal unramifiedness needed to form the conormal sheaf is supplied by the vanishing of the
differentials, through [Stacks Project, Tag 02H9].
declarations.statement:
public theorem formallyEtale_iff_isZero_relativeDifferentials_and_universalConormalSheaf
    (f : X ⟶ S) :
    FormallyEtale f ↔
      ∃ hΩ : IsZero (Scheme.Hom.relativeDifferentials f),
        letI : FormallyUnramified f :=
          (Scheme.Hom.formallyUnramified_iff_isZero_relativeDifferentials f).mpr hΩ
        IsZero (universalConormalSheaf f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.formallyEtale_of_unramified_flat
declarations.doc:
**An unramified flat morphism of schemes is formally étale.** Existence of the filler is
local on the thickening by `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isAffineOpen_lift_of_unramified_flat`; the
local fillers agree on overlaps by `Stacks.Smooth.lift_unique` applied to the restricted
thickening, so they glue by `Stacks.Smooth.exists_lift_of_isOpenCover`; and that same uniqueness
is the `∃!`.
declarations.statement:
theorem formallyEtale_of_unramified_flat {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [Unramified f] [Flat f] :
    FormallyEtale f

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.mapDifferenceDerivation
declarations.doc:
**The difference of two infinitesimal deformations of a map is a derivation**, affine case of
[Stacks Project, Tag 04FG]. Let `i : X ⟶ X'` and `j : Y ⟶ Y'` be first-order thickenings with
`X'` and `Y'` affine, let `p : X' ⟶ S` and `q : Y' ⟶ S` make them thickenings over `S`, and let
`(a, a')` and `(a, b')` be two morphisms of thickenings over `S` with the same reduction `a` —
hypothesis (1) of the source. Assume the two induced maps of conormal modules agree — hypothesis
(2). Then the difference of the two comorphisms descends to a `Γ(S, ⊤)`-derivation of `Γ(Y, ⊤)`
with values in the conormal module of `i`.

The conormal module carries two module structures here: over `Γ(Y, ⊤)` along `a`, and over
`Γ(S, ⊤)` along the structure morphism `i ≫ p` of `X` over `S`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def mapDifferenceDerivation [IsAffine X'] [IsAffine Y']
    (hi : IsFirstOrderThickening i) (hj : IsFirstOrderThickening j)
    (comm_a : i ≫ a' = a ≫ j) (comm_b : i ≫ b' = a ≫ j)
    (ha' : a' ≫ q = p) (hb' : b' ≫ q = p)
    (hC : conormalMap hi hj comm_a = conormalMap hi hj comm_b) :
    letI := appTopAlgebra (j ≫ q)
    letI := conormalModuleAlong hi a
    letI := conormalModuleAlong hi (i ≫ p)
    Derivation Γ(S, (⊤ : S.Opens)) Γ(Y, (⊤ : Y.Opens)) (RingHom.ker i.appTop.hom)

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.mapDifferenceDerivation_appTop
declarations.doc:
**The factorization of [Stacks Project, Tag 04FG], affine case.** The difference of the two
comorphisms `a'.appTop` and `b'.appTop` on `Γ(Y', ⊤)` is the composite
```
Γ(Y', ⊤) --j.appTop--> Γ(Y, ⊤) --D--> RingHom.ker i.appTop.hom ⊆ Γ(X', ⊤)
```
where `D` is the `Γ(S, ⊤)`-derivation `Stacks.Thickenings.mapDifferenceDerivation`.
declarations.statement:
theorem mapDifferenceDerivation_appTop [IsAffine X'] [IsAffine Y']
    (hi : IsFirstOrderThickening i) (hj : IsFirstOrderThickening j)
    (comm_a : i ≫ a' = a ≫ j) (comm_b : i ≫ b' = a ≫ j)
    (ha' : a' ≫ q = p) (hb' : b' ≫ q = p)
    (hC : conormalMap hi hj comm_a = conormalMap hi hj comm_b)
    (x : Γ(Y', (⊤ : Y'.Opens))) :
    letI := appTopAlgebra (j ≫ q)
    letI := conormalModuleAlong hi a
    letI := conormalModuleAlong hi (i ≫ p)
    ((mapDifferenceDerivation hi hj comm_a comm_b ha' hb' hC (j.appTop.hom x) :
        RingHom.ker i.appTop.hom) : Γ(X', (⊤ : X'.Opens)))
      = a'.appTop.hom x - b'.appTop.hom x

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.mapDifferenceSheaf
declarations.doc:
**The derivation `D` of [Stacks Project, Tag 04FG].** For an open `V` of `Y'` this is the map
`Γ(Y, j ⁻¹ᵁ V) → Γ(X', a' ⁻¹ᵁ V)`, that is `𝒪_Y ⟶ a_*𝒞_{X/X'}` on sections over `V`, through
which `(a')^♯ - (b')^♯` factors. It is characterised by
`Stacks.Thickenings.mapDifferenceSheaf_spec`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def mapDifferenceSheaf (hi : IsFirstOrderThickening i)
    (hj : IsFirstOrderThickening j) (comm_a : i ≫ a' = a ≫ j) (comm_b : i ≫ b' = a ≫ j)
    (hC : AgreeOnIdeal j a' b') (V : Y'.Opens) (s : Γ(Y, j ⁻¹ᵁ V)) : Γ(X', a' ⁻¹ᵁ V)

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.mapDifferenceSheaf_app
declarations.doc:
**The factorization of [Stacks Project, Tag 04FG].** The difference of the two comorphisms on
`Γ(Y', V)` is the composite of `j^♯ : 𝒪_{Y'} ⟶ 𝒪_Y` with the derivation `D`.
declarations.statement:
theorem mapDifferenceSheaf_app (hi : IsFirstOrderThickening i) (hj : IsFirstOrderThickening j)
    (comm_a : i ≫ a' = a ≫ j) (comm_b : i ≫ b' = a ≫ j) (hC : AgreeOnIdeal j a' b')
    (V : Y'.Opens) (x : Γ(Y', V)) :
    mapDifferenceSheaf hi hj comm_a comm_b hC V ((j.app V).hom x)
      = mapDifferenceLE (le_refl (a' ⁻¹ᵁ V)) (preimage_le_preimage hi comm_a comm_b V) x

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.app_mapDifferenceSheaf
declarations.doc:
**The derivation takes values in the conormal sheaf.** The value of `D` is killed by the
comorphism of `i`, i.e. it is a section of the defining ideal of `X ⊂ X'`, which for a first-order
thickening is `𝒞_{X/X'}`. This is what makes the factorization of
`Stacks.Thickenings.mapDifferenceSheaf_app` pass through `a_*𝒞_{X/X'}` and not merely through
`a_*𝒪_{X'}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem app_mapDifferenceSheaf (hi : IsFirstOrderThickening i) (hj : IsFirstOrderThickening j)
    (comm_a : i ≫ a' = a ≫ j) (comm_b : i ≫ b' = a ≫ j) (hC : AgreeOnIdeal j a' b')
    (V : Y'.Opens) (s : Γ(Y, j ⁻¹ᵁ V)) :
    (i.app (a' ⁻¹ᵁ V)).hom (mapDifferenceSheaf hi hj comm_a comm_b hC V s) = 0
declarations.comment: the factorization passes through the conormal sheaf

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.mapDifferenceSheaf_map
declarations.doc: **`D` is a map of sheaves**: it commutes with restriction.
declarations.statement:
theorem mapDifferenceSheaf_map (hi : IsFirstOrderThickening i) (hj : IsFirstOrderThickening j)
    (comm_a : i ≫ a' = a ≫ j) (comm_b : i ≫ b' = a ≫ j) (hC : AgreeOnIdeal j a' b')
    {V V' : Y'.Opens} (hV : V' ≤ V) (s : Γ(Y, j ⁻¹ᵁ V)) :
    resOpen (a'.preimage_mono hV) (mapDifferenceSheaf hi hj comm_a comm_b hC V s)
      = mapDifferenceSheaf hi hj comm_a comm_b hC V' (resOpen (j.preimage_mono hV) s)
declarations.comment: D is a map of sheaves

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.mapDifferenceSheaf_add
declarations.doc: **`D` is additive.**
declarations.statement:
theorem mapDifferenceSheaf_add (hi : IsFirstOrderThickening i) (hj : IsFirstOrderThickening j)
    (comm_a : i ≫ a' = a ≫ j) (comm_b : i ≫ b' = a ≫ j) (hC : AgreeOnIdeal j a' b')
    (V : Y'.Opens) (s t : Γ(Y, j ⁻¹ᵁ V)) :
    mapDifferenceSheaf hi hj comm_a comm_b hC V (s + t)
      = mapDifferenceSheaf hi hj comm_a comm_b hC V s
        + mapDifferenceSheaf hi hj comm_a comm_b hC V t

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.mapDifferenceSheaf_appLE_base
declarations.doc:
**`D` kills the sections pulled back from the base.** This is `𝒪_S`-linearity: a section of
`𝒪_S` over an open `Z` of `S` pulls back to a section of `𝒪_Y` over `j ⁻¹ᵁ V` for `V ≤ q ⁻¹ᵁ Z`,
and `D` vanishes on it, because the two lifts `a'` and `b'` are morphisms over `S` and therefore
agree on sections coming from `S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem mapDifferenceSheaf_appLE_base (hi : IsFirstOrderThickening i)
    (hj : IsFirstOrderThickening j) (comm_a : i ≫ a' = a ≫ j) (comm_b : i ≫ b' = a ≫ j)
    (hC : AgreeOnIdeal j a' b') (ha' : a' ≫ q = p) (hb' : b' ≫ q = p) {Z : S.Opens}
    {V : Y'.Opens} (hV : V ≤ q ⁻¹ᵁ Z) (hjV : j ⁻¹ᵁ V ≤ (j ≫ q) ⁻¹ᵁ Z) (r : Γ(S, Z)) :
    mapDifferenceSheaf hi hj comm_a comm_b hC V
        (((j ≫ q).appLE Z (j ⁻¹ᵁ V) hjV).hom r) = 0

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.mapDifferenceSheaf_mul
declarations.doc:
**The Leibniz rule for `D`.** This is the last clause of [Stacks Project, Tag 04FG]: together
with `Stacks.Thickenings.mapDifferenceSheaf_add` and
`Stacks.Thickenings.mapDifferenceSheaf_appLE_base` it says that `D` is an `𝒪_S`-derivation of
`𝒪_Y` with values in `a_*𝒞_{X/X'}`.

The proof is the computation of the affine case, read on an affine open of `Y'` after lifting the
two sections: the difference of the two comorphisms on a product is
`Δ(u)·(a')^♯ v + (b')^♯ u·Δ(v)`, and this agrees with `(a')^♯ u·Δ(v) + (a')^♯ v·Δ(u)` because the
two differences lie in the defining ideal of `i`, whose square vanishes.
declarations.statement:
theorem mapDifferenceSheaf_mul (hi : IsFirstOrderThickening i) (hj : IsFirstOrderThickening j)
    (comm_a : i ≫ a' = a ≫ j) (comm_b : i ≫ b' = a ≫ j) (hC : AgreeOnIdeal j a' b')
    (V : Y'.Opens) (s t : Γ(Y, j ⁻¹ᵁ V)) :
    mapDifferenceSheaf hi hj comm_a comm_b hC V (s * t)
      = conormalSmul hi hj comm_a V (mapDifferenceSheaf hi hj comm_a comm_b hC V t)
            (app_mapDifferenceSheaf hi hj comm_a comm_b hC V t) s
        + conormalSmul hi hj comm_a V (mapDifferenceSheaf hi hj comm_a comm_b hC V s)
            (app_mapDifferenceSheaf hi hj comm_a comm_b hC V s) t

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.differenceDerivation
declarations.doc:
**The `𝒪_S`-derivation `D : 𝒪_Y ⟶ a_*𝒞_{X/X'}` of [Stacks Project, Tag 04FG], at sheaf
level.** Let `i : X ⟶ X'` be a first-order thickening, let `j : Y ⟶ Y'` be an immersion with
structure morphism `q : Y' ⟶ S`, and let `(a, a')` and `(a, b')` be two morphisms of thickenings
over `S` with the same reduction `a` — hypothesis (1) of the source — whose two induced maps
`a^*𝒞_{Y/Y'} ⟶ 𝒞_{X/X'}` of [Stacks Project, Tag 01R4] agree — hypothesis (2). Then the
difference `(a')^♯ - (b')^♯` factors through this derivation; the factorization is
`Stacks.Thickenings.firstOrderImmersionConormalSheafι_differenceDerivation_d`.

It is `Stacks.Thickenings.differenceDerivationHom` composed with the universal relative
derivation of `Y` over `S`, so that it is an `𝒪_S`-derivation by construction.
declarations.statement:
def differenceDerivation (hi : i.ker ^ 2 = ⊥) (hq : b' ≫ q = a' ≫ q) (ca : i ≫ a' = a ≫ j)
    (cb : i ≫ b' = a ≫ j)
    (hC : Stacks.Immersion.immersionConormalSheafMap i j a a'
        (Stacks.Immersion.toShHom_square ca) =
      Stacks.Immersion.immersionConormalSheafMap i j a b'
        (Stacks.Immersion.toShHom_square cb)) :
    SheafOfModules.SheafDerivation (inverseImageStructureMap (j ≫ q))
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward a).obj (Stacks.Conormal.conormalSheaf i))
declarations.comment: the derivation D, for arbitrary X' and Y'

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.firstOrderImmersionConormalSheafι_differenceDerivation_d
declarations.doc:
**The factorization of [Stacks Project, Tag 04FG], at sheaf level.** The difference
`(a')^♯ s - (b')^♯ s` of the two comorphisms, on a section `s` of `𝒪_{Y'}` over `V` and read over
the open `(b')⁻¹V ⊓ (a')⁻¹V` of `X'` where both are defined, is the image of
`D (j^♯ s)` under the inclusion `𝒞_{X/X'} ⟶ 𝒪_{X'}` of the conormal sheaf of the first-order
thickening `i`.

That is the composite `𝒪_{Y'} ⟶ 𝒪_Y --D--> a_*𝒞_{X/X'} ⟶ a_*𝒪_{X'}` of the source.
declarations.statement:
theorem firstOrderImmersionConormalSheafι_differenceDerivation_d (hi : i.ker ^ 2 = ⊥)
    (hq : b' ≫ q = a' ≫ q) (ca : i ≫ a' = a ≫ j) (cb : i ≫ b' = a ≫ j)
    (hC : Stacks.Immersion.immersionConormalSheafMap i j a a'
        (Stacks.Immersion.toShHom_square ca) =
      Stacks.Immersion.immersionConormalSheafMap i j a b'
        (Stacks.Immersion.toShHom_square cb))
    (V : Y'.Opens) (s : Γ(Y', V)) :
    (Stacks.Thickenings.firstOrderImmersionConormalSheafι i hi).val.app
        (op (liftPairOpen a' b' V))
        ((Stacks.Conormal.conormalSheaf i).val.map
          (homOfLE (preimage_liftPairOpen ca cb V).le).op
          ((differenceDerivation q hi hq ca cb hC).d (X := op (j ⁻¹ᵁ V))
            ((j.app V).hom s))) =
      (a'.appLE V (liftPairOpen a' b' V) inf_le_right).hom s -
        (b'.appLE V (liftPairOpen a' b' V) inf_le_left).hom s
declarations.comment: the factorization, for arbitrary X' and Y'

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.isSheaf_compatibleLiftsPresheaf
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks Project, Tag 04FH].** For a scheme `S`, immersions `i : X ⟶ X'` and `j : Y ⟶ Y'`, a
morphism `a : X ⟶ Y` and a map `A : a^* 𝒞_{Y/Y'} ⟶ 𝒞_{X/X'}`, the rule assigning to an open `V`
of `X'` the set of morphisms `V ⟶ Y'` over `S` restricting to `a` on `i⁻¹V` and inducing the
restriction of `A` there is a **sheaf of sets** on `X'`.

The proof is the unique-gluing form of the sheaf condition. A compatible family of lifts glues to
a morphism by `Stacks.Thickenings.glueCompatibleLifts`, that morphism is again a compatible lift
by `Stacks.Thickenings.isCompatibleLift_glueCompatibleLifts`, and a lift over the union is
determined by its restrictions to the cover.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSheaf_compatibleLiftsPresheaf (pX' : X' ⟶ S) (pY' : Y' ⟶ S) (a : X ⟶ Y)
    (A : (modulePullback a.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj (immersionConormalSheaf j) ⟶
      immersionConormalSheaf i) :
    (compatibleLiftsPresheaf pX' pY' a A).IsSheaf

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.IsCompatibleLift.restrict
declarations.doc:
**The three conditions of [Stacks Project, Tag 04FI] are stable under restriction.** A lift of
`a` over an open `V` of `X'` compatible with `A` restricts to a compatible lift over any smaller
open `V'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsCompatibleLift.restrict (hb : IsCompatibleLift pX' pY' a A V b)
    {V' : X'.Opens} (hV : V' ≤ V) :
    IsCompatibleLift pX' pY' a A V' (X'.homOfLE hV ≫ b)

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.compatibleLiftsPresheaf
declarations.doc:
**The presheaf of compatible lifts.** The rule assigning to an open `V` of `X'` the set of
morphisms `V ⟶ Y'` over `S` restricting to `a` on `i⁻¹V` and inducing the restriction of `A`
there, with the restriction maps of `Stacks.Thickenings.compatibleLiftsRestrict`.
declarations.statement:
def compatibleLiftsPresheaf (pX' : X' ⟶ S) (pY' : Y' ⟶ S) (a : X ⟶ Y)
    (A : (modulePullback a.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj (immersionConormalSheaf j) ⟶
      immersionConormalSheaf i) :
    TopCat.Presheaf (Type u) X'.carrier

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.firstOrderCompatibleLifts
declarations.doc:
**The set of compatible lifts for first-order thickenings.** The set
`Stacks.Thickenings.compatibleLifts` when `i` and `j` are first-order thickenings in the sense of
[Stacks Project, Tag 04EX].
declarations.statement:
abbrev firstOrderCompatibleLifts (hi : IsFirstOrderThickening i)
    (hj : IsFirstOrderThickening j) (pX' : X' ⟶ S) (pY' : Y' ⟶ S) (a : X ⟶ Y)
    (A : letI := hi.1; letI := hj.1;
      (modulePullback a.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj (immersionConormalSheaf j) ⟶
        immersionConormalSheaf i)
    (V : X'.Opens) : Type u

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.exists_addAction_compatibleLifts
declarations.doc:
**The sheaf `SheafHom_{𝒪_X}(a^*Ω_{Y/S}, 𝒞_{X/X'})` acts on the sheaf of
[Stacks Project, Tag 04FI]**, [Stacks Project, Tag 04FJ] for arbitrary schemes.

Let `S` be a scheme, let `i : X ⟶ X'` be a first-order thickening, let `j : Y ⟶ Y'` be an
immersion, let `p : X' ⟶ S` and `q : Y' ⟶ S` be the structure morphisms, let `a : X ⟶ Y` and let
`A : a^*𝒞_{Y/Y'} ⟶ 𝒞_{X/X'}` be a map of `𝒪_X`-modules. For every open `V` of `X'` the additive
group of sections of `SheafHom_{𝒪_X}(a^*Ω_{Y/S}, 𝒞_{X/X'})` over the part `i⁻¹V` of `X` cut out
by `V` acts on the set `Stacks.Thickenings.compatibleLifts` of [Stacks Project, Tag 04FI] of
lifts of `a` over `V` inducing `A`, and the action commutes with the restriction maps of the
sheaf `Stacks.Thickenings.compatibleLiftsPresheaf` of [Stacks Project, Tag 04FH]: it is an action
of sheaves.

Nothing is affine, the datum is the one of the source — a morphism of sheaves of `𝒪_X`-modules
out of the pulled-back sheaf of relative differentials, read over an open — and the third
condition of [Stacks Project, Tag 04FI] is the equality of maps of conormal **sheaves**.

The action is `Stacks.Thickenings.compatibleLiftsVAdd`, the group laws are
`Stacks.Thickenings.homSectionAct_zero` and `Stacks.Thickenings.homSectionAct_add`, and the
compatibility with restriction is
`Stacks.Thickenings.compatibleLiftsRestrict_compatibleLiftsVAdd`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_addAction_compatibleLifts (hsq : i.ker ^ 2 = ⊥) (pX' : X' ⟶ S) (pY' : Y' ⟶ S)
    (a : X ⟶ Y)
    (A : (modulePullback a.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj (immersionConormalSheaf j) ⟶
      immersionConormalSheaf i) :
    ∃ act : ∀ V : X'.Opens, deformationHomSections i a (j ≫ pY') V →
        compatibleLifts pX' pY' a A V → compatibleLifts pX' pY' a A V,
      (∀ (V : X'.Opens) (c : compatibleLifts pX' pY' a A V), act V 0 c = c) ∧
        (∀ (V : X'.Opens) (θ η : deformationHomSections i a (j ≫ pY') V)
          (c : compatibleLifts pX' pY' a A V), act V (θ + η) c = act V θ (act V η c)) ∧
        ∀ (V V' : X'.Opens) (hV : V' ≤ V) (θ : deformationHomSections i a (j ≫ pY') V)
          (c : compatibleLifts pX' pY' a A V),
          compatibleLiftsRestrict pX' pY' a A hV (act V θ c)
            = act V' (moduleHomSections.restrict (i.preimage_mono hV) θ)
                (compatibleLiftsRestrict pX' pY' a A hV c)
declarations.comment: the action of SheafHom(a^*Ω, 𝒞) on the sheaf of Tag 04FI, for arbitrary schemes

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.existsUnique_compatibleLiftsVAdd_eq
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks Project, Tag 04FJ], the transitivity clause, for arbitrary schemes.** Let `S` be a
scheme, let `i : X ⟶ X'` be a first-order thickening, let `j : Y ⟶ Y'` be an immersion, let
`a : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism and let `A : a^*𝒞_{Y/Y'} ⟶ 𝒞_{X/X'}` be a map of `𝒪_X`-modules. Over an
open `V` of `X'` **carrying a lift**, the action of
`SheafHom_{𝒪_X}(a^*Ω_{Y/S}, 𝒞_{X/X'})` of `Stacks.Thickenings.compatibleLiftsVAdd` on the lifts of
[Stacks Project, Tag 04FI] is **simply transitive**: for any two lifts `b₀`, `c₀` over `V` there
is exactly one section carrying `b₀` to `c₀`.

No affineness is assumed, of `S`, `X'`, `Y'` or `V`.

Existence is the unrestricted [Stacks Project, Tag 04FG] read for the restricted thickening
`i ∣_ V` and transported to the deformation sheaf's conormal track
(`Stacks.Thickenings.exists_isDerivationAction_over`), followed by the uniqueness half of
[Stacks Project, Tag 02H5] (`Stacks.Thickenings.eq_of_isDerivationAction`) identifying the lift it
produces with `θ ⬝ b₀` (`Stacks.Thickenings.homSectionAct_eq_derivationActionSheaf`). Uniqueness of
the section is `Stacks.Thickenings.deformationHomSections_ext`.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_compatibleLiftsVAdd_eq (hsq : i.ker ^ 2 = ⊥) (pX' : X' ⟶ S) (pY' : Y' ⟶ S)
    (a : X ⟶ Y)
    (A : (modulePullback a.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj (immersionConormalSheaf j) ⟶
      immersionConormalSheaf i) (V : X'.Opens) (b₀ c₀ : compatibleLifts pX' pY' a A V) :
    ∃! θ : deformationHomSections i a (j ≫ pY') V,
      compatibleLiftsVAdd hsq pX' pY' a A V θ b₀ = c₀
declarations.comment: simple transitivity over an open carrying a lift, for arbitrary schemes

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.deformationAddAction
declarations.doc:
**The action of [Stacks Project, Tag 04FJ], affine case.** The additive group of
`Γ(Y, ⊤)`-linear maps `Ω[Γ(Y, ⊤)⁄Γ(S, ⊤)] ⟶ 𝒞_{X/X'}` — the sections over the affine `X'` of
`SheafHom_{𝒪_X}(a^*Ω_{Y/S}, 𝒞_{X/X'})` — acts on the deformations of `a` with conormal map `A`,
by `Stacks.Thickenings.Deformation.act`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def deformationAddAction [IsAffine S] [IsAffine X'] [IsAffine Y']
    (hi : IsFirstOrderThickening i) (hj : IsFirstOrderThickening j) (p : X' ⟶ S) (q : Y' ⟶ S)
    (a : X ⟶ Y)
    (A : letI := Smooth.thickeningKerModule hj
      letI := conormalModuleAlong hi a
      RingHom.ker j.appTop.hom →ₗ[Γ(Y, (⊤ : Y.Opens))] RingHom.ker i.appTop.hom) :
    letI := appTopAlgebra (j ≫ q)
    letI := conormalModuleAlong hi a
    AddAction (Ω[Γ(Y, (⊤ : Y.Opens))⁄Γ(S, (⊤ : S.Opens))] →ₗ[Γ(Y, (⊤ : Y.Opens))]
        RingHom.ker i.appTop.hom) (Deformation hi hj p q a A)
declarations.comment: the action on the deformations with a fixed conormal map, over affine schemes

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.eq_zero_of_isIso
declarations.doc:
**The map `A` of [Stacks Project, Tag 04FH] is zero when `Y = Y'`.** This is the first
assertion of [Stacks Project, Tag 04FK]: in the case `Y = Y'` the conormal datum "is always
zero".
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_isIso [IsIso j] (a : X ⟶ Y)
    (A : (modulePullback a.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj (immersionConormalSheaf j) ⟶
      immersionConormalSheaf i) : A = 0
declarations.comment: the vanishing of the conormal datum A

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.compatibleLiftsPresheafIsoLiftsOverBasePresheaf
declarations.doc:
**The sheaf of [Stacks Project, Tag 04FH] is the elementary rule when `Y = Y'`.** The
presheaf of compatible lifts for a datum `A` is isomorphic to the presheaf of lifts over `S`
extending `a`, by the isomorphism which is the identity on underlying morphisms.

This is the description of the sheaf asserted by [Stacks Project, Tag 04FK]. The simply
transitive action of `Hom_{𝒪_X}(a^*Ω_{Y/S}, 𝒞_{X/X'})` on the elementary rule — the last
assertion of that remark — is
`Stacks.Thickenings.exists_simplyTransitive_addAction_liftsOverBase` in
`StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.MoreMorphisms.InfinitesimalDeformationUnthickenedTargetAction`,
obtained by transporting the unrestricted [Stacks Project, Tag 04FJ] along this very
isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
def compatibleLiftsPresheafIsoLiftsOverBasePresheaf [IsIso j]
    (A : (modulePullback a.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj (immersionConormalSheaf j) ⟶
      immersionConormalSheaf i) :
    compatibleLiftsPresheaf pX' pY' a A ≅ liftsOverBasePresheaf i j pX' pY' a
declarations.comment: the elementary description of the lifting sheaf

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.exists_simplyTransitive_addAction_liftsOverBase
declarations.doc:
**The action clause of [Stacks Project, Tag 04FK].** Let `S` be a scheme, let `i : X ⟶ X'`
be a first order thickening, let `j : Y ⟶ Y'` be an isomorphism — the case `Y = Y'` of the
remark — let `p : X' ⟶ S` and `q : Y' ⟶ S` be the structure morphisms and let `a : X ⟶ Y`. The
sheaf `Hom_{𝒪_X}(a^*Ω_{Y/S}, 𝒞_{X/X'})` acts on the elementary rule
`Stacks.Thickenings.liftsOverBasePresheaf` of the remark: over every open `V` of `X'` the
additive group of sections of `SheafHom_{𝒪_X}(a^*Ω_{Y/S}, 𝒞_{X/X'})` over `i⁻¹V` acts on the
morphisms `V ⟶ Y'` over `S` restricting to `a` on `i⁻¹V`, the action commutes with the
restriction maps of that rule, and over an open carrying a lift it is **simply transitive**.

No affineness is assumed, of `S`, `X'`, `Y'` or `V`, and no condition on conormal sheaves
appears anywhere: this is the action on the elementary rule itself, which is what the remark
asserts.

The action is `Stacks.Thickenings.liftsOverBaseVAdd`; everything about it is the unrestricted
[Stacks Project, Tag 04FJ] transported along
`Stacks.Thickenings.compatibleLiftsEquivLiftsOverBase`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_simplyTransitive_addAction_liftsOverBase (hsq : i.ker ^ 2 = ⊥) (pX' : X' ⟶ S)
    (pY' : Y' ⟶ S) (a : X ⟶ Y) :
    ∃ act : ∀ V : X'.Opens, deformationHomSections i a (j ≫ pY') V →
        liftsOverBase i j pX' pY' a V → liftsOverBase i j pX' pY' a V,
      (∀ (V : X'.Opens) (c : liftsOverBase i j pX' pY' a V), act V 0 c = c) ∧
        (∀ (V : X'.Opens) (θ η : deformationHomSections i a (j ≫ pY') V)
          (c : liftsOverBase i j pX' pY' a V), act V (θ + η) c = act V θ (act V η c)) ∧
        (∀ (V V' : X'.Opens) (hV : V' ≤ V) (θ : deformationHomSections i a (j ≫ pY') V)
          (c : liftsOverBase i j pX' pY' a V),
          liftsOverBaseRestrict i j pX' pY' a hV (act V θ c)
            = act V' (moduleHomSections.restrict (i.preimage_mono hV) θ)
                (liftsOverBaseRestrict i j pX' pY' a hV c)) ∧
        ∀ (V : X'.Opens) (b₀ c₀ : liftsOverBase i j pX' pY' a V),
          ∃! θ : deformationHomSections i a (j ≫ pY') V, act V θ b₀ = c₀
declarations.comment: the action of Hom(a^*Ω_{Y/S}, 𝒞_{X/X'}) on the elementary lifting rule, with the group laws, the compatibility with restriction, and simple transitivity over an open carrying a lift

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.homEquiv_diagonalConormalSheafMap_d
declarations.doc:
**The difference of two maps to a fixed scheme, through the diagonal**,
[Stacks, Tag 04FL].
declarations.statement:
theorem homEquiv_diagonalConormalSheafMap_d [IsImmersion i] (hq : b' ≫ q = a' ≫ q)
    (comm_a : i ≫ a' = a) (comm_b : i ≫ b' = a) (V : Y.Opens) (s : Γ(Y, V)) :
    (((modulePullbackPushforwardAdjunction a.toLRSHom.toShHom).homEquiv _ _
          (diagonalConormalSheafMap hq comm_a comm_b)).val.app (op V))
        (q.universalRelativeDerivation.d s) =
      conormalClass i (liftPairOpen a' b' V) (le_preimage_liftPairOpen comm_a comm_b V)
        (liftDiffSection a' b' V s) (app_liftDiffSection comm_a comm_b V s)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.etaleStalkSkyscraperAdjunction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04FM.** The stalk functor at a geometric point `s̄` of `S` is left adjoint to the
skyscraper functor at `s̄`: a map `F_s̄ ⟶ M` is the same as a map `F ⟶ s̄_* M`.
declarations.comment: the stalk at a geometric point is left adjoint to the skyscraper there

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.geometricPointFiber
declarations.doc:
The lifts of a geometric point to objects of the small étale site, i.e. the functor

`u : S_étale ⟶ Sets`, `U ↦ {ū such that (U, ū) is an étale neighbourhood of s̄}`

sending `U` to the morphisms `s̄ ⟶ U` over `S`.
declarations.statement: public def geometricPointFiber : SmallEtale B S hS ⥤ Type u

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.geometricPointFiberObjEquivGeometricFibre
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04FM**, the identification of the two descriptions of the value of the
fibre functor. For an object `U` of the small étale site of `S`, the set
`(geometricPointFiber B S hS s).obj U` of lifts of the geometric point `s` to `U` — the set
`{ū : (U, ū) is an étale neighbourhood of s̄}` of the source — is in bijection with the
underlying set `|U_s̄|` of the geometric fibre of `U` at `s`.
declarations.comment: the two descriptions of `u(U)`: the geometric fibre and the étale neighbourhoods

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.geometricPointSitePoint
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04FM.** The functor `u` of
`AlgebraicGeometry.geometricPointFiber` defines a point `p` of the site `S_étale`: a geometric
point of `S`, viewed as a point of the small étale site of `S`, with fiber functor `u`.

The source obtains this from the criterion of Sites, Proposition 00YC, checking that `u(S)` is
a singleton, that `u` preserves fibre products, and that `∐ u(U_i) ⟶ u(U)` is surjective for a
covering. Mathlib's `CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.Point` asks instead for
cofilteredness of the category of elements of `u`, which for this `u` is the cofilteredness of
the category of étale neighbourhoods of the geometric point
(`AlgebraicGeometry.isCofiltered_geometricPointFiber_elements`), together with the joint
surjectivity, which is `AlgebraicGeometry.geometricPointFiber_jointly_surjective`. The two
descriptions of a point agree on a site with finite limits by
`CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.Point.equivFiber`, the formalization of Tag 00YC.
declarations.statement:
public def geometricPointSitePoint :
    (SmallEtale.topology B S hS).Point
declarations.comment: the functor `u` defines a point of the small étale site

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.etaleStalk_eq_presheafFiber
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04FM**, the final assertion: the stalk functor `F ↦ F_p` attached to
the point `p = AlgebraicGeometry.geometricPointSitePoint` by Sites, Equation 04EH — which is
`CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.Point.presheafFiber` — is the stalk functor
`F ↦ F_s̄` at the geometric point of Tag 040R, which is `AlgebraicGeometry.etaleStalk`. Both
are given by the same colimit over the category of étale neighbourhoods, so the general theory
of points of a site — exactness, invariance under sheafification, commutation with colimits —
applies to the stalk at a geometric point.
declarations.statement:
public theorem etaleStalk_eq_presheafFiber {A : Type v} [Category.{w} A]
    [HasColimitsOfSize.{u, u} A] (F : (SmallEtale B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ A) :
    etaleStalk B S hS s F = (geometricPointSitePoint B S hS s).presheafFiber.obj F
declarations.comment: the stalk functor of `p` is the stalk at the geometric point

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.etaleGerm_eq_zero_iff_mem_zeroOpen
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04FR, part (3).** A germ vanishes exactly when the lift lands in the maximal open
zero locus of the section.

A geometric point `ū` of the object `W` of the small étale site is a lift `q` to `W` of a geometric
point `t` of `S`, the relation `t = (W → S) ∘ ū` of the source being the defining condition on a
lift; so quantifying over `t` and over `q` is quantifying over the geometric points of `W`. The
germ `etaleGerm … t F.obj W q a` is the source's class of `(U, ū, σ)` in `F_s̄`, and
`zeroOpen … W a` is the source's `W`, so this is the asserted equivalence
`(U, ū, σ) = 0 in F_s̄ ↔ ū ∈ W`.

The coefficient universe `v` is free, which is more general than the source; `UnivLE.{u, v}` and
the existence of the colimit are what that extra generality costs, and both are automatic
instances at `v = u`, so at the source's generality the statement carries no hypothesis. They are
size conditions for the stalk to be formed at all, not mathematical hypotheses: `etaleGerm` is a
colimit injection and does not typecheck without the colimit.
declarations.statement:
public theorem etaleGerm_eq_zero_iff_mem_zeroOpen (W : SmallEtale B S hS)
    (q : (geometricPointFiber B S hS t).obj W) (a : F.obj.obj (op W)) :
    etaleGerm B S hS t F.obj W q a = 0 ↔
      q.1.base default ∈
        (zeroOpen B S hS F W a : Set ((SmallEtale.toScheme B S hS).obj W))
declarations.comment: part (3): a germ vanishes exactly when the lift lands in the zero locus

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.map_eq_zero_iff_range_subset_zeroOpen
declarations.doc:
A section pulls back to zero along an arbitrary arrow of the small étale site precisely when
the image of that arrow is contained in its maximal Zariski open zero locus.
declarations.statement:
public theorem map_eq_zero_iff_range_subset_zeroOpen
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS) AddCommGrpCat.{v})
    (U : SmallEtale B S hS) (σ : F.obj.obj (op U))
    (V : SmallEtale B S hS) (f : V ⟶ U) :
    F.obj.map f.op σ = 0 ↔
      Set.range ((SmallEtale.toScheme B S hS).map f).base ⊆
        (zeroOpen B S hS F U σ : Set ((SmallEtale.toScheme B S hS).obj U))
