declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isClosed_range_mapArrows_of_isOpen
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04Q6.** If a morphism of groupoid schemes whose common object
scheme is the spectrum of a field has open image on arrows, then that image is closed.
declarations.statement:
public lemma isClosed_range_mapArrows_of_isOpen
    {S : Scheme.{u}} {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {G₁ G₂ : GroupoidScheme S} (F : GroupoidScheme.Hom G₁ G₂)
    (hobjects : G₁.objects = G₂.objects)
    (hfield : G₁.objects.left = Spec (.of k))
    (hmapObjects : F.mapObjects = eqToHom hobjects)
    (hopen : IsOpen (Set.range F.mapArrows.left.base)) :
    IsClosed (Set.range F.mapArrows.left.base)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.comp_mapsTo_closure_range_mapArrows
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04Q7.** For a morphism of groupoid schemes over a field which is the
identity on the common scheme of objects, the closure of the image on arrows is stable under
composition.
declarations.statement:
theorem comp_mapsTo_closure_range_mapArrows {S : Scheme.{u}} {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {G₁ G₂ : GroupoidScheme S} (F : GroupoidScheme.Hom G₁ G₂)
    (hobjects : G₁.objects = G₂.objects) (hfield : G₁.objects.left = Spec (.of k))
    (hmapObjects : F.mapObjects = eqToHom hobjects) :
    Set.MapsTo G₂.comp.left.base
      ((pullback.fst G₂.source G₂.target).left.base ⁻¹'
          closure (Set.range F.mapArrows.left.base) ∩
        (pullback.snd G₂.source G₂.target).left.base ⁻¹'
          closure (Set.range F.mapArrows.left.base))
      (closure (Set.range F.mapArrows.left.base))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidScheme.reducedClosureImage
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04Q8.** The reduced closure of the image on arrows of a morphism of
groupoid schemes over a perfect field which is the identity on objects carries a groupoid
structure for which the closed immersion into the target is a morphism of groupoid schemes.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def reducedClosureImage {k : Type u} [Field k] [PerfectField k]
    (F : GroupoidScheme.Hom G₁ G₂) (hobjects : G₁.objects = G₂.objects)
    (hfield : G₁.objects.left = Spec (.of k))
    (hmapObjects : F.mapObjects = eqToHom hobjects) : ReducedClosureImage F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidScheme.reducedClosureGroupoid_objects
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04Q8.** The reduced-closure groupoid has the same scheme of objects
as the target groupoid.
declarations.statement:
theorem reducedClosureGroupoid_objects {k : Type u} [Field k] [PerfectField k]
    (F : GroupoidScheme.Hom G₁ G₂) (hobjects : G₁.objects = G₂.objects)
    (hfield : G₁.objects.left = Spec (.of k))
    (hmapObjects : F.mapObjects = eqToHom hobjects) :
    (reducedClosureGroupoid F hobjects hfield hmapObjects).objects = G₂.objects

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidScheme.reducedClosureGroupoid_arrows
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04Q8.** The scheme of arrows of the reduced-closure groupoid is the
reduced closure of the image on arrows.
declarations.statement:
theorem reducedClosureGroupoid_arrows {k : Type u} [Field k] [PerfectField k]
    (F : GroupoidScheme.Hom G₁ G₂) (hobjects : G₁.objects = G₂.objects)
    (hfield : G₁.objects.left = Spec (.of k))
    (hmapObjects : F.mapObjects = eqToHom hobjects) :
    (reducedClosureGroupoid F hobjects hfield hmapObjects).arrows = reducedClosureArrows F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidScheme.reducedClosureInclusion_mapObjects
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04Q8.** The canonical morphism from the reduced-closure groupoid is
the identity on objects.
declarations.statement:
theorem reducedClosureInclusion_mapObjects {k : Type u} [Field k] [PerfectField k]
    (F : GroupoidScheme.Hom G₁ G₂) (hobjects : G₁.objects = G₂.objects)
    (hfield : G₁.objects.left = Spec (.of k))
    (hmapObjects : F.mapObjects = eqToHom hobjects) :
    (reducedClosureInclusion F hobjects hfield hmapObjects).mapObjects =
      eqToHom (reducedClosureGroupoid_objects F hobjects hfield hmapObjects)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidScheme.reducedClosureInclusion_mapArrows_left
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04Q8.** On arrows the canonical morphism from the reduced-closure
groupoid is the closed immersion of the reduced closure of the image.
declarations.statement:
theorem reducedClosureInclusion_mapArrows_left {k : Type u} [Field k] [PerfectField k]
    (F : GroupoidScheme.Hom G₁ G₂) (hobjects : G₁.objects = G₂.objects)
    (hfield : G₁.objects.left = Spec (.of k))
    (hmapObjects : F.mapObjects = eqToHom hobjects) :
    (reducedClosureInclusion F hobjects hfield hmapObjects).mapArrows.left =
      eqToHom (congrArg Over.left
        (reducedClosureGroupoid_arrows F hobjects hfield hmapObjects)) ≫
        (reducedClosureArrowImage F).subschemeι

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isClosed_range_mapArrows_of_isLocallyClosed
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04Q9.** The image on arrows of a morphism of groupoid schemes over a
field which is the identity on their common scheme of objects is closed as soon as it is
locally closed.
declarations.statement:
theorem isClosed_range_mapArrows_of_isLocallyClosed {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (F : GroupoidScheme.Hom G₁ G₂) (hobjects : G₁.objects = G₂.objects)
    (hfield : G₁.objects.left = Spec (.of k))
    (hmapObjects : F.mapObjects = eqToHom hobjects)
    (h : IsLocallyClosed (Set.range F.mapArrows.left.base)) :
    IsClosed (Set.range F.mapArrows.left.base)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_groupoidScheme_image
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04QA.** The scheme-theoretic image of a quasi-compact
arrow map of groupoid schemes over a field has the restricted groupoid structure.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_groupoidScheme_image
    {S : Scheme.{u}} {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {G₁ G₂ : GroupoidScheme S} (F : GroupoidScheme.Hom G₁ G₂)
    (hobjects : G₁.objects = G₂.objects)
    (hfield : G₁.objects.left = Spec (.of k))
    (hmapObjects : F.mapObjects = eqToHom hobjects)
    [QuasiCompact F.mapArrows.left] :
    ∃ (H : GroupoidScheme S) (j : GroupoidScheme.Hom H G₂)
      (hHobjects : H.objects = G₂.objects)
      (hHarrows : H.arrows = Over.mk
        (F.mapArrows.left.imageι ≫ G₂.arrows.hom)),
        (j.mapObjects = eqToHom hHobjects) ∧
        (j.mapArrows.left =
          eqToHom (congrArg Over.left hHarrows) ≫ F.mapArrows.left.imageι)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.comp_mapsTo_closure_range_groupoidPreRelation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04QB.** Let `(U, R, s, t, c)` be a groupoid scheme over `S` with `U`
the spectrum of a field, and let `Z` be the closure of the image of `j = (t, s)` in `U ×_S U`.
Then `pr₀₂` maps `Z ×_{pr₁, U, pr₀} Z` into `Z`.
declarations.statement:
theorem comp_mapsTo_closure_range_groupoidPreRelation :
    Set.MapsTo
      (prod.lift
        (pullback.fst (prod.snd : G.objects ⨯ G.objects ⟶ G.objects) prod.fst ≫ prod.fst)
        (pullback.snd (prod.snd : G.objects ⨯ G.objects ⟶ G.objects) prod.fst
          ≫ prod.snd)).left.base
      ((pullback.fst (prod.snd : G.objects ⨯ G.objects ⟶ G.objects) prod.fst).left.base ⁻¹'
          closure (Set.range (groupoidPreRelation G).left.base) ∩
        (pullback.snd (prod.snd : G.objects ⨯ G.objects ⟶ G.objects) prod.fst).left.base ⁻¹'
          closure (Set.range (groupoidPreRelation G).left.base))
      (closure (Set.range (groupoidPreRelation G).left.base))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.reducedClosureGroupoidPreRelation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04QC.** For a groupoid scheme `(U, R, s, t, c)` over `S` with `U` the
spectrum of a perfect field, the reduced closed subscheme `Z` of `U ×_S U` supported on the
closure of the image of `j = (t, s)` is the scheme of arrows of a groupoid scheme on `U` whose
structure maps are the restrictions of `pr₁`, `pr₀` and `pr₀₂`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def reducedClosureGroupoidPreRelation [PerfectField k] :
    GroupoidScheme.ReducedClosureImage (groupoidPreRelationHom G)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_groupoidScheme_image_groupoidPreRelation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04QD.** For a groupoid scheme `(U, R, s, t, c)` over `S` with `U` the
spectrum of a field and `R` quasi-compact, the scheme-theoretic image of `j = (t, s)` in
`U ×_S U` is the scheme of arrows of a groupoid scheme on `U` whose structure maps are the
restrictions of `pr₁`, `pr₀` and `pr₀₂`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_groupoidScheme_image_groupoidPreRelation [CompactSpace G.arrows.left] :
    ∃ (H : GroupoidScheme S) (ι : GroupoidScheme.Hom H (prodPairGroupoid G.objects))
      (hHobjects : H.objects = G.objects)
      (hHarrows : H.arrows = Over.mk ((groupoidPreRelation G).left.imageι ≫
        (G.objects ⨯ G.objects).hom)),
        (ι.mapObjects = eqToHom hHobjects) ∧
        (ι.mapArrows.left =
          eqToHom (congrArg Over.left hHarrows) ≫ (groupoidPreRelation G).left.imageι)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isEtale_of_isEtale_comp_baseMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04QE.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` and let `U` be
a scheme of the big fppf site. A morphism from the presheaf represented by `U` to the finite
part `(X/Y)_fin` — equivalently, a morphism `U ⟶ Y` together with an open subspace of
`U ×_Y X` finite over `U` — is representable by schemes and étale as soon as its composite
with the projection `(X/Y)_fin ⟶ Y` is.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEtale_of_isEtale_comp_baseMap
    (B : AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (U : AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver B S hS)
    (p : yoneda.obj U ⟶
      (finiteOpenSubspacePresheaf B S hS f).toFunctor)
    (hp : (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
      (@Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
      (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf
        (p ≫ (finiteOpenSubspacePresheaf B S hS f).baseMap)) :
    (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
      (@Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
      (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf p

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FinitePartPresheaf.isPullback_mapOfPullbackSquare
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04QF.** Let `S` be a scheme and let a square `X' → X`, `X' → Y'`, `X → Y`,
`Y' → Y` be a fibre product square of algebraic spaces over `S`. Then the square
`(X'/Y')_fin → (X/Y)_fin`, `(X'/Y')_fin → Y'`, `(X/Y)_fin → Y`, `Y' → Y` is a fibre product
square of sheaves on the big fppf site of `S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPullback_mapOfPullbackSquare (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains S) {X' X Y' Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f' : X' ⟶ X) (g' : X' ⟶ Y')
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (h : IsPullback f' g' f g) (P : FinitePartPresheaf B S hS g')
    (Q : FinitePartPresheaf B S hS f) :
    IsPullback (mapOfPullbackSquare B S hS f' g' f g h P Q) P.baseMap Q.baseMap g.hom

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_surjective_etale_chart_finiteOpenSubspacePresheaf
declarations.doc:
The finite-part sheaf of a separated, locally quasi-finite morphism of
algebraic spaces has a surjective étale scheme cover that is étale over the
target.
declarations.statement:
theorem _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_surjective_etale_chart_finiteOpenSubspacePresheaf
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf_sep : Space.IsSeparated B S hS f.hom)
    (hf_lqf : Space.IsLocallyQuasiFinite B S hS f.hom) :
    ∃ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS)
      (p : yoneda.obj U ⟶
        (Space.finiteOpenSubspacePresheaf B S hS f).toFunctor),
      (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
        (@Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
        (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf
          (p ≫ (Space.finiteOpenSubspacePresheaf B S hS f).baseMap) ∧
      (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
        (@Surjective.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
        (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf p ∧
      (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
        (@Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
        (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf p

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAlgebraicSpace_finiteOpenSubspacePresheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04QH, the first conclusion.** The finite part `(X/Y)_fin` of a separated morphism
`f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces over `S` which is locally of finite type is an algebraic space
over `S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAlgebraicSpace_finiteOpenSubspacePresheaf
    {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hsep : IsSeparated B S hS f.hom) (hf : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f.hom) :
    IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS (finiteOpenSubspacePresheaf B S hS f).toFunctor

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isEtale_baseMap_finiteOpenSubspacePresheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04QH, the second conclusion.** The projection `(X/Y)_fin ⟶ Y` of the finite part
of a separated morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces over `S` which is locally of finite
type is étale.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEtale_baseMap_finiteOpenSubspacePresheaf
    {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hsep : IsSeparated B S hS f.hom) (hf : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f.hom) :
    IsEtale B S hS (finiteOpenSubspacePresheaf B S hS f).baseMap

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.chartInclusion_origin_ne
declarations.doc:
The two chart origins of affine space with doubled origin are distinct points of the glued
scheme.
declarations.statement:
theorem chartInclusion_origin_ne (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ) :
    chartInclusion k n 0 (affineOrigin k n) ≠ chartInclusion k n 1 (affineOrigin k n)
declarations.comment: the example: the two chart origins are distinct points

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.flat_locallyOfFinitePresentation_not_isSeparated_coordinateMorphism
declarations.doc:
In positive dimension the coordinate morphism of affine space with doubled origin is flat and
locally of finite presentation but not separated.
declarations.statement:
theorem flat_locallyOfFinitePresentation_not_isSeparated_coordinateMorphism
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    Flat (coordinateMorphism k n) ∧
      LocallyOfFinitePresentation (coordinateMorphism k n) ∧
      ¬ IsSeparated (coordinateMorphism k n)
declarations.comment: the example: flat and locally of finite presentation but not separated

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.doubledOrigin_finitePart
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04QI.** The condition that `f` be separated cannot be dropped from
Stacks 04QH. Let `X` be affine `n`-space over a field `k` with its origin doubled, `n > 0`
(the remark takes `n = 1`, the affine line with zero doubled), `Y` affine `n`-space, and
`f : X ⟶ Y` the coordinate morphism, read as a morphism of algebraic spaces over `Spec k` in a
big fppf site containing `Spec k`. Then:

1. `f` is locally of finite type but not separated, so it satisfies every hypothesis of Stacks
   04QH except separatedness;
2. over the origin of `Y` there are exactly two points `0₁ ≠ 0₂` of `X`, the chart origins, and
   `(X/Y)_fin` has exactly four points over the origin, its sections over `Spec k` lying over the
   origin, which correspond to the four subsets `∅`, `{0₁}`, `{0₂}`, `{0₁, 0₂}` of that fibre
   (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_equiv_originPoints`);
3. of these, exactly the three subsets `∅`, `{0₁}`, `{0₂}` lift to an open subscheme of
   `U ×_Y X` finite over `U` for an étale `U ⟶ Y`
   (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsEtaleLiftablePoint`, chart index `i` standing for the chart
   origin `0ᵢ`);
4. hence `(X/Y)_fin`, if it is an algebraic space, is not étale over `Y`;
5. in fact `(X/Y)_fin` is not an algebraic space ("Details omitted" in the source).

The second clause of (1) also follows from (5) and Stacks 04QH, which is how it is proved here;
(4) is proved by the argument of the remark, independently of (5).
declarations.statement:
theorem doubledOrigin_finitePart (hn : 0 < n) :
    (IsLocallyOfFiniteType B (Spec (.of k)) hk (schemeSpaceMap (doubledCoordHom B k hk n)).hom ∧
      ¬ IsSeparated B (Spec (.of k)) hk (schemeSpaceMap (doubledCoordHom B k hk n)).hom) ∧
    ((coordinateMorphism k n).base ⁻¹' {affineOrigin k n} =
        {chartInclusion k n 0 (affineOrigin k n), chartInclusion k n 1 (affineOrigin k n)} ∧
      chartInclusion k n 0 (affineOrigin k n) ≠ chartInclusion k n 1 (affineOrigin k n)) ∧
    (∃ e : originPoints (B := B) (k := k) (hk := hk) (n := n) ≃ Set (Fin 2),
      ∀ ξ, e ξ = chartIndices ((doubledOriginFinitePart B k hk n).sections _ ξ.1)) ∧
    Nat.card (originPoints (B := B) (k := k) (hk := hk) (n := n)) = 4 ∧
    {T : Set (Fin 2) | IsEtaleLiftablePoint B k hk n T} = {∅, {0}, {1}} ∧
    (IsAlgebraicSpace B (Spec (.of k)) hk (doubledOriginFinitePart B k hk n).toFunctor →
      ¬ IsEtale B (Spec (.of k)) hk (doubledOriginFinitePart B k hk n).baseMap) ∧
    ¬ IsAlgebraicSpace B (Spec (.of k)) hk (doubledOriginFinitePart B k hk n).toFunctor

declarations.name: Stacks.Examples.exists_ideal_locally_span_idempotents_not_globally
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04QL.** A closed subscheme of an affine scheme can be locally, but not globally,
cut out by ideals generated by idempotents.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_ideal_locally_span_idempotents_not_globally :
    ∃ (R : Type u) (_ : CommRing R) (I : Ideal R),
      (∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R,
        ∃ f : R, f ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
          ∃ s : Set (Localization.Away f),
            (∀ e ∈ s, IsIdempotentElem e) ∧
              Ideal.map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away f)) I = Ideal.span s) ∧
      ¬ ∃ s : Set R, (∀ e ∈ s, IsIdempotentElem e) ∧ I = Ideal.span s

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.smooth_of_isLocallyFree_relativeDifferentials_of_charZero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04QN.** A scheme locally of finite type over a field of
characteristic zero is smooth if its sheaf of relative differentials is locally free.
declarations.statement:
theorem smooth_of_isLocallyFree_relativeDifferentials_of_charZero
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [CharZero k] {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (hΩ : _root_.SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFree.{u, u, u} f.relativeDifferentials) :
    Smooth f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.smooth_of_isLocallyFree_relativeDifferentials_of_perfectField
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04QP.** A reduced scheme locally of finite type over a perfect field
is smooth if its sheaf of relative differentials is locally free.
declarations.statement:
theorem smooth_of_isLocallyFree_relativeDifferentials_of_perfectField
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [PerfectField k] {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [IsReduced X] [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (hΩ : _root_.SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFree.{u, u, u} f.relativeDifferentials) :
    Smooth f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GermOfScheme
declarations.doc: A germ of a scheme is a scheme together with a distinguished point.
declarations.statement: structure GermOfScheme

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.MorphismOfGerms
declarations.doc:
A morphism of germs of schemes is a representative defined on an open neighbourhood of the
distinguished source point, modulo agreement on a possibly smaller such neighbourhood.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def MorphismOfGerms (X S : GermOfScheme.{u}) : Type u

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.MorphismOfGerms.comp
declarations.doc:
Composition of morphisms of germs, obtained by composing representatives after restricting
the first one to the inverse image of the domain of the second.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def comp {X Y Z : GermOfScheme.{u}} :
    MorphismOfGerms X Y → MorphismOfGerms Y Z → MorphismOfGerms X Z

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.MorphismOfGerms.IsEtale
declarations.doc:
A morphism of germs is étale if it is represented on some open neighbourhood by an étale
morphism of schemes.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsEtale {X S : GermOfScheme.{u}} (f : MorphismOfGerms X S) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.MorphismOfGerms.IsSmooth
declarations.doc:
A morphism of germs is smooth if it is represented on some open neighbourhood by a smooth
morphism of schemes.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsSmooth {X S : GermOfScheme.{u}} (f : MorphismOfGerms X S) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackSnd_of_flat
declarations.doc:
A property of morphisms of schemes which is fpqc local on the target is preserved by flat base
change.
declarations.statement:
theorem pullbackSnd_of_flat
    (P : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) [P.IsLocalAtTarget Scheme.fpqcPrecoverage]
    {X Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y)
    (hf : P f) (hg : Flat g) : P (pullback.snd f g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackSnd_of_flat_locallyOfFinitePresentation
declarations.doc:
A property of morphisms of schemes which is fppf local on the target is preserved by base
change along a flat morphism which is locally of finite presentation.
declarations.statement:
theorem pullbackSnd_of_flat_locallyOfFinitePresentation
    (P : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) [P.IsLocalAtTarget Scheme.fppfPrecoverage]
    {X Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y)
    (hf : P f) (hg : Flat g) (hlfp : LocallyOfFinitePresentation g) :
    P (pullback.snd f g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackSnd_of_syntomic
declarations.doc:
A property of morphisms of schemes which is syntomic local on the target is preserved by
syntomic base change.
declarations.statement:
theorem pullbackSnd_of_syntomic (P : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
    [P.IsLocalAtTarget (Scheme.precoverage (@Syntomic.{u}))]
    {X Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y)
    (hf : P f) (hg : Syntomic g) : P (pullback.snd f g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackSnd_of_smooth
declarations.doc:
A property of morphisms of schemes which is smooth local on the target is preserved by smooth
base change.
declarations.statement:
theorem pullbackSnd_of_smooth (P : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
    [P.IsLocalAtTarget (Scheme.precoverage (@Smooth))]
    {X Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y)
    (hf : P f) (hg : Smooth g) : P (pullback.snd f g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackSnd_of_etale
declarations.doc:
A property of morphisms of schemes which is étale local on the target is preserved by étale
base change.
declarations.statement:
theorem pullbackSnd_of_etale (P : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
    [P.IsLocalAtTarget Scheme.etalePrecoverage]
    {X Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y)
    (hf : P f) (hg : Etale g) : P (pullback.snd f g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackSnd_of_isOpenImmersion
declarations.doc:
A property of morphisms of schemes which is Zariski local on the target is preserved by base
change along an open immersion.
declarations.statement:

    [P.IsLocalAtTarget Scheme.zariskiPrecoverage]
    {X Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y)
    (hf : P f) (hg : IsOpenImmersion g) : P (pullback.snd f g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.targetIsLocallyNoetherian
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04QX.** The property of a morphism of schemes that its target is
locally Noetherian.
declarations.statement: abbrev targetIsLocallyNoetherian : CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.targetIsLocallyNoetherian_not_respectsRight_etale
declarations.doc:
The property that the target is locally Noetherian is not stable under postcomposition
with an étale morphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem targetIsLocallyNoetherian_not_respectsRight_etale :
    ¬ (targetIsLocallyNoetherian : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}).RespectsRight
        (@Etale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.targetIsLocallyNoetherian_isLocalAtTarget
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04QX.** The property that the target is locally Noetherian is étale
local on the target. Stability under étale base change is "locally of finite type over a
locally Noetherian scheme"; descent is `isLocallyNoetherian_of_etale_jointlySurjective`, through
Stacks Tag 033E.
declarations.statement:
instance targetIsLocallyNoetherian_isLocalAtTarget :
    MorphismProperty.IsLocalAtTarget
      (targetIsLocallyNoetherian : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) Scheme.etalePrecoverage

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.targetIsLocallyNoetherian_iff_forall_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04QX**, locality on the source, over a nonempty source: for an étale
covering of a nonempty scheme `X` and `f : X ⟶ Y`, the target of `f` is locally Noetherian if and
only if the target of every composite with a member of the covering is.
declarations.statement:
theorem targetIsLocallyNoetherian_iff_forall_comp {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [Nonempty X]
    {R : Presieve X} (hR : R ∈ Scheme.etalePrecoverage X) :
    targetIsLocallyNoetherian f ↔
      ∀ ⦃U : Scheme.{u}⦄ ⦃g : U ⟶ X⦄, R g → targetIsLocallyNoetherian (g ≫ f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.targetIsLocallyNoetherian_not_isLocalAtSource_etale
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04QX**, locality on the source as stated, is false: the empty family is
an étale covering of the empty scheme, and the morphism from the empty scheme to the spectrum of
a non-Noetherian ring does not have a locally Noetherian target.
declarations.statement:
theorem targetIsLocallyNoetherian_not_isLocalAtSource_etale :
    ¬ (targetIsLocallyNoetherian : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}).IsLocalAtSource
        Scheme.etalePrecoverage

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsNoetherianOnSpecializations
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04QY.** Every specialization of a point in the image of a scheme
morphism has a Noetherian local ring on the target.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsNoetherianOnSpecializations {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isNoetherianOnSpecializations_isLocalAtTarget
declarations.doc: The specialization-Noetherian property is local on the target for étale coverings.
declarations.statement:
instance isNoetherianOnSpecializations_isLocalAtTarget :
    MorphismProperty.IsLocalAtTarget
      (@IsNoetherianOnSpecializations : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
      Scheme.etalePrecoverage

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isNoetherianOnSpecializations_isLocalAtSource
declarations.doc: The specialization-Noetherian property is local on the source for étale coverings.
declarations.statement:
instance isNoetherianOnSpecializations_isLocalAtSource :
    MorphismProperty.IsLocalAtSource
      (@IsNoetherianOnSpecializations : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
      Scheme.etalePrecoverage

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ManyVariableExample.exists_commSq_isNoetherianOnSpecializations_not
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04QY.** There is a commutative square with surjective étale vertical
arrows whose top morphism has the specialization-Noetherian property while its bottom morphism
does not. Together with étale locality on the source and on the target, this is the example's
point: the two localities do not add up to locality on source-and-target.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_commSq_isNoetherianOnSpecializations_not :
    ∃ (U V X Y : Scheme.{0}) (a : U ⟶ X) (b : V ⟶ Y) (h : U ⟶ V) (f : X ⟶ Y),
      a ≫ f = h ≫ b ∧ Surjective a ∧ Etale a ∧ Surjective b ∧ Etale b ∧
        IsNoetherianOnSpecializations h ∧ ¬ IsNoetherianOnSpecializations f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget
declarations.doc:
A property of morphisms of schemes is étale local on the source and target if it is
preserved by étale precomposition and étale base change, and can be checked in a commutative
square of étale neighbourhoods around every point of the source.
declarations.statement: structure IsEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget (P : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget.of_comp_etale
declarations.doc:
An étale morphism can be cancelled on the right of a composite for a property which is
étale local on the source and target.
declarations.statement:
lemma of_comp_etale {P : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}}
    (hP : IsEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget P)
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hg : Etale g) (hfg : P (f ≫ g)) : P f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget.postcomp_of_etale
declarations.doc:
A property that is étale local on the source and target is preserved by postcomposition
with an étale morphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem postcomp_of_etale (P : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
    (hP : IsEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget P) {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : P f)
    (g : Y ⟶ Z) (hg : Etale g) : P (f ≫ g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget.isLocalAtSource_etalePrecoverage
declarations.doc: A morphism property étale local on the source and target is étale local on the source.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocalAtSource_etalePrecoverage (P : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
    (hP : IsEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget P) :
    P.IsLocalAtSource Scheme.etalePrecoverage

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget.isLocalAtTarget
declarations.doc:
A property of scheme morphisms that is étale local on the source and target is étale local
on the target.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocalAtTarget (P : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
    (hP : IsEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget P) :
    P.IsLocalAtTarget Scheme.etalePrecoverage

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget.iff_forall_etale_diagrams
declarations.doc:
A property étale local on source and target holds iff it holds in every commuting square
whose vertical maps are étale.
declarations.statement:
theorem iff_forall_etale_diagrams (hP : IsEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget P) :
    P f ↔
      ∀ {U V : Scheme.{u}} (a : U ⟶ X) (b : V ⟶ Y) (h : U ⟶ V),
        Etale a → Etale b → h ≫ b = a ≫ f → P h

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget.iff_exists_surjective_etale_diagram
declarations.doc: It suffices to test one commuting étale square whose map to the source is surjective.
declarations.statement:
theorem iff_exists_surjective_etale_diagram (hP : IsEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget P) :
    P f ↔
      ∃ (U V : Scheme.{u}) (a : U ⟶ X) (b : V ⟶ Y) (h : U ⟶ V),
        Etale a ∧ Etale b ∧ Function.Surjective a.base ∧
          h ≫ b = a ≫ f ∧ P h

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget.iff_exists_etale_target_cover
declarations.doc: An étale-local property can be tested after an étale covering of the target.
declarations.statement:
theorem iff_exists_etale_target_cover (hP : IsEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget P) :
    P f ↔
      ∃ 𝒰 : Y.Cover.{u} Scheme.etalePrecoverage,
      ∀ i : 𝒰.I₀, P (pullback.fst (𝒰.f i) f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget.iff_exists_etale_source_cover
declarations.doc: An étale-local property can be tested after an étale covering of the source.
declarations.statement:
theorem iff_exists_etale_source_cover (hP : IsEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget P) :
    P f ↔
      ∃ 𝒰 : X.Cover.{u} Scheme.etalePrecoverage,
      ∀ i : 𝒰.I₀, P (𝒰.f i ≫ f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget.iff_exists_bi_etale_covers
declarations.doc:
An étale-local property can be tested after covering the target and then the base-changed
source by étale morphisms.
declarations.statement:
theorem iff_exists_bi_etale_covers (hP : IsEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget P) :
    P f ↔
      ∃ 𝒰 : Y.Cover.{u} Scheme.etalePrecoverage,
        ∀ i : 𝒰.I₀,
          ∃ 𝒱 : (pullback (𝒰.f i) f).Cover.{u} Scheme.etalePrecoverage,
            ∀ j : 𝒱.I₀, P (𝒱.f j ≫ pullback.fst (𝒰.f i) f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget_of_isLocalAtSource_isLocalAtTarget
declarations.doc:
A morphism property that is étale local on each of the source and target separately,
and is preserved by postcomposition with open immersions, is étale local on the source
and target together.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget_of_isLocalAtSource_isLocalAtTarget
    (P : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
    [P.IsLocalAtSource Scheme.etalePrecoverage]
    [P.IsLocalAtTarget Scheme.etalePrecoverage]
    [P.RespectsRight (@IsOpenImmersion : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})] :
    IsEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget P

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.etale_isEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04R3, the étale case.** Being an étale morphism of schemes is étale local on the
source and target.

The local criterion is reduced, through
`AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.iff_flat_and_formallyUnramified`, to the flat and
locally-of-finite-presentation cases of [Stacks Project, Tag 04R3] together with its unramified
case, from which formal unramifiedness is extracted by [Stacks Project, Tag 02HE].
declarations.statement:
theorem etale_isEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget :
    IsEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget (@Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyOfFinitePresentation.isEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget
declarations.doc:
Being a morphism of schemes locally of finite presentation is étale local on the source and
target.
declarations.statement:
theorem LocallyOfFinitePresentation.isEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget :
    IsEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget
      (@LocallyOfFinitePresentation : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyOfFiniteType.isEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04R3, the case of being locally of finite type.** Being a morphism of
schemes locally of finite type is étale local on the source and target.
declarations.statement:
theorem LocallyOfFiniteType.isEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget :
    IsEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget
      (@LocallyOfFiniteType : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Flat.isEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04R3, flat case.** Being a flat morphism of schemes is étale local on
the source and target.
declarations.statement:
theorem Flat.isEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget :
    IsEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget (@Flat : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget_gUnramified
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04R3, item (10).** Being a G-unramified morphism of schemes is étale
local on the source and target.

This is the criterion of Tag 04R2 applied to G-unramifiedness: it is étale local on the source
and on the target by the two instances above, and postcomposition with an open immersion
preserves it. The source cites Tag 03YV for the first and Tag 02VM for the second; the two
localities used here are the ones proved in this file, which is enough, since Tag 04R2 asks for
étale locality only.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget_gUnramified :
    IsEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget (@GUnramified.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.locallyOfFiniteType_inf_locallyQuasiFinite_isEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04R3, the case of being locally quasi-finite.** Being a morphism of schemes
locally of finite type and locally quasi-finite is étale local on the source and target.
declarations.statement:
theorem locallyOfFiniteType_inf_locallyQuasiFinite_isEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget :
    IsEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget
      ((@LocallyOfFiniteType.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) ⊓
        (@LocallyQuasiFinite.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Smooth.isEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04R3, smooth case.** Being a smooth morphism of schemes is étale
local on the source and target.
declarations.statement:
theorem Smooth.isEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget :
    IsEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget (@Smooth : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.UniversallyOpen.isEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget
declarations.doc: Being a universally open morphism of schemes is étale local on the source and target.
declarations.statement:
theorem UniversallyOpen.isEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget :
    IsEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget (@UniversallyOpen : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Unramified.isEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04R3, unramified case.** Being an unramified morphism of schemes is
étale local on the source and target.

This is the formal half of Tag 04R2 applied to unramifiedness: it is local on the source for the
étale topology by the instance above, stable under arbitrary base change by Tag 02GA, and
preserved by postcomposition with an étale morphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem Unramified.isEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget :
    IsEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget (@Unramified : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.syntomic_isEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04R3, syntomic case.** Being a syntomic morphism of schemes is étale
local on the source and target.

The geometric content of Tag 04R2 is not needed: postcomposition with an étale morphism
preserves syntomicity outright, by `AlgebraicGeometry.Syntomic.respectsRight_etale`, and base
change is Tag 01UI. The local criterion comes from étale source-locality of syntomic morphisms
of schemes, `AlgebraicGeometry.Syntomic.isLocalAtSource_etalePrecoverage`.
declarations.statement:
theorem syntomic_isEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget :
    IsEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget (@Syntomic.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.MorphismOfGerms.hasRepresentativeWithProperty_isEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget
declarations.doc:
Étale locality on the source and target of a property of morphisms of schemes passes to
the property it induces on morphisms of germs.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasRepresentativeWithProperty_isEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget
    (P : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
    (hP : AlgebraicGeometry.IsEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget P) :
    IsEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget (HasRepresentativeWithProperty P)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget.iff_forall_hasRepresentativeWithProperty
declarations.doc:
A property of morphisms of schemes which is étale local on the source and target holds for
a morphism exactly when the associated property of morphisms of germs holds for every induced
morphism of germs.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget.iff_forall_hasRepresentativeWithProperty
    (P : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) (hP : IsEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget P)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    P f ↔ ∀ x : X, MorphismOfGerms.HasRepresentativeWithProperty P
      (MorphismOfGerms.ofSchemeHom f x)

declarations.name: Stacks.Groupoids.GroupoidScheme.conormalToDifferentials
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks Project, Tag 04R9]: the canonical map `t^* 𝒞_{U/R} ⟶ Ω_{R/U}`**, from the pullback
along the target morphism of the conormal sheaf of the identity section to the sheaf of
relative differentials of the source morphism.

It is the canonical map of conormal sheaves of [Stacks Project, Tag 01R4] attached to the
cartesian square `Stacks.Groupoids.GroupoidScheme.isPullback_diagonal_divide`, whose source is
`t^* 𝒞_{U/R}` and whose target is the conormal sheaf of the diagonal of `s`, followed by the
inverse of the isomorphism of [Stacks Project, Tag 08S2] identifying that conormal sheaf with
`Ω_{R/U}`. See the module docstring on which of `s` and `t` carries the differentials.
declarations.statement:
def conormalToDifferentials :
    (RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.modulePullback G.target.left.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj
        (Stacks.Conormal.conormalSheaf G.identity.left) ⟶
      Scheme.Hom.relativeDifferentials G.source.left

declarations.name: Stacks.Groupoids.GroupoidScheme.epi_conormalToDifferentials
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks Project, Tag 04R9]: the canonical map `t^* 𝒞_{U/R} ⟶ Ω_{R/U}` is surjective.**
The sheaf of differentials of `R` over `U` is a quotient of the pullback along the target
morphism of the conormal sheaf of the identity section.

The map of conormal sheaves of the cartesian square is surjective by
[Stacks Project, Tag 0473], and the comparison of [Stacks Project, Tag 08S2] is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement: theorem epi_conormalToDifferentials : Epi G.conormalToDifferentials

declarations.name: Stacks.Groupoids.GroupoidScheme.isIso_conormalToDifferentials
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks Project, Tag 04R9]: the canonical map `t^* 𝒞_{U/R} ⟶ Ω_{R/U}` is an isomorphism
when the source morphism is flat.** With `R` over `U` via `s`, the sheaf of differentials of `R`
over `U` is then *equal* to the pullback along the target morphism of the conormal sheaf of the
identity section, not merely a quotient of it.

Flatness of `s` makes division flat, by
`Stacks.Groupoids.GroupoidScheme.flat_divide`: division is a base change of the target morphism,
which is flat with the source morphism because the inverse is an isomorphism. The map of conormal
sheaves of the cartesian square is then an isomorphism by the flat half of
[Stacks Project, Tag 0473], and so is the comparison of [Stacks Project, Tag 08S2].
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_conormalToDifferentials [Flat G.source.left] :
    IsIso G.conormalToDifferentials
declarations.comment: an isomorphism when the source morphism is flat

declarations.name: Stacks.Groupoids.GroupoidScheme.targetConormalToDifferentials
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks Project, Tag 04R9]: the canonical map `s^* 𝒞_{U/R} ⟶ Ω_{R/U}`**, with `R` over `U`
via `t`. This is the reading of the tag in which the differentials are those of the target
morphism; it is the previous map pulled back along the inverse, and is built here the same way,
from the cartesian square
`Stacks.Groupoids.GroupoidScheme.isPullback_diagonal_divideTarget` and the isomorphism of
[Stacks Project, Tag 08S2].
declarations.statement:
def targetConormalToDifferentials :
    (RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.modulePullback G.source.left.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj
        (Stacks.Conormal.conormalSheaf G.identity.left) ⟶
      Scheme.Hom.relativeDifferentials G.target.left
declarations.comment: the canonical map for the differentials of the target

declarations.name: Stacks.Groupoids.GroupoidScheme.epi_targetConormalToDifferentials
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks Project, Tag 04R9]: the canonical map `s^* 𝒞_{U/R} ⟶ Ω_{R/U}` is surjective**, with
`R` over `U` via `t`. The sheaf of differentials of `R` seen as a scheme over `U` via the target
morphism is a quotient of the pullback along the source morphism of the conormal sheaf of the
identity section.
declarations.statement: theorem epi_targetConormalToDifferentials : Epi G.targetConormalToDifferentials
declarations.comment: the canonical surjection for the differentials of the target

declarations.name: Stacks.Groupoids.GroupoidScheme.isIso_targetConormalToDifferentials
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks Project, Tag 04R9]: the canonical map `s^* 𝒞_{U/R} ⟶ Ω_{R/U}` is an isomorphism
when the source morphism is flat**, with `R` over `U` via `t`. This is the second reading of the
tag, in which the differentials are those of the target morphism.

Here flatness of `s` is used directly: division on this side is a base change of the source
morphism, by `Stacks.Groupoids.GroupoidScheme.isPullback_divideTarget_fst`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_targetConormalToDifferentials [Flat G.source.left] :
    IsIso G.targetConormalToDifferentials
declarations.comment: an isomorphism for the differentials of the target when the source map is flat

declarations.name: Stacks.Groupoids.GroupoidScheme.smooth_source_left_of_charZero
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks Project, Tag 04RA]: the source morphism of a groupoid scheme on a field of
characteristic zero is smooth.** If the scheme of objects of a groupoid scheme is the spectrum of
a field of characteristic zero and the source morphism is locally of finite type, then the source
morphism is smooth.

The sheaf of differentials `Ω_{R/U}` is free by
`Stacks.Groupoids.GroupoidScheme.exists_free_iso_relativeDifferentials_source_left`, and a
scheme locally of finite type over a field of characteristic zero whose differentials are locally
free is smooth by [Stacks Project, Tag 04QN].
declarations.statement:
theorem smooth_source_left_of_charZero [CharZero k] (e : G.objects.left ≅ Spec (.of k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType G.source.left] : Smooth G.source.left

declarations.name: Stacks.Groupoids.GroupoidScheme.smooth_target_left_of_charZero
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks Project, Tag 04RA]: the target morphism of a groupoid scheme on a field of
characteristic zero is smooth.** This is the previous statement transported along the inverse,
which is an automorphism of the scheme of arrows carrying the source morphism to the target
morphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem smooth_target_left_of_charZero [CharZero k] (e : G.objects.left ≅ Spec (.of k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType G.source.left] : Smooth G.target.left

declarations.name: Stacks.Groupoids.GroupoidScheme.smooth_source_left_of_isReduced_of_perfectField
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks Project, Tag 04RB]: the source morphism of a groupoid scheme with reduced scheme of
arrows on a perfect field is smooth.** If the scheme of objects of a groupoid scheme is the
spectrum of a perfect field, the source morphism is locally of finite type and the scheme of
arrows is reduced, then the source morphism is smooth.

The sheaf of differentials `Ω_{R/U}` is free by
`Stacks.Groupoids.GroupoidScheme.exists_free_iso_relativeDifferentials_source_left`, and a
reduced scheme locally of finite type over a perfect field whose differentials are locally free
is smooth by [Stacks Project, Tag 04QP].
declarations.statement:
theorem smooth_source_left_of_isReduced_of_perfectField [PerfectField k]
    (e : G.objects.left ≅ Spec (.of k)) [IsReduced G.arrows.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType G.source.left] : Smooth G.source.left

declarations.name: Stacks.Groupoids.GroupoidScheme.smooth_target_left_of_isReduced_of_perfectField
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks Project, Tag 04RB]: the target morphism of a groupoid scheme with reduced scheme of
arrows on a perfect field is smooth.** This is the previous statement transported along the
inverse, which is an automorphism of the scheme of arrows carrying the source morphism to the
target morphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem smooth_target_left_of_isReduced_of_perfectField [PerfectField k]
    (e : G.objects.left ≅ Spec (.of k)) [IsReduced G.arrows.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType G.source.left] : Smooth G.target.left

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasPropertyAtPoint
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04RC.** A property `P` of germs of schemes holds at a point `x` of an algebraic
space `F` when it holds at the germ of some étale scheme chart `yoneda.obj U ⟶ F` at some
field-valued point of `U` lying over `x`. For an étale-local property the choice of chart is
immaterial, by `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.forall_etale_chart_iff_exists_etale_chart`; stating
this one-chart condition needs neither that hypothesis nor that `F` is an algebraic space.
declarations.statement:
abbrev HasPropertyAtPoint (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (x : points B S hS F)
    (P : GermOfScheme.{u} → Prop) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HoldsOnEveryEtaleChartAtPoint
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04RE.** The property holds in every pair of étale charts at the point. For a
property of morphisms of germs of schemes which is étale local on the source-and-target this
is the definition of a morphism of algebraic spaces *having that property at a point*: by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.holdsOnEveryEtaleChartAtPoint_iff_some` it is equivalent to the
some-chart condition, which is the equivalence the definition invokes.
declarations.statement:
abbrev HoldsOnEveryEtaleChartAtPoint
    (Q : ∀ {X Y : GermOfScheme.{u}}, MorphismOfGerms X Y → Prop)
    (f : F ⟶ G) (x : points B S hS F) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.holdsOnEveryEtaleChartAtPoint_iff_exists_open
declarations.doc:
A morphism has the germ property at a point exactly when it has the
corresponding scheme-morphism property on an open neighbourhood of that point.
declarations.statement:
theorem holdsOnEveryEtaleChartAtPoint_iff_exists_open
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (P : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
    (hP : AlgebraicGeometry.IsEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget P)
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : points B S hS X) :
    HoldsOnEveryEtaleChartAtPoint B S hS
      (MorphismOfGerms.HasRepresentativeWithProperty P) f x ↔
      ∃ (U : Subfunctor X), IsOpenSubspace B S hS U ∧
        x ∈ Set.range (pointsMap B S hS U.toFunctor U.ι) ∧
          HoldsOnEveryEtaleChart B S hS P (U.ι ≫ f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.holdsOnEveryEtaleChart_iff_forall_atPoint
declarations.doc:
A morphism of algebraic spaces has an étale-local property if and only if
its germ has the associated property at every source point.
declarations.statement:
theorem holdsOnEveryEtaleChart_iff_forall_atPoint
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (P : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
    (hP : AlgebraicGeometry.IsEtaleLocalOnSourceAndTarget P)
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    HoldsOnEveryEtaleChart B S hS P f ↔
      ∀ x : points B S hS X,
        HoldsOnEveryEtaleChartAtPoint B S hS
          (MorphismOfGerms.HasRepresentativeWithProperty P) f x

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsEtaleAt
declarations.doc:
A morphism of algebraic spaces is étale at a point if it is étale on an open subspace
containing that point.
declarations.statement:
abbrev IsEtaleAt (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (x : points B S hS X) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSeparated_baseMap_finiteOpenSubspacePresheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04RI, part (1).** For a separated, flat morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces
over `S` which is locally of finite presentation, the projection `(X/Y)_fin ⟶ Y` from the
finite part of `f` is separated.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSeparated_baseMap_finiteOpenSubspacePresheaf
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hsep : IsSeparated B S hS f.hom)
    (hflat : IsFlat B S hS f.hom)
    (hfp : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS f.hom) :
    IsSeparated B S hS (finiteOpenSubspacePresheaf B S hS f).baseMap

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isEtale_baseMap_finiteOpenSubspacePresheaf_of_isFlat
declarations.doc:
For a separated, flat morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces over `S` which is locally of
finite presentation, the projection `(X/Y)_fin ⟶ Y` from the finite part of `f` is étale: such
a morphism is in particular locally of finite type.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEtale_baseMap_finiteOpenSubspacePresheaf_of_isFlat
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hsep : IsSeparated B S hS f.hom)
    (_hflat : IsFlat B S hS f.hom)
    (hfp : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS f.hom) :
    IsEtale B S hS (finiteOpenSubspacePresheaf B S hS f).baseMap

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.relativelyRepresentable_baseMap_finiteOpenSubspacePresheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04RI, part (1).** For a separated, flat morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces
over `S` which is locally of finite presentation, the projection `(X/Y)_fin ⟶ Y` from the finite
part of `f` is representable: it is étale, hence locally quasi-finite, and separated.
declarations.statement:
theorem relativelyRepresentable_baseMap_finiteOpenSubspacePresheaf
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hsep : IsSeparated B S hS f.hom)
    (hflat : IsFlat B S hS f.hom)
    (hfp : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS f.hom) :
    yoneda.relativelyRepresentable (finiteOpenSubspacePresheaf B S hS f).baseMap

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isRepresentable_finiteOpenSubspacePresheaf_of_isRepresentable
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04RI, part (2).** If moreover `Y` is a scheme, then the finite part `(X/Y)_fin` of
a separated, flat morphism locally of finite presentation is a scheme: it is separated and
locally quasi-finite over the representable `Y`, so Stacks 03XX applies.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRepresentable_finiteOpenSubspacePresheaf_of_isRepresentable
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hsep : IsSeparated B S hS f.hom)
    (hflat : IsFlat B S hS f.hom)
    (hfp : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS f.hom)
    (hY : Y.obj.IsRepresentable) :
    (finiteOpenSubspacePresheaf B S hS f).toFunctor.IsRepresentable
declarations.comment: part (2): the finite part over a scheme is a scheme

declarations.name: Stacks.Groupoids.GroupoidScheme.isQuasiSplitAt_of_isLocallyArtinian_arrows
declarations.doc:
**A groupoid scheme with a one-point object scheme and a zero-dimensional arrow scheme is
quasi-split at every point of its object scheme**, in the sense of part (3) of
**Stacks 04RK**.
declarations.statement: theorem isQuasiSplitAt_of_isLocallyArtinian_arrows (u : G.objects.left) : IsQuasiSplitAt G u
declarations.comment: part (3): a groupoid scheme with a one-point object scheme and a zero-dimensional arrow scheme is quasi-split at every point of its object scheme, the quasi-splitting being the open and closed piece of the arrow scheme through the identity

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.OpenFiniteSubgroupoid
declarations.doc:
An open subspace of the arrow space of a groupoid in algebraic spaces which is itself a
groupoid on the ambient object space, with the restricted source and target morphisms finite
and with composition the restriction of the ambient composition.

This is conditions (a) and (b) shared by the three splittings of **Stacks 04RK**.
declarations.statement: structure OpenFiniteSubgroupoid (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B)
declarations.comment: conditions (a) and (b) on the open subspace

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.identityPoint_hasCommonExtension
declarations.doc:
Taking the identity arrow at a field-valued point of the object space respects common
extension, so it descends to the points of the two spaces.
declarations.statement:
theorem identityPoint_hasCommonExtension (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B)
    {p q : Space.FieldValuedPoint C S hS G.objects.obj}
    (h : Space.FieldValuedPoint.HasCommonExtension C S hS G.objects.obj p q) :
    Space.FieldValuedPoint.HasCommonExtension C S hS G.arrows.obj
      (identityPoint G p) (identityPoint G q)
declarations.comment: part (3): the identity on points is well defined

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.StrongSplitting
declarations.doc:
A strong splitting of a groupoid in algebraic spaces at a point `u` of its object space: an
open finite subgroupoid containing every point of the arrow space whose source and target are
both `u`.
declarations.statement:
structure StrongSplitting (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B)
    (u : Space.points C S hS G.objects.obj) extends OpenFiniteSubgroupoid G

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.Splitting
declarations.doc:
A splitting of a groupoid in algebraic spaces at a point `u` of its object space: an open
finite subgroupoid containing every point of the stabilizer which lies over `u`.
declarations.statement:
structure Splitting (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B)
    (u : Space.points C S hS G.objects.obj) extends OpenFiniteSubgroupoid G

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.QuasiSplitting
declarations.doc:
A quasi-splitting of a groupoid in algebraic spaces at a point `u` of its object space: an
open finite subgroupoid containing the identity arrow at `u`.
declarations.statement:
structure QuasiSplitting (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B)
    (u : Space.points C S hS G.objects.obj) extends OpenFiniteSubgroupoid G

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.IsStronglySplitAt
declarations.doc:
A groupoid in algebraic spaces is *strongly split* at a point of its object space when a
strong splitting there exists.
declarations.statement:
abbrev IsStronglySplitAt (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B)
    (u : Space.points C S hS G.objects.obj) : Prop
declarations.comment: part (1): strongly split over a point

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.IsSplitAt
declarations.doc:
A groupoid in algebraic spaces is *split* at a point of its object space when a splitting
there exists.
declarations.statement:
abbrev IsSplitAt (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B)
    (u : Space.points C S hS G.objects.obj) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.IsQuasiSplitAt
declarations.doc:
A groupoid in algebraic spaces is *quasi-split* at a point of its object space when a
quasi-splitting there exists.
declarations.statement:
abbrev IsQuasiSplitAt (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces C S hS B)
    (u : Space.points C S hS G.objects.obj) : Prop

declarations.name: Stacks.Groupoids.GroupoidScheme.OpenFiniteSubgroupoid
declarations.doc:
An open subscheme of the arrow scheme of a groupoid scheme which is itself a groupoid scheme
on the ambient object scheme, with the restricted source and target morphisms finite and with
composition the restriction of the ambient composition.

This is conditions (a) and (b) shared by the three splittings of **Stacks 04RK**, read for a
groupoid scheme.
declarations.statement: structure OpenFiniteSubgroupoid (G : GroupoidScheme S)
declarations.comment: conditions (a) and (b) on the open subscheme, for a groupoid scheme

declarations.name: Stacks.Groupoids.GroupoidScheme.QuasiSplitting
declarations.doc:
A quasi-splitting of a groupoid scheme over a point `u` of its object scheme: an open finite
subgroupoid whose scheme of arrows contains the identity arrow `e(u)`.
declarations.statement:
structure QuasiSplitting (G : GroupoidScheme S) (u : G.objects.left) extends
    OpenFiniteSubgroupoid G
declarations.comment: part (3), for a groupoid scheme: a quasi-splitting of R over u

declarations.name: Stacks.Groupoids.GroupoidScheme.IsQuasiSplitAt
declarations.doc:
A groupoid scheme is *quasi-split* over a point of its object scheme when a quasi-splitting
there exists.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsQuasiSplitAt (G : GroupoidScheme S) (u : G.objects.left) : Prop
declarations.comment: part (3), for a groupoid scheme: R is quasi-split over u

declarations.name: Stacks.Groupoids.GroupoidScheme.OpenFiniteSubgroupoid.toQuasiSplitting
declarations.doc:
The footnote to part (3) of **Stacks 04RK**: condition (c) is implied by condition (a).
An open finite subgroupoid of a groupoid scheme contains the identity arrow at every point of
the object scheme, because the inclusion is a morphism of groupoid schemes which is the identity
on objects, and so carries the identity section of the subgroupoid to that of the ambient
groupoid.
declarations.statement:
def OpenFiniteSubgroupoid.toQuasiSplitting {G : GroupoidScheme S} (P : OpenFiniteSubgroupoid G)
    (u : G.objects.left) : QuasiSplitting G u
declarations.comment: the footnote to part (3): condition (c) follows from condition (a)

declarations.name: Stacks.Groupoids.GroupoidScheme.StrongSplitting
declarations.doc:
A strong splitting of a groupoid scheme over a point `u` of its object scheme: an open
finite subgroupoid whose scheme of arrows contains every arrow of `R` whose source and target
are both `u`.

This is part (1) of **Stacks 04RK**, read for a groupoid scheme.  It is strictly stronger than
`Stacks.Groupoids.GroupoidScheme.QuasiSplitting`, whose condition (c) asks only for the identity
arrow `e(u)`; see `Stacks.Groupoids.GroupoidScheme.StrongSplitting.toQuasiSplitting`.
declarations.statement:
structure StrongSplitting (G : GroupoidScheme S) (u : G.objects.left) extends
    OpenFiniteSubgroupoid G
declarations.comment: part (1), for a groupoid scheme: a strong splitting of R over u

declarations.name: Stacks.Groupoids.GroupoidScheme.IsStronglySplitAt
declarations.doc:
A groupoid scheme is *strongly split* over a point of its object scheme when a strong
splitting there exists.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsStronglySplitAt (G : GroupoidScheme S) (u : G.objects.left) : Prop
declarations.comment: part (1), for a groupoid scheme: R is strongly split over u

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.StrongSplittingSituation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04RL.** The standing strong splitting situation for a groupoid
scheme: a chosen object with finite stabilizer, at whose stabilizer points the source is
quasi-finite.
declarations.statement: structure StrongSplittingSituation

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.restrict
declarations.doc:
Restriction along an arbitrary map to the object space, with its canonical

declarations.comment: the fibre-product diagram defining R' with its source and target maps

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.isLocallyOfFiniteType_restrict_source
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04RP.** If the source of a groupoid in algebraic spaces over `B` and the morphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.isLocallyOfFinitePresentation_restrict_source
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04RP.** If the source of a groupoid in algebraic spaces over `B` and the morphism
`g` along which it is restricted are locally of finite presentation, then so is the source of

theorem isLocallyOfFinitePresentation_restrict_source

    Space.IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation C S hS (restrict G g).groupoid.source.hom
declarations.comment: part (2): the restricted source is locally of finite presentation

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces.isLocallyOfFinitePresentation_restrict_target
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04RP.** If the target of a groupoid in algebraic spaces over `B` and the morphism
`g` along which it is restricted are locally of finite presentation, then so is the target of

    Space.IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation C S hS (restrict G g).groupoid.target.hom

declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04RP.** If the source of a groupoid in algebraic spaces over `B` and the morphism

    Space.IsFlat C S hS (restrict G g).groupoid.source.hom

declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04RP.** If the target of a groupoid in algebraic spaces over `B` and the morphism

theorem isFlat_restrict_target (ht : Space.IsFlat C S hS G.target.hom)

    Space.IsFlat C S hS (restrict G g).groupoid.target.hom

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FiniteOpenPairWithSection
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04RQ.** For a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces over `S` with a section
`σ`, and an algebraic space `T`, a morphism `a : T ⟶ Y` together with an open subspace `Z` of
`T ×_Y X` which is finite over `T` and contains the section of `T ×_Y X` over `T` induced
by `σ`.
declarations.statement:
structure FiniteOpenPairWithSection (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (X Y T : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS) (f : X ⟶ Y) (σ : Y ⟶ X)
    (hσ : σ.hom ≫ f.hom = 𝟙 Y.obj)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.finitePartWithSection
declarations.doc:
The canonical transformation from finite open pairs containing a section
to all finite open pairs, with its pointwise characterization.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def finitePartWithSection
    (B : AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y : AlgebraicGeometry.AlgebraicSpaces B S hS}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (σ : Y ⟶ X) (hσ : σ.hom ≫ f.hom = 𝟙 Y.obj) :
    FinitePartWithSection B S hS f σ hσ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isOpenImmersion_finitePartWithSection
declarations.doc: The transformation is representable by open immersions.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isOpenImmersion_finitePartWithSection
    (B : AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y : AlgebraicGeometry.AlgebraicSpaces B S hS}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (σ : Y ⟶ X) (hσ : σ.hom ≫ f.hom = 𝟙 Y.obj) :
