declarations.statement: theorem isIso_of_isIso_base : IsIso φ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SheafTorsors.projection_effectiveDescent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04UM.** Condition (3) of Stacks 02ZI for the functor
`p : 𝒢/ℬ-Torsors ⥤ (Sch/S)_fppf` of Stacks 04UL: every descent datum of `𝒢/ℬ-Torsors`
relative to a covering family of the big fppf site of `S` is effective.
declarations.statement:
theorem projection_effectiveDescent
    (hB : Presheaf.IsSheaf (BigFppfOver.topology 𝒞 S hS) B)
    (hG : Presheaf.IsSheaf (BigFppfOver.topology 𝒞 S hS) G.X.left) :
    ∀ {U : BigFppfOver 𝒞 S hS} {I : Type w} (V : I → BigFppfOver 𝒞 S hS)
      (f : ∀ i, V i ⟶ U), Sieve.ofArrows V f ∈ BigFppfOver.topology 𝒞 S hS U →
      ∀ (Vij : I → I → BigFppfOver 𝒞 S hS)
        (pr₁ : ∀ i j, Vij i j ⟶ V i) (pr₂ : ∀ i j, Vij i j ⟶ V j)
        (hVij : ∀ i j, IsPullback (pr₁ i j) (pr₂ i j) (f i) (f j))
        (Vijk : I → I → I → BigFppfOver 𝒞 S hS)
        (s₁₂ : ∀ i j k, Vijk i j k ⟶ Vij i j) (s₂₃ : ∀ i j k, Vijk i j k ⟶ Vij j k)
        (hVijk : ∀ i j k, IsPullback (s₁₂ i j k) (s₂₃ i j k) (pr₂ i j) (pr₁ j k))
        (q₁ : ∀ i j k, Vijk i j k ⟶ V i) (q₂ : ∀ i j k, Vijk i j k ⟶ V j)
        (q₃ : ∀ i j k, Vijk i j k ⟶ V k)
        (hq₁ : ∀ i j k, q₁ i j k = s₁₂ i j k ≫ pr₁ i j)
        (hq₂ : ∀ i j k, q₂ i j k = s₁₂ i j k ≫ pr₂ i j)
        (hq₃ : ∀ i j k, q₃ i j k = s₂₃ i j k ≫ pr₂ j k)
        (D : Functor.DescentDatum (projection G) V f Vij pr₁ pr₂ hVij Vijk s₁₂ s₂₃ hVijk
          q₁ q₂ q₃ hq₁ hq₂ hq₃),
        D.IsEffective

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SheafTorsors.projection_isStackInGroupoids
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04UM.** The functor `p : 𝒢/ℬ-Torsors ⥤ (Sch/S)_fppf` of Stacks 04UL is a stack in
groupoids over the big fppf site of `S`: the three conditions of Stacks 02ZI, namely
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SheafTorsors.projection_isFiberedInGroupoids`,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SheafTorsors.projection_isomIsSheaf` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SheafTorsors.projection_effectiveDescent`.
declarations.statement:
theorem projection_isStackInGroupoids
    (hB : Presheaf.IsSheaf (BigFppfOver.topology 𝒞 S hS) B)
    (hG : Presheaf.IsSheaf (BigFppfOver.topology 𝒞 S hS) G.X.left) :
    Functor.IsStackInGroupoids.{w} (projection G) (BigFppfOver.topology 𝒞 S hS)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SheafTorsors.projection_isFiberedInGroupoids
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04UM.** Condition (1) of Stacks 02ZI for the functor
`p : 𝒢/ℬ-Torsors ⥤ (Sch/S)_fppf` of Stacks 04UL: `p` is fibred in groupoids. Every morphism
`f : V ⟶ U` of the big fppf site of `S` lifts to the restriction `(V, b ∘ f, f^{-1}F)` of an
object `(U, b, F)` along `f`, and fill-ins exist and are unique.
declarations.statement: theorem projection_isFiberedInGroupoids : (projection G).IsFiberedInGroupoids
declarations.comment: condition (1): p is fibred in groupoids

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SheafTorsors.projection_isomIsSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04UM.** Condition (2) of Stacks 02ZI for the functor
`p : 𝒢/ℬ-Torsors ⥤ (Sch/S)_fppf` of Stacks 04UL: for two objects `(U, b, F)` and `(U, b', F')`
over the same object of the big fppf site of `S`, the presheaf `Isom(F, F')` is a sheaf. A family
of isomorphisms of the restrictions along a covering family which agree on the overlaps glues,
uniquely, to an isomorphism over `U`, because the total spaces are sheaves and the restrictions
have as total spaces their base changes.
declarations.statement:
theorem projection_isomIsSheaf
    (hB : Presheaf.IsSheaf (BigFppfOver.topology 𝒞 S hS) B) :
    ∀ {U : BigFppfOver 𝒞 S hS} (x y : SheafTorsors G)
      (hx : (projection G).obj x = U) (hy : (projection G).obj y = U)
      {I : Type w} (V : I → BigFppfOver 𝒞 S hS) (f : ∀ i, V i ⟶ U),
      Sieve.ofArrows V f ∈ BigFppfOver.topology 𝒞 S hS U →
      ∀ (Vij : I → I → BigFppfOver 𝒞 S hS)
        (pr₁ : ∀ i j, Vij i j ⟶ V i) (pr₂ : ∀ i j, Vij i j ⟶ V j)
        (hVij : ∀ i j, IsPullback (pr₁ i j) (pr₂ i j) (f i) (f j))
        (xr : ∀ i, Functor.Restriction (projection G) (f i) x hx)
        (yr : ∀ i, Functor.Restriction (projection G) (f i) y hy)
        (xrij : ∀ i j, Functor.Restriction (projection G) (pr₁ i j ≫ f i) x hx)
        (yrij : ∀ i j, Functor.Restriction (projection G) (pr₁ i j ≫ f i) y hy),
        Functor.IsomIsSheafFor (projection G) x y hx hy V f Vij pr₁ pr₂ hVij xr yr xrij yrij
declarations.comment: condition (2): the Isom presheaves are sheaves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.TorsorsFor.Hom
declarations.doc:
A morphism `(U, b, X) ⟶ (U', b', X')` of torsors: a morphism `f : U ⟶ U'` over `B` together
with an equivariant identification of `X` with `U ×_{f, U'} X'`.
declarations.statement: structure Hom (T T' : TorsorsFor hB G P)
declarations.comment: the morphisms of G-Principal, stated for an arbitrary trivializing covering property

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.TorsorsFor.instCategory
declarations.doc:
The torsors under a group algebraic space `G` over `B` which are trivialized by a family
satisfying `P` form a category: morphisms compose by composing `f` and the identification of the
total spaces.
declarations.statement: instance instCategory : Category (TorsorsFor hB G P)
declarations.comment: the category G-Principal, whose composition is stated for an arbitrary trivializing covering property

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.TorsorsFor.isIso_of_isIso_base
declarations.doc:
A morphism of torsors whose morphism `f` of the big fppf site is an isomorphism is itself an
isomorphism. Every morphism of a fibre category of the functor `p` to the site lies over an
identity, so this says that the fibre category over `U` — the disjoint union over the morphisms
`b : U ⟶ B` of the categories of torsors under `U ×_{b, B} G` trivialized by a family satisfying
`P` — is a groupoid.
declarations.statement: theorem isIso_of_isIso_base : IsIso φ
declarations.comment: the fibre categories of p : G-Principal ⥤ (Sch/S)_fppf are groupoids, by the assertion for an arbitrary trivializing covering property

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.PrincipalHomogeneousSpaces
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04UN.** An object of the category `G-Principal`: an object `U` of the big fppf site
of `S`, a morphism `b : U ⟶ B`, and a principal homogeneous space `X` over `U` under
`G_U = U ×_{b, B} G`, that is a pseudo-torsor trivialized by an fpqc covering of `U`.
declarations.statement: abbrev PrincipalHomogeneousSpaces

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.PrincipalHomogeneousSpaces.projection
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04UN.** The functor `p : G-Principal ⥤ (Sch/S)_fppf` sending `(U, b, X)` to `U`,
which is how `G-Principal` is regarded as a category over the big fppf site of `S`.
declarations.statement:
abbrev PrincipalHomogeneousSpaces.projection :
    PrincipalHomogeneousSpaces hB G ⥤ BigFppfOver 𝒞 S hS
declarations.comment: the functor p to the site

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.PrincipalHomogeneousSpaces.isStackInGroupoids_of_descent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04UP.** If principal homogeneous spaces satisfy effective descent along the
coverings of `(Sch/S)_fppf` (items (1)–(4) of the remark,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.PrincipalHomogeneousSpaceDescent`), then
`p : G-Principal ⥤ (Sch/S)_fppf` is a stack in groupoids over `(Sch/S)_fppf`.

This is the formal content of the remark: Stacks conjectures that `p` is a stack in groupoids and
says that this would follow from the descent statement (1)–(4), whose proof by the technique of
Stacks 04U1 stops at a set theoretical question; that descent statement is the antecedent here,
and the implication is proved in full.

* Condition (1) of Stacks 02ZI, that `p` is fibred in groupoids, is
  `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.PrincipalHomogeneousSpaces.projection_isFiberedInGroupoids`.
* Condition (2), that the `Isom` presheaves are sheaves, is
  `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.TorsorsFor.projection_isomIsSheaf` at the fpqc coverings: isomorphisms
  of total spaces glue because the total spaces are algebraic spaces, hence sheaves.
* Condition (3): given a descent datum of `G-Principal` along a covering `{Vᵢ ⟶ U}`, the sections
  `bᵢ : Vᵢ ⟶ B` glue to `b : U ⟶ B` because `B` is a sheaf
  (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.PrincipalHomogeneousSpaces.exists_glued_sec`); with
  `H = U ×_{b, B} G` the acting groups `Vᵢ ×_{bᵢ, B} G` are identified with `H_{Vᵢ}`
  (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.groupCompIso`), which turns the datum into one of the shape (1)–(4)
  (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.PrincipalHomogeneousSpaces.descentDatumOfBase`); the antecedent makes
  it effective, and the descended principal homogeneous `H`-space read back in `G-Principal`
  makes the original datum effective
  (`PrincipalHomogeneousSpaces.isEffective_of_isEffective_descentDatumOfBase`).

"Up to a replacement as in Stacks 03ZZ" is not needed: an object of `G-Principal` carries as total
space an object of the slice over a representable presheaf of the set-sized big fppf site, so
`G-Principal` is a genuine category and `p` a functor, as for Stacks 04US.
declarations.statement:
theorem isStackInGroupoids_of_descent (h : PrincipalHomogeneousSpaceDescent.{w} 𝒞 S hS) :
    Functor.IsStackInGroupoids.{w} (projection hB G) (BigFppfOver.topology 𝒞 S hS)
declarations.comment: p : G-Principal ⥤ (Sch/S)_fppf is a stack in groupoids once principal homogeneous spaces descend along fppf coverings as in (1)-(4)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FppfTorsors
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04UR.** An object of the category `G-Torsors`: an object `U` of the big fppf site
of `S`, a morphism `b : U ⟶ B`, and an fppf torsor `X` over `U` under `G_U = U ×_{b, B} G`.
declarations.statement: abbrev FppfTorsors

declarations.statement: structure Hom (T T' : TorsorsFor hB G P)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.TorsorsFor.instCategory
declarations.doc:
The torsors under a group algebraic space `G` over `B` which are trivialized by a family

declarations.statement: instance instCategory : Category (TorsorsFor hB G P)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.TorsorsFor.isIso_of_isIso_base
declarations.doc:
A morphism of torsors whose morphism `f` of the big fppf site is an isomorphism is itself an

declarations.statement: theorem isIso_of_isIso_base : IsIso φ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FppfTorsors.projection
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04UR.** The functor `p : G-Torsors ⥤ (Sch/S)_fppf` sending `(U, b, X)` to `U`,
which is how `G-Torsors` is regarded as a category over the big fppf site of `S`.
declarations.statement: abbrev projection : FppfTorsors hB G ⥤ BigFppfOver 𝒞 S hS
declarations.comment: the functor p to the site

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FppfTorsors.projection_isFiberedInGroupoids
declarations.doc:
Condition (1) of Stacks 02ZI for the functor `p : G-Torsors ⥤ (Sch/S)_fppf` of Stacks 04UR:
`p` is fibred in groupoids.
declarations.statement: theorem projection_isFiberedInGroupoids : (projection hB G).IsFiberedInGroupoids
declarations.comment: condition (1): p is fibred in groupoids

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FppfTorsors.projection_isomIsSheaf
declarations.statement:
theorem projection_isomIsSheaf
    {U : BigFppfOver 𝒞 S hS} (x y : FppfTorsors hB G)
    (hx : (projection hB G).obj x = U) (hy : (projection hB G).obj y = U)
    {I : Type w} (V : I → BigFppfOver 𝒞 S hS) (f : ∀ i, V i ⟶ U)
    (hf : Sieve.ofArrows V f ∈ BigFppfOver.topology 𝒞 S hS U)
    (Vij : I → I → BigFppfOver 𝒞 S hS)
    (pr₁ : ∀ i j, Vij i j ⟶ V i) (pr₂ : ∀ i j, Vij i j ⟶ V j)
    (hVij : ∀ i j, IsPullback (pr₁ i j) (pr₂ i j) (f i) (f j))
    (xr : ∀ i, Functor.Restriction (projection hB G) (f i) x hx)
    (yr : ∀ i, Functor.Restriction (projection hB G) (f i) y hy)
    (xrij : ∀ i j, Functor.Restriction (projection hB G) (pr₁ i j ≫ f i) x hx)
    (yrij : ∀ i j, Functor.Restriction (projection hB G) (pr₁ i j ≫ f i) y hy) :
    Functor.IsomIsSheafFor (projection hB G) x y hx hy V f Vij pr₁ pr₂ hVij
      xr yr xrij yrij
declarations.comment: condition (2): the Isom presheaves are sheaves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FppfTorsors.hasEffectiveDescent_projection
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04US**, condition (3) of Stacks 026F for `p : G-Torsors ⥤ (Sch/S)_fppf`, with
nothing carried: every descent datum relative to a covering sieve of the big fppf site of `S` is
effective.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FppfTorsors.hasEffectiveDescent_projection_of_bootstrap` with
both of its hypotheses discharged: Stacks 04S6 part (3) by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isBootstrapAlgebraicSpaceAlongFlatSurjection`, and condition (3) of
Stacks 04UM for `𝒢/ℬ-Torsors` by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SheafTorsors.projection_hasEffectiveDescent`, whose two sheaf
hypotheses hold because `B` and `G` are algebraic spaces.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasEffectiveDescent_projection (hB : IsAlgebraicSpace 𝒞 S hS B)
    (G : GroupAlgebraicSpace 𝒞 S hS B hB) :
    letI : (projection hB G).IsFibered :=
      (projection_isFiberedInGroupoids (hB := hB) (G := G)).isFibered
    Functor.HasEffectiveDescent (projection hB G) (BigFppfOver.topology 𝒞 S hS)
declarations.comment: condition (3): effectivity of descent, with nothing carried

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FppfTorsors.projection_isStack
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04US**, with nothing carried: the projection
`p : G-Torsors ⥤ (Sch/S)_fppf` of Stacks 04UR is a stack over the big fppf site of `S`, in the
sense of Stacks 026F.

Condition (1) is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FppfTorsors.projection_isFiberedInGroupoids`;
condition (2) is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FppfTorsors.projection_isomIsSheaf`, read through
`CategoryTheory.Functor.isMorSheaf_of_isomIsSheaf`; condition (3) is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FppfTorsors.hasEffectiveDescent_projection`.
declarations.statement:
theorem projection_isStack (hB : IsAlgebraicSpace 𝒞 S hS B)
    (G : GroupAlgebraicSpace 𝒞 S hS B hB) :
    Functor.IsStack (projection hB G) (BigFppfOver.topology 𝒞 S hS)
declarations.comment: the three conditions of Stacks 026F together, with nothing carried

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FppfTorsors.projection_isStackInGroupoids
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04US**, with nothing carried, in the rendering of Stacks 02ZI: the projection
`p : G-Torsors ⥤ (Sch/S)_fppf` is a stack in groupoids over the big fppf site of `S`.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FppfTorsors.projection_isStack` read through the forward bridge
of Stacks 02ZJ, `CategoryTheory.Functor.IsStack.isStackInGroupoids`.
declarations.statement:
theorem projection_isStackInGroupoids (hB : IsAlgebraicSpace 𝒞 S hS B)
    (G : GroupAlgebraicSpace 𝒞 S hS B hB) :
    Functor.IsStackInGroupoids.{w} (projection hB G) (BigFppfOver.topology 𝒞 S hS)
declarations.comment: the stack in groupoids in the rendering of Stacks 02ZI, with nothing carried

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.torsorProjection_isFiberedInGroupoids
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04US**, condition (1) of Stacks 02ZI for the second rendering of the category of
fppf `G`-torsors: `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.torsorProjection` is fibred in groupoids.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FppfTorsors.projection_isFiberedInGroupoids` transported along
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.torsorObjBasedEquivalence` by Stacks 042G.
declarations.statement:
theorem torsorProjection_isFiberedInGroupoids :
    (torsorProjection hB G).IsFiberedInGroupoids
declarations.comment: condition (1) for the TorsorObj rendering, with nothing carried

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.torsorProjection_isStack
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04US** in full, with nothing carried, for the second rendering of the category of
fppf `G`-torsors: `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.torsorProjection` is a stack over the big fppf site
of `S`.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FppfTorsors.projection_isStack` transported along
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.torsorObjBasedEquivalence` by Stacks 042W.
declarations.statement:
theorem torsorProjection_isStack :
    (torsorProjection hB G).IsStack (BigFppfOver.topology 𝒞 S hS)
declarations.comment: the stack property for the TorsorObj rendering, with nothing carried

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FppfTorsors.comparison
declarations.doc:
The comparison functor `G-Torsors ⥤ 𝒢/ℬ-Torsors` which associates to a triple `(U, b, X)`
the triple `(U, b, 𝒳)` where `𝒳` is `X` viewed as a sheaf.
declarations.statement:
def comparison (hB : IsAlgebraicSpace 𝒞 S hS B) (G : GroupAlgebraicSpace 𝒞 S hS B hB) :
    FppfTorsors hB G ⥤ SheafTorsors G.obj

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FppfTorsors.comparison_comp_projection
declarations.doc:
The comparison functor is a 1-morphism of categories over the big fppf site of `S`: it
sends a triple `(U, b, X)` to a triple with the same base object `U` and a morphism to a
morphism with the same morphism `f` of the site.
declarations.statement:
theorem comparison_comp_projection (hB : IsAlgebraicSpace 𝒞 S hS B)
    (G : GroupAlgebraicSpace 𝒞 S hS B hB) :
    comparison hB G ⋙ SheafTorsors.projection G.obj = projection hB G
declarations.comment: the comparison functor lies over the site

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FppfTorsors.instFaithfulComparison
declarations.doc:
The comparison functor is faithful: a morphism of `G-Torsors` is determined by the
morphism of `𝒢/ℬ-Torsors` it becomes.
declarations.statement: instance instFaithfulComparison : (comparison hB G).Faithful

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FppfTorsors.instFullComparison
declarations.doc:
The comparison functor is full: a morphism of `𝒢/ℬ-Torsors` between torsors of algebraic
spaces is already a morphism of `G-Torsors`.
declarations.statement: instance instFullComparison : (comparison hB G).Full

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FppfTorsors.isEquivalenceOverComparison
declarations.doc:
If every descent datum of fppf torsors of algebraic spaces along a covering sieve of the big
fppf site of `S` is effective (`hdesc`, condition (3) of Stacks 02ZI for
`p : G-Torsors ⥤ (Sch/S)_fppf`), then the comparison functor `G-Torsors ⥤ 𝒢/ℬ-Torsors`, which
sends a triple `(U, b, X)` to the triple `(U, b, 𝒳)` with `𝒳` the total space seen as a sheaf, is
an equivalence of stacks in groupoids over the big fppf site of `S`: it has a quasi-inverse which
is again a functor over the site, with vertical unit and counit.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def isEquivalenceOverComparison (hB : IsAlgebraicSpace 𝒞 S hS B)
    (G : GroupAlgebraicSpace 𝒞 S hS B hB)
    (hdesc : letI : (projection hB G).IsFibered :=
        (projection_isFiberedInGroupoids (hB := hB) (G := G)).isFibered
      Functor.HasEffectiveDescent (projection hB G) (BigFppfOver.topology 𝒞 S hS)) :
    Functor.IsEquivalenceOver (projection hB G) (SheafTorsors.projection G.obj)
      (comparison hB G)
declarations.comment: the hypothesis-carrying form, taking hdesc — effectivity of descent for G-Torsors, condition (3) of Stacks 02ZI in Stacks 04US. That hypothesis is PROVED, as `FppfTorsors.hasEffectiveDescent_projection`, and the form carrying nothing is `FppfTorsors.nonempty_isEquivalenceOver_comparison`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FppfTorsors.nonempty_isEquivalenceOver_comparison_of_isStack
declarations.doc:
If both `p : G-Torsors ⥤ (Sch/S)_fppf` and `p : 𝒢/ℬ-Torsors ⥤ (Sch/S)_fppf` are stacks over
the big fppf site of `S` (Stacks 04US and Stacks 04UM), then the comparison functor is an
equivalence over that site.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_isEquivalenceOver_comparison_of_isStack (hB : IsAlgebraicSpace 𝒞 S hS B)
    (G : GroupAlgebraicSpace 𝒞 S hS B hB)
    (hsource : (projection hB G).IsStack (BigFppfOver.topology 𝒞 S hS))
    (htarget : (SheafTorsors.projection G.obj).IsStack (BigFppfOver.topology 𝒞 S hS)) :
    Nonempty (Functor.IsEquivalenceOver (projection hB G) (SheafTorsors.projection G.obj)
      (comparison hB G))
declarations.comment: the hypothesis-carrying form of the criterion Stacks 046N, taking the two stack conditions Stacks 04US and Stacks 04UM as hsource and htarget. BOTH are proved — `FppfTorsors.projection_isStack` and `SheafTorsors.projection_isStackInGroupoids` — and the form carrying nothing is `FppfTorsors.nonempty_isEquivalenceOver_comparison`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FppfTorsors.isEquivalenceOverComparisonOfAlgebraic
declarations.doc:
The comparison functor `G-Torsors ⥤ 𝒢/ℬ-Torsors` is an equivalence of stacks in groupoids
over the big fppf site of `S` as soon as every torsor of sheaves has an algebraic space as total
space.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def isEquivalenceOverComparisonOfAlgebraic
    (hB : IsAlgebraicSpace 𝒞 S hS B) (G : GroupAlgebraicSpace 𝒞 S hS B hB)
    (halg : ∀ T : SheafTorsors G.obj, IsAlgebraicSpace 𝒞 S hS T.total.left) :
    Functor.IsEquivalenceOver (projection hB G) (SheafTorsors.projection G.obj)
      (comparison hB G)
declarations.comment: the hypothesis-carrying form, taking halg — algebraicity of the total space of every 𝒢/ℬ-torsor sheaf, which `isAlgebraicSpace_total_of_isEquivalenceOver` shows the tag's conclusion in turn implies, so the two are equivalent. halg is PROVED, via `isBootstrapAlgebraicSpaceAlongFlatSurjection`, and the form carrying nothing is `FppfTorsors.nonempty_isEquivalenceOver_comparison`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FppfTorsors.nonempty_isEquivalenceOver_comparison_iff_isAlgebraicSpace_total
declarations.doc:
The comparison functor `G-Torsors ⥤ 𝒢/ℬ-Torsors` is an equivalence of stacks in groupoids
over the big fppf site of `S` if and only if every `𝒢/ℬ`-torsor sheaf has an algebraic space as
total space.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_isEquivalenceOver_comparison_iff_isAlgebraicSpace_total
    (hB : IsAlgebraicSpace 𝒞 S hS B) (G : GroupAlgebraicSpace 𝒞 S hS B hB) :
    Nonempty (Functor.IsEquivalenceOver (projection hB G) (SheafTorsors.projection G.obj)
        (comparison hB G)) ↔
      ∀ T : SheafTorsors G.obj, IsAlgebraicSpace 𝒞 S hS T.total.left
declarations.comment: the equivalence holds exactly when every 𝒢/ℬ-torsor sheaf has an algebraic space as total space; the tag asserts the left-hand side, which this does not prove unconditionally

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FppfTorsors.isFibredOneMorphism_comparison
declarations.doc:
The comparison functor `G-Torsors ⥤ 𝒢/ℬ-Torsors` is a 1-morphism of fibred categories over
the big fppf site of `S`: it lies over the site and preserves strongly cartesian morphisms.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFibredOneMorphism_comparison (hB : IsAlgebraicSpace 𝒞 S hS B)
    (G : GroupAlgebraicSpace 𝒞 S hS B hB) :
    Functor.IsFibredOneMorphism (projection hB G) (SheafTorsors.projection G.obj)
      (comparison hB G)
declarations.comment: the comparison functor is a 1-morphism of fibred categories

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FppfTorsors.nonempty_isEquivalenceOver_comparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04UT**, with nothing carried, and with it the `𝒢/ℬ-Torsors` leg of **Stacks
0CQJ**: the comparison functor `G-Torsors ⥤ 𝒢/ℬ-Torsors` is an equivalence of stacks in
groupoids over the big fppf site of `S`.

The hypothesis every earlier rendering carried is the object half of Stacks 04U1, equivalently
Stacks 04S6 part (3), which is now the theorem
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isBootstrapAlgebraicSpaceAlongFlatSurjection`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_isEquivalenceOver_comparison (hB : IsAlgebraicSpace 𝒞 S hS B)
    (G : GroupAlgebraicSpace 𝒞 S hS B hB) :
    Nonempty (Functor.IsEquivalenceOver (projection hB G) (SheafTorsors.projection G.obj)
      (comparison hB G))
declarations.comment: the equivalence of stacks in groupoids, with nothing carried

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.size_le_of_mono_quasiCompact
declarations.doc: If `f : X ⟶ Y` is a quasi-compact monomorphism of schemes, then `size X ≤ size Y`.
declarations.statement:
theorem Scheme.size_le_of_mono_quasiCompact
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [Mono f] [QuasiCompact f] :
    X.size ≤ Y.size

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.size_le_of_mono_locallyOfFinitePresentation
declarations.doc:
If `f : X ⟶ Y` is a monomorphism of schemes which is locally of finite presentation, then
`size X ≤ size Y`.
declarations.statement:
theorem Scheme.size_le_of_mono_locallyOfFinitePresentation
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [Mono f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] :
    X.size ≤ Y.size

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.exists_mono_locallyOfFiniteType_not_size_le
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04VA, the final statement.** The bound `size X ≤ size Y` does not hold for
monomorphisms locally of finite type: there is a monomorphism `f : X ⟶ Y` locally of finite type
with `¬ size X ≤ size Y`.

Here `Y = Spec 𝔽₂[x₀, x₁, …]` has size `ℵ₀`, and `X = ∐_s Spec 𝔽₂` is the coproduct of its
rational points, one for each `s : ℕ → 𝔽₂`, mapped to `Y` by evaluation at `s`. Each component
is a closed immersion, so `f` is locally of finite type and surjective on stalks, and `f` is
injective on points, hence a monomorphism. The components give `2 ^ ℵ₀` affine opens of `X`.
Stacks takes `Y = Spec ∏_{n ∈ ℕ} 𝔽₂` and `X` the coproduct of its points over the ultrafilters on
`ℕ`; the countable ring used here gives the same failure with a cardinality count that is
Cantor's theorem.
declarations.statement:
theorem Scheme.exists_mono_locallyOfFiniteType_not_size_le :
    ∃ (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Y), Mono f ∧ LocallyOfFiniteType f ∧ ¬ X.size ≤ Y.size
declarations.comment: final statement: the bound fails for monomorphisms locally of finite type

registrations.name: MorphismProperty.IsMultiplicative
registrations.comment: LMS1 = RMS1: identities and composites of elements of S lie in S

registrations.name: MorphismProperty.HasLeftCalculusOfFractions
registrations.comment: left multiplicative system: LMS1, LMS2 (exists_leftFraction), LMS3 (ext)

registrations.name: MorphismProperty.HasRightCalculusOfFractions
registrations.comment: right multiplicative system: RMS1, RMS2 (exists_rightFraction), RMS3 (ext)

registrations.name: MorphismProperty.LeftFraction
registrations.comment: the pairs (f : X → Y', s : Y → Y') with s ∈ S

registrations.name: MorphismProperty.equivalenceLeftFractionRel
registrations.comment: (1) the relation is an equivalence relation

registrations.name: MorphismProperty.LeftFraction.comp₀_rel
registrations.comment: (2) the class of the composite does not depend on the square chosen by LMS2

registrations.name: MorphismProperty.LeftFraction.Localization.Hom.comp_eq
registrations.comment: (2) composition of classes is computed on representatives

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Localization.exists_common_leftFraction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04VE**.
Let `W : MorphismProperty C` have left calculus of fractions and let `L` be a
localisation functor for `W`. For any finite family
`g : ∀ i, L.obj (X i) ⟶ L.obj Y`, there exist a common target `Y' : C`, a
morphism `s : Y ⟶ Y'` with `W s`, and a family `f : ∀ i, X i ⟶ Y'` such that
each `g i` equals `L.map (f i) ≫ (Localization.isoOfHom L W s _).inv`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_common_leftFraction
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {W : MorphismProperty C}
    {D : Type*} [Category D] (L : C ⥤ D) [L.IsLocalization W]
    [W.HasLeftCalculusOfFractions]
    {ι : Type*} [Finite ι]
    {X : ι → C} {Y : C}
    (g : ∀ i, L.obj (X i) ⟶ L.obj Y) :
    ∃ (Y' : C) (s : Y ⟶ Y') (hs : W s) (f : ∀ i, X i ⟶ Y'),
      ∀ i, g i = L.map (f i) ≫ (Localization.isoOfHom L W s hs).inv

declarations.name: leftFraction_map_eq_tfae_of_same_denominator
declarations.statement:
theorem leftFraction_map_eq_tfae_of_same_denominator {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D]
    (L : C ⥤ D) {W : MorphismProperty C} [W.HasLeftCalculusOfFractions] [L.IsLocalization W]
    {X Y Y' : C} (f g : X ⟶ Y') (s : Y ⟶ Y') (hs : W s) :
    List.TFAE
      [(LeftFraction.mk f s hs).map L (Localization.inverts _ _) =
          (LeftFraction.mk g s hs).map L (Localization.inverts _ _),
        ∃ (Y'' : C) (t : Y' ⟶ Y''), W t ∧ f ≫ t = g ≫ t,
        ∃ (Y'' : C) (a : Y' ⟶ Y''), W (s ≫ a) ∧ f ≫ a = g ≫ a]
declarations.comment:
Mathlib's `LeftFraction` `(f, s)` is the Stacks fraction `s⁻¹f`; the
localization `S⁻¹𝒞` is represented by any localization functor `L` at `W`.

registrations.name: MorphismProperty.LeftFraction.Localization.Q_map
registrations.comment: (1) Q sends f to the class of (f, id)

registrations.name: MorphismProperty.LeftFraction.Localization.StrictUniversalPropertyFixedTarget.inverts
registrations.comment: (2) Q(s) is an isomorphism for s ∈ S

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty.RightFraction.comp_rel_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04VH (2)**.
The canonical composition of representatives respects the equivalence relation
in both arguments. Combined with `RightFraction.comp_rel_compOfOre`, which identifies it
with the composition along an arbitrary Ore square, this is well-definedness of
composition on the quotient.
declarations.statement:
theorem RightFraction.comp_rel_comp [W.HasRightCalculusOfFractions] {X Y Z : C}
    {φ φ' : W.RightFraction X Y} {ψ ψ' : W.RightFraction Y Z} (hφ : RightFractionRel φ φ')
    (hψ : RightFractionRel ψ ψ') :
    RightFractionRel (RightFraction.comp W φ ψ) (RightFraction.comp W φ' ψ')

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty.RightLocalization.category
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04VH (3)**.
The objects of the right-fractions model `W⁻¹C` are the objects of `C`, the hom-sets are
`RightLocalization.Hom W X Y`, identities are `RightLocalization.Hom.id W X`, and
composition is `RightLocalization.Hom.comp W`. The category axioms are
`RightLocalization.Hom.id_comp`, `.comp_id` and `.assoc`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable instance RightLocalization.category [W.HasRightCalculusOfFractions] :
    Category (RightLocalization W)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Localization.exists_common_rightFraction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04VI** (common right denominator).

Let `W : MorphismProperty C` admit a right calculus of fractions. Given a
finite family of morphisms `g i : W.Q.obj X ⟶ W.Q.obj (Y i)` in the
localization with common source `W.Q.obj X`, there exist an object `X'` of
`C`, a morphism `s : X' ⟶ X` in `W`, and a family `f i : X' ⟶ Y i` in `C`
such that each `g i` is represented by the right fraction `(s, f i)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_common_rightFraction
    (W : MorphismProperty C) [W.HasRightCalculusOfFractions]
    {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] {X : C} {Y : ι → C}
    (g : ∀ i, W.Q.obj X ⟶ W.Q.obj (Y i)) :
    ∃ (X' : C) (s : X' ⟶ X) (hs : W s) (f : ∀ i, X' ⟶ Y i),
      ∀ i, g i = (MorphismProperty.RightFraction.mk s hs (f i)).map
        W.Q (Localization.inverts _ W)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty.RightFraction.map_mk_eq_map_mk_tfae
declarations.statement:
theorem map_mk_eq_map_mk_tfae {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D] (L : C ⥤ D)
    {W : MorphismProperty C} [W.HasRightCalculusOfFractions] [L.IsLocalization W]
    {X Y X' : C} (s : X' ⟶ X) (hs : W s) (f g : X' ⟶ Y) :
    List.TFAE
      [(RightFraction.mk s hs f).map L (Localization.inverts _ _) =
          (RightFraction.mk s hs g).map L (Localization.inverts _ _),
        ∃ (X'' : C) (t : X'' ⟶ X'), W t ∧ t ≫ f = t ≫ g,
        ∃ (X'' : C) (a : X'' ⟶ X'), a ≫ f = a ≫ g ∧ W (a ≫ s)]

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty.RightLocalization.Q
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04VK (1)**: the functor `Q : C ⥤ S⁻¹C` into the category of right fractions,
the identity on objects and sending `f : X ⟶ Y` to the class of the pair `(f, 𝟙 X)`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def Q : C ⥤ RightLocalization W

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty.RightLocalization.isIso_Q_map
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04VK (2)**: for `s ∈ W`, the morphism `Q s` is an isomorphism of
`RightLocalization W`; its inverse is the class of the pair `(𝟙 X, s)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_Q_map {X Y : C} (s : X ⟶ Y) (hs : W s) :
    IsIso ((RightLocalization.Q W).map s)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty.RightLocalization.existsUnique_lift
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04VK (3)**: every functor `G : C ⥤ D` inverting the right multiplicative system
`W` factors as `G = Q ⋙ H` for a unique functor `H : RightLocalization W ⥤ D` out of the
category of right fractions.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_lift (G : C ⥤ D) (hG : W.IsInvertedBy G) :
    ∃! H : RightLocalization W ⥤ D, RightLocalization.Q W ⋙ H = G

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty.leftFractionEquivRightFraction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04VL.**
The category of left fractions `LeftFraction.Localization W` and the category of right
fractions `(LeftFraction.Localization W.op)ᵒᵖ` of `C` at the multiplicative system `W` are
canonically equivalent. The equivalence is the one induced by the universal property of the
localisation: both `LeftFraction.Localization.Q W` and `rightFractionQ W` invert exactly `W`,
so `Localization.uniq` produces the canonical comparison, compatible with the two
localisation functors (see `compLeftFractionEquivRightFractionFunctor`).
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def leftFractionEquivRightFraction :
    LeftFraction.Localization W ≌ (LeftFraction.Localization W.op)ᵒᵖ

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty.compLeftFractionEquivRightFractionFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04VL.** The canonical equivalence of 04VL is *canonical*: it is compatible
with the two localisation functors out of `C`, i.e. it identifies a morphism written as a
left fraction with the same morphism written as a right fraction.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def compLeftFractionEquivRightFractionFunctor :
    LeftFraction.Localization.Q W ⋙ (leftFractionEquivRightFraction W).functor ≅
      rightFractionQ W

declarations.name: CommRingCat.epi_tfae
declarations.doc:
**The tensor square detects a ring epimorphism** (Stacks 04VN). Let `R → S` be a ring map.
The following are equivalent: (1) `R → S` is an epimorphism of commutative rings; (2) the two
ring maps `S → S ⊗_R S`, namely `s ↦ s ⊗ 1` and `s ↦ 1 ⊗ s`, are equal; (3) `s ↦ s ⊗ 1` is an
isomorphism; (4) `s ↦ 1 ⊗ s` is an isomorphism; (5) the multiplication map `S ⊗_R S → S` is an
isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem CommRingCat.epi_tfae {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] :
    List.TFAE
      [CategoryTheory.Epi (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)),
       (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : S →ₐ[R] S ⊗[R] S) = Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight,
       Function.Bijective (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : S →ₐ[R] S ⊗[R] S),
       Function.Bijective (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : S →ₐ[R] S ⊗[R] S),
       Function.Bijective (Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul' (S := S) R)]
declarations.comment:
Item (1) is `CategoryTheory.Epi` in `CommRingCat`, the source's categorical
notion, rather than the class `Algebra.IsEpi`, which is by definition injectivity of the
multiplication map and would make item (5) restate item (1); `CommRingCat.epi_iff_epi` transfers
between them. The source's `either of the ring maps` is the two items (3) and (4) below, one per
map, and `is an isomorphism` is `Function.Bijective`. See the module docstring.

registrations.name: CategoryTheory.epi_comp
registrations.comment: The case `C = CommRingCat` of the general categorical fact.

declarations.name: epi_includeLeftRingHom_of_epi
declarations.doc:
**Base change of an epimorphism is an epimorphism.** If `R → S` is an
epimorphism in `CommRingCat` and `R → R'` is any ring map, then the canonical
ring map `R' → R' ⊗_R S` is an epimorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem epi_includeLeftRingHom_of_epi
    (R R' S : Type) [CommRing R] [CommRing R'] [CommRing S]
    [Algebra R R'] [Algebra R S]
    (h : Epi (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))) :
    Epi (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom :
        R' →+* TensorProduct R R' S))

declarations.name: Algebra.IsEpi.tower_top
declarations.doc:
**An epimorphism of rings stays one over a larger base** (Stacks 04VR). If `A → B → C`
are ring maps, `A → C` being the composite, and `A → C` is an epimorphism, then `B → C` is
an epimorphism.

The proof transports the identity `1 ⊗ c = c ⊗ 1` along the base-enlargement comparison map
`TensorProduct.mapOfCompatibleSMul B A B C C : C ⊗[A] C →ₗ[B] C ⊗[B] C`, whose
`TensorProduct.CompatibleSMul B A C C` instance is where `IsScalarTower A B C` enters.
declarations.statement:
theorem tower_top {A B C : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
    [Algebra A B] [Algebra A C] [Algebra B C] [IsScalarTower A B C] [Algebra.IsEpi A C] :
    Algebra.IsEpi B C
declarations.comment:
Epimorphy is Mathlib's `Algebra.IsEpi` (equivalently `CategoryTheory.Epi`
in `CommRingCat`, by `CommRingCat.epi_iff_epi`), and the source's hypothesis that `A → C`
is the composite `A → B → C` is `IsScalarTower A B C`. Named after its sibling
`Algebra.IsIntegral.tower_top`. See the module docstring.

declarations.name: CommRingCat.epi_ofHom_iff_forall_prime
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Tag 04VS.** Being an epimorphism is a local property of a ring
map: a ring map `f : R →+* S` is an epimorphism of rings if and only if for
every prime ideal `p` of `R`, the induced map `R_p →+* S_p` is an epimorphism of
rings.
declarations.statement:
theorem CommRingCat.epi_ofHom_iff_forall_prime {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) :
    Epi (CommRingCat.ofHom f) ↔
      ∀ (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime], Epi (CommRingCat.ofHom (inducedLocalizationMap f p))

registrations.name: RingHom.surjective_iff_epi_and_finite
registrations.comment: a ring map is surjective iff it is a finite epimorphism

declarations.name: faithfullyFlat_epimorphism_isIso
declarations.doc:
If `algebraMap R S` is an epimorphism of commutative rings and `S` is faithfully flat as
an `R`-module, then `algebraMap R S` is bijective, i.e. an isomorphism of rings.
declarations.statement:
theorem faithfullyFlat_epimorphism_isIso
    (R S : Type*) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [Algebra.IsEpi R S] [Module.FaithfullyFlat R S] :
    Function.Bijective (algebraMap R S)

declarations.name: Algebra.IsEpi.surjective_algebraMap_of_field
declarations.doc:
An epimorphism of rings `k → S` out of a field `k` is surjective; equivalently, `S = k` or
`S = 0`.

Over a field the line `k · 1 ⊆ S` is split off by a linear functional `φ : S →ₗ[k] k` with
`φ 1 = 1`; applying `φ` to the left factor of the identity `1 ⊗ s = s ⊗ 1` in `S ⊗[k] S` turns
it into `s = algebraMap k S (φ s)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem surjective_algebraMap_of_field {k S : Type*} [Field k] [Ring S] [Algebra k S]
    [Algebra.IsEpi k S] : Function.Surjective (algebraMap k S)
declarations.comment:
The source's `S = k` or `S = 0` is stated as surjectivity of `algebraMap k S`,
which over a field is equivalent to it; the target need not be commutative. See the module
docstring.

declarations.name: PrimeSpectrum.comap_injective_and_residueFieldMap_bijective_of_isEpi
declarations.doc:
Let `R → S` be an epimorphism of rings. Then `Spec S → Spec R` is injective, and for every
prime `𝔮 ⊆ S` lying over a prime `𝔭 ⊆ R` the canonical residue field extension
`κ(𝔭) → κ(𝔮)` is bijective, that is, `κ(𝔭) = κ(𝔮)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem comap_injective_and_residueFieldMap_bijective_of_isEpi
    {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] [Algebra.IsEpi R S] :
    Function.Injective (comap (algebraMap R S)) ∧
      ∀ (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime] (q : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime] (h : p = q.comap (algebraMap R S)),
        Function.Bijective (Ideal.ResidueField.map p q (algebraMap R S) h)
declarations.comment:
The equality `κ(𝔭) = κ(𝔮)` of part (2) is bijectivity of the canonical map
`Ideal.ResidueField.map`; it is not surjectivity of `R_𝔭 → S_𝔮`, which is false for
epimorphisms. See the module docstring.

declarations.name: TensorProduct.sum_tmul_eq_zero_iff_exists_finsupp
declarations.doc:
**Vanishing of a sum of pure tensors.** Let `x : I → M` generate `M` and `y : J → N`
generate `N`, and let `m : J →₀ M` be a finitely supported family. Then `∑_j m_j ⊗ y_j = 0` in
`M ⊗_R N` if and only if there are scalars `a_{ij}`, only finitely many nonzero, such that
`m_j = ∑_i a_{ij} x_i` for every `j` and `∑_j a_{ij} y_j = 0` for every `i`.

The proof tensors the exact sequence `0 → K → (J →₀ R) → N → 0` given by the `y_j` with `M`,
and writes an element of `M ⊗_R K` as `∑_i x_i ⊗ k_i` using the generators `x_i`.

declarations.name: tmul_one_eq_one_tmul_iff
declarations.doc:
For `g : S`, the identity `g ⊗ 1 = 1 ⊗ g` in `S ⊗[R] S` holds if and only if
`g = ∑ i, ∑ j, φ (xᵢⱼ) * yᵢ * zⱼ` for some `yᵢ, zⱼ : S` and `xᵢⱼ : R` whose column sums
`∑ i, φ (xᵢⱼ) * yᵢ` and row sums `∑ j, φ (xᵢⱼ) * zⱼ` all lie in the image of `φ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem tmul_one_eq_one_tmul_iff (R S : Type*) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] (g : S) :
    (g ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : S) = (1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] g) ↔
    (∃ (n : ℕ) (y z : Fin n → S) (x : Fin n → Fin n → R),
      g = ∑ i, ∑ j, (algebraMap R S (x i j)) * y i * z j ∧
      (∀ j, ∃ r : R, ∑ i, (algebraMap R S (x i j)) * y i = algebraMap R S r) ∧
      (∀ i, ∃ r : R, ∑ j, (algebraMap R S (x i j)) * z j = algebraMap R S r))

declarations.name: epi_card_le
declarations.doc: If `f : R → S` is an epimorphism of commutative rings, then `|S| ≤ |R|`.
declarations.statement:
theorem epi_card_le (R S : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S)
    (hf : Epi (CommRingCat.ofHom f)) :
    Cardinal.mk S ≤ Cardinal.mk R

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.changeBigSiteSheafPullback_fullyFaithful
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04W1, full faithfulness**, with no descent hypothesis. Inverse image along the
inclusion of localized big fppf sites is fully faithful on the algebraic spaces over `S` defined
using the smaller site, as a functor into the sheaves on the larger site.
declarations.statement:
theorem changeBigSiteSheafPullback_fullyFaithful :
    Nonempty (changeBigSiteSheafPullback B B' h S hS).FullyFaithful
declarations.comment: full faithfulness, for the sheaf-valued inverse image

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.changeBigSite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04W1, the functor.** Inverse image along the inclusion of localized big fppf sites,
as a functor from the algebraic spaces over `S` defined using the smaller site to those defined
using the larger one, with no hypothesis.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.changeBigSiteOfDescent` with its descent hypothesis discharged by
`AlgebraicGeometry.descentForQuotients`.
declarations.statement:
def changeBigSite :
    AlgebraicSpaces B S hS ⥤ AlgebraicSpaces B' S (largerContains h hS)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.changeBigSite_fullyFaithful
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04W1, full faithfulness.** Inverse image along the inclusion of localized big fppf
sites is fully faithful as a functor on the algebraic spaces over `S`.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.changeBigSiteOfDescent_fullyFaithful` with its descent hypothesis
discharged. It is the statement of 04W1 proper, where
`AlgebraicGeometry.changeBigSiteSheafPullback_fullyFaithful` is the same conclusion for the
functor valued in sheaves on the larger site.
declarations.statement:
theorem changeBigSite_fullyFaithful :
    Nonempty (changeBigSite B B' h S hS).FullyFaithful

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.mem_essentialImage_changeBigSite_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04W1, the essential image.** An algebraic space on the enlarged big fppf site
descends precisely when an object of the smaller site surjects onto it as a map of sheaves and
another object of the smaller site surjects onto the kernel pair of that surjection.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.mem_essentialImage_changeBigSiteOfDescent_iff` with both descent
hypotheses discharged.
declarations.statement:
theorem mem_essentialImage_changeBigSite_iff
    (X' : AlgebraicSpaces B' S (largerContains h hS)) :
    (∃ X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS,
      Nonempty ((changeBigSite B B' h S hS).obj X ≅ X')) ↔
      (letI K := BigFppfOver.topology B' S (largerContains h hS)
       let i := inclusionOver h S hS
       ∃ (U R : BigFppfOver B S hS) (f : yoneda.obj (i.obj U) ⟶ X'.obj)
         (g : yoneda.obj (i.obj R) ⟶ pullback f f),
         Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective K f ∧ Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective K g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.QuasiCoherentDescent.DescentDatum
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04W3, part (1).**  A descent datum for quasi-coherent modules relative to a family
`(f i : Y i ⟶ X)` of algebraic spaces over `X`: a quasi-coherent module on each `Y i`, an
isomorphism of the two inverse images on each pairwise fibre product, and the cocycle
condition.
declarations.statement: structure DescentDatum (Y : I → AlgebraicSpaces B S hS) (f : ∀ i, Y i ⟶ X)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.QuasiCoherentDescent.DescentDatum.Hom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04W3, part (2).**  A morphism of descent data: a family of morphisms of the
component modules commuting with every pairwise isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
structure DescentDatum.Hom {Y : I → AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} {f : ∀ i, Y i ⟶ X}
    (D E : DescentDatum B S hS Y f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.QuasiCoherentDescent.pullbackDatum
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04W4, part (1).**  The pullback of a descent datum for quasi-coherent modules along
a morphism of families of morphisms with fixed target: the inverse images `(h₀ i)^*F (s₀ i)`,
with the pairwise isomorphisms of the given datum pulled back to the pairwise fibre products of
the source family.
declarations.statement:
def pullbackDatum (Φ : 𝒰.HomOver 𝒱 g)
    (D : DescentDatum B S hS 𝒱.X 𝒱.f) : DescentDatum B S hS 𝒰.X 𝒰.f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.QuasiCoherentDescent.pullbackFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04W4, part (2).**  Pullback of descent data along a morphism of families of
morphisms with fixed target is a functor on the categories of descent data of Stacks 04W3.
declarations.statement:
def pullbackFunctor (Φ : 𝒰.HomOver 𝒱 g) :
    DescentDatum B S hS 𝒱.X 𝒱.f ⥤ DescentDatum B S hS 𝒰.X 𝒰.f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.QuasiCoherentDescent.pullbackCompare
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04W4, part (3).**  For two morphisms of families with the same morphism of
targets, the pairwise isomorphism of the given datum read on `U i` along `h₀ i` and `h₀' i` is
an isomorphism of the `i`-th components of the two pulled-back data.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.QuasiCoherentDescent.pullbackCompare_naturality
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04W4, part (3).**  The components of `pullbackCompare` commute with the pairwise
isomorphisms of the two pulled-back data, so that they constitute a morphism of descent data:
two applications of the cocycle condition of the given datum on the test space `U i ×_U U j`,
which carries four morphisms to members of `𝒱`.
declarations.statement:
theorem pullbackCompare_naturality
    (Φ Ψ : 𝒰.HomOver 𝒱 g) (D : DescentDatum B S hS 𝒱.X 𝒱.f) (i j : 𝒰.I₀) :
    (modulePullback B S hS (pairFst B S hS 𝒰.X 𝒰.f i j)).mapIso
          (pullbackCompare B S hS Φ Ψ D i) ≪≫ pullbackTransition B S hS Ψ D i j =
      pullbackTransition B S hS Φ D i j ≪≫
        (modulePullback B S hS (pairSnd B S hS 𝒰.X 𝒰.f i j)).mapIso
          (pullbackCompare B S hS Φ Ψ D j)
declarations.comment: part (3), compatibility of the comparison with the pairwise isomorphisms

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.QuasiCoherentDescent.pullbackCompare_datum_naturality
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04W4, part (3).**  The comparison is natural in the descent datum: it commutes
with the components of the pulled-back morphisms, which are the components of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.QuasiCoherentDescent.pullbackHom`.
declarations.statement:
theorem pullbackCompare_datum_naturality (Φ Ψ : 𝒰.HomOver 𝒱 g)
    {D E : DescentDatum B S hS 𝒱.X 𝒱.f} (a : D ⟶ E) (i : 𝒰.I₀) :
    (modulePullback B S hS (Φ.h₀ i)).map (a.app (Φ.s₀ i)) ≫
        (pullbackCompare B S hS Φ Ψ E i).hom =
      (pullbackCompare B S hS Φ Ψ D i).hom ≫
        (modulePullback B S hS (Ψ.h₀ i)).map (a.app (Ψ.s₀ i))
declarations.comment: part (3), naturality of the comparison in the descent datum

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.QuasiCoherentDescent.canonicalDescentDatum
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04W5.**  The canonical descent datum `(M|_{Y i}, can)` of a quasi-coherent
`𝒪_X`-module `M` relative to a family `(f i : Y i ⟶ X)`: the inverse images `(f i)^*M`, with
the canonical comparison of the two inverse images of `M` on each pairwise fibre product.
declarations.statement:
def canonicalDescentDatum
    (Y : I → AlgebraicSpaces B S hS) (f : ∀ i, Y i ⟶ X)
    (M : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) (hM : M.IsQuasicoherentOnSite) :
    DescentDatum B S hS Y f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.QuasiCoherentDescent.trivialDescentDatum
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04W5.**  The trivial descent datum of a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module: its canonical
descent datum relative to the one-member family `{𝟙 X}`.
declarations.statement:
def trivialDescentDatum
    (M : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) (hM : M.IsQuasicoherentOnSite) :
    DescentDatum B S hS (fun _ : PUnit.{v + 1} => X) (fun _ => 𝟙 X)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.QuasiCoherentDescent.IsEffective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04W5.**  A descent datum for quasi-coherent modules is effective when it is
isomorphic to the canonical descent datum of a quasi-coherent module on the target.
declarations.statement:
def IsEffective
    (Y : I → AlgebraicSpaces B S hS) (f : ∀ i, Y i ⟶ X)
    (D : DescentDatum B S hS Y f) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.QuasiCoherentDescent.isEtaleEffective_and_fullyFaithful_of_isZariskiCovering
declarations.doc:
For a Zariski covering of an algebraic space, every descent datum for quasi-coherent modules is
effective, and the canonical descent functor is fully faithful.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEtaleEffective_and_fullyFaithful_of_isZariskiCovering
    (hcov : IsZariskiCovering B S hS I (fun i => (Yi i).1) (fun i => (f i).hom)) :
    (∀ D : DescentDatum B S hS Yi f, IsEtaleEffective B S hS Yi f hf D) ∧
      (etaleCanonicalDescentFunctor B S hS Yi f hf).Full ∧
        (etaleCanonicalDescentFunctor B S hS Yi f hf).Faithful

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.QuasiCoherentDescent.faithful_canonicalDescentFunctor_of_isFpqcCovering
declarations.doc:
**The faithfulness half of the full-faithfulness clause of Stacks 04W8.**  The canonical
descent functor of Stacks 04W5, from the quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-modules of Stacks 03G9 to the
descent data of Stacks 04W3 relative to an fpqc covering `(f i : X i ⟶ X)` of algebraic spaces
in the sense of Stacks 03MQ, is faithful.

The covering is the only input.  Its members are flat and it is jointly surjective on points, so
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.QuasiCoherentDescent.reprFpqcHomInjective` supplies the represented case
of the reduction above.  The two data needed to form the functor are supplied, not assumed: the
associativity coherence of the comparison of inverse images of Stacks 03LU is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.modulePullbackCompIsoAssoc`, and quasi-coherence of the inverse images
is Stacks 03GA for an arbitrary morphism of algebraic spaces.

This is the faithfulness half only.  The fullness half of the full-faithfulness clause, and the
effectivity clause of the same tag, are not proved here.
declarations.statement:
theorem faithful_canonicalDescentFunctor_of_isFpqcCovering
    (hf : IsFpqcCovering B S hS fun i => (f i).hom) :
    (canonicalDescentFunctor' B S hS Xi f).Faithful
declarations.comment: the faithfulness half of the full-faithfulness clause, for an fpqc covering of algebraic spaces: the members of an fpqc covering are flat and the covering is jointly surjective on points, so a morphism of quasi-coherent modules is determined by its inverse images along it and the canonical descent functor of Stacks 04W5 is faithful. The fullness half of that clause and the effectivity clause are separate assertions of the tag and are not proved here

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.QuasiCoherentDescent.isEquivalence_canonicalDescentFunctor'_of_isFpqcCovering
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04W8: for an fpqc covering `(f i : X i ⟶ X)` of algebraic spaces, the canonical
descent functor from the quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-modules to the descent data relative to the
covering is an equivalence.**

This is the tag, both of whose clauses the equivalence carries: *the functor is fully faithful*,
and *every descent datum on quasi-coherent sheaves for the family is effective* — which is
essential surjectivity by
`…essSurj_canonicalDescentFunctor'_iff_forall_isEffective`.  The full-faithfulness clause is
`…nonempty_fullyFaithful_canonicalDescentFunctor_of_isFpqcCovering` and the effectivity clause is
`…forall_isEffective_of_isFpqcCovering`; both are proved, and nothing is assumed beyond the
covering.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEquivalence_canonicalDescentFunctor'_of_isFpqcCovering
    (Xi : I → AlgebraicSpaces B S hS) (f : ∀ i, Xi i ⟶ X)
    (hf : IsFpqcCovering B S hS fun i => (f i).hom) :
    (canonicalDescentFunctor' B S hS Xi f).IsEquivalence

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Functor.Stackification.restrict_isEquivalence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04W9.** Restriction along a stackification `G : 𝒮 ⥤ 𝒮'` is an equivalence from the
category of 1-morphisms `𝒮' ⥤ 𝒳` of fibred categories over `𝒞` into a stack, and their
2-morphisms, onto the category of 1-morphisms `𝒮 ⥤ 𝒳` and their 2-morphisms.
declarations.statement: theorem restrict_isEquivalence : (restrictMor (q := q) hG).IsEquivalence

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Functor.Stackification.restrictEquivalence
declarations.doc:
**The canonical equivalence of morphism categories of Stacks 04W9**,
`Mor_{Stacks/𝒞}(𝒮', 𝒳) ≌ Mor_{Fib/𝒞}(𝒮, 𝒳)`. Its functor is restriction along the stackification
`G`, and a quasi-inverse is the extension of Stacks 0435.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def restrictEquivalence : FibredMor p' q ≌ FibredMor p q

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.StrictPullback.isFibered_structureFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04WB**.
If `p : 𝒮 ⥤ 𝒟` is a fibred category, then so is the pushforward `u^p𝒮 ⥤ 𝒞` along any
functor `u : 𝒞 ⥤ 𝒟`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFibered_structureFunctor (u : 𝒞 ⥤ 𝒟) (p : 𝒮 ⥤ 𝒟) [p.IsFibered] :
    (structureFunctor u p).IsFibered

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.StrictPullback.isStack_structureFunctor_toGrothendieck
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04WC**.
Let `(𝒞, J₀)` be a site in the sense of Stacks 00VH, given by its coverings `J₀`, and let
`(𝒟, K₀)` be a category with coverings `K₀`. Let `u : 𝒞 ⥤ 𝒟` be a continuous functor of sites in
the sense of Stacks 00WU: `u` sends coverings to coverings (`J₀ ≤ K₀.comap u`), and for every
covering `{Vⱼ ⟶ V}` of `𝒞` and every morphism `T ⟶ V` it commutes with the fibre product
`Vⱼ ×_V T` (`hpres`). If `p : 𝒮 ⥤ 𝒟` is a stack over `𝒟`, then the pushforward `u^p𝒮 ⥤ 𝒞` is
a stack over `𝒞`.

Stacks over the sites are stacks for the Grothendieck topologies their coverings generate; see
the implementation notes.
declarations.statement:
theorem isStack_structureFunctor_toGrothendieck (J₀ : Precoverage 𝒞) [J₀.HasIsos]
    [J₀.IsStableUnderComposition] [J₀.IsStableUnderBaseChange] [J₀.HasPullbacks]
    (K₀ : Precoverage 𝒟) (u : 𝒞 ⥤ 𝒟) (hu : J₀ ≤ K₀.comap u)
    (hpres : ∀ ⦃V : 𝒞⦄ ⦃R : Presieve V⦄, R ∈ J₀ V → ∀ ⦃W : 𝒞⦄ ⦃f : W ⟶ V⦄, R f →
      ∀ ⦃T : 𝒞⦄ (g : T ⟶ V), PreservesLimit (cospan f g) u)
    (p : 𝒮 ⥤ 𝒟) (hp : Functor.IsStack p K₀.toGrothendieck) :
    Functor.IsStack (structureFunctor u p) J₀.toGrothendieck

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.StrictPullback.isStack_isFiberedInGroupoids_structureFunctor_toGrothendieck
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04WD**.
Let `(𝒞, J₀)` be a site in the sense of Stacks 00VH, `(𝒟, K₀)` a category with coverings, and
`u : 𝒞 ⥤ 𝒟` a continuous functor of sites in the sense of Stacks 00WU, as in
`CategoryTheory.StrictPullback.isStack_structureFunctor_toGrothendieck`. If `p : 𝒮 ⥤ 𝒟` is a
stack in groupoids over `𝒟`, then the pushforward `u^p𝒮 ⥤ 𝒞` is a stack in groupoids over `𝒞`.

As in the source, the proof is Stacks 04WC together with the fact that the fibre categories of
`u^p𝒮` are groupoids (`CategoryTheory.StrictPullback.isFiberedInGroupoids_structureFunctor`).
Neither all fibre products in `𝒞` nor their preservation by `u` is assumed; the version that
assumes both is `CategoryTheory.StrictPullback.isStack_isFiberedInGroupoids_structureFunctor`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isStack_isFiberedInGroupoids_structureFunctor_toGrothendieck (J₀ : Precoverage 𝒞)
    [J₀.HasIsos] [J₀.IsStableUnderComposition] [J₀.IsStableUnderBaseChange] [J₀.HasPullbacks]
    (K₀ : Precoverage 𝒟) (u : 𝒞 ⥤ 𝒟) (hu : J₀ ≤ K₀.comap u)
    (hpres : ∀ ⦃V : 𝒞⦄ ⦃R : Presieve V⦄, R ∈ J₀ V → ∀ ⦃W : 𝒞⦄ ⦃f : W ⟶ V⦄, R f →
      ∀ ⦃T : 𝒞⦄ (g : T ⟶ V), PreservesLimit (cospan f g) u)
    (p : 𝒮 ⥤ 𝒟) (hp : Functor.IsStack p K₀.toGrothendieck) (hp' : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids) :
    Functor.IsStack (structureFunctor u p) J₀.toGrothendieck ∧
      (structureFunctor u p).IsFiberedInGroupoids
declarations.comment: a stack in groupoids (Stacks 02ZI) is rendered as `Functor.IsStack` together with `Functor.IsFiberedInGroupoids`; stacks over a site given by coverings are stacks for the Grothendieck topology the coverings generate

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.pushforwardFibredCategory
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04WE**.
Notation: for a morphism of sites `f : 𝒟 → 𝒞` given by a continuous functor
`u : 𝒞 ⥤ 𝒟` and a fibred category `p : 𝒮 ⥤ 𝒟`, one writes `f_*𝒮` for the fibred category
`u^p𝒮` over `𝒞` and calls it the *pushforward of `𝒮` along `f`*. The topologies `J` and `K`
and the continuity of `u` play no role in the construction; they are the data of `f`, which
is what this notation names.

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Comma.hasRightCalculusOfFractions_stronglyCartesianOver
declarations.doc:
**The morphisms with identity base component and strongly cartesian fibre component form a
right multiplicative system.** Let `u : 𝒞 ⥤ 𝒟` be a functor, let `p : 𝒮 ⥤ 𝒞` be a fibred category,
assume `𝒞` has nonempty finite limits and that `u` commutes with nonempty finite limits. In the
category `u_pp 𝒮 = Comma (𝟭 𝒟) (p ⋙ u)`, whose objects are the triples
`(U, φ : V ⟶ u(U), x ∈ 𝒮_U)`, consider the set `R` of morphisms
`(a, id_V, α) : (U', φ' : V ⟶ u(U'), x') ⟶ (U, φ : V ⟶ u(U), x)` whose `𝒟`-component is an
identity and whose `α` is strongly cartesian. Then `R` is a right multiplicative system: it
contains the identities and is stable under composition (RMS1), every left fraction over `R` can
be turned into a right fraction (RMS2), and two morphisms equalized by postcomposition with an
element of `R` are equalized by precomposition with an element of `R` (RMS3).
declarations.statement:
public theorem Comma.hasRightCalculusOfFractions_stronglyCartesianOver
    (p : 𝒮 ⥤ 𝒞) (u : 𝒞 ⥤ 𝒟) [p.IsFibered] [HasNonemptyFiniteLimits 𝒞]
    (hu : ∀ (J : Type) [SmallCategory J] [FinCategory J] [Nonempty J],
      Limits.PreservesLimitsOfShape J u) :
    MorphismProperty.HasRightCalculusOfFractions
      (fun (X Y : Comma (𝟭 𝒟) (p ⋙ u)) (f : X ⟶ Y) =>
        (∃ h : X.left = Y.left, f.left = eqToHom h) ∧ stronglyCartesianOver p f.right)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Comma.pullbackLocalization
declarations.doc:
**`u_p 𝒮 = R⁻¹ u_pp 𝒮`**, the localization of `u_pp 𝒮 = Comma (𝟭 𝒟) (p ⋙ u)` at the set `R`
of Stacks 04WF.
declarations.statement: abbrev pullbackLocalization

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Comma.pullbackProj
declarations.doc:
**The structure functor `p_p : u_p 𝒮 ⥤ 𝒟`**, the extension of `p_pp` to the localization
`u_p 𝒮` obtained from the universal property because `p_pp` inverts `R`. This is how `u_p 𝒮` is
regarded as a category over `𝒟`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def pullbackProj : pullbackLocalization p u ⥤ 𝒟

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Comma.isFibered_pullbackProj
declarations.doc:
**`u_p 𝒮` is a fibred category over `𝒟`** (Stacks 04WG). Let `u : 𝒞 ⥤ 𝒟` be a functor, let
`p : 𝒮 ⥤ 𝒞` be a fibred category, assume `𝒞` has nonempty finite limits and that `u` commutes
with nonempty finite limits, so that the set `R` of Stacks 04WF is a right multiplicative system.
Then the structure functor `p_p : u_p 𝒮 ⥤ 𝒟` of the localization `u_p 𝒮 = R⁻¹ u_pp 𝒮` is a fibred
category: every morphism `β : V' ⟶ V` of `𝒟` and every object of `u_p 𝒮` over `V` admit a
strongly cartesian lift, namely the image of the reindexing morphism `(id_U, β, id_x)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFibered_pullbackProj
    (hu : ∀ (J : Type) [SmallCategory J] [FinCategory J] [Nonempty J],
      Limits.PreservesLimitsOfShape J u) :
    (pullbackProj p u).IsFibered

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Comma.isFiberedInGroupoids_pullbackProj
declarations.doc:
**`u_p 𝒮` is fibred in groupoids over `𝒟`** (Stacks 04WH). With notation and assumptions as in
Stacks 04WG — `u : 𝒞 ⥤ 𝒟` a functor commuting with nonempty finite limits, `𝒞` with nonempty finite
limits, and `u_p 𝒮 = R⁻¹ u_pp 𝒮` the localization of `u_pp 𝒮 = Comma (𝟭 𝒟) (p ⋙ u)` at the set `R`
of Stacks 04WF, regarded as a category over `𝒟` through `p_p = Comma.pullbackProj p u` — if
`p : 𝒮 ⥤ 𝒞` is fibred in groupoids then so is `p_p`.

By Stacks 04WG the functor `p_p` is fibred, and its fibres are groupoids
(`Comma.isGroupoid_fiber_pullbackProj`), so this is Stacks 003V.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiberedInGroupoids_pullbackProj (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (hu : ∀ (J : Type) [SmallCategory J] [FinCategory J] [Nonempty J],
      Limits.PreservesLimitsOfShape J u) :
    (pullbackProj p u).IsFiberedInGroupoids

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.equivalenceIsFibredOneMorphismStrictPullbackPullbackLocalization
declarations.doc:
**The pullback of a fibred category along `u` is adjoint to the pushforward along `u`**
(Stacks 04WI). Let `u : 𝒞 ⥤ 𝒟` be a functor, let `p : 𝒮 ⥤ 𝒞` and `q : 𝒯 ⥤ 𝒟` be fibred
categories, assume `𝒞` has nonempty finite limits and that `u` commutes with nonempty finite
limits. Then the morphism category `Mor_{Fib/𝒞}(𝒮, u^p 𝒯)` of 1-morphisms `𝒮 ⟶ u^p 𝒯` of fibred
categories over `𝒞` is canonically equivalent to the morphism category `Mor_{Fib/𝒟}(u_p 𝒮, 𝒯)` of
1-morphisms `u_p 𝒮 ⟶ 𝒯` of fibred categories over `𝒟`, where `u^p 𝒯` is the pushforward of `𝒯`
along `u` (Stacks 04WB) and `u_p 𝒮` is the pullback of `𝒮` along `u` (Stacks 04WG). Each morphism
category is realized as the full subcategory of the category of based functors on those which
preserve strongly cartesian morphisms, its morphisms being the morphisms of functors whose
components lie over identities of the base.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def equivalenceIsFibredOneMorphismStrictPullbackPullbackLocalization {𝒞 : Type u₁}
    [Category.{v₁} 𝒞] {𝒟 : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} 𝒟] {𝒮 : Type u₃} [Category.{v₃} 𝒮] {𝒯 : Type u₄}
    [Category.{v₄} 𝒯] (u : 𝒞 ⥤ 𝒟) (p : 𝒮 ⥤ 𝒞) (q : 𝒯 ⥤ 𝒟) [p.IsFibered] [q.IsFibered]
    [HasNonemptyFiniteLimits 𝒞]
    (hu :
      ∀ (J : Type) [SmallCategory J] [FinCategory J] [Nonempty J],
        Limits.PreservesLimitsOfShape J u) :
    ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory
        (fun G :
            BasedCategory.ofFunctor p ⥤ᵇ
              BasedCategory.ofFunctor (StrictPullback.structureFunctor u q) =>
          Functor.IsFibredOneMorphism p (StrictPullback.structureFunctor u q) G.toFunctor) ≌
      ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory
        (fun G : BasedCategory.ofFunctor (Comma.pullbackProj p u) ⥤ᵇ BasedCategory.ofFunctor q =>
          Functor.IsFibredOneMorphism (Comma.pullbackProj p u) q G.toFunctor)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Comma.pullbackStack
declarations.doc:
**The pullback `f⁻¹𝒮` of the stack `𝒮` along the morphism of sites `f`** (Stacks 04WJ), given
as its structure functor over `𝒟`.

`f : 𝒟 ⟶ 𝒞` is the morphism of sites attached to the continuous functor `u : 𝒞 ⥤ 𝒟` by
Sites 00X6, `𝒮` is a stack over `(𝒞, J)`, and `f⁻¹𝒮` is the stackification over `(𝒟, K)` of the
fibred category `u_p 𝒮 = Comma.pullbackLocalization p u` of Stacks 04WG. The stackification is
supplied: `q : 𝒳 ⥤ 𝒟` is a stack over `(𝒟, K)` and `G : u_p 𝒮 ⥤ 𝒳` is a 1-morphism of fibred
categories over `𝒟` satisfying the two clauses of Stacks 02ZN — local bijectivity of the induced
maps of morphism presheaves, and local essential surjectivity on fibres. Relative to that data,
`f⁻¹𝒮` is `q`.
declarations.statement:
def pullbackStack (p : 𝒮 ⥤ 𝒞) (u : 𝒞 ⥤ 𝒟) [p.IsFibered] [HasFiniteLimits 𝒞]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits u] [u.IsContinuous J K] {𝒳 : Type u₄} [Category.{max u₂ u₃ vb v} 𝒳]
    {q : 𝒳 ⥤ 𝒟} [q.IsFibered] {G : pullbackLocalization p u ⥤ 𝒳}
    (_hs : p.IsStack J) (_hq : q.IsStack K)
    (hG : (pullbackProj p u).IsFibredOneMorphism q G)
    (_hmor : ∀ (V : 𝒟) (x y : (pullbackProj p u).Fiber V),
      Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective (K.over V) (hG.morPresheafMap x y) ∧
        Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (K.over V) (hG.morPresheafMap x y))
    (_hobj : ∀ (V : 𝒟) (x' : q.Fiber V), ∃ R ∈ K V, ∀ ⦃W : 𝒟⦄ ⦃g : W ⟶ V⦄, R.arrows g →
      (Functor.fiberFunctorOfCompEq hG.comp_eq W).essImage (Functor.pullbackFiber q x' g)) :
    𝒳 ⥤ 𝒟

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Comma.pullbackStackMap
declarations.doc:
**The canonical 1-morphism `u_p 𝒮 ⥤ f⁻¹𝒮`** (Stacks 04WJ), exhibiting the pullback of `𝒮`
along `f` as the stackification of `u_p 𝒮`.
declarations.statement:
def pullbackStackMap (p : 𝒮 ⥤ 𝒞) (u : 𝒞 ⥤ 𝒟) [p.IsFibered] [HasFiniteLimits 𝒞]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits u] [u.IsContinuous J K] {𝒳 : Type u₄} [Category.{max u₂ u₃ vb v} 𝒳]
    {q : 𝒳 ⥤ 𝒟} [q.IsFibered] {G : pullbackLocalization p u ⥤ 𝒳}
    (_hs : p.IsStack J) (_hq : q.IsStack K)
    (hG : (pullbackProj p u).IsFibredOneMorphism q G)
    (_hmor : ∀ (V : 𝒟) (x y : (pullbackProj p u).Fiber V),
      Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective (K.over V) (hG.morPresheafMap x y) ∧
        Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (K.over V) (hG.morPresheafMap x y))
    (_hobj : ∀ (V : 𝒟) (x' : q.Fiber V), ∃ R ∈ K V, ∀ ⦃W : 𝒟⦄ ⦃g : W ⟶ V⦄, R.arrows g →
      (Functor.fiberFunctorOfCompEq hG.comp_eq W).essImage (Functor.pullbackFiber q x' g)) :
    pullbackLocalization p u ⥤ 𝒳

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Functor.equivalenceFibredMorStrictPullbackStackification
declarations.doc:
**The pullback of a stack along `f` is adjoint to the pushforward along `f`** (Stacks 04WK).
Let `f : 𝒟 ⟶ 𝒞` be the morphism of sites given by a functor `u : 𝒞 ⥤ 𝒟` as in Sites 00X6, let
`p : 𝒮 ⥤ 𝒞` be a fibred category and let `q : 𝒯 ⥤ 𝒟` be a stack. Let `G : u_p 𝒮 ⥤ 𝒮'` exhibit
`𝒮'` as the stackification of the pullback `u_p 𝒮` of Stacks 04WG, in the sense of Stacks 02ZN, so
that `𝒮' = f⁻¹𝒮` is the pullback of Stacks 04WJ. Then the morphism category
`Mor_{Stacks/𝒞}(𝒮, f_*𝒯)` of 1-morphisms `𝒮 ⟶ f_*𝒯` over `𝒞` and their 2-morphisms is
canonically equivalent to the morphism category `Mor_{Stacks/𝒟}(f⁻¹𝒮, 𝒯)`, where `f_*𝒯 = u^p 𝒯`
is the pushforward of Stacks 04WB. The equivalence is the composite of Stacks 04WI, the same
adjunction at the level of fibred categories, with Stacks 04W9, restriction along the
stackification `G`.

This statement is *conditional on being given a stackification* `G`: its hypotheses are the
unfolded clauses of Stacks 02ZN, which that construction supplies once it is assembled.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def equivalenceFibredMorStrictPullbackStackification
    (hu : ∀ (J : Type) [SmallCategory J] [FinCategory J] [Nonempty J],
      Limits.PreservesLimitsOfShape J u)
    (hG : (Comma.pullbackProj p u).IsFibredOneMorphism p' G)
    (hmor : ∀ (V : 𝒟) (x y : (Comma.pullbackProj p u).Fiber V),
      Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective (K.over V) (hG.morPresheafMap x y) ∧
        Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (K.over V) (hG.morPresheafMap x y))
    (hqmor : ∀ (V : 𝒟) (x y : q.Fiber V), IsMorSheaf q K V x y)
    (hobj : ∀ (V : 𝒟) (x' : p'.Fiber V), ∃ R ∈ K V, ∀ ⦃W : 𝒟⦄ ⦃f : W ⟶ V⦄, R.arrows f →
      (fiberFunctorOfCompEq hG.comp_eq W).essImage (pullbackFiber p' x' f))
    (hdesc : HasEffectiveDescent q K) :
    FibredMor p (StrictPullback.structureFunctor u q) ≌ FibredMor p' q

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Functor.equivalenceFibredMorPushforwardPullbackStack
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04WK**, written with the pushforward `f_*𝒯` of Stacks 04WE and the pullback `f⁻¹𝒮`
of Stacks 04WJ. Let `f : 𝒟 ⟶ 𝒞` be the morphism of sites attached by Sites 00X6 to a continuous
functor `u : 𝒞 ⥤ 𝒟` between a finitely complete `(𝒞, J)` and `(𝒟, K)` which is left exact, let
`𝒮` be a stack over `(𝒞, J)` and let `𝒯` be a stack over `(𝒟, K)`. Then

`Mor_{Stacks/𝒞}(𝒮, f_*𝒯) ≃ Mor_{Stacks/𝒟}(f⁻¹𝒮, 𝒯)`.

The pullback `f⁻¹𝒮` is represented by the supplied stackification of `u_p 𝒮`: the stack
`q : 𝒳 ⥤ 𝒟` and the 1-morphism `G : u_p 𝒮 ⥤ 𝒳` satisfying the clauses `hG`,
`hmor`, `hobj` of Stacks 02ZN. So this statement too is conditional on being given a
stackification, which Stacks 02ZN supplies once assembled.

The instance `[t.IsFibered]` is implied by `ht` and is taken separately only because the notation
`f_*𝒯` of Stacks 04WE needs it to elaborate.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def equivalenceFibredMorPushforwardPullbackStack
    (hs : p.IsStack J) (hq : q.IsStack K)
    (hG : (Comma.pullbackProj p u).IsFibredOneMorphism q G)
    (hmor : ∀ (V : 𝒟) (x y : (Comma.pullbackProj p u).Fiber V),
      Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective (K.over V) (hG.morPresheafMap x y) ∧
        Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (K.over V) (hG.morPresheafMap x y))
    (hobj : ∀ (V : 𝒟) (x' : q.Fiber V), ∃ R ∈ K V, ∀ ⦃W : 𝒟⦄ ⦃g : W ⟶ V⦄, R.arrows g →
      (fiberFunctorOfCompEq hG.comp_eq W).essImage (pullbackFiber q x' g))
    (ht : t.IsStack K) :
    FibredMor p (pushforwardFibredCategory J K u t) ≌ FibredMor q t

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.GroupActionSituation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 04WL.** The data a quotient by a group action is formed from: a
scheme `S` of a big fppf site, an algebraic space `B` over `S`, a group algebraic space `G`
over `B`, an algebraic space `X` over `B`, and an action of `G` on `X` over `B`.
declarations.statement: structure GroupActionSituation

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.trivialTorsorWithMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04WM**, the trivial torsor with its equivariant map.  The object of the category
`[[X/G]]` of Situation 04WL attached to a point `x : U ⟶ X` of `X`: the trivial torsor
`G_U = U ×_{b, B} G` over `U`, for `b = x ≫ X.hom`, with its left translation action, together
with the `G`-equivariant morphism `G_U ⟶ X`, `h ↦ h · x`.
declarations.statement:
def trivialTorsorWithMap (U : BigFppfOver 𝒞 S hS) (x : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X.left) :
    TorsorWithMap hB G X
declarations.comment: the trivial torsor with equivariant map attached to a point of X

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.quotientStackTorsorEquivalence
declarations.doc:
The quotient stack `[X/G]` of the action of a group algebraic space `G` over
an algebraic space `B` on an algebraic space `X` over `B` is canonically equivalent, over the big
fppf site of `S`, to the stack `[[X/G]]` of fppf `G`-torsors with a `G`-equivariant map to `X`;
and the forward 1-morphism of the equivalence extends the explicit pointwise comparison `F_p` of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.actionPointwiseComparison`, the identification being a natural
isomorphism all of whose components lie over identities of the site.

The source is the quotient stack of the action groupoid `(X, G ×_B X, pr₁, a, m)` of Stacks 0444,
that is `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.quotientStackOfAction` of Stacks 044Q part (2).
declarations.statement:
def quotientStackTorsorEquivalence :
    {e : StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver
        (Stack.quotientStackOfAction ⟨B, hB⟩ G.obj.X X G.property hX).p
        (TorsorWithMap.projection hB G X) //
      ∃ α : Stack.pointwiseToQuotientStack
            (groupoidOfAction ⟨B, hB⟩ G.obj.X X G.property hX).groupoid ⋙ e.hom.functor ≅
          actionPointwiseComparison hB G X hX,
        ∀ A : (actionPointwiseCategory hB G X hX).obj,
          (TorsorWithMap.projection hB G X).IsHomLift (𝟙 A.base) (α.hom.app A)}
declarations.comment: the canonical equivalence [X/G] ≌ [[X/G]] over the big fppf site, whose forward functor extends the explicit pointwise comparison F_p

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.picardBasedCategory_isStackInGroupoids
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04WN.**  In Situation 0D25, the functor `p : Picardstack_{X/B} ⟶ (Sch/S)_fppf` of
Section 0372, sending `(U, b, L)` to `U`, is a stack in groupoids over the big fppf site of `S`:
it is fibred in groupoids, its `Isom` presheaves are sheaves, and every descent datum relative to
an fppf covering is effective.

The statement is made for `p` itself rather than for the cutdown of Stacks 03ZZ, the objects of
`Picardstack_{X/B}` forming a type.

This is the sole 04WN registration.  The former conditional sibling
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.picardProjection_isFiberedInGroupoids`, condition (1) only, is an
unregistered step of this proof, entering through
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.picardBasedCategory_isFiberedInGroupoids`.
declarations.statement:
theorem picardBasedCategory_isStackInGroupoids (s : PicardSituation B S hS) :
    Functor.IsStackInGroupoids.{w} (picardBasedCategory (modulePushforwardCoherence B S hS) s).p
      (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS)
declarations.comment: the functor Picardstack_{X/B} ⟶ (Sch/S)_fppf of Section 0372, for the category built from the coherence data of 03LU, is a stack in groupoids: all three conditions of Stacks 02ZI, for p itself (stronger than the cutdown of 03ZZ, which follows)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isProper_isStableUnderBaseChange
declarations.doc:
Properness of morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` is stable under base
change.
declarations.statement:
instance isProper_isStableUnderBaseChange :
    MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange
      (fun ⦃F G : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS⦄ (f : F ⟶ G) => IsProper B S hS f.hom)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Functor.IsFibredOneMorphism.full_and_faithful_iff_isIso_morSheafMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04WQ.** Let `F : 𝒳 ⥤ 𝒴` be a 1-morphism of stacks `p : 𝒳 ⥤ 𝒞`, `r : 𝒴 ⥤ 𝒞` over a
site `(𝒞, J)`. Then `F` is fully faithful (as a functor between the total categories) if and only
if for every object `U` of `𝒞` and all `x y` in the fibre over `U`, the induced map
`Mor(x, y) ⟶ Mor(F x, F y)` is an isomorphism of sheaves on `𝒞/U`.

(1) ⇒ (2): over `f : V ⟶ U` the map is the action of `F` on morphisms of the fibre over `V`,
conjugated by the comparison isomorphisms between chosen pullbacks, and a fully faithful `F` is
fully faithful on fibres. (2) ⇒ (1): evaluating at the identity of `U` makes `F` fully faithful on
every fibre; a morphism of `𝒳` over `f` factors uniquely as a morphism of the fibre followed by a
strongly cartesian lift of `f`, which `F` preserves, so `F` is full and faithful on the total
categories (`CategoryTheory.Comma.full_of_fiber_full`,
`CategoryTheory.Comma.faithful_of_fiber_faithful`).
declarations.statement:
theorem full_and_faithful_iff_isIso_morSheafMap (hF : p.IsFibredOneMorphism r F)
    (hp : p.IsStack J) (hr : r.IsStack J) :
    (F.Full ∧ F.Faithful) ↔
      ∀ (U : 𝒞) (x y : p.Fiber U), IsIso (hF.morSheafMap hp hr x y)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.pullback_stackification
declarations.doc:
Let `f : 𝒟 ⟶ 𝒞` be the morphism of sites given by a continuous
`u : 𝒞 ⥤ 𝒟` satisfying the hypotheses of Sites 00X6, let `p : 𝒮 ⥤ 𝒞` be a fibred category and let
`G : 𝒮 ⥤ 𝒮'` be its stackification (clauses (1) and (2) of Stacks 02ZN, spelled out as `hmor` and
`hobj`). Let `G' : u_p 𝒮' ⥤ 𝒯` exhibit the stack `q : 𝒯 ⥤ 𝒟` as the stackification of `u_p 𝒮'` —
that is, let `𝒯` be `f⁻¹𝒮'` in the sense of Stacks 04WJ — and let `H : u_p 𝒮 ⥤ 𝒯` be the canonical
functor, pinned down by its restriction `Q ⋙ H = Φ ⋙ Q' ⋙ G'` along the localization functor.
Then `H` exhibits `𝒯` as the stackification of `u_p 𝒮`: `f⁻¹𝒮'` is the stackification of
`u_p 𝒮`.
declarations.statement:
theorem pullback_stackification
    [p.IsFibered] [p'.IsFibered] [HasNonemptyFiniteLimits 𝒞]
    (J : GrothendieckTopology 𝒞) (K : GrothendieckTopology 𝒟) [u.IsContinuous J K]
    (hu : ∀ (J' : Type) [SmallCategory J'] [FinCategory J'] [Nonempty J'],
      Limits.PreservesLimitsOfShape J' u)
    (hGG : p.IsFibredOneMorphism p' G)
    (hmor : ∀ (U : 𝒞) (x y : p.Fiber U),
      Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective (J.over U) (hGG.morPresheafMap x y) ∧
        Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (J.over U) (hGG.morPresheafMap x y))
    (hobj : ∀ (U : 𝒞) (x' : p'.Fiber U), ∃ R ∈ J U, ∀ ⦃U₁ : 𝒞⦄ ⦃d : U₁ ⟶ U⦄, R.arrows d →
      (Functor.fiberFunctorOfCompEq hGG.comp_eq U₁).essImage (Functor.pullbackFiber p' x' d))
    {q : 𝒯 ⥤ 𝒟} (hq : q.IsStack K)
    {G' : Comma.pullbackLocalization p' u ⥤ 𝒯}
    (hG' : haveI : (Comma.pullbackProj p' u).IsFibered := Comma.isFibered_pullbackProj p' u hu
      (Comma.pullbackProj p' u).IsFibredOneMorphism q G')
    (hmor' : haveI : (Comma.pullbackProj p' u).IsFibered := Comma.isFibered_pullbackProj p' u hu
      haveI : q.IsFibered := hq.isFibered
      ∀ (V : 𝒟) (x y : (Comma.pullbackProj p' u).Fiber V),
        Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective (K.over V) (hG'.morPresheafMap x y) ∧
          Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (K.over V) (hG'.morPresheafMap x y))
    (hobj' : haveI : q.IsFibered := hq.isFibered
      ∀ (V : 𝒟) (z : q.Fiber V), ∃ T ∈ K V, ∀ ⦃V₁ : 𝒟⦄ ⦃β : V₁ ⟶ V⦄, T.arrows β →
        (Functor.fiberFunctorOfCompEq hG'.comp_eq V₁).essImage (Functor.pullbackFiber q z β))
    (H : Comma.pullbackLocalization p u ⥤ 𝒯)
    (hH : (Comma.idBaseStronglyCartesian p u).Q ⋙ H =
      commaMapOver u hGG.comp_eq ⋙ (Comma.idBaseStronglyCartesian p' u).Q ⋙ G') :
    haveI : (Comma.pullbackProj p u).IsFibered := Comma.isFibered_pullbackProj p u hu
    haveI : q.IsFibered := hq.isFibered
    ∃ hH' : (Comma.pullbackProj p u).IsFibredOneMorphism q H,
      (∀ (V : 𝒟) (x y : (Comma.pullbackProj p u).Fiber V),
          Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective (K.over V) (hH'.morPresheafMap x y) ∧
            Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (K.over V) (hH'.morPresheafMap x y)) ∧
        ∀ (V : 𝒟) (z : q.Fiber V), ∃ T ∈ K V, ∀ ⦃V₁ : 𝒟⦄ ⦃β : V₁ ⟶ V⦄, T.arrows β →
          (Functor.fiberFunctorOfCompEq hH'.comp_eq V₁).essImage
            (Functor.pullbackFiber q z β)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Comma.equivalenceOverPullbackStackCan
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04WS (1), as data.** Let `u : 𝒞 ⥤ 𝒟` satisfy the assumptions of Sites 00XU —
continuous, cocontinuous, fully faithful, `𝒞` finitely complete and `u` left exact — and let
`f : 𝒟 ⟶ 𝒞` be the associated morphism of sites. Let `𝒮` be a stack over `(𝒞, J)` and let
`G : u_p 𝒮 ⥤ f⁻¹𝒮` exhibit `f⁻¹𝒮` as the stackification of `u_p 𝒮` over `(𝒟, K)` in the sense of
Stacks 02ZN. Then the canonical functor `𝒮 ⟶ f_*f⁻¹𝒮` is an **equivalence of stacks over `𝒞`**:
a quasi-inverse strictly over `𝒞`, together with vertical unit and counit isomorphisms.

By Stacks 046N it suffices that the canonical functor be fully faithful and that every object of a
fibre of `f_*f⁻¹𝒮` be locally in its essential image on fibres, which are
`CategoryTheory.Comma.fullyFaithful_pullbackStackCan` and
`CategoryTheory.Comma.locallyEssSurjOnFibers_pullbackStackCan`.

The statement is *conditional on being given a stackification*, which Stacks 02ZN supplies once
assembled.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def equivalenceOverPullbackStackCan
    (hobj : ∀ (V : 𝒟) (x' : q.Fiber V), ∃ R ∈ K V, ∀ ⦃W : 𝒟⦄ ⦃g : W ⟶ V⦄, R.arrows g →
      (Functor.fiberFunctorOfCompEq hG.comp_eq W).essImage (Functor.pullbackFiber q x' g)) :
    Functor.IsEquivalenceOver p (StrictPullback.structureFunctor u q)
      (pullbackStackCan p u hG)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Comma.equivalenceFibredMorPullbackStack
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04WS (2), for the pullbacks given by supplied stackifications.** Let `u : 𝒞 ⥤ 𝒟`
satisfy the assumptions of Sites 00XU and let `f : 𝒟 ⟶ 𝒞` be the associated morphism of sites.
