theorem hasRelativeProperty_iff_prop_representingMap_of_fppf
    (P : MorphismProperty (AlgebraicSpaces B S hS)) [P.IsStableUnderBaseChange]
    [P.IsLocalAtTarget (Space.Topology.fppf.precoverage.{u, max u t} B S hS)]
    (𝒳 𝒴 𝒲 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, u, u + 1, u + 1} (BigFppfOver B S hS))
    (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (g : 𝒲 ⟶ 𝒴) (hf : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS f.hom)
    (hgr : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS g.hom)
    (hg : ∀ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS)
      (yv : BigFppfOver B V.left.1 V.left.2 ⥤ 𝒴.val.obj)
      (_hyv : yv ⋙ 𝒴.val.p = Over.map V.hom)
      (F : (BigFppfOver B V.left.1 V.left.2)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
      (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B V.left.1 V.left.2 F),
      Nonempty (StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver
        (TwoFibreProductOver.fst (Over.map V.hom) 𝒲.val.p 𝒴.val.p yv
          (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor g))
        (presheafOfCategories (F ⋙ typeToCat)).p) →
      (let h := (algebraicSpaceMap B S hS V
        ((spacesOverSmallerBaseFunctor B V.left.1 S V.left.2 hS V.hom).obj ⟨F, hF⟩)).hom
       Space.IsSurjective B S hS h ∧ Space.IsFlat B S hS h ∧
         Space.IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS h))
    (Q : Bicategory.TwoCommSq g f) (hQ : Bicategory.IsTwoFibreProduct Q)
    (V W : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hV : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS V) (hW : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS W)
    (eV : StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver
      Q.pt.val.p (presheafOfCategories (V ⋙ typeToCat)).p)
    (eW : StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver
      𝒲.val.p (presheafOfCategories (W ⋙ typeToCat)).p) :
    HasRelativeProperty.{u, u, u + 1, max u t} B S hS P f hf ↔
      P (ObjectProperty.homMk (representingMap B S hS Q.pt 𝒲 V W eV eW Q.fst) :
        (⟨V, hV⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS) ⟶ (⟨W, hW⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.points
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04XG.** The points of a category fibred in groupoids, in particular of an
algebraic stack, are the equivalence classes of its field-valued points.
declarations.statement: abbrev points (h𝒳 : 𝒳.p.IsFiberedInGroupoids) : Type (max (u + 1) t)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.exists_point_of_isTwoFibreProduct
declarations.doc:
**Points of a 2-fibre product of categories fibred in groupoids**: a point of `𝒵` and a
point of `𝒳` with the same image in `|𝒴|` lift to a point of any 2-fibre product of
`g : 𝒵 ⟶ 𝒴` and `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_point_of_isTwoFibreProduct
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {𝒵 𝒳 𝒴 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, u, u + 1, u + 1} (BigFppfOver B S hS)}
    {g : 𝒵 ⟶ 𝒴} {f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴}
    (P : Bicategory.TwoCommSq g f) (hP : Bicategory.IsTwoFibreProduct P)
    (z : points B S hS 𝒵.val 𝒵.property) (x : points B S hS 𝒳.val 𝒳.property)
    (h : pointsMap B S hS 𝒵.val 𝒵.property 𝒴.property g.hom z =
      pointsMap B S hS 𝒳.val 𝒳.property 𝒴.property f.hom x) :
    ∃ p : points B S hS P.pt.val P.pt.property,
      pointsMap B S hS P.pt.val P.pt.property 𝒵.property P.fst.hom p = z ∧
        pointsMap B S hS P.pt.val P.pt.property 𝒳.property P.snd.hom p = x
declarations.comment: for a 2-fibre product of categories fibred in groupoids

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.exists_point_of_isTwoFibreProduct_algebraicStacks
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04XH.** Let `g : 𝒵 ⟶ 𝒴` and `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` be 1-morphisms of algebraic stacks over
`S` and let `P` be a 2-fibre product of that cospan in the 2-category of algebraic stacks. A
point of `𝒵` and a point of `𝒳` with the same image in `|𝒴|` lift to a point of `P`; that is,
the canonical map `|P| ⟶ |𝒵| ×_{|𝒴|} |𝒳|` is surjective.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_point_of_isTwoFibreProduct_algebraicStacks
    {𝒵 𝒳 𝒴 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS} {g : 𝒵 ⟶ 𝒴} {f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴}
    (P : Bicategory.TwoCommSq g f) (hP : Bicategory.IsTwoFibreProduct P)
    (z : points B S hS 𝒵.val.val (Classical.choose 𝒵.property))
    (x : points B S hS 𝒳.val.val (Classical.choose 𝒳.property))
    (h : pointsMap B S hS 𝒵.val.val (Classical.choose 𝒵.property)
          (Classical.choose 𝒴.property) g.hom.hom z =
        pointsMap B S hS 𝒳.val.val (Classical.choose 𝒳.property)
          (Classical.choose 𝒴.property) f.hom.hom x) :
    ∃ p : points B S hS P.pt.val.val (Classical.choose P.pt.property),
      pointsMap B S hS P.pt.val.val (Classical.choose P.pt.property)
          (Classical.choose 𝒵.property) P.fst.hom.hom p = z ∧
        pointsMap B S hS P.pt.val.val (Classical.choose P.pt.property)
          (Classical.choose 𝒳.property) P.snd.hom.hom p = x

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.exists_point_of_isTwoFibreProduct
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04XH** for a 2-fibre product in the 2-category of algebraic stacks: a point of `𝒵`
and a point of `𝒳` with the same image in `|𝒴|` lift to a point of any 2-fibre product of
`g : 𝒵 ⟶ 𝒴` and `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴`.

This is the same proposition as
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.exists_point_of_isTwoFibreProduct_algebraicStacks`, which writes the
points and the maps on points in longhand instead of through the abbreviations
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.points` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.pointsMap`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_point_of_isTwoFibreProduct {g : 𝒵 ⟶ 𝒴} {f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴}
    (P : Bicategory.TwoCommSq g f) (hP : Bicategory.IsTwoFibreProduct P)
    (z : points B S hS 𝒵) (x : points B S hS 𝒳)
    (h : pointsMap B S hS g z = pointsMap B S hS f x) :
    ∃ p : points B S hS P.pt,
      pointsMap B S hS P.fst p = z ∧ pointsMap B S hS P.snd p = x

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.pointsMap_surjective_iff_isRelativelySurjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04XI.** A 1-morphism of algebraic stacks over `S` which is representable by
algebraic spaces is surjective — the relative property of Stacks 03YK at surjectivity of
morphisms of algebraic spaces — exactly when the map it induces on points is surjective.
declarations.statement:
theorem pointsMap_surjective_iff_isRelativelySurjective
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {𝒳 𝒴 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS}
    (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hf : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS f.hom.hom) :
    Function.Surjective
        (pointsMap B S hS 𝒳.val.val (Classical.choose 𝒳.property)
          (Classical.choose 𝒴.property) f.hom.hom) ↔
      HasRelativeProperty B S hS (Space.surjectiveMorphismProperty B S hS) f.hom hf

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.GroupoidPresentation.range_pointsMap_source_target
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04XJ, the equivalence relation.** Let `𝒳 = [U/R]` be a presentation of a category
`𝒳` over the big fppf site of `S` which is fibred in groupoids. Then the image of
`|R| ⟶ |U| × |U|` is an equivalence relation on `|U|`, namely the kernel of the map
`|p| : |U| ⟶ |𝒳|` induced by the presenting 1-morphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem range_pointsMap_source_target (P : GroupoidPresentation B S hS 𝒳)
    (h𝒳 : 𝒳.p.IsFiberedInGroupoids) :
    Set.range (fun r : arrowSpacePoints P.groupoid ↦
        (sourcePointsMap P.groupoid r, targetPointsMap P.groupoid r)) =
      {q : objectSpacePoints P.groupoid × objectSpacePoints P.groupoid |
        (Setoid.ker (P.presentingPointsMap h𝒳)).r q.1 q.2}
declarations.comment: part 1: the image of |R| → |U| × |U| is an equivalence relation

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.GroupoidPresentation.pointsQuotientEquivOfPresentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04XJ, the quotient.** Let `𝒳 = [U/R]` be a presentation of a category `𝒳` over the
big fppf site of `S` which is fibred in groupoids. Then `|𝒳|` is the quotient of `|U|` by the
equivalence relation of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.GroupoidPresentation.range_pointsMap_source_target`, the image of
`|R| ⟶ |U| × |U|`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def pointsQuotientEquivOfPresentation (P : GroupoidPresentation B S hS 𝒳)
    (h𝒳 : 𝒳.p.IsFiberedInGroupoids) :
    Quotient (Setoid.ker (P.presentingPointsMap h𝒳)) ≃ points B S hS 𝒳 h𝒳
declarations.comment: part 2: |X| is the quotient of |U| by that relation

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.range_prod_pointsMapToSpace_eq
declarations.doc:
**The image of the relation on points.** For a 2-fibre product `R` of a chart
`f : U ⟶ 𝒳` by an algebraic space with itself, the image of `|R| ⟶ |U| × |U|` is exactly the
set of pairs of points of `U` with the same image in `|𝒳|`.
declarations.comment: image of the relation on points

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.equivalence_mem_range_prod_pointsMapToSpace
declarations.doc:
**The relation on points is an equivalence relation.** The image of
`|R| ⟶ |U| × |U|` is the kernel of `|f|`.
declarations.statement:
theorem equivalence_mem_range_prod_pointsMapToSpace
    {F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F)
    {𝒳 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS}
    {p : algebraicSpaceStack.{u, w} B S hS F hF ⟶ 𝒳}
    (P : Bicategory.TwoCommSq p p) (hP : Bicategory.IsTwoFibreProduct P) :
    Equivalence (fun x y : Space.points B S hS F =>
      (x, y) ∈ Set.range (fun r : AlgebraicStacks.points B S hS P.pt =>
        (pointsMapToSpace B S hS hF P.fst r, pointsMapToSpace B S hS hF P.snd r)))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.spacePointsQuotientEquiv
declarations.doc:
**The points of the stack as a quotient.** For a surjective chart
`f : U ⟶ 𝒳` by an algebraic space, `|𝒳|` is the quotient of `|U|` by the kernel of `|f|`,
which is the image of `|R| ⟶ |U| × |U|` by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.range_prod_pointsMapToSpace_eq`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def spacePointsQuotientEquiv
    {F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F)
    {𝒳 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS}
    (p : algebraicSpaceStack.{u, w} B S hS F hF ⟶ 𝒳) (hsurj : IsSurjective B S hS p) :
    Quotient (Setoid.ker (spacePointMap B S hS F 𝒳.val p.hom.hom)) ≃
      AlgebraicStacks.points B S hS 𝒳
declarations.comment: the points of the stack as a quotient

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.spacePointMap_class
declarations.doc:
The chosen quotient representative in `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.spacePointMap` has the same
image as any field-valued representative of the point.
declarations.statement:
theorem spacePointMap_class (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (𝒳 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, u, u + 1, u + 1} (BigFppfOver B S hS))
    (f : (fibredCategory B S hS F).val ⥤ᵇ 𝒳.val)
    (p : Space.FieldValuedPoint B S hS F) :
    spacePointMap B S hS F 𝒳 f (p.class B S hS F) =
      pointClass B S hS 𝒳.val 𝒳.property
        (fieldValuedPointMap B S hS (fibredCategory B S hS F).val f
          (spaceFieldValuedPoint B S hS F p))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.existsUnique_pointTopologyFamily
declarations.doc:
There is a unique family of topologies on the points of the algebraic stacks over `S` which
makes every 1-morphism continuous on points and makes a 1-morphism from an algebraic space whose
represented base changes are all flat and locally of finite presentation continuous and open on
points.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_pointTopologyFamily :
    ∃! _t : PointTopologyFamily.{u, w} B S hS, True

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isLocallyOfFiniteType_isomPresheaf
declarations.doc:
Let `𝒳` be an algebraic stack over `S`, let `T` be an object of the big fppf site of `S` and
let `x`, `y` be two objects of the fibre of `𝒳` over `T`. Then the structural morphism of the
isomorphism sheaf `Isom(x, y)`, read over `T`, is locally of finite type.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyOfFiniteType_isomPresheaf
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (𝒳 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, u, u + 1, u + 1} (BigFppfOver B S hS))
    (h𝒳 : IsAlgebraicStack.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳.val)
    (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) :
    letI : 𝒳.val.p.IsFibered := 𝒳.isFiberedInGroupoids.isFibered
    ∀ x y : 𝒳.val.p.Fiber T,
      Space.IsLocallyOfFiniteType B T.left.1 T.left.2
        (terminal.from ((Over.iteratedSliceBackward T).op ⋙ 𝒳.val.p.isomPresheaf x y))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isLocallyOfFiniteType_relativeDiagonal_of_isAlgebraicStack
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04XS, part (2).** The relative diagonal of a 1-morphism `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` of algebraic
stacks over the big fppf site of `S` is locally of finite type: it is representable by algebraic
spaces, and every algebraic space representing one of its base changes along a scheme-valued
point of `𝒳 ×_{f, 𝒴, f} 𝒳` has locally-of-finite-type structural morphism — the
every-étale-chart form of part (1) of Stacks 03XF.

No hypothesis is placed on `f`; part (2) of Stacks 04YQ is the same statement for a 1-morphism
representable by algebraic spaces.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyOfFiniteType_relativeDiagonal_of_isAlgebraicStack
    {𝒳 𝒴 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, t} B S hS} (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) :
    ∃ _hΔ : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS
        (relativeDiagonalBasedFunctor B S hS 𝒳.val 𝒴.val f.hom.hom),
      ∀ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS)
        (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤
          (twoFibreProduct B S hS 𝒴.val 𝒳.val 𝒳.val f.hom.hom f.hom.hom).val.obj)
        (_hy : y ⋙ (twoFibreProduct B S hS 𝒴.val 𝒳.val 𝒳.val f.hom.hom f.hom.hom).val.p
          = Over.map U.hom)
        (F : (BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
        (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B U.left.1 U.left.2 F),
        Nonempty (StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver
          (TwoFibreProductOver.fst (Over.map U.hom) 𝒳.val.val.p
            (twoFibreProduct B S hS 𝒴.val 𝒳.val 𝒳.val f.hom.hom f.hom.hom).val.p y
            (relativeDiagonalBasedFunctor B S hS 𝒳.val 𝒴.val f.hom.hom).toFunctor)
          (presheafOfCategories (F ⋙ typeToCat)).p) →
        Space.IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS (algebraicSpaceMap B S hS U
          ((spacesOverSmallerBaseFunctor B U.left.1 S U.left.2 hS U.hom).obj ⟨F, hF⟩)).hom

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_relativeDiagonal_of_isAlgebraicStack
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04XS, part (1).** The relative diagonal `Δ_f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒳 ×_{f, 𝒴, f} 𝒳` of a
1-morphism `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` of algebraic stacks over the big fppf site of `S` is representable by
algebraic spaces.

Only the representability of the absolute diagonals of `𝒳` and of `𝒴` — the second clause of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.IsAlgebraicStack` — is used, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_relativeDiagonal`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_relativeDiagonal_of_isAlgebraicStack
    (𝒳 𝒴 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, max u v, u + 1, max (max (u + 1) w) v}
      (BigFppfOver B S hS))
    (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (h𝒳 : IsAlgebraicStack.{u, t} B S hS 𝒳.val)
    (h𝒴 : IsAlgebraicStack.{u, t} B S hS 𝒴.val) :
    IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS
      (relativeDiagonalBasedFunctor B S hS 𝒳 𝒴 f.hom)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.closedImmersion_conditions_tfae
declarations.doc:
The six equivalent characterizations of a proper monomorphism, hence of a closed immersion,
in parts (2) through (7).
declarations.statement:
public theorem closedImmersion_conditions_tfae {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) :
    List.TFAE
      [ IsProper f ∧ Mono f,
        IsProper f ∧ (Unramified f ∧ UniversallyInjective f),
        UniversallyClosed f ∧ (Unramified f ∧ Mono f),
        UniversallyClosed f ∧ (Unramified f ∧ UniversallyInjective f),
        UniversallyClosed f ∧ (LocallyOfFiniteType f ∧ Mono f),
        UniversallyClosed f ∧
          (UniversallyInjective f ∧ (LocallyOfFiniteType f ∧ FormallyUnramified f)) ]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isQuasiCompact_of_universallyClosed
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04XW.** A universally closed morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is
quasi-compact.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasiCompact_of_universallyClosed
    {F G : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F)
    (hG : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS G) (f : F ⟶ G) (hf : UniversallyClosed B S hS f) :
    IsQuasiCompact B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSmooth_of_isEtale
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04XX.** An étale morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is smooth: an étale
morphism of schemes is smooth.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSmooth_of_isEtale
    {F G : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hG : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS G)
    {f : F ⟶ G} (hf : IsEtale B S hS f) :
    IsSmooth B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isProper_comp'
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04XY.** The composite of two proper morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` is
proper: each of the three conjuncts of properness is stable under composition.

Algebraicity of the source is not needed and is not assumed, which is what distinguishes this
from `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isProper_comp`. None of the three conjuncts asks for it:
separatedness is a condition on a relative diagonal, and the quantifiers of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsQuasiCompact` and `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.UniversallyClosed` reach
only the intermediate and final spaces.
declarations.statement:
theorem isProper_comp' (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (hZ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z)
    (hf : IsProper B S hS f) (hg : IsProper B S hS g) :
    IsProper B S hS (f ≫ g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isProper_of_isClosedImmersion
declarations.doc: **Stacks 04XZ.** A closed immersion of algebraic spaces over `S` is proper.
declarations.statement:
theorem isProper_of_isClosedImmersion
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : IsClosedImmersion B S hS f) :
    IsProper B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSeparated_tfae_diagonal
declarations.doc:
For a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` the following are equivalent: it is separated;
its relative diagonal is universally closed; its relative diagonal is proper.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSeparated_tfae_diagonal (f : X ⟶ Y) (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) :
    List.TFAE [IsSeparated B S hS f,
      UniversallyClosed B S hS (pullback.diagonal f),
      IsProper B S hS (pullback.diagonal f)]

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.TwoFibreProductOver.isStackification_stackifyMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04Y1.** Let `(𝒞, J)` be a site, let `f : 𝒳 ⥤ 𝒴` and `g : 𝒵 ⥤ 𝒴` be 1-morphisms of
fibred categories over `𝒞`, and let `i : 𝒳 ⥤ 𝒳'`, `j : 𝒴 ⥤ 𝒴'`, `k : 𝒵 ⥤ 𝒵'` be stackifications
(Stacks 02ZP: the targets are stacks over `(𝒞, J)`, the induced maps `Mor(x, y) ⟶ Mor(i x, i y)` of
presheaves on `𝒞/U` are locally bijective, and every object of the target is locally in the
essential image), and let `f' : 𝒳' ⥤ 𝒴'`, `g' : 𝒵' ⥤ 𝒴'` be 1-morphisms of fibred categories over
`𝒞` 2-commuting with `f` and `g` along `i`, `j`, `k` via vertical 2-isomorphisms `α`, `β`. Then the
stackification of the 2-fibre product is the 2-fibre product of the stackifications: the 2-fibre
product `𝒳' ×_{𝒴'} 𝒵'` is a stack over `(𝒞, J)` — it is a fibred category by Stacks 02XQ — and the
canonical 1-morphism `𝒳 ×_𝒴 𝒵 ⥤ 𝒳' ×_{𝒴'} 𝒵'`,
`CategoryTheory.TwoFibreProductOver.stackifyMap`, is a 1-morphism of fibred categories over `𝒞`
which is a stackification of `𝒳 ×_𝒴 𝒵`, in the same two clauses.
declarations.statement:
theorem isStackification_stackifyMap {J : GrothendieckTopology 𝒞}
    (h𝒳 : p𝒳.IsFibered) (h𝒴 : p𝒴.IsFibered) (h𝒵 : p𝒵.IsFibered)
    (hs𝒳' : p𝒳'.IsStack J) (hs𝒴' : p𝒴'.IsStack J) (hs𝒵' : p𝒵'.IsStack J)
    (hf : p𝒳.IsFibredOneMorphism p𝒴 f) (hg : p𝒵.IsFibredOneMorphism p𝒴 g)
    (hf' : p𝒳'.IsFibredOneMorphism p𝒴' f') (hg' : p𝒵'.IsFibredOneMorphism p𝒴' g')
    (hi : p𝒳.IsFibredOneMorphism p𝒳' i) (hj : p𝒴.IsFibredOneMorphism p𝒴' j)
    (hk : p𝒵.IsFibredOneMorphism p𝒵' k)
    (hmor𝒳 : haveI : p𝒳.IsFibered := h𝒳
      haveI : p𝒳'.IsFibered := hs𝒳'.isFibered
      ∀ (V : 𝒞) (x₁ x₂ : p𝒳.Fiber V),
        Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective (J.over V) (hi.morPresheafMap x₁ x₂) ∧
          Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (J.over V) (hi.morPresheafMap x₁ x₂))
    (hobj𝒳 : ∀ x' : 𝒳', ∃ R ∈ J (p𝒳'.obj x'), ∀ ⦃V : 𝒞⦄ (u : V ⟶ p𝒳'.obj x'), R.arrows u →
      ∃ (x : 𝒳) (φ : i.obj x ⟶ x'), p𝒳'.IsStronglyCartesian u φ)
    (hmor𝒴 : haveI : p𝒴.IsFibered := h𝒴
      haveI : p𝒴'.IsFibered := hs𝒴'.isFibered
      ∀ (V : 𝒞) (y₁ y₂ : p𝒴.Fiber V),
        Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective (J.over V) (hj.morPresheafMap y₁ y₂) ∧
          Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (J.over V) (hj.morPresheafMap y₁ y₂))
    (_hobj𝒴 : ∀ y' : 𝒴', ∃ R ∈ J (p𝒴'.obj y'), ∀ ⦃V : 𝒞⦄ (u : V ⟶ p𝒴'.obj y'), R.arrows u →
      ∃ (y : 𝒴) (φ : j.obj y ⟶ y'), p𝒴'.IsStronglyCartesian u φ)
    (hmor𝒵 : haveI : p𝒵.IsFibered := h𝒵
      haveI : p𝒵'.IsFibered := hs𝒵'.isFibered
      ∀ (V : 𝒞) (z₁ z₂ : p𝒵.Fiber V),
        Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective (J.over V) (hk.morPresheafMap z₁ z₂) ∧
          Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (J.over V) (hk.morPresheafMap z₁ z₂))
    (hobj𝒵 : ∀ z' : 𝒵', ∃ R ∈ J (p𝒵'.obj z'), ∀ ⦃V : 𝒞⦄ (u : V ⟶ p𝒵'.obj z'), R.arrows u →
      ∃ (z : 𝒵) (φ : k.obj z ⟶ z'), p𝒵'.IsStronglyCartesian u φ)
    (α : i ⋙ f' ≅ f ⋙ j) (hα : ∀ x : 𝒳, p𝒴'.IsHomLift (𝟙 (p𝒳.obj x)) (α.hom.app x))
    (β : k ⋙ g' ≅ g ⋙ j) (hβ : ∀ z : 𝒵, p𝒴'.IsHomLift (𝟙 (p𝒵.obj z)) (β.hom.app z)) :
    haveI : p𝒳.IsFibered := h𝒳
    haveI : p𝒴.IsFibered := h𝒴
    haveI : p𝒵.IsFibered := h𝒵
    haveI : p𝒳'.IsFibered := hs𝒳'.isFibered
    haveI : p𝒴'.IsFibered := hs𝒴'.isFibered
    haveI : p𝒵'.IsFibered := hs𝒵'.isFibered
    haveI : (structureFunctor p𝒳 p𝒵 p𝒴 f g).IsFibered :=
      isFibered_structureFunctor p𝒳 p𝒵 p𝒴 f g hf hg
    haveI : (structureFunctor p𝒳' p𝒵' p𝒴' f' g').IsFibered :=
      isFibered_structureFunctor p𝒳' p𝒵' p𝒴' f' g' hf' hg'
    (structureFunctor p𝒳' p𝒵' p𝒴' f' g').IsStack J ∧
      ∃ hH : Functor.IsFibredOneMorphism (structureFunctor p𝒳 p𝒵 p𝒴 f g)
          (structureFunctor p𝒳' p𝒵' p𝒴' f' g') (stackifyMap hi hj hk α hα β hβ),
        (∀ (U : 𝒞) (P Q : (structureFunctor p𝒳 p𝒵 p𝒴 f g).Fiber U),
            Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective (J.over U) (hH.morPresheafMap P Q) ∧
              Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (J.over U) (hH.morPresheafMap P Q)) ∧
          ∀ P' : TwoFibreProductOver p𝒳' p𝒵' p𝒴' f' g', ∃ R ∈ J P'.base,
            ∀ ⦃V : 𝒞⦄ (u : V ⟶ P'.base), R.arrows u →
              ∃ (P : TwoFibreProductOver p𝒳 p𝒵 p𝒴 f g)
                (Φ : (stackifyMap hi hj hk α hα β hβ).obj P ⟶ P'),
                (structureFunctor p𝒳' p𝒵' p𝒴' f' g').IsStronglyCartesian u Φ

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.TwoFibreProductOver.isStackification_of_isStackification
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04Y2.** Let `(𝒞, J)` be a site, let `f : 𝒳 ⥤ 𝒴` and `g : 𝒵 ⥤ 𝒴` be 1-morphisms of
categories fibred in groupoids over `𝒞`, let `i : 𝒳 ⥤ 𝒳'`, `j : 𝒴 ⥤ 𝒴'`, `k : 𝒵 ⥤ 𝒵'` be
stackifications (Stacks 02ZP: the targets are stacks in groupoids, the induced maps
`Mor(x, y) ⟶ Mor(i x, i y)` of presheaves on `𝒞/U` are locally bijective, and every object of the
target is locally in the essential image), and let `f' : 𝒳' ⥤ 𝒴'`, `g' : 𝒵' ⥤ 𝒴'` be 1-morphisms
over `𝒞` 2-commuting with `f` and `g` along `i`, `j`, `k` via vertical 2-isomorphisms `α`, `β`.
Then the stackification of the 2-fibre product is the 2-fibre product of the stackifications: the
2-fibre product `𝒳' ×_{𝒴'} 𝒵'` is a stack over `(𝒞, J)` — a stack in groupoids, being fibred in
groupoids by Stacks 0041 — and every canonical 1-morphism `H : 𝒳 ×_𝒴 𝒵 ⥤ 𝒳' ×_{𝒴'} 𝒵'`, that is
every morphism of the two 2-commutative squares, is a 1-morphism of fibred categories over `𝒞`
which is a stackification of `𝒳 ×_𝒴 𝒵`, in the same two clauses.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isStackification_of_isStackification {J : GrothendieckTopology 𝒞} {p𝒳 : 𝒳 ⥤ 𝒞}
    {p𝒴 : 𝒴 ⥤ 𝒞} {p𝒵 : 𝒵 ⥤ 𝒞} {p𝒳' : 𝒳' ⥤ 𝒞} {p𝒴' : 𝒴' ⥤ 𝒞} {p𝒵' : 𝒵' ⥤ 𝒞}
    (h𝒳 : p𝒳.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (h𝒴 : p𝒴.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (h𝒵 : p𝒵.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (h𝒳' : p𝒳'.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (h𝒴' : p𝒴'.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (h𝒵' : p𝒵'.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (hs𝒳' : p𝒳'.IsStack J) (hs𝒴' : p𝒴'.IsStack J)
    (hs𝒵' : p𝒵'.IsStack J) {f : 𝒳 ⥤ 𝒴} {g : 𝒵 ⥤ 𝒴} (hf : f ⋙ p𝒴 = p𝒳) (hg : g ⋙ p𝒴 = p𝒵)
    {f' : 𝒳' ⥤ 𝒴'} {g' : 𝒵' ⥤ 𝒴'} (hf' : f' ⋙ p𝒴' = p𝒳') (hg' : g' ⋙ p𝒴' = p𝒵') {i : 𝒳 ⥤ 𝒳'}
    {j : 𝒴 ⥤ 𝒴'} {k : 𝒵 ⥤ 𝒵'} (hi : i ⋙ p𝒳' = p𝒳) (hj : j ⋙ p𝒴' = p𝒴) (hk : k ⋙ p𝒵' = p𝒵)
    (hmor𝒳 :
      haveI : p𝒳.IsFibered := h𝒳.isFibered
      haveI : p𝒳'.IsFibered := h𝒳'.isFibered
      ∀ (U : 𝒞) (x₁ x₂ : p𝒳.Fiber U),
        Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective (J.over U)
            ((h𝒳'.isFibredOneMorphism hi).morPresheafMap x₁ x₂) ∧
          Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (J.over U)
            ((h𝒳'.isFibredOneMorphism hi).morPresheafMap x₁ x₂))
    (hobj𝒳 :
      ∀ x' : 𝒳',
        ∃ R ∈ J (p𝒳'.obj x'),
          ∀ ⦃V : 𝒞⦄ (u : V ⟶ p𝒳'.obj x'),
            R u → ∃ (x : 𝒳) (φ : i.obj x ⟶ x'), p𝒳'.IsStronglyCartesian u φ)
    (hmor𝒴 :
      haveI : p𝒴.IsFibered := h𝒴.isFibered
      haveI : p𝒴'.IsFibered := h𝒴'.isFibered
      ∀ (U : 𝒞) (y₁ y₂ : p𝒴.Fiber U),
        Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective (J.over U)
            ((h𝒴'.isFibredOneMorphism hj).morPresheafMap y₁ y₂) ∧
          Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (J.over U)
            ((h𝒴'.isFibredOneMorphism hj).morPresheafMap y₁ y₂))
    (_hobj𝒴 :
      ∀ y' : 𝒴',
        ∃ R ∈ J (p𝒴'.obj y'),
          ∀ ⦃V : 𝒞⦄ (u : V ⟶ p𝒴'.obj y'),
            R u → ∃ (y : 𝒴) (φ : j.obj y ⟶ y'), p𝒴'.IsStronglyCartesian u φ)
    (hmor𝒵 :
      haveI : p𝒵.IsFibered := h𝒵.isFibered
      haveI : p𝒵'.IsFibered := h𝒵'.isFibered
      ∀ (U : 𝒞) (z₁ z₂ : p𝒵.Fiber U),
        Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective (J.over U)
            ((h𝒵'.isFibredOneMorphism hk).morPresheafMap z₁ z₂) ∧
          Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (J.over U)
            ((h𝒵'.isFibredOneMorphism hk).morPresheafMap z₁ z₂))
    (hobj𝒵 :
      ∀ z' : 𝒵',
        ∃ R ∈ J (p𝒵'.obj z'),
          ∀ ⦃V : 𝒞⦄ (u : V ⟶ p𝒵'.obj z'),
            R u → ∃ (z : 𝒵) (φ : k.obj z ⟶ z'), p𝒵'.IsStronglyCartesian u φ)
    (α : i ⋙ f' ≅ f ⋙ j) (hα : ∀ x : 𝒳, p𝒴'.IsHomLift (𝟙 (p𝒳.obj x)) (α.hom.app x))
    (β : k ⋙ g' ≅ g ⋙ j) (hβ : ∀ z : 𝒵, p𝒴'.IsHomLift (𝟙 (p𝒵.obj z)) (β.hom.app z))
    {H : TwoFibreProductOver p𝒳 p𝒵 p𝒴 f g ⥤ TwoFibreProductOver p𝒳' p𝒵' p𝒴' f' g'}
    (γ : H ⋙ fst p𝒳' p𝒵' p𝒴' f' g' ≅ fst p𝒳 p𝒵 p𝒴 f g ⋙ i)
    (hγ : ∀ P : TwoFibreProductOver p𝒳 p𝒵 p𝒴 f g, p𝒳'.IsHomLift (𝟙 P.base) (γ.hom.app P))
    (δ : H ⋙ snd p𝒳' p𝒵' p𝒴' f' g' ≅ snd p𝒳 p𝒵 p𝒴 f g ⋙ k)
    (hδ : ∀ P : TwoFibreProductOver p𝒳 p𝒵 p𝒴 f g, p𝒵'.IsHomLift (𝟙 P.base) (δ.hom.app P))
    (hψ :
      Functor.whiskerLeft H (psi p𝒳' p𝒵' p𝒴' f' g') ≫ Functor.whiskerRight δ.hom g' =
        Functor.whiskerRight γ.hom f' ≫
          Functor.whiskerLeft (fst p𝒳 p𝒵 p𝒴 f g) α.hom ≫
          Functor.whiskerRight (psi p𝒳 p𝒵 p𝒴 f g) j ≫
          Functor.whiskerLeft (snd p𝒳 p𝒵 p𝒴 f g) β.inv) :
    haveI : (structureFunctor p𝒳 p𝒵 p𝒴 f g).IsFibered :=
      (isFiberedInGroupoids p𝒳 p𝒵 p𝒴 f g h𝒳 h𝒵 h𝒴 hf hg).isFibered
    haveI : (structureFunctor p𝒳' p𝒵' p𝒴' f' g').IsFibered :=
      (isFiberedInGroupoids p𝒳' p𝒵' p𝒴' f' g' h𝒳' h𝒵' h𝒴' hf' hg').isFibered
    (structureFunctor p𝒳' p𝒵' p𝒴' f' g').IsStack J ∧
      ∃ hH :
        Functor.IsFibredOneMorphism (structureFunctor p𝒳 p𝒵 p𝒴 f g)
          (structureFunctor p𝒳' p𝒵' p𝒴' f' g') H,
        (∀ (U : 𝒞) (P Q : (structureFunctor p𝒳 p𝒵 p𝒴 f g).Fiber U),
            Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective (J.over U) (hH.morPresheafMap P Q) ∧
              Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (J.over U) (hH.morPresheafMap P Q)) ∧
          ∀ P' : TwoFibreProductOver p𝒳' p𝒵' p𝒴' f' g',
            ∃ R ∈ J P'.base,
              ∀ ⦃V : 𝒞⦄ (u : V ⟶ P'.base),
                R u →
                  ∃ (P : TwoFibreProductOver p𝒳 p𝒵 p𝒴 f g) (φ : H.obj P ⟶ P'),
                    (structureFunctor p𝒳' p𝒵' p𝒴' f' g').IsStronglyCartesian u φ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isFinalTwoCommSq_auxQuotientSquare
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04Y4.** Let `φ : (U, R, s, t, c) ⟶ (U', R', s', t', c')` be a morphism of groupoids in
algebraic spaces over an algebraic space `B` over a scheme `S` of a big fppf site, written
`f : U ⟶ U'` on object spaces, and let `(U'', R'', s'', t'', c'')` be the groupoid in algebraic
spaces over `B` of Section 78.21, with `U'' = U ×_{f, U', t'} R'`, `R'' = R ×_{f ∘ s, U', t'} R'`,
`s''(r, r') = (s(r), r')`, `t''(r, r') = (t(r), c'(f(r), r'))` and
`c''((r₁, r'₁), (r₂, r'₂)) = (c(r₁, r₂), r'₂)`. Then the square

```
[U''/R''] ---[g]---> [U/R]
    |                  |
    |                 [φ]
    v                  v
  𝒮_{U'} ----π'----> [U'/R']
```

— whose horizontal arrow is the 1-morphism `[g]` of Stacks 046Q induced by the projection
`g : (U'', R'', s'', t'', c'') ⟶ (U, R, s, t, c)`, whose vertical arrow on the left is the descent
to `[U''/R'']` of the `R''`-invariant morphism `U'' ⟶ U'`, `(u, r') ↦ s'(r')`, whose vertical
arrow on the right is the 1-morphism `[φ]` of Stacks 046Q, whose lower horizontal arrow is the
canonical projection `π'` of Stacks 044R, and whose filler
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.auxSquareCell` is the arrow `r'` of the evaluated groupoid of `G'` at a
point `(u, r')` of `U''` — **is a 2-fibre product** in the sense of Stacks 003Q in the
2-category of stacks in groupoids over the big fppf site (a final object of the 2-category of
2-commutative diagrams over the cospan, with the uniqueness of the 2-isomorphism of
Stacks 003P (2)), so it identifies `[U''/R'']` with `[U/R] ×_{[φ], [U'/R'], π'} 𝒮_{U'}`. The
legs of the explicit 2-fibre product of the cospan detect 2-cells, and detection passes to every
terminal object of the quotient category of squares.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def isFinalTwoCommSq_auxQuotientSquare (φ : Hom G G') :
    Bicategory.IsFinalTwoCommSq (auxQuotientSquare φ)
declarations.comment: the 2-commutative square of Section 78.21 and the identification of the quotient stack of the auxiliary groupoid with the 2-fibre product of the cospan

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.faithful_homFunctor_tfae
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04Y5.** For a 1-morphism `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` of algebraic stacks over `S` the following are
equivalent:

1. for every object `U` of the big fppf site of `S` the functor `f_U : 𝒳_U ⥤ 𝒴_U` on fibres is
   faithful;
2. the functor `f` is faithful;
3. `f` is representable by algebraic spaces.

The equivalence (1) ⟺ (2) is Stacks 003Z (1),
`CategoryTheory.Functor.IsFiberedInGroupoids.faithful_iff_forall_fiber`; the implication
(3) ⟹ (2) is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.faithful_homFunctor_of_isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces`
and the implication (2) ⟹ (3) is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_of_faithful`.
declarations.statement:
theorem faithful_homFunctor_tfae {𝒳 𝒴 : Stack.AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS} (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) :
    List.TFAE
      [∀ U : BigFppfOver B S hS, (Functor.Fiber.mapOfComp 𝒳.val.val.p 𝒴.val.val.p
          (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom)
          (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor_comp_p f.hom) U).Faithful,
        (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom).Faithful,
        IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS f.hom.hom]
