declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isQuasiCompact_of_universallyOpen_isSurjective
declarations.doc:
Let `g : G' ⟶ G` be a universally open surjective morphism of algebraic spaces over `S`.
If the base change of `f : F ⟶ G` along `g` is quasi-compact, then so is `f`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasiCompact_of_universallyOpen_isSurjective
    {F G G' : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F)
    (hG : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS G) (hG' : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS G') (f : F ⟶ G)
    (g : G' ⟶ G) (hgopen : UniversallyOpen B S hS g) (hgsurj : IsSurjective B S hS g)
    (hf : IsQuasiCompact B S hS (pullback.fst g f)) :
    IsQuasiCompact B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallyNoetherian_of_isLocallyOfFiniteType
declarations.doc:
A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` which is locally of finite type and whose target is
locally Noetherian has locally Noetherian source.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyNoetherian_of_isLocallyOfFiniteType
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f)
    (hN : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS Y (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian T)) :
    HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS X (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian T)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isNoetherian_of_isFinitePresentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04ZL.** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` of finite presentation whose
target is Noetherian has Noetherian source.

Noetherianity of an algebraic space (Stacks 03EA) is quasi-compactness, quasi-separatedness
and local Noetherianity. The first two of the three are exactly Stacks 06G5 applied to the
quasi-compact and quasi-separated target, and local Noetherianity of the source comes from
Stacks 04ZK, the morphism being locally of finite type by Stacks 0464.
declarations.statement:
theorem isNoetherian_of_isFinitePresentation (hZ : B.Contains (⊤_ Scheme.{u})) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hf : IsFinitePresentation B S hS f) (hYnoeth : IsNoetherian B S hS hZ Y) :
    IsNoetherian B S hS hZ X

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.RelativeInertia.π_isEquivalence_iff
declarations.doc:
Let `(𝒞, J)` be a site and let `𝒮` be a stack in groupoids over `𝒞`, written out as a stack
with groupoid fibres. The forgetful 1-morphism `π : I_𝒮 ⥤ 𝒮` of the absolute inertia is an
equivalence if and only if `𝒮` is a stack in setoids.
declarations.statement:
theorem π_isEquivalence_iff (hp : p.IsStack J) (hg : ∀ U, IsGroupoid (p.Fiber U)) :
    (RelativeInertia.π p).IsEquivalence ↔ p.IsStackInSetoids J

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.RelativeInertia.π_comp_neutralSection_eq_id
declarations.doc:
For a stack in setoids the neutral section `x ↦ (x, 𝟙)` is a strict two-sided inverse of `π`,
so `π` is an isomorphism of categories over `𝒞` and in particular an equivalence in the 2-category
of stacks over `𝒞`, not merely an equivalence of categories.
declarations.statement:
theorem π_comp_neutralSection_eq_id (h : p.IsStackInSetoids J) :
    RelativeInertia.π p ⋙ RelativeInertia.neutralSection p = 𝟭 (AbsoluteInertia p)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isTwoFibreProduct_functorialitySquare_of_isPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04ZN.** Let `φ : (U, R, s, t, c) ⟶ (U', R', s', t', c')` be a morphism of groupoids in
algebraic spaces over an algebraic space `B` over a scheme `S` of a big fppf site, and suppose the
square formed by the two **source** maps,

```
R ---f---> R'
|          |
s          s'
v          v
U ---f---> U'
```

is cartesian. Then the square

```
𝒮_U ----π----> [U/R]
 |              |
𝒮_f            [φ]
 v              v
𝒮_{U'} --π'--> [U'/R']
```

of the projections of Stacks 044R, the induced 1-morphism of Stacks 046Q and the 1-morphism of
Stacks 0458 **is a 2-fibre product** in the 2-category of stacks in groupoids over the big fppf
site.

Both halves of the proof consume the cartesian source square and nothing else:
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.functorialityComparison_full` for fullness of the comparison
1-morphism — and faithfulness is free — and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.locallyEssSurjOnFibers_functorialityComparison` for local essential
surjectivity on fibres. The reduction of the 2-fibre product property to those two is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isTwoFibreProduct_functorialitySquare`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def isTwoFibreProduct_functorialitySquare_of_isPullback (φ : Hom G G')
    (hφ : IsPullback φ.toGroupoidHom.mapArrows G.source.hom G'.source.hom
      φ.toGroupoidHom.mapObjects) :
    Bicategory.IsTwoFibreProduct (functorialitySquare φ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isTwoFibreProduct_presentationQuotientMapSquare
declarations.doc:
**The square of a morphism into a presenting groupoid is a 2-fibre product.** Let `𝒳` be an
algebraic stack over `S` presented by a smooth groupoid `(U, R, s, t, c)` (Stacks 04TI), and let
`φ : (U', R', s', t', c') ⟶ (U, R, s, t, c)` be a morphism from a smooth groupoid in algebraic
spaces whose square of source maps

```
R' --φ--> R
|s'       |s
v         v
U' --φ--> U
```

is cartesian. Then the square
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.presentationQuotientMapSquare`

```
𝒮_{U'} ------> [U'/R']
  |               |
  v               v
𝒮_U   ------>     𝒳
```

is a 2-fibre product in the 2-category of algebraic stacks over `S` (Stacks 03YP).
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def isTwoFibreProduct_presentationQuotientMapSquare
    (hφ : IsPullback φ.toGroupoidHom.mapArrows G'.source.hom P.groupoid.source.hom
      φ.toGroupoidHom.mapObjects) :
    Bicategory.IsTwoFibreProduct (presentationQuotientMapSquare B S hS P hG' φ)
declarations.comment: in the 2-category of algebraic stacks, for a morphism into a presenting groupoid

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_iff_isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpace_pt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04ZP.** Let `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` be a 1-morphism of algebraic stacks over `S`, let `𝒲` be
represented by an algebraic space `W` and let `g : 𝒲 ⟶ 𝒴` be surjective, flat and locally of
finite presentation. Then `f` is representable by algebraic spaces if and only if the apex
`W ×_𝒴 𝒳` of a 2-fibre product square over the cospan `(g, f)` is represented by an algebraic
space.

The implication (1) ⟹ (2) is Stacks 0300,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpace_of_isTwoFibreProduct`, which needs none
of the hypotheses on `g`; the converse is
`isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_of_isTwoFibreProduct_of_bootstrap`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_iff_isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpace_pt
    {𝒳 𝒴 : Stack.AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS}
    (𝒲 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, u, u + 1, u + 1} (BigFppfOver B S hS))
    (h𝒲 : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpace B S hS 𝒲)
    (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (g : 𝒲 ⟶ 𝒴.val)
    (hg : ∀ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS)
      (yv : BigFppfOver B V.left.1 V.left.2 ⥤ 𝒴.val.val.obj)
      (_hyv : yv ⋙ 𝒴.val.val.p = Over.map V.hom)
      (F : (BigFppfOver B V.left.1 V.left.2)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
      (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B V.left.1 V.left.2 F),
      Nonempty (StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver
        (TwoFibreProductOver.fst (Over.map V.hom) 𝒲.val.p 𝒴.val.val.p yv
          (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor g))
        (presheafOfCategories (F ⋙ typeToCat)).p) →
      (let h := (algebraicSpaceMap B S hS V
        ((spacesOverSmallerBaseFunctor B V.left.1 S V.left.2 hS V.hom).obj ⟨F, hF⟩)).hom
       Space.IsSurjective B S hS h ∧ Space.IsFlat B S hS h ∧
         Space.IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS h))
    (Q : Bicategory.TwoCommSq g f.hom) (hQ : Bicategory.IsTwoFibreProduct Q) :
    IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS f.hom.hom ↔
      IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpace B S hS Q.pt

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_of_isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpace_pt
declarations.doc:
Let `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` be a 1-morphism of algebraic stacks over `S`, let `g : 𝒲 ⟶ 𝒴` be
surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation with `𝒲` an algebraic space, and suppose a
2-fibre product `𝒲 ×_𝒴 𝒳` of the cospan `(g, f)` is an algebraic space. Then `f` is
representable by algebraic spaces.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_of_isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpace_pt
    {𝒳 𝒴 𝒲 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS} (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (g : 𝒲 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (h𝒲 : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpace B S hS 𝒲.val)
    (hSurj : IsSurjective B S hS g) (hFlat : AlgebraicStacks.IsFlat B S hS g)
    (hLfp : AlgebraicStacks.IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS g)
    (Q : Bicategory.TwoCommSq g f) (hQ : Bicategory.IsTwoFibreProduct Q)
    (hQpt : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpace B S hS Q.pt.val) :
    IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS f.hom.hom

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.SpacesOverStack
declarations.doc:
An object of the 2-category `Spaces/𝒴`: an algebraic stack over `S` together with a
1-morphism to `𝒴` which is representable by algebraic spaces.
declarations.statement:
structure SpacesOverStack
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (𝒴 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.SpacesOverStack.Hom
declarations.doc:
A 1-morphism of `Spaces/𝒴`: a 1-morphism of the source stacks together with a 2-morphism
from the structure morphism of the source to its composite with that of the target.
declarations.statement: structure Hom (F G : SpacesOverStack B S hS 𝒴)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.SpacesOverStack.Hom₂
declarations.doc:
A 2-morphism of `Spaces/𝒴`: a 2-morphism of the underlying 1-morphisms of source stacks,
compatible with the two comparison 2-morphisms.
declarations.statement: structure Hom₂ {F G : SpacesOverStack B S hS 𝒴} (f g : Hom F G)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.SpacesOverStack.instCategoryStruct
declarations.doc: The 1-morphisms of `Spaces/𝒴`, with their identities and composition.
declarations.statement: instance instCategoryStruct : CategoryStruct.{u + 1} (SpacesOverStack B S hS 𝒴)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.SpacesOverStack.instHomCategory
declarations.doc:
The category of 1-morphisms and 2-morphisms of `Spaces/𝒴` between two fixed objects: the
hom-category of its 2-category structure.
declarations.statement: instance instHomCategory (F G : SpacesOverStack B S hS 𝒴) : Category.{u + 1} (F ⟶ G)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.SpacesOverStack.instBicategory
declarations.doc:
The 2-category `Spaces/𝒴` of algebraic spaces over the algebraic stack `𝒴`, with the
objects `SpacesOverStack`, the 1-morphisms `Hom` and the 2-morphisms `Hom₂`.
declarations.statement: instance instBicategory : Bicategory.{u + 1, u + 1} (SpacesOverStack B S hS 𝒴)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.SpacesOverStack.isSetoidCategory_hom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04ZQ.** Every hom-category of `Spaces/𝒴` is a setoid in the sense of Stacks 02XZ:
it is a groupoid and it is thin, so a 1-morphism of `Spaces/𝒴` has no automorphism but the
identity. This is the source's claim that the morphism categories
`Mor_{Spaces/𝒴}((f₁ : 𝒳₁ ⟶ 𝒴), (f₂ : 𝒳₂ ⟶ 𝒴))` are all setoids.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSetoidCategory_hom (F G : SpacesOverStack B S hS 𝒴) :
    IsSetoidCategory (F ⟶ G)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.SpacesOverStack.isoClassCategory
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04ZQ.** Replacing the 1-morphisms of `Spaces/𝒴` by their isomorphism classes gives a
category: the objects are those of `Spaces/𝒴`, a morphism `F ⟶ G` is an isomorphism class of
1-morphisms `F ⟶ G` of the 2-category, and the identities and the composition are induced by
those of the 2-category.

Composition descends because whiskering turns a pair of isomorphic 1-morphisms into isomorphic
composites, and the three category laws hold because the unitors and the associator of
`Spaces/𝒴` become equalities of isomorphism classes.
declarations.statement: def isoClassCategory : Category.{u + 1} (SpacesOverStack B S hS 𝒴)
declarations.comment: the category of isomorphism classes of 1-morphisms

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.IsSurjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04ZS.** A morphism of algebraic stacks is surjective if its map on points is
surjective.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsSurjective {𝒳 𝒴 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS} (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isSurjective_comp
declarations.doc: The composite of two surjective 1-morphisms of algebraic stacks over `S` is surjective.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSurjective_comp (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (g : 𝒴 ⟶ 𝒵)
    (hf : IsSurjective B S hS f) (hg : IsSurjective B S hS g) :
    IsSurjective B S hS (f ≫ g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isSurjective_of_isTwoFibreProduct
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04ZU.** The base change of a surjective 1-morphism of algebraic stacks over `S` is
surjective: in a 2-fibre-product square over the cospan `(g, f)`, if `g` is surjective then so is
the projection to the source of `f`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSurjective_of_isTwoFibreProduct
    {𝒵 𝒳 𝒴 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS} {g : 𝒵 ⟶ 𝒴} {f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴}
    (P : Bicategory.TwoCommSq g f) (hP : Bicategory.IsTwoFibreProduct P)
    (hg : IsSurjective B S hS g) : IsSurjective B S hS P.snd

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.IsMonomorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04ZW.** A 1-morphism of algebraic stacks over `S` is a *monomorphism* when it is
representable by algebraic spaces and every algebraic space representing one of its base changes
along a scheme-valued point of the target has structural morphism a monomorphism of algebraic
spaces over `S`.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.HasRelativeProperty` (**Stacks 03YK**, the Section 04XB notion
the source refers to) at the monomorphisms, written out rather than invoked; see the
implementation notes.
declarations.statement:
abbrev AlgebraicStacks.IsMonomorphism
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {𝒳 𝒴 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS} (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isMonomorphism_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04ZY.** A composite of monomorphisms of algebraic stacks over `S` (**Stacks 04ZW**)
is a monomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isMonomorphism_comp (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (g : 𝒴 ⟶ 𝒵)
    (hf : IsMonomorphism B S hS f) (hg : IsMonomorphism B S hS g) :
    IsMonomorphism B S hS (f ≫ g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.mono_hom_representingMaps_of_full_and_faithful
declarations.doc:
**The implication (2) ⟹ (1) of Stacks 04ZZ.** A fully faithful 1-morphism `j : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` of
categories fibred in groupoids over the big fppf site of `S` is a monomorphism in the sense of
Stacks 04XB: every algebraic space representing a base change of `j` along a scheme-valued point
of `𝒴` has monomorphic structural morphism.

This is the converse of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.full_and_faithful_homFunctor_of_mono_representingMaps`, and it carries
no representability hypothesis.
declarations.statement:
theorem mono_hom_representingMaps_of_full_and_faithful
    {𝒳 𝒴 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, v, u + 1, w} (BigFppfOver B S hS)} (j : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hfull : (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor j).Full)
    (hfaithful : (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor j).Faithful)
    (U : BigFppfOver B S hS)
    (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ 𝒴.val.obj)
    (_hy : y ⋙ 𝒴.val.p = Over.map U.hom)
    (F : (BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B U.left.1 U.left.2 F)
    (he : Nonempty (StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver
      (TwoFibreProductOver.fst (Over.map U.hom) 𝒳.val.p 𝒴.val.p y
        (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor j))
      (presheafOfCategories (F ⋙ typeToCat)).p)) :
    Mono (algebraicSpaceMap B S hS U
      ((spacesOverSmallerBaseFunctor B U.left.1 S U.left.2 hS U.hom).obj ⟨F, hF⟩)).hom
declarations.comment: (2) implies (1), the monomorphism clause for categories fibred in groupoids

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.mono_representingMaps_of_full_and_faithful
declarations.doc:
**The implication (2) ⟹ (1) of Stacks 04ZZ, in the category of algebraic spaces.** This is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.mono_hom_representingMaps_of_full_and_faithful` read in the category of
algebraic spaces over `S`, which is the form the relative properties of Stacks 03YK — and hence
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.IsMonomorphism` — are stated in.
declarations.statement:
theorem mono_representingMaps_of_full_and_faithful
    {𝒳 𝒴 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, v, u + 1, w} (BigFppfOver B S hS)} (j : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hfull : (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor j).Full)
    (hfaithful : (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor j).Faithful)
    (U : BigFppfOver B S hS)
    (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ 𝒴.val.obj)
    (_hy : y ⋙ 𝒴.val.p = Over.map U.hom)
    (F : (BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B U.left.1 U.left.2 F)
    (he : Nonempty (StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver
      (TwoFibreProductOver.fst (Over.map U.hom) 𝒳.val.p 𝒴.val.p y
        (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor j))
      (presheafOfCategories (F ⋙ typeToCat)).p)) :
    Mono (algebraicSpaceMap B S hS U
      ((spacesOverSmallerBaseFunctor B U.left.1 S U.left.2 hS U.hom).obj ⟨F, hF⟩))
declarations.comment: (2) implies (1), the monomorphism clause read in the category of algebraic spaces over S

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isMonomorphism_of_full_and_faithful
declarations.doc:
**The implication (2) ⟹ (1) of Stacks 04ZZ, for a 1-morphism of algebraic stacks.** A fully
faithful 1-morphism `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` of algebraic stacks over `S` is a monomorphism in the sense of
**Stacks 04ZW**.

The representability conjunct of `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.IsMonomorphism` is the
implication (2) ⟹ (3) of Stacks 04Y5,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_of_faithful`;
the monomorphy conjunct is `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.mono_representingMaps_of_full_and_faithful`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isMonomorphism_of_full_and_faithful
    {𝒳 𝒴 : Stack.AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS} (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hfull : (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom).Full)
    (hfaithful : (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom).Faithful) :
    AlgebraicStacks.IsMonomorphism B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isMonomorphism_tfae_of_bootstrap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 04ZZ.** For a 1-morphism `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` of algebraic stacks over `S` the following
are equivalent:

1. `f` is a monomorphism (Stacks 04ZW);
2. `f` is fully faithful;
3. the diagonal `Δ_f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒳 ×_𝒴 𝒳` is an equivalence;
4. there are an algebraic space `W` and a surjective, flat, locally finitely presented
   `W ⟶ 𝒴` such that `V = 𝒳 ×_𝒴 W` is an algebraic space and `V ⟶ W` is a monomorphism.

(1) ⟹ (2) is Stacks 05UK, (2) ⟺ (3) is Stacks 04Z7, (2) ⟹ (1) is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isMonomorphism_of_full_and_faithful` (through
Stacks 04Y5), (1) ⟹ (4) is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.hasMonomorphicFppfSpaceBaseChange_of_isMonomorphism` and
(4) ⟹ (2) is `full_and_faithful_homFunctor_of_hasMonomorphicFppfSpaceBaseChange`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isMonomorphism_tfae_of_bootstrap (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) :
    List.TFAE
      [IsMonomorphism B S hS f,
        (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom).Full ∧
          (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom).Faithful,
        (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor
          (relativeDiagonalAlgebraicStacks B S hS f).hom).IsEquivalence,
        HasMonomorphicFppfSpaceBaseChange B S hS f]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.full_and_faithful_homFunctor_of_isMonomorphism
declarations.doc:
**The implication (1) ⟹ (2) of Stacks 04ZZ: a monomorphism of algebraic stacks is fully
faithful.** A 1-morphism of algebraic stacks over `S` which is a monomorphism in the sense of
**Stacks 04ZW** has fully faithful underlying functor.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.full_and_faithful_homFunctor_of_mono_representingMaps`
(**Stacks 05UK** with Stacks 003Z) read in the 2-category of algebraic stacks of Stacks 03YP. The
representability witness is the first conjunct of Stacks 04ZW, and its second conjunct gives the
monomorphy of each representing structural morphism in the category of algebraic spaces over `S`,
which **Stacks 042M** turns into monomorphy of the underlying morphism of presheaves.
declarations.statement:
theorem full_and_faithful_homFunctor_of_isMonomorphism (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hf : IsMonomorphism B S hS f) :
    (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom).Full ∧
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom).Faithful
declarations.comment: the implication (1) ⟹ (2): a monomorphism of algebraic stacks is fully faithful
